docs.title: Bottom-up first-cut interval table
docs.text: Sort a copied cut list between stick endpoints. An interval with no interior requested cut costs zero; otherwise try every first cut and add the interval length once.

docs.title: Memoized endpoint-index cutting costs

docs.title: Bottom-up first-cut interval table
docs.text: Every valid cutting order has one first interior cut. It charges the full current interval, then leaves independent left/right tasks; minimizing all such choices is necessary and sufficient.

docs.title: Memoized endpoint-index cutting costs
docs.text: The first-cut decomposition is exhaustive and subinterval costs depend only on fixed endpoints, not earlier cuts outside them. Memoization therefore reuses identical tasks without changing the optimum.

Bottom-up first-cut interval table: O(c^3) time; O(c^2) space. Memoized endpoint-index cutting costs: O(c^3) time; O(c^2) space.

c is requested cut count plus two; sorting O(c log c) and the O(c) position copy are included in the larger bounds. Both preserve cuts. Memo depth is at most 101 for the official 100-cut limit. Greedily choosing a cheap immediate cut ignores how it changes future piece lengths.

docs.title: 1. Bottom-up first-cut interval table
docs.text:
Time: O(c^3)

Space: O(c^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bottom-up first-cut interval table
    Time: O(c^3)
    Space: O(c^2)
    """

    def minCost(self, n: int, cuts: list[int]) -> int:
        positions = [0, *sorted(cuts), n]
        size = len(positions)
        dp = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        for distance in range(2, size):
            for left in range(size - distance):
                right = left + distance
                dp[left][right] = (
                    positions[right]
                    - positions[left]
                    + min(dp[left][cut] + dp[cut][right] for cut in range(left + 1, right))
                )
        return dp[0][-1]

docs.title: 2. Memoized endpoint-index cutting costs
docs.text:
Time: O(c^3)

Space: O(c^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized endpoint-index cutting costs
    Time: O(c^3)
    Space: O(c^2)
    """

    def minCost(self, n: int, cuts: list[int]) -> int:
        from functools import cache

        positions = [0, *sorted(cuts), n]

        @cache
        def cost(left, right):
            if right - left <= 1:
                return 0
            return (
                positions[right]
                - positions[left]
                + min(cost(left, cut) + cost(cut, right) for cut in range(left + 1, right))
            )

        return cost(0, len(positions) - 1)

docs.title: Positive and negative suffix lengths

class Solution:
    """Approach: Positive and negative suffix lengths
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def getMaxLen(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        positive = negative = answer = 0
        for value in nums:
            if value > 0:
                positive += 1
                negative = negative + 1 if negative else 0
            elif value < 0:
                positive, negative = (negative + 1 if negative else 0), positive + 1
            else:
                positive = negative = 0
            answer = max(answer, positive)
        return answer

Time: O(n)

Space: O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Zero-separated parity runs
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def getMaxLen(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        start = 0
        first_negative = -1
        negatives = answer = 0
        for index, value in enumerate(nums):
            if value == 0:
                start, first_negative, negatives = index + 1, -1, 0
                continue
            if value < 0:
                negatives += 1
                if first_negative < 0:
                    first_negative = index
            if negatives % 2 == 0:
                answer = max(answer, index - start + 1)
            else:
                answer = max(answer, index - first_negative)
        return answer

Read each approach's limits and mutation notes below. Educational baselines may exceed a required complexity bound; the default is the first implementation.

docs.title: Shared-first twin union-find forests
docs.text: Build a maximal shared forest, clone its union-find state for each player, and add only private edges that join distinct components. Reject if either resulting graph stays disconnected.

docs.title: Shared-component contraction and graph connectivity
docs.text: Flood-fill shared edges into components. Build a component graph of private edges for each player and test connectivity, then count the necessary shared and private spanning-forest edges.

docs.title: Shared-first twin union-find forests
docs.text: A shared forest with c components uses n-c edges and benefits both players. Each player needs at least c-1 additional private edges. Successful unions attain these lower bounds, so the number retained is minimum.

docs.title: Shared-component contraction and graph connectivity

docs.title: 1. Shared-first twin union-find forests
docs.text:
Time: O((V+E)*alpha(V))

Space: O(V)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Shared-first twin union-find forests
    Time: O((V+E)*alpha(V))
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def maxNumEdgesToRemove(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        def find(parent, node):
            while parent[node] != node:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        def union(parent, size, a, b):
            a, b = find(parent, a), find(parent, b)
            if a == b:
                return False
            if size[a] < size[b]:
                a, b = b, a
            parent[b] = a
            size[a] += size[b]
            return True

        shared, sizes = list(range(n)), [1] * n
        used = 0
        for kind, a, b in edges:
            if kind == 3:
                used += union(shared, sizes, a - 1, b - 1)
        for kind in (1, 2):
            parent, size = shared.copy(), sizes.copy()
            for edge_type, a, b in edges:
                if edge_type == kind:
                    used += union(parent, size, a - 1, b - 1)
            if any(find(parent, node) != find(parent, 0) for node in range(n)):
                return -1
        return len(edges) - used

docs.title: 2. Shared-component contraction and graph connectivity
docs.text:
Time: O(V+E)

Space: O(V+E)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Shared-component contraction and graph connectivity
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def maxNumEdgesToRemove(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        shared = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for kind, a, b in edges:
            if kind == 3:
                shared[a - 1].append(b - 1)
                shared[b - 1].append(a - 1)
        component = [-1] * n
        count = 0
        for start in range(n):
            if component[start] >= 0:
                continue
            component[start] = count
            stack = [start]
            while stack:
                node = stack.pop()
                for other in shared[node]:
                    if component[other] < 0:
                        component[other] = count
                        stack.append(other)
            count += 1
        for kind in (1, 2):
            graph = [[] for _ in range(count)]
            for edge_type, a, b in edges:
                if edge_type == kind:
                    x, y = component[a - 1], component[b - 1]
                    graph[x].append(y)
                    graph[y].append(x)
            seen, stack = {0}, [0]
            while stack:
                node = stack.pop()
                for other in graph[node]:
                    if other not in seen:
                        seen.add(other)
                        stack.append(other)
            if len(seen) != count:
                return -1
        return len(edges) - ((n - count) + 2 * (count - 1))

Space: O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dense Prim with on-demand distances
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minCostConnectPoints(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(points)
        distance, used = [float("inf")] * n, [False] * n
        distance[0] = 0
        total = 0
        for _ in range(n):
            node = min((i for i in range(n) if not used[i]), key=lambda i: distance[i])
            total += distance[node]
            used[node] = True
            x, y = points[node]
            for other, (ox, oy) in enumerate(points):
                if not used[other]:
                    distance[other] = min(distance[other], abs(x - ox) + abs(y - oy))
        return total

docs.title: 2. All-edge Kruskal
docs.text:
Time: O(n^2 log n)

Space: O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: All-edge Kruskal
    Time: O(n^2 log n)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def minCostConnectPoints(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        edges = sorted(
            (abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1]), i, j)
            for i, a in enumerate(points)
            for j, b in enumerate(points)
            if i < j
        )
        parent, size = list(range(len(points))), [1] * len(points)

        def find(node):
            while parent[node] != node:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        total, remaining = 0, len(points) - 1
        for cost, a, b in edges:
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra == rb:
                continue
            if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                ra, rb = rb, ra
            parent[rb] = ra
            size[ra] += size[rb]
            total += cost
            remaining -= 1
            if remaining == 0:
                break
        return total

docs.title: 1. Latest index per prefix remainder
docs.text:
Time: O(n) expected

Space: O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left


class Solution:
    """Approach: Latest index per prefix remainder
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minSubarray(self, nums: list[int], p: int) -> int:
        required = sum(nums) % p
        if required == 0:
            return 0
        latest = {0: -1}
        remainder = 0
        best = len(nums)
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            remainder = (remainder + value) % p
            wanted = (remainder - required) % p
            if wanted in latest:
                best = min(best, i - latest[wanted])
            latest[remainder] = i
        return best if best < len(nums) else -1

docs.title: 2. Batch prefix positions and predecessor search
docs.text:
Time: O(n log n)

Space: O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left


class Solution:
    """Approach: Batch prefix positions and predecessor search
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minSubarray(self, nums: list[int], p: int) -> int:
        required = sum(nums) % p
        if required == 0:
            return 0
        prefix = [0]
        positions = {0: [0]}
        for i, value in enumerate(nums, 1):
            prefix.append((prefix[-1] + value) % p)
            positions.setdefault(prefix[-1], []).append(i)
        best = len(nums)
        for end in range(1, len(prefix)):
            candidates = positions.get((prefix[end] - required) % p, [])
            index = bisect_left(candidates, end) - 1
            if index >= 0:
                best = min(best, end - candidates[index])
        return best if best < len(nums) else -1

docs.title: 1. Minimax Dijkstra
docs.text:
Time: O(RC log(RC))

Space: O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Minimax Dijkstra
    Time: O(R*C log(R*C))
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def minimumEffortPath(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from heapq import heappop, heappush

        rows, columns = len(heights), len(heights[0])
        best = {(0, 0): 0}
        heap = [(0, 0, 0)]
        while heap:
            effort, r, c = heappop(heap)
            if best[(r, c)] != effort:
                continue
            if (r, c) == (rows - 1, columns - 1):
                return effort
            for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns:
                    candidate = max(effort, abs(heights[r][c] - heights[nr][nc]))
                    if candidate < best.get((nr, nc), float("inf")):
                        best[(nr, nc)] = candidate
                        heappush(heap, (candidate, nr, nc))
        return 0

docs.title: 2. Threshold connectivity by sorted edges
docs.text:
Time: O(RC log(RC))

Space: O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Threshold connectivity by sorted edges
    Time: O(R*C log(R*C))
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def minimumEffortPath(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, columns = len(heights), len(heights[0])
        parent, size = list(range(rows * columns)), [1] * (rows * columns)
        edges = []
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(columns):
                for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c), (r, c + 1)):
                    if nr < rows and nc < columns:
                        edges.append(
                            (
                                abs(heights[r][c] - heights[nr][nc]),
                                r * columns + c,
                                nr * columns + nc,
                            )
                        )

        def find(node):
            while parent[node] != node:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        for cost, a, b in sorted(edges):
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra != rb:
                if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                    ra, rb = rb, ra
                parent[rb] = ra
                size[ra] += size[rb]
            if find(0) == find(rows * columns - 1):
                return cost
        return 0

docs.text: Map each left-prefix sum to its removal count. Enumerate right-suffix sums and look up the remaining amount, accepting only disjoint sides.

docs.title: Longest retained positive-sum window
docs.text: Every valid removal leaves exactly one window of sum total-x, and conversely every such window defines a valid prefix/suffix removal. Maximizing retained length therefore minimizes operations.

docs.title: Removed-prefix map and suffix enumeration
docs.text: Every removal is a unique pair of prefix and suffix lengths whose sums add to x. Positive values make each prefix sum unique; checking all suffixes and enforcing total length at most n covers exactly the valid pairs.

Space: O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Longest retained positive-sum window
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def minOperations(self, nums: list[int], x: int) -> int:
        target = sum(nums) - x
        if target < 0:
            return -1
        left = total = 0
        longest = 0 if target == 0 else -1
        for right, value in enumerate(nums):
            total += value
            while total > target:
                total -= nums[left]
                left += 1
            if total == target:
                longest = max(longest, right - left + 1)
        return -1 if longest < 0 else len(nums) - longest

docs.title: 2. Removed-prefix map and suffix enumeration
docs.text:
Time: O(n) expected

Space: O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Removed-prefix map and suffix enumeration
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minOperations(self, nums: list[int], x: int) -> int:
        prefix = {0: 0}
        total = 0
        for count, value in enumerate(nums, 1):
            total += value
            prefix[total] = count
        best = len(nums) + 1
        suffix = 0
        for right_count in range(len(nums) + 1):
            left_count = prefix.get(x - suffix)
            if left_count is not None and left_count + right_count <= len(nums):
                best = min(best, left_count + right_count)
            if right_count < len(nums):
                suffix += nums[len(nums) - 1 - right_count]
        return -1 if best > len(nums) else best

class Solution:
    """Approach: Accumulate eligible maxima
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def mergeTriplets(self, triplets: list[list[int]], target: list[int]) -> bool:
        best = [0, 0, 0]
        for values in triplets:
            if all(value <= bound for value, bound in zip(values, target, strict=True)):
                for i in range(3):
                    best[i] = max(best[i], values[i])
        return best == target

docs.text:
Time: O(n)

Space: O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Coordinate witness bit mask
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def mergeTriplets(self, triplets: list[list[int]], target: list[int]) -> bool:
        witnessed = 0
        for values in triplets:
            if any(value > target[i] for i, value in enumerate(values)):
                continue
            for i, value in enumerate(values):
                if value == target[i]:
                    witnessed |= 1 << i
        return witnessed == 7

docs.text: For each new prefix mask, add counts of that same earlier mask and its ten one-bit neighbors, then record this prefix.

docs.text: Count all prefix masks first. Equal masks contribute c choose 2; differing one-bit mask groups contribute their frequency product, counted only in one direction.

docs.title: Online parity-mask neighbors
docs.text: The XOR of two prefix masks gives exactly the substring parity mask. Zero or one set bits are precisely the wonderful condition; each earlier prefix defines a distinct substring.

docs.title: Batch mask-pair counting

class Solution:
    """Approach: Online parity-mask neighbors
    Time: O(10n)
    Space: O(2^10)
    """

    def wonderfulSubstrings(self, word: str) -> int:
        counts = [0] * 1024
        counts[0] = 1
        mask = answer = 0
        for char in word:
            mask ^= 1 << (ord(char) - 97)
            answer += counts[mask]
            for bit in range(10):
                answer += counts[mask ^ (1 << bit)]
            counts[mask] += 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. Batch mask-pair counting
docs.text:
Time: O(n+10*2^10)

Space: O(2^10)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Batch mask-pair counting
    Time: O(n+10*2^10)
    Space: O(2^10)
    """

    def wonderfulSubstrings(self, word: str) -> int:
        counts = [0] * 1024
        counts[0] = 1
        mask = 0
        for char in word:
            mask ^= 1 << (ord(char) - 97)
            counts[mask] += 1
        answer = sum(count * (count - 1) // 2 for count in counts)
        for mask, count in enumerate(counts):
            for bit in range(10):
                neighbor = mask ^ (1 << bit)
                if mask < neighbor:
                    answer += count * counts[neighbor]
        return answer

  2. Positive weights orient every shortest-path edge toward a strictly larger source distance.

Approach Time Space Dijkstra distances and tied-route counts O((V+E) log(V+1)) O(V+E) Floyd distances and shortest-path DAG DP O(V^3+V log(V+1)+E) O(V^2+E)

Read each approach's limits and mutation notes below. Educational baselines may exceed a required complexity bound; the default is the first implementation.

docs.title: Dijkstra distances and tied-route counts
docs.text: Track best distances and counts together in heap Dijkstra. A strict improvement copies its predecessor count; an equal-distance relaxation adds that count modulo the modulus.

docs.title: Floyd distances and shortest-path DAG DP
docs.text: Compute all-pairs distances with Floyd-Warshall. Sort vertices by distance from zero and propagate counts only over edges satisfying dist[u]+weight=dist[v].

docs.title: Dijkstra distances and tied-route counts
docs.text: Every shortest route has a final edge from a strictly nearer predecessor. All such predecessors are finalized before the vertex is popped, so their disjoint final-edge route families can be summed exactly.

docs.title: Floyd distances and shortest-path DAG DP
docs.text: Floyd gives exact shortest metrics. Positivity makes the retained edges a DAG ordered by source distance, and its forward path-count DP enumerates exactly all shortest routes.

docs.title: Walkthrough

Equal-distance discoveries must add rather than overwrite. Do not push another heap entry solely for a tie. The dense Floyd alternative is useful at the small vertex limit but substantially slower on sparse graphs.

docs.title: 1. Dijkstra distances and tied-route counts
docs.text:
Time: O((V+E) log(V+1))

Space: O(V+E)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Dijkstra distances and tied-route counts
    Time: O((V+E) log(V+1))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def countPaths(self, n: int, roads: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for left, right, weight in roads:
            adjacency[left].append((right, weight))
            adjacency[right].append((left, weight))
        distances = [float("inf")] * n
        counts = [0] * n
        distances[0], counts[0] = 0, 1
        heap = [(0, 0)]
        while heap:
            distance, node = heappop(heap)
            if distance != distances[node]:
                continue
            for neighbor, weight in adjacency[node]:
                candidate = distance + weight
                if candidate < distances[neighbor]:
                    distances[neighbor] = candidate
                    counts[neighbor] = counts[node]
                    heappush(heap, (candidate, neighbor))
                elif candidate == distances[neighbor]:
                    counts[neighbor] = (counts[neighbor] + counts[node]) % modulus
        return counts[-1]

docs.title: 2. Floyd distances and shortest-path DAG DP
docs.text:
Time: O(V^3+V log(V+1)+E)

Space: O(V^2+E)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Floyd distances and shortest-path DAG DP
    Time: O(V^3+V log(V+1)+E)
    Space: O(V^2+E)
    """

    def countPaths(self, n: int, roads: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        distances = [[float("inf")] * n for _ in range(n)]
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for node in range(n):
            distances[node][node] = 0
        for left, right, weight in roads:
            distances[left][right] = distances[right][left] = weight
            adjacency[left].append((right, weight))
            adjacency[right].append((left, weight))
        for middle in range(n):
            for left in range(n):
                prefix = distances[left][middle]
                for right in range(n):
                    candidate = prefix + distances[middle][right]
                    if candidate < distances[left][right]:
                        distances[left][right] = candidate
        best = distances[0]
        counts = [0] * n
        counts[0] = 1
        for node in sorted(range(n), key=best.__getitem__):
            if best[node] == float("inf"):
                break
            for neighbor, weight in adjacency[node]:
                if best[node] + weight == best[neighbor]:
                    counts[neighbor] = (counts[neighbor] + counts[node]) % modulus
        return counts[-1]

docs.title: Task
docs.text: Find the second distinct arrival time from vertex 1 to vertex n in a connected undirected graph. Each edge takes time units. All signals alternate green/red every change units, starting green; leave immediately on green and wait on red.

docs.title: Hints
docs.text:
1. Because travel times and signals are identical, arrival time depends only on the number of edges walked.
  2. Keep two distinct labels per vertex; equal-time routes do not form a second minimum.
Show approaches, complexity comparison, proofs, and Python solutions

docs.title: Approach comparison
docs.text:
Approach Time Space Two hop distances then signal simulation O(V+E) O(V+E) Two-arrival time-dependent Dijkstra O((V+E) log(V+1)) O(V+E)

Read each approach's limits and mutation notes below. Educational baselines may exceed a required complexity bound; the default is the first implementation.

docs.title: Two hop distances then signal simulation
docs.text: BFS the two smallest distinct edge counts to every vertex. When the second destination count is popped, simulate that many departures, waiting to the next green boundary on red.

docs.title: Two-arrival time-dependent Dijkstra
docs.text: Maintain two distinct arrival labels per vertex in a min-heap. Before traversing an edge, apply its compulsory signal wait, then relax the new arrival. Return the second destination label when popped.

docs.title: Two hop distances then signal simulation
docs.text: All walks of h edges have the same arrival T(h), and T(h+1)>T(h). Thus the second distinct hop count yields the second distinct time. Two-label BFS enumerates the two smallest distances; an undirected backtrack guarantees a second walk.

docs.title: Two-arrival time-dependent Dijkstra
docs.text: Signal waiting is FIFO: arriving later cannot permit an earlier departure. Here the shared timing recurrence also strictly orders realizable hop-count arrivals, so retaining two distinct labels suffices. Heap extraction finalizes those labels in increasing time.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text: For a single edge, time=1 and change=2, the first arrival is 1. The next walk is 1->2->1->2: arrive back at time 2, wait until 4, then reach 2 at time 5.

docs.title: Cost and pitfalls
docs.text: Two hop distances then signal simulation: O(V+E) time; O(V+E) space. Two-arrival time-dependent Dijkstra: O((V+E) log(V+1)) time; O(V+E) space. Inputs are unchanged. Routes may revisit vertices, including the destination. A time exactly divisible by change begins the next signal phase. Wait before departures, never after the final arrival. Equal first-arrival routes still count as one time.

docs.text:
Time: O(V+E)

Space: O(V+E)

from collections import deque
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Two hop distances then signal simulation
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def secondMinimum(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]], time: int, change: int) -> int:
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
        for left, right in edges:
            adjacency[left].append(right)
            adjacency[right].append(left)
        distances = [[float("inf")] * 2 for _ in range(n + 1)]
        distances[1][0] = 0
        queue = deque([(1, 0)])
        while queue:
            node, hops = queue.popleft()
            if node == n and hops == distances[n][1]:
                arrival = 0
                for _ in range(hops):
                    phase = arrival // change
                    if phase % 2:
                        arrival = (phase + 1) * change
                    arrival += time
                return arrival
            for neighbor in adjacency[node]:
                candidate = hops + 1
                if candidate < distances[neighbor][0]:
                    distances[neighbor][1] = distances[neighbor][0]
                    distances[neighbor][0] = candidate
                    queue.append((neighbor, candidate))
                elif distances[neighbor][0] < candidate < distances[neighbor][1]:
                    distances[neighbor][1] = candidate
                    queue.append((neighbor, candidate))
        raise AssertionError("Connected undirected graphs admit a second walk")

docs.title: 2. Two-arrival time-dependent Dijkstra
docs.text:
Time: O((V+E) log(V+1))

Space: O(V+E)

from collections import deque
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Two-arrival time-dependent Dijkstra
    Time: O((V+E) log(V+1))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def secondMinimum(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]], time: int, change: int) -> int:
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
        for left, right in edges:
            adjacency[left].append(right)
            adjacency[right].append(left)
        arrivals = [[float("inf")] * 2 for _ in range(n + 1)]
        arrivals[1][0] = 0
        heap = [(0, 1)]
        while heap:
            arrival, node = heappop(heap)
            if arrival > arrivals[node][1]:
                continue
            if node == n and arrival == arrivals[n][1]:
                return arrival
            phase = arrival // change
            departure = (phase + 1) * change if phase % 2 else arrival
            candidate = departure + time
            for neighbor in adjacency[node]:
                if candidate < arrivals[neighbor][0]:
                    arrivals[neighbor][1] = arrivals[neighbor][0]
                    arrivals[neighbor][0] = candidate
                    heappush(heap, (candidate, neighbor))
                elif arrivals[neighbor][0] < candidate < arrivals[neighbor][1]:
                    arrivals[neighbor][1] = candidate
                    heappush(heap, (candidate, neighbor))
        raise AssertionError("Connected undirected graphs admit a second walk")

docs.title: 1. One rolling window sum
docs.text:
Time: O(n)

Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output

class Solution:
    """Approach: One rolling window sum
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def getAverages(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        width = 2 * k + 1
        answer = [-1] * len(nums)
        if width > len(nums):
            return answer
        total = sum(nums[i] for i in range(width))
        answer[k] = total // width
        for right in range(width, len(nums)):
            total += nums[right] - nums[right - width]
            answer[right - k] = total // width
        return answer

docs.title: 2. Prefix sums per center
docs.text:
Time: O(n)

Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output

class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix sums per center
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def getAverages(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        answer = [-1] * len(nums)
        for center in range(k, len(nums) - k):
            answer[center] = (prefix[center + k + 1] - prefix[center - k]) // (2 * k + 1)
        return answer

    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(1)

    def numberOfBeams(self, bank: list[str]) -> int:
        previous = answer = 0

class Solution:
    """Approach: Filtered device-count sequence
    Time: O(mn)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Shrinking score window
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        left = total = answer = 0
        for right, value in enumerate(nums):
            total += value
            while left <= right and total * (right - left + 1) >= k:
                total -= nums[left]
                left += 1
            answer += right - left + 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. Prefix sums and binary-searched starts
docs.text:
Time: O(n log n)

Space: O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix sums and binary-searched starts
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        answer = 0
        for end in range(1, len(prefix)):
            low, high = 0, end
            while low < high:
                middle = (low + high) // 2
                if (prefix[end] - prefix[middle]) * (end - middle) < k:
                    high = middle
                else:
                    low = middle + 1
            answer += end - low
        return answer

docs.title: Approach comparison
docs.text:
Approach Time Space Implicit frontier and restored min-heap O(log(a+1)) expected amortized pop/addBack; O(1) frontier pop O(a) Finite removed-set complement O(r+1) expected popSmallest; O(1) expected addBack O(r)

Read each approach's limits and mutation notes below. Educational baselines may exceed a required complexity bound; the default is the first implementation.

docs.title: Implicit frontier and restored min-heap
docs.text: Keep a frontier starting at one plus a heap and membership set of restored smaller numbers. Pop the heap first, otherwise consume the frontier. AddBack inserts only removed-frontier-side values not already queued.

docs.title: Finite removed-set complement
docs.text: Store only currently removed integers. To pop, scan positive integers from one until finding one absent from that set; addBack discards its argument from the removed set.

docs.title: Implicit frontier and restored min-heap
docs.text: All values at least the frontier remain present, while all smaller present values are exactly the restoration heap. Its minimum, or the frontier when empty, is therefore the global minimum.

docs.title: Finite removed-set complement
docs.text: The represented infinite set is exactly the complement of the finite removed set among positive integers. The first absent removed-set member is precisely its smallest present number.

docs.title: Walkthrough
docs.text: Pop 1, then 2, restore 1, and pop again: the result is 1. The following pop returns 3 because 2 remains removed.

docs.title: Cost and pitfalls
docs.text: Implicit frontier and restored min-heap: O(log(a+1)) expected amortized pop/addBack; O(1) frontier pop time; O(a) space. Finite removed-set complement: O(r+1) expected popSmallest; O(1) expected addBack time; O(r) space. Objects own finite state; neither approach invents a fixed upper universe bound. a and r are peak stored restored-set and removed-set sizes; Python sets can retain capacity after deletions. Repeated addBack is idempotent. The scan baseline trades simpler representation for repeated prefix scans.

docs.text:
Time: O(log(a+1)) expected amortized pop/addBack; O(1) frontier pop

Space: O(a)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class SmallestInfiniteSet:
    """Approach: Implicit frontier and restored min-heap
    Time: O(log(a+1)) expected amortized pop/addBack; O(1) frontier pop
    Space: O(a)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.frontier = 1
        self.restored = []
        self.queued = set()

    def popSmallest(self) -> int:
        if self.restored:
            value = heappop(self.restored)
            self.queued.remove(value)
            return value
        value = self.frontier
        self.frontier += 1
        return value

    def addBack(self, num: int) -> None:
        if num < self.frontier and num not in self.queued:
            self.queued.add(num)
            heappush(self.restored, num)

docs.title: 2. Finite removed-set complement
docs.text:
Time: O(r+1) expected popSmallest; O(1) expected addBack

Space: O(r)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class SmallestInfiniteSet:
    """Approach: Finite removed-set complement
    Time: O(r+1) expected popSmallest; O(1) expected addBack
    Space: O(r)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.removed = set()

    def popSmallest(self) -> int:
        candidate = 1
        while candidate in self.removed:
            candidate += 1
        self.removed.add(candidate)
        return candidate

    def addBack(self, num: int) -> None:
        self.removed.discard(num)

Approach Time Space Free-room and finish-time heaps O(n+M log(M+1)+M log(n+1)) O(M+n) Linear room-availability scan O(M log(M+1)+M*n) O(M+n)

Read each approach's limits and mutation notes below. Educational baselines may exceed a required complexity bound; the default is the first implementation.

docs.title: Free-room and finish-time heaps
docs.text: Sort a copy of meetings. Release rooms finishing by the next original start into an ID heap. Choose its minimum, or pop the earliest (finish,room) and add the preserved meeting duration.

docs.title: Linear room-availability scan
docs.text: For each sorted meeting, scan room IDs for the first room free at its start. If none is free, choose the minimum (available_time,room) by scanning all rooms.

docs.title: Free-room and finish-time heaps

docs.title: Linear room-availability scan

Meetings are unchanged; sorted copies cost O(M) references. End times are exclusive, so a room finishing at a meeting's start is free. Delaying shifts both endpoints and must not shorten duration. Tied final counts favor the smallest room.

docs.title: 1. Free-room and finish-time heaps
docs.text:
Time: O(n+M log(M+1)+M log(n+1))

Space: O(M+n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Free-room and finish-time heaps
    Time: O(n+M log(M+1)+M log(n+1))
    Space: O(M+n)
    """

    def mostBooked(self, n: int, meetings: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        available = list(range(n))
        heapify(available)
        busy = []
        counts = [0] * n
        for start, end in sorted(meetings):
            while busy and busy[0][0] <= start:
                _, room = heappop(busy)
                heappush(available, room)
            if available:
                room = heappop(available)
                finish = end
            else:
                release, room = heappop(busy)
                finish = release + end - start
            counts[room] += 1
            heappush(busy, (finish, room))
        return counts.index(max(counts))

docs.title: 2. Linear room-availability scan
docs.text:
Time: O(M log(M+1)+M*n)

Space: O(M+n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Linear room-availability scan
    Time: O(M log(M+1)+M*n)
    Space: O(M+n)
    """

    def mostBooked(self, n: int, meetings: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        free_at = [0] * n
        counts = [0] * n
        for start, end in sorted(meetings):
            room = next((index for index in range(n) if free_at[index] <= start), None)
            if room is None:
                room = min(range(n), key=lambda index: (free_at[index], index))
            free_at[room] = max(start, free_at[room]) + end - start
            counts[room] += 1
        return counts.index(max(counts))

docs.title: Latest bound and invalid positions
docs.text: Those inequalities are necessary and sufficient: they exclude every invalid value and include both required bounds. The number of allowed starts is max(0,min(last_min,last_max)-last_bad).

docs.text:
Time: O(n)

Space: O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Latest bound and invalid positions
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], minK: int, maxK: int) -> int:
        last_min = last_max = last_bad = -1
        answer = 0
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            if value < minK or value > maxK:
                last_bad = i
            if value == minK:
                last_min = i
            if value == maxK:
                last_max = i
            answer += max(0, min(last_min, last_max) - last_bad)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. Four bounded-run counts by inclusion-exclusion
docs.text:
Time: O(n)

Space: O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Four bounded-run counts by inclusion-exclusion
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], minK: int, maxK: int) -> int:
        def bounded(low, high):
            run = answer = 0
            for value in nums:
                run = run + 1 if low <= value <= high else 0
                answer += run
            return answer

        return (
            bounded(minK, maxK)
            - bounded(minK + 1, maxK)
            - bounded(minK, maxK - 1)
            + bounded(minK + 1, maxK - 1)
        )

Space: O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Balance matching around the pivot
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        pivot = nums.index(k)
        counts = {0: 1}
        balance = 0
        for i in range(pivot - 1, -1, -1):
            balance += 1 if nums[i] > k else -1
            counts[balance] = counts.get(balance, 0) + 1
        balance = answer = 0
        for i in range(pivot, len(nums)):
            if i > pivot:
                balance += 1 if nums[i] > k else -1
            answer += counts.get(-balance, 0) + counts.get(1 - balance, 0)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. Difference of median-threshold Fenwick counts
docs.text:
Time: O(n log n)

Space: O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Difference of median-threshold Fenwick counts
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        def at_least(threshold):
            size = 2 * len(nums) + 3
            offset = len(nums) + 1
            bit = [0] * size

            def add(index):
                while index < size:
                    bit[index] += 1
                    index += index & -index

            def count(index):
                answer = 0
                while index:
                    answer += bit[index]
                    index -= index & -index
                return answer

            prefix = answer = 0
            add(offset)
            for value in nums:
                prefix += 1 if value >= threshold else -1
                answer += count(prefix + offset - 1)
                add(prefix + offset)
            return answer

        return at_least(k) - at_least(k + 1)

docs.title: Max-heap greedy replacement
docs.text: Heapify negated values. Repeatedly take the maximum reward and replace that heap root with its reduced positive integer ceiling.

docs.title: Frequency-compressed maximum batches
docs.text: Count equal values and heapify distinct maxima. Consume up to the maximum's full multiplicity in one batch, merging its reduced values into their count bucket. At maximum one, every remaining reward is one.

docs.title: Max-heap greedy replacement
docs.text: Each element offers a decreasing reward sequence under repeated division. Taking the largest exposed reward is the standard merge of those decreasing sequences, selecting the globally largest k rewards.

docs.title: Frequency-compressed maximum batches
docs.text: While any copies of maximum v remain, their reward v dominates all other exposed rewards, including their reduced successors. Batching them therefore makes the same greedy choices while reducing heap operations.

The compressed approach helps duplicate-heavy inputs but has the same worst-case bound when all maxima are distinct.

docs.title: 1. Max-heap greedy replacement
docs.text:
Time: O(n+k log(n+1))

Space: O(n)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush, heapreplace


class Solution:
    """Approach: Max-heap greedy replacement
    Time: O(n+k log(n+1))
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxKelements(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        heap = [-value for value in nums]
        heapify(heap)
        score = 0
        for _ in range(k):
            value = -heap[0]
            score += value
            heapreplace(heap, -((value + 2) // 3))
        return score

Space: O(n)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush, heapreplace


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency-compressed maximum batches
    Time: O(n+k log(n+1)) worst
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxKelements(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        counts = Counter(nums)
        heap = [-value for value in counts]
        heapify(heap)
        score = 0
        while k:
            value = -heappop(heap)
            multiplicity = counts.pop(value)
            if value == 1:
                return score + k
            taken = min(k, multiplicity)
            score += taken * value
            k -= taken
            if taken < multiplicity:
                counts[value] = multiplicity - taken
                heappush(heap, -value)
            reduced = (value + 2) // 3
            if reduced not in counts:
                counts[reduced] = 0
                heappush(heap, -reduced)
            counts[reduced] += taken
        return score

docs.title: 頻率​表
docs.text:
​使用​可雜​湊​的​摘要​表示​一組​等​價資料​。​計數​能​保留​重​複​次數​，​集合​不能​。​固定​大小​鍵值​的​雜湊表​操作​平均​為常數​時間​，​但​建立​或雜​湊長​鍵值​也​有​成本​。

from collections import defaultdict


def group_lowercase(words):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for word in words:
        counts = [0] * 26
        for char in word:
            counts[ord(char) - ord("a")] += 1
        groups[tuple(counts)].append(word)
    return list(groups.values())

​不變量​：​每個​桶​恰好​包含​字元​計數​向量​相同​的​單字​。​時間​為​ O(​總字元數​ + 26 × ​單字數​)，​另計​儲存鍵值​及​輸出​的​空間​。

docs.title: 前後綴​聚合
docs.text:
​答案​若​由​某​位置​之前​與​之​後​的​所有​元素​組成​，​可計算​不​包含​該​位置​的​前綴​與後綴​。​結合​運算須​滿足​結合律並​具有​單位​元素​，​不必​有​反運算​。

def exclusive_products(nums):
    out = [1] * len(nums)
    prefix = 1
    for i, value in enumerate(nums):
        out[i] = prefix
        prefix *= value
    suffix = 1
    for i in range(len(nums) - 1, -1, -1):
        out[i] *= suffix
        suffix *= nums[i]
    return out

​不變量​：​先​使用​累積值​，​再​把​目前​元素​合​併​進去​，​確保​排除​自身​。​時間​ O(n)，​輸出​以外​的​輔助​空間​ O(1)。​前後綴​最大值​也​能構​成接​雨水​題​的​ O(n) ​空間​基準​解法​。

docs.title: 雜湊​集合​連續​段
docs.text:
​尋找​連續​整數​段​時​，​只​從​不​存在​前一個​整數​的​位置​開始​，​避免​重​複​掃​描同​一段​長​序列​。

def longest_run(nums):
    values = set(nums)
    best = 0
    for start in values:
        if start - 1 in values:
            continue
        end = start
        while end in values:
            end += 1
        best = max(best, end - start)
    return best

​不變量​：​每個​相異​整數​恰好​屬​於​一次​掃描​。​平均​時間​ O(n)，​空間​ O(n)。​走訪​集合​而​非​原始​陣列​，​避免​重​複​值​造成​重​複​起點​。

docs.title: 雙指標
docs.text:
​利用​排序​一次​排除​一​整列​或​一整​欄​的​配對候​選​。​已​排序​陣列​的​兩數​和​若​小​於​目標​，​便​可​排除​目前​左端​點​。

def sorted_pair(values, target):
    left, right = 0, len(values) - 1
    while left < right:
        total = values[left] + values[right]
        if total == target:
            return left, right
        if total < target:
            left += 1
        else:
            right -= 1
    return None

​不變量​：​所有​可能​答案​仍位​於​兩​指標​之間​。​排序​後​時間​ O(n)、​空間​ O(1)。​固定​一個​錨點​可​延伸​為​ 3Sum，​並略​過重​複​錨點​及​成功​配對​後​的​重​複​端點​。​容器​面積題​移動​較​矮​的​一側​；​接​雨水​題​結算​已知​邊界​最大值​較​小​的​一側​。​每種​移動​規則​都​需要​自己​的​排除​證明​。

docs.title: 滑動視​窗
docs.text:
​對​符合​單調​預算​上限​的​最長​視窗​，​先​擴張​右端​，​再​縮小到​合法​。​對涵​蓋​所有​需求​的​最​短視​窗​，​合法​時持續​縮​小​，​並在​移除​左端​字元前​記錄​候選​。

def longest_unique(text):
    last = {}
    left = best = 0
    for right, char in enumerate(text):
        left = max(left, last.get(char, -1) + 1)
        last[char] = right
        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
    return best

​不變量​：​此​模板​的​視窗​沒​有​重​複​字​元​，​且​左端​永不​後​退​。​平均​時間​ O(n)，​空間​ O(​字元集​大小​)。​固定​長​度​排列​視窗​使用​計數​，​移除​ right-width ​的​元素​。​字元替​換須​滿足​ window_length-max_frequency<=k。​最小​涵蓋區​間須​記錄​次數​，​不能​只檢​查字​元​是否​存在​。​先存​答案​索引​，​最後再​切片​。

docs.title: 單調​雙端​佇列
docs.text:
​移動視​窗​最大值​只​保留值​遞減​的​候選​。​儲存​索引​以判斷​過期​；​更新​且值​不小​的​元素​會​支配​較​舊候​選​。

from collections import deque


def window_maximum(nums, width):
    candidates, out = deque(), []
    for right, value in enumerate(nums):
        while candidates and candidates[0] <= right - width:
            candidates.popleft()
        while candidates and nums[candidates[-1]] <= value:
            candidates.pop()
        candidates.append(right)
        if right >= width - 1:
            out.append(nums[candidates[0]])
    return out

​不變量​：​索引​遞增​、​值​遞減​，​隊首​就是​目前​最大值​。​每個​索引​只​進出​一次​，​總時間​ O(n)，​輔助​空間​ O(width)。​視窗​寬度須​符合​輸入​範圍​。

docs.title: 堆疊
docs.text:
​堆疊​保存​尚未​完成​的​巢狀​或​循序​工作​。​計算後綴​表示​式​時​，​先​取出​右運算元​，​再取​左運算元​。

def evaluate_postfix(tokens, operations):
    stack = []
    for token in tokens:
        if token not in operations:
            stack.append(int(token))
            continue
        right, left = stack.pop(), stack.pop()
        stack.append(operations[token](left, right))
    return stack.pop()


def truncate_division(left, right):
    value = abs(left) // abs(right)
    return -value if (left < 0) != (right < 0) else value

​不變量​：​每個​堆疊​項目​都​是​已​完成​、​等待​被​使用​的​子​表示​式​。​數值​有界時​，​時間​與​空間​皆​為​ O(n)。​呼叫者​需​提供​四則​運算​的​對​應​函式​，​且​題目​排除​除以​零​。MinStack ​可​讓​每個值​攜帶​該​深度​的​最小值​，pop ​時​便​能​還原​之前​的​最小值​。

docs.title: 單調​堆疊
docs.text:
​保留​尚未​得到​答案​且值​非​遞增​的​索引​。​新值​嚴格​較​大時​，​就​能​解決​堆​頂​所有​較小值​。

def next_greater_distances(values):
    waiting = []
    out = [0] * len(values)
    for i, value in enumerate(values):
        while waiting and values[waiting[-1]] < value:
            previous = waiting.pop()
            out[previous] = i - previous
        waiting.append(i)
    return out

​不變量​：​每個​等待​索引​都​尚未​遇到​更大​的​值​。​總時間​攤銷​ O(n)，​空間​ O(n)。​等值​如何​處理​取決​於​題目​要求​嚴格​或非​嚴格​比​較​。​直方圖​最大​矩形​改存​ (​最早​起點​, ​高度​)；​較​矮​柱子​結束​較​高區​段​，​最後加​虛擬​高度​ 0 ​以​結算​剩餘​項目​。

docs.title: 矩陣​模擬
docs.text:
​移動值​之前​先寫​座標​映射​。n×n ​方陣​順時​針旋轉​把​ (row,col) ​映射​為​ (col,n-1-row)，​可用​轉置​後​反轉​每列​實作​。

def rotate_clockwise(matrix):
    size = len(matrix)
    for row in range(size):
        for col in range(row + 1, size):
            matrix[row][col], matrix[col][row] = matrix[col][row], matrix[row][col]
    for row in matrix:
        row.reverse()

​時間​ O(n²)、​輔助​空間​ O(1)，​會​修改​方陣​。​逐層​四點​循環​是​另​一種​原地​寫法​。​螺旋​走訪​維護​四個​邊界​，​每次​取用​前​確認​剩餘列​或​欄​仍​存在​。​生命​遊戲​等​同步​更新​須從​副本​讀取​原狀態​，​或用​不同​位元​編碼​舊​／​新值​，​最後再​轉換​。

docs.title: 二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​選定​一種​邊界​慣例​並持續​維護​。​此半​開區間​搜尋找​第一​個​至少​等​於​ target ​的​值​，​插入​位置​可以​等​於​ len(values)。

def lower_bound(values, target):
    left, right = 0, len(values)
    while left < right:
        middle = (left + right) // 2
        if values[middle] < target:
            left = middle + 1
        else:
            right = middle
    return left

​不變量​：left ​之前​的​值​都​太小​，right ​及​之​後​的​值​都​滿足​條件​。​時間​ O(log n)、​空間​ O(1)。​旋轉​陣列​可辨​認已​排序​的​一半​，​或​比​較​ middle ​與​ right；​簡單​規則​需要​相異值​。​時間​戳​查詢​可用​ bisect_right ​再​減一​。Python bisect ​文件​ ​定義​左右​插入​邊界​，key ​參數​自​ Python 3.10 ​起​提供​。

docs.title: 對​答案​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​答案​是​最小​可行​容量​、​速度​、​門檻​或​時間​時​，​可對​單調​的​可行性​判斷​二分​搜尋​。​起始​上界​必須​可行​。

def first_feasible(low, high, feasible):
    while low < high:
        middle = (low + high) // 2
        if feasible(middle):
            high = middle
        else:
            low = middle + 1
    return low

​不變量​：​第一​個​可行​答案​始終​在​閉區間​ [low,high] ​內​。​時間​ O(​判斷​成本​ × log(​搜尋範圍​+1))，​判斷​函式​以外​空間​ O(1)。​正​整數​的​向上​取整​可用​ (amount+rate-1)//rate。​套用​前​必須​先證明​可行性​的​單​調性​。

docs.title: 二分​分割
docs.text:
​對​兩個​已​排序​陣列​，​在​較​短者​搜尋切點​，​再由合​併​後​左側​的​預定​大小​推得​另​一切​點​。

def median_partition(a, b):
    if len(a) > len(b):
        a, b = b, a
    m, n = len(a), len(b)
    low, high = 0, m
    while low <= high:
        i = (low + high) // 2
        j = (m + n + 1) // 2 - i
        al = a[i - 1] if i else float("-inf")
        ar = a[i] if i < m else float("inf")
        bl = b[j - 1] if j else float("-inf")
        br = b[j] if j < n else float("inf")
        if al <= br and bl <= ar:
            if (m + n) % 2:
                return max(al, bl)
            return (max(al, bl) + min(ar, br)) / 2
        if al > br:
            high = i - 1
        else:
            low = i + 1

​不變量​：​左側​總長​度​固定​；​比較​邊界​以​找到​左側​所有​值不大​於​右側​所有​值​的​切點​。​輸入須​已​排序​，​合​併​長​度須​大​於​零​。​時間​ O(log(min(m,n)+1))，​空間​ O(1)。

docs.title: 自訂​排序
docs.text:
​比較​方式​須對​應輸出​目標​。​拼接​數字應​比​較​ a+b ​與​ b+a，​而​非數值​或長​度​。

from functools import cmp_to_key


def largest_concatenation(values):
    parts = [str(value) for value in values]

    def compare(a, b):
        return (b + a > a + b) - (b + a < a + b)

    parts.sort(key=cmp_to_key(compare))
    return "".join(parts).lstrip("0") or "0"

​不變量​：​沒有​相鄰​一​對​能​靠​交換​拼接​順序​改善​答案​。n ​個​最長​ L ​的​字串​，​比較​排序​ O(n log n × L)，​字串​儲存​及​輸出​ O(nL)。​全零輸​入化​為​單一​ 0。​二維​信封​ LIS ​先​按​寬度​遞增​、​等​寬​高度​遞減​，​再​做​嚴格​ LIS，​避免​等​寬​信封​被​錯誤​嵌套​。

docs.title: 貪心​排序
docs.text:
​證明​目前​選擇​可以​取代​最佳解​的​下​一個​選擇​。​對​不​重疊區​間​，​最早​結束​的​區間​保留​最多後續​空間​。

def maximum_compatible(intervals):
    end = float("-inf")
    kept = 0
    for start, finish in sorted(intervals, key=lambda item: item[1]):
        if start >= end:
            end = finish
            kept += 1
    return kept

​不變量​：​保留​同樣​數量​區間​的​各種​方案​中​，​貪心​方案​的​結束​時間​不會​更​晚​。​時間​ O(n log n)，​排序​空間​ O(n)。​此​排程​版本​允許​端點​接觸​。​車隊題​按​位置​由​前往​後​排序​；​只有​抵達​時間​大​於​前方​車隊​時​才​產生​新車隊​。​距離​／​速度​的​分數​可用​交叉​相乘​比較​。

docs.title: 貪心​可達​範圍
docs.text:
​可達​索引​形成​前綴​時​，​一個​最遠​邊界​即可​摘要​全部​可達​位置​。​最少​跳躍數​可​把​這些​前綴​視為​壓縮​後​的​ BFS ​層​。

def can_reach(nums):
    farthest = 0
    for i, step in enumerate(nums):
        if i > farthest:
            return False
        farthest = max(farthest, i + step)
    return True


def minimum_jumps(nums):  # Destination is guaranteed reachable.
    jumps = boundary = farthest = 0
    for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
        farthest = max(farthest, i + nums[i])
        if i == boundary:
            jumps += 1
            boundary = farthest
    return jumps

​不變量​：​只有​可達​位置​才能​擴張​ reach；​每​完成​一層​便​多​一次​跳躍​。​時間​ O(n)，​空間​ O(1)。​跳躍計數​迴​圈​不​處理​終點​，​避免​額外​多​跳​一次​。

docs.title: 區間
docs.text:
​按​起點​排序​後​，​合​併​區間​時​只​需檢查​輸出​中​的​最後一個​區間​。

def merge_closed(intervals):
    out = []
    for start, end in sorted(intervals):
        if out and start <= out[-1][1]:
            out[-1][1] = max(out[-1][1], end)
        else:
            out.append([start, end])
    return out

​不變量​：​輸出​恰好​覆蓋​已處​理區間​，​且​各項​互不​重疊​。​時間​ O(n log n)，​排序​及輸出​空間​ O(n)。​插入​已​排序​且​不​重疊​的​區間​時​，​分成​完全​在​前​、​重疊​、​完全​在​後​三段​掃描​。​先確​認端點​接觸​是否​算​重疊​。

docs.title: 鏈結​串列
docs.text:
​覆寫​連結前​先​保存​後​繼節點​。​虛擬​前​驅​可​把​刪​除頭​節點​與​建立​空輸​出化​為​一般​連結​操作​。

def reverse(head):
    previous = None
    while head:
        following = head.next
        head.next = previous
        previous, head = head, following
    return previous


def remove_nth(head, n, Node):  # n is valid.
    dummy = Node(0, head)
    slow = fast = dummy
    for _ in range(n):
        fast = fast.next
    while fast.next:
        slow, fast = slow.next, fast.next
    slow.next = slow.next.next
    return dummy.next

​反轉​不​變量​：previous ​是​已​反轉​的​處理​前綴​，head ​是​尚未​處理​的​原始​後​綴​。​間​距​不​變量​：fast ​始終​比​ slow ​領先​ n ​條連結​。​兩者​時間​ O(n)、​輔助​空間​ O(1)，​都​會​修改​連結​。​重排​串列​結合​找​中點​、​切斷​、​反轉​及​交錯合​併​；​數位​加法​則​配置​新節點​並維護​進位​。

docs.title: 物件​複​製
docs.text:
​以​原始​物件​身分​為鍵​，​在​走訪​可能​成環的邊​之前​先​建立​複​本​。​僅有值​相等​不能​代表​同一​物件​。

from collections import deque


def clone_graph(start, make_node):
    if start is None:
        return None
    copies = {start: make_node(start.val)}
    queue = deque([start])
    while queue:
        original = queue.popleft()
        for neighbor in original.neighbors:
            if neighbor not in copies:
                copies[neighbor] = make_node(neighbor.val)
                queue.append(neighbor)
            copies[original].neighbors.append(copies[neighbor])
    return copies[start]

​不變量​：​每個​已​發現​原​物件​恰好​有​一個​複​本​，​複​製​的​邊​始​終​指向​複​本​。​平均​時間​ O(V+E)，​映射​及​佇列​空間​ O(V)，​另加​輸出​。​隨機​指標​串列​可​先​建立​所有​複​本​，​再​透過​映射​連接​ next/random；None ​對應​ None。

docs.title: 雙向​鏈結​串列
docs.text:
​雜湊表​提供​依​身分​查找​，​雙向​鏈結​串列​提供​已知​節點​的​ O(1) ​移除​與​重新​插入​。​頭尾​哨兵​簡化​端點​更新​。

def detach(node):  # A real linked node, not a sentinel.
    node.prev.next = node.next
    node.next.prev = node.prev
    node.prev = node.next = None


def append_before(tail, node):  # node is detached.
    previous = tail.prev
    node.prev, node.next = previous, tail
    previous.next = tail.prev = node

​不變量​：​每對​相鄰​節點​的​前​後​參照​一致​，​每個​有效​映射​項目​恰好​指向​一個​串列​節點​。​每次​移動​ O(1)。LRU ​把​成功​存取​移​到​最新​端​；LFU ​另​按​頻率​分組​，​在​最小​頻率​組內​套用​新舊​順序​。​瀏覽器​歷史​從​舊頁​前往​新頁​時​，​丟棄​原有​前進​分支​。

docs.title: 環狀​緩衝區
docs.text:
​只​儲存​ head ​與​ size，​以​容量​取模​推得​下​一個​插入​位置​，​避免​獨立頭​尾旗標​組合出​矛盾​狀態​。

class RingQueue:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.data = [0] * capacity
        self.head = 0
        self.size = 0

    def enqueue(self, value):
        if self.size == len(self.data):
            return False
        index = (self.head + self.size) % len(self.data)
        self.data[index] = value
        self.size += 1
        return True

    def dequeue(self):
        if self.size == 0:
            return False
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % len(self.data)
        self.size -= 1
        return True

    def front(self):
        return self.data[self.head] if self.size else -1

​不變量​：0<=size<=capacity，​有效​項目​從​ head ​起連續​占據​ size ​個​環狀​位置​。​容量​為​正​，​操作​ O(1)，​空間​ O(capacity)。​空​／​滿由​ size ​決定​，​因此​環狀​索引​相等​不會產生​歧義​。

docs.title: LRU ​快取
docs.text:
​同時​維護​依鍵​查詢​及​可​移動​的​新​舊​順序​。​標準庫​ OrderedDict ​支援​把​既有​鍵​移至​端點​及​移除​最舊​項目​。

from collections import OrderedDict


class Cache:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.data = OrderedDict()

    def get(self, key):
        if key not in self.data:
            return -1
        self.data.move_to_end(key)
        return self.data[key]

    def put(self, key, value):
        self.data[key] = value
        self.data.move_to_end(key)
        if len(self.data) > self.capacity:
            self.data.popitem(last=False)

​不變量​：​迭代​順序​由​最久​未​使用​到​最近​使用​。​操作​平均​ O(1)，​空間​ O(capacity)。​更新​值​也​會​刷新​新舊​順序​，​查詢​失敗則​不會​。​手寫​版本​可用​鍵到​節點​的​字典​，​加頭​尾​哨兵​的​雙向​鏈結​串列​。get/put ​把​節點​摘下​再​插​到​ tail ​前​；​淘汰​時同​時​從​兩種​結構​移除​ head.next。

docs.title: 樹​的​走訪
docs.text:
​中序​走訪​使用​明確​的​祖先​堆疊​。​層序​走訪​使用​佇列​，​每層​開始​前​固定​佇列​大小​。

def inorder(root):
    stack = []
    current = root
    while current or stack:
        while current:
            stack.append(current)
            current = current.left
        current = stack.pop()
        yield current
        current = current.right

​不變量​：​每次​ pop ​都​是​下​一個​中序​節點​。​時間​ O(n)、​堆疊​空間​ O(h)。​嚴格​ BST ​的​中序​序列​嚴格​遞增​；​第​ k ​小可​計算​ pop ​次數​。​層序​ BFS ​時間​ O(n)、​空間​ O(​最大​寬度​)，​每層​最後一個​節點​構成​右側​視圖​。LCA ​可記​錄父​節點​、​收集​其中​一個​目標​的​祖先​，​再​讓​另​一目​標​向上​找到​第一​個​交集​；​比較​物件​身分​。

docs.title: 樹的後序​處理
docs.text:
​先計​算子​節點​，​再​計算父​節點​。​帶有​「​已展​開​」​狀態​的​明確​堆​疊​可​避開​偏斜​樹​的​遞​迴​深度​限制​。

def reduce_tree(root, combine):
    if root is None:
        return None
    values = {}
    stack = [(root, False)]
    while stack:
        node, expanded = stack.pop()
        if expanded:
            values[node] = combine(node.val, values.get(node.left), values.get(node.right))
            continue
        stack.append((node, True))
        if node.right:
            stack.append((node.right, False))
        if node.left:
            stack.append((node.left, False))
    return values[root]

​不變量​：​執行​ combine ​時​，​左右​子樹​的​結果​都​已​存在​。​此​通用​版本​時間​ O(n)，​儲存​結果​的​空間​ O(n)。​最大​路徑​和​的​完整​路徑​可​使用​兩側​收益​，​但​傳給​父節點​的​收益​只能​選一側​。​子​收益​至少​取​ 0，​全域​答案​初值​則必須​低​於​所有​節點值​。

docs.title: 樹​的​建構
docs.text:
​前序​走訪​提供​根節點​；​中序​走訪​指出​左側​子樹何​時​完成​。​此​迭代​重建​要求​節點值​相異且​兩個​走訪​序列​一致​。

def from_preorder_inorder(preorder, inorder, Node):
    values = iter(preorder)
    root = Node(next(values))
    stack = [root]
    index = 0
    for value in values:
        parent = stack[-1]
        child = Node(value)
        if parent.val != inorder[index]:
            parent.left = child
        else:
            while stack and stack[-1].val == inorder[index]:
                parent = stack.pop()
                index += 1
            parent.right = child
        stack.append(child)
    return root

​不變量​：​堆疊​是​尚未​結束​的​祖先​路徑​，index ​指向​下一個​應​結束​的​中序​節點​。​時間​ O(n)、​輔助​堆疊​ O(h)，​新節點​ O(n)。​輸入​非空​。​也​可用​索引​區間​遞​迴​重建​；​但​遞​迴​切片​有​複​製​成本​，Python ​呼叫​深度​也​可能​超限​。

docs.title: 樹​的​序列化
docs.text:
​除了​值​，​也​必須​記錄​樹形​。​這裡​是​含明​確空​節點​標記​的​前序​模板​；​對​應題​解​另​使用​廣度​優先​格式​。

def encode_tree(root):
    stack, tokens = [root], []
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        if node is None:
            tokens.append("#")
            continue
        tokens.append(str(node.val))
        stack.append(node.right)
        stack.append(node.left)
    return ",".join(tokens)


def decode_tree(data, Node):
    tokens = iter(data.split(","))
    first = next(tokens)
    if first == "#":
        return None
    root = Node(int(first))
    slots = [(root, "right"), (root, "left")]
    for token in tokens:
        parent, side = slots.pop()
        child = None if token == "#" else Node(int(token))
        setattr(parent, side, child)
        if child is not None:
            slots.extend([(child, "right"), (child, "left")])
    return root

​不變量​：​下一個​ token ​填入​下一個​前序​子節點​位置​。​編碼​與​解碼​必須​採用​相同​格式​，​解碼​輸入​假設​由​編碼​器產生​。​整數​有界時​，​時間​ O(n)，​輔助​及​編碼​總空間​ O(n)。​空標​記用​來區​分​缺少​左子​節點​與​缺少​右子​節點​。

docs.title: 字典​樹
docs.text:
​一個​節點​代表​一個​前綴​，​並​持有​各字元​的​子邊​。​終止​旗​標區​分​完整​單字​與僅​存在​的​前綴​。

class TrieNode:
    def __init__(self):
        self.children = {}
        self.terminal = False


def insert_word(root, word):
    node = root
    for char in word:
        if char not in node.children:
            node.children[char] = TrieNode()
        node = node.children[char]
    node.terminal = True


def find_prefix(root, prefix):
    node = root
    for char in prefix:
        node = node.children.get(char)
        if node is None:
            return None
    return node

​不變量​：​已​走​過的邊​恰好​拼出​已​消耗​前綴​。​一般​操作​平均​時間​ O(L)，​總儲​存量​以​插入​的​字​元​總數​為​上界​。​精確​搜尋​需要​終止​節點​，startsWith ​只​需節點​存在​。​萬用​點號​可維護候​選前​緣​並展​開​所有​孩子​，​一個點​恰好​消耗​一個​字​元​；​最壞​可能​走訪​整棵​字典​樹​。

docs.title: 堆積
docs.text:
​保留​最好​的​ k ​個候​選​，​並​快速​取得​其中​最差​的​一個​。Python ​的​一般​ heapq ​操作​使用​最小​堆積​；​在​ Python 3.10 ​可用​負優​先值​模擬​最大​堆積​。

from heapq import heapify, heapreplace


def k_largest(values, k):
    heap = values[:k]
    heapify(heap)
    for i in range(k, len(values)):
        if values[i] > heap[0]:
            heapreplace(heap, values[i])
    return heap

​不變量​：​堆積​持有​已處​理值​中​最大​的​ k ​個​，k ​須在​ 1..n ​之間​。​時間​ O(n log(k+1))、​空間​ O(k)；​堆積​並非​完全​排序​。​找​最近​ k ​點​可用​負的​距離​平方​，​讓​最遠​點位​於​根​。k ​路合​併​每個​串流​保留​一個頭​項目​，​取出​後​補入後繼​。​堆積​ tuple ​中​，​不能​排序​的​物件​之前​須放數​字​作為​同值​時​的​比​較鍵​。

docs.title: 頻率​桶
docs.text:
​頻率​為​不​超過​ n ​的​整數​時​，​可依​頻率​分桶​，​不必​排序​所有​值​。

from collections import Counter


def most_frequent(nums, k):
    buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(nums) + 1)]
    for value, frequency in Counter(nums).items():
        buckets[frequency].append(value)
    out = []
    for frequency in range(len(nums), 0, -1):
        out.extend(buckets[frequency])
        if len(out) >= k:
            return out[:k]

​不變量​：​由高到​低​的​桶​索引​代表​非遞​增頻​率​。k ​合法​時​，​平均​時間​及​輔助​空間​均​為​ O(n)。​每個​桶​必須​是​獨立​串列​；​把​包含​一個​空串列​的​串列​相乘​會​讓​各桶​共用​物件​。​截止​頻率​有​同值​時​須確​認題​目規則​，​本題​所選​集合​保證​唯一​。

docs.title: 雙堆​積
docs.text:
​把​串流​分為​較​小​一半​的​最大​堆積​與​較​大​一半​的​最小​堆積​。​前者​大小​等​於​後​者​或​恰好​多一個​。

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class RunningMedian:
    def __init__(self):
        self.lower, self.upper = [], []

    def add(self, value):
        heappush(self.lower, -value)
        heappush(self.upper, -heappop(self.lower))
        if len(self.upper) > len(self.lower):
            heappush(self.lower, -heappop(self.upper))

    def median(self):  # At least one value has been added.
        if len(self.lower) > len(self.upper):
            return -self.lower[0]
        return (-self.lower[0] + self.upper[0]) / 2

​不變量​：​較​小​半部​的​所有​值不大​於​較​大半部​，​且​大小​平衡​。​插入​ O(log n)、​取中​位數​ O(1)、​空間​ O(n)。​讀取​及​移動​負值​表示​的​堆積​元素​時​都​要​還原​符號​。​相等​的​值​可以​出現​在​兩個​堆積​中​。

docs.title: 圖​的​走訪
docs.text:
BFS ​求無權​圖​的​最少​邊數​。​入列​時​就​標記​，​避免​多個​父節​點重​複​把​同一​節點​加入​佇列​。

from collections import deque


def bfs_distances(starts, neighbors):
    distance = {node: 0 for node in starts}
    queue = deque(distance)
    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()
        for child in neighbors(node):
            if child in distance:
                continue
            distance[child] = distance[node] + 1
            queue.append(child)
    return distance

​不變量​：​佇列​以​非遞​減距離​處理​。​明確​儲存​的​圖​時間​ O(V+E)、​走訪​空間​ O(V)。​同時​擴散​的​多個​起點​都​以​距離​ 0 ​入列​。Flood fill ​可數​連通​元件​；​水流​問題​可​反轉​流向​，​從​海岸​邊界​出發​。​隱含​單字​圖要​計入​字串​建立​成本​，​並​清空​已處理​萬​用字​元桶​。DFS ​使用​串列​堆疊​與​相同​發現​規則​，​但​第一次​抵達​不​保證​最​短無權​距離​。

docs.title: 拓樸​排序
docs.text:
Kahn ​演算法​移除​沒有​剩餘​依賴​的​頂點​。prerequisite->course ​的​邊讓​ course ​多一條​入邊​依賴​。

from collections import deque


def topological_order(adjacency):
    degree = [0] * len(adjacency)
    for children in adjacency:
        for child in children:
            degree[child] += 1
    queue = deque(i for i, count in enumerate(degree) if count == 0)
    order = []
    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()
        order.append(node)
        for child in adjacency[node]:
            degree[child] -= 1
            if degree[child] == 0:
                queue.append(child)
    return order if len(order) == len(adjacency) else []

​不變量​：degree ​只計算來​自未​移除​頂點​的​入邊​。​時間​ O(V+E)，​鄰接表​以外​空間​ O(V)。​輸出​頂點​不足​證明​存在​環​，​也​要​初始化​孤立​頂點​。​嚴格遞​增網格​的​邊從​小值​指向​大​值​，​不​可能​成環​；​固定​大小​的​ BFS ​分層數​就是​最長​路​徑長​度​。​重​複​邊必須​一致​地計入​與​扣除​。

docs.title: 並查集​（Union Find）
docs.text:
​無向邊​逐一​加入​時​追​蹤​連​通​元件​。​若​兩端​已有​相同​代表​，​這條邊​便​會​成環​。​可​按​ size（​元件​元素​數​）​或​ rank（​樹高​上界​）​合​併​。​以下​兩​版本​都​使用​迭代​式​路徑​折半​，​兩端​原本​已連​通時​回傳​ False。

class DisjointSet:
    def __init__(self, count):
        self.parent = list(range(count))
        self.size = [1] * count

    def find(self, node):
        while node != self.parent[node]:
            self.parent[node] = self.parent[self.parent[node]]
            node = self.parent[node]
        return node

    def union(self, a, b):
        a, b = self.find(a), self.find(b)
        if a == b:
            return False
        if self.size[a] < self.size[b]:
            a, b = b, a
        self.parent[b] = a
        self.size[a] += self.size[b]
        return True


class DisjointSetByRank:
    def __init__(self, count):
        self.parent = list(range(count))
        self.rank = [0] * count

    def find(self, node):
        while node != self.parent[node]:
            self.parent[node] = self.parent[self.parent[node]]
            node = self.parent[node]
        return node

    def union(self, a, b):
        a, b = self.find(a), self.find(b)
        if a == b:
            return False
        if self.rank[a] < self.rank[b]:
            a, b = b, a
        self.parent[b] = a
        if self.rank[a] == self.rank[b]:
            self.rank[a] += 1
        return True

​不變量​：​每棵​父節​點樹​代表​一個​元件​；​只有​根​的​ size ​有意​義​。​初始化​ O(V)、​空間​ O(V)，​路徑​壓縮​搭配​按​ size ​合​併​，​每次​操作​攤銷​ O(alpha(V))。​搭配​按​ rank ​合​併​具有​相同​界限​。

​低​ rank ​根​接到​高​ rank ​根​；​只有​兩個​不同​根​的​ rank ​相等​時​，​才​增加​存活​根​的​ rank。​重​複​ union ​不得​增加​ rank。​壓縮會​縮​短路​徑​，​因此​ rank ​是​歷史​樹高​上界​，​不是​現在​高度​，​也​不是​元件​大小​。find ​不​降低​ rank。​沒有​壓縮​時​，​僅按​ rank ​合​併​的​ find/union ​最壞​ O(log V)；​壓縮​後​的​界限​是​攤​銷值​，​不​代表​每次​都​為​最壞​常數​時間​。

​例如​ union(0,1) ​讓​根​ 0 ​的​ rank ​變​ 1，union(2,3) ​讓​根​ 2 ​的​ rank ​變​ 1；​再​ union(0,2) ​讓​根​ 0 ​的​ rank ​變​ 2。find(3) ​縮短​到​根​ 0 ​的​路徑​，​但​ rank ​仍為​ 2。​需要​元件​元素​數時​使用​ size，rank ​無法​回答​這個​問題​。​本結構​處理連​通性​，​不處理​有​向環​判定​或​最​短路​徑​。

docs.title: Dijkstra ​最​短路​徑
docs.text:
​對非​負權​重邊​，​用​最小​堆積​維護​暫定​距離​。​之後若​找到​更​短路​，​舊​項目​仍​在​堆積​中​；​取出​時略過​過期​項目​。

from heapq import heappop, heappush


def shortest_distances(adjacency, start):
    distances = [float("inf")] * len(adjacency)
    distances[start] = 0
    heap = [(0, start)]
    while heap:
        distance, node = heappop(heap)
        if distance != distances[node]:
            continue
        for child, weight in adjacency[node]:
            candidate = distance + weight
            if candidate < distances[child]:
                distances[child] = candidate
                heappush(heap, (candidate, child))
    return distances

​不變量​：​下一個​未​過期​的​最小​距離​可以​確定​；​非​負邊​使​尚未​確定​且​距離​更​大​的​節點​無法​提供​更​短路​。​此延遲​刪除​版本​時間​ O(V + E log(E+2))，​包含​堆積項​目的​空間​ O(V+E)。​無限大​代表​不可​達​。​零權​重​合法​，​負權​重則​破壞​此證明​。

docs.title: 歐拉路徑
docs.text:
​每張​有​向​機票​都​須用​一次​時​，​要​找​的​是​使用​所有​邊的​歐拉路徑​。Hierholzer ​演算法​在​一個​頂點​的​所有​出邊​都​用​完後才​記錄​它​。

from collections import defaultdict


def itinerary(tickets, start):
    graph = defaultdict(list)
    for origin, destination in sorted(tickets, reverse=True):
        graph[origin].append(destination)
    stack, reversed_route = [start], []
    while stack:
        node = stack[-1]
        if graph[node]:
            stack.append(graph[node].pop())
        else:
            reversed_route.append(stack.pop())
    return reversed_route[::-1]

​不變量​：​透過​反向​後​序​，​把​已​走​完​的​路段​拼成​使用​所有​邊的​路徑​。​輸入須​保證​從​ start ​存在​歐拉路徑​。​目的地​反向​排序​後​ pop ​可先取​字典​序​最小​邊​；​後​序​處理​了​直接​貪心​輸出​可能​走入​的​死路​。​排序​ O(E log E)，​走訪​時間​及​空間​ O(E)。​使用​串列​保留​重​複​機票​代表​的​多​條邊​。

docs.title: 最小​生成​樹
docs.text:
​以​最小​總邊​權連接​所有​頂點​。​按權​重​排序​邊​，​只​接受​連接​不同​元件​的邊​。

def spanning_tree_cost(vertex_count, weighted_edges, components):
    # components is a fresh DisjointSet(vertex_count).
    total = used = 0
    for weight, a, b in sorted(weighted_edges):
        if components.union(a, b):
            total += weight
            used += 1
    return total if used == vertex_count - 1 else None

​不變量​：​選取​的邊​形成​可​延伸​為​最小​生成​樹​的​森林​；​依​切割​性質​，​跨​元件​的​最輕邊​可以​安全​加入​。​排序​ O(E log E)，​另加​近線性​的​並查集​操作​，​空間​ O(V+E)。Prim ​改為​擴張​一個​已​連通​前緣​。​對​所有​點兩​兩曼哈頓​距離​這種​稠密​隱含​圖​，​陣列版​ Prim ​可用​ O(V²) ​時間​、O(V) ​狀態​，​不必​建立​全部​邊​。

docs.title: 狀態​空間​搜尋
docs.text:
​位置​未必​代表​完整​狀態​。​剩餘資源​、​已訪​頂點​或​已​收集​鑰匙​，​會​改變​同一​位置​可​採取​的​移動​。

from collections import deque


def shortest_state_path(starts, neighbors, goal):
    distances = {state: 0 for state in starts}
    queue = deque(distances)
    while queue:
        state = queue.popleft()
        if goal(state):
            return distances[state]
        for following in neighbors(state):
            if following in distances:
                continue
            distances[following] = distances[state] + 1
            queue.append(following)
    return -1

​不變量​：​完整​狀態​首次​被​發現​時​，​其無權​最​短距​離​已​確定​。R×C ​格子​與​ K ​把​鑰匙​的​狀態​上界​是​ O(R×C×2^K)，​不是​ O(R×C)。​走訪​所有​頂點​使用​ (node,visited_mask)；​可​自由​選起點​時​，​把​每個​起點​都​入列​。​僅以​格子​作為​ visited ​鍵​，​會​錯誤​丟棄​取得​鑰匙​後​必要​的​重訪​。

docs.title: 橋邊​搜尋
docs.text:
​無向​簡單​圖中​，DFS ​樹邊​ parent->child ​是橋​，​若且唯若​孩子​子樹​無法​另​走​到​父節點​或​更​早​祖先​。​明確​迭代​器​可​保留​遞​迴​ DFS ​的​進入​／​離開​順序​。

def graph_bridges(adjacency):
    size = len(adjacency)
    entered = [-1] * size
    low = [0] * size
    parent = [-1] * size
    clock = 0
    result = []
    for start in range(size):
        if entered[start] != -1:
            continue
        entered[start] = low[start] = clock
        clock += 1
        stack = [(start, iter(adjacency[start]))]
        while stack:
            node, edges = stack[-1]
            child = next(edges, None)
            if child is None:
                stack.pop()
                above = parent[node]
                if above != -1:
                    if low[node] > entered[above]:
                        result.append((above, node))
                    low[above] = min(low[above], low[node])
                continue
            if child == parent[node]:
                continue
            if entered[child] != -1:
                low[node] = min(low[node], entered[child])
                continue
            parent[child] = node
            entered[child] = low[child] = clock
            clock += 1
            stack.append((child, iter(adjacency[child])))
    return result

​不變量​：low[node] ​是​經過​已​完成​ DFS ​子樹​、​再​至多​走​一條​非​父邊​回邊​可達​的​最早​發現​時間​。​時間​ O(V+E)，​走訪​空間​ O(V)。​模板​假設​整數​頂點​且​無​平行​邊​；​多重​圖須​用邊​ ID ​識別​父邊​。​迭代​版本​可避​開十萬節​點長​鏈​的​遞​迴​深度​問題​。

docs.title: 回溯​搜尋
docs.text:
​每個​解​都​需要​自己​的​決策​序列​時​，​枚舉​所有​選擇​。​狀態​只屬​於​目前​路徑​，​分支​結束​後​必須​還原​。

def enumerate_paths(state, choices, apply, undo, complete, emit):
    def visit():
        if complete(state):
            emit(state)  # emit must save an independent snapshot.
            return
        for choice in choices(state):
            apply(state, choice)
            visit()
            undo(state, choice)

    visit()

​不變量​：state ​恰好​描述​目前​路徑​，undo ​還原​父狀態​。​時間​為​搜尋樹​探索​成本​加​複​製​輸​出​成本​；​輔助​空間​取決​於​最大​深度​及路徑​狀態​。​組合​使用​遞增​索引​，​可重​複​用候​選時​留在​原​索引​遞​迴​。​排列​追​蹤​未​用​索引​；​網格​找​字​追​蹤​本​路​徑​格子​；​皇后​追​蹤​欄​與​兩​種​對​角​線​。​不同​路徑​遇到​相同​狀態​時​，​須先確​認快​取​是否​保留​完整​語意​。

docs.title: 線性​動態​規劃
docs.text:
​先定​義一個​前綴​或​總量​代表​的​狀態​，​再​寫​轉移​。​只有​確認​所有​依賴​之​後​，​才能​丟棄​舊​狀態​。

def nonadjacent_maximum(values):
    two_back = one_back = 0
    for value in values:
        two_back, one_back = one_back, max(one_back, two_back + value)
    return one_back


def minimum_coins(coins, amount):
    impossible = amount + 1
    dp = [0] + [impossible] * amount
    for total in range(1, amount + 1):
        for coin in coins:
            if coin <= total:
                dp[total] = min(dp[total], dp[total - coin] + 1)
    return -1 if dp[amount] > amount else dp[amount]

​打家劫舍​不變量​：one_back ​是​已​處理​前綴​的​最佳值​，two_back ​是​再​前​一個​前綴​的​最佳值​；​時間​ O(n)、​空間​ O(1)。​硬幣​不​變量​：dp[total] ​是​恰好​組成​ total ​的​最少​數量​；​正面​額使​較​早​總量​足夠​，​時間​ O(amount × coin_count)、​空間​ O(amount)。​環狀​搶​劫​分別​排除​兩端​做​兩次​線性​計算​。Word Break ​追​蹤​可​達​前​綴​長​度​：​可達​起點​搭配​字典​中​的​子​字串​，​使​終點​可達​。​若​最大​字長​ L，Python ​直接​切片​與​雜湊​最高​可花​ O(n × L²)，​不能​只算​ O(nL)。

docs.title: 最長​遞​增子​序列
docs.text:
​對​每個​遞​增子​序列​長​度​，​維護​可達​的​最小​尾值​。​二分​搜尋新值​應​取代​或​延伸​哪個​尾值​。

from bisect import bisect_left


def increasing_length(values):
    tails = []
    for value in values:
        index = bisect_left(tails, value)
        if index == len(tails):
            tails.append(value)
        else:
            tails[index] = value
    return len(tails)

​不變量​：tails[i] ​是​長​度​ i+1 ​的​子​序列​可達​的​最小​結尾​。​時間​ O(n log n)、​空間​ O(n)。bisect_left ​對應​嚴格​遞增​，bisect_right ​允許​相等值​。tails ​給出​正​確長​度​，​但​未必​是​一條​實際子​序列​；​重建​需要​前​驅資訊​。

docs.title: 網格動態​規劃
docs.text:
​只能​向​右​或​向​下移​動時​，​每格​只​依賴​上方​與​左方​。​單列​陣列​同時​保存​舊​的​上方​結果​與​剛算出​的​左方​結果​。

def count_grid_paths(rows, cols):
    dp = [1] * cols
    for _ in range(1, rows):
        for col in range(1, cols):
            dp[col] += dp[col - 1]
    return dp[-1]


def minimum_grid_cost(grid):
    cols = len(grid[0])
    dp = [float("inf")] * cols
    dp[0] = 0
    for row in grid:
        for col, cost in enumerate(row):
            left = dp[col - 1] if col else float("inf")
            dp[col] = cost + min(dp[col], left)
    return dp[-1]

​不變量​：​更新​一欄​之前​，dp[col] ​是​上方​結果​；​更新​後​就是​目前​格子​結果​。​兩個​模板​時間​ O(rows × cols)、​輔助​空間​ O(cols)，​要求​網​格非​空​。​路徑​數以​加法​合​併​；​最小​成本​先取​最小值​再​加​目前​格子​的​成本​。​起點​只​初始化​一次​。

docs.title: 字串​動態​規劃
docs.text:
​以​兩個​字串​的​前綴​長​度​為​座標​。​壓縮成​單列時​，​覆寫​目前​格子​前先​保存​舊​對​角線值​。

def edit_distance(a, b):
    dp = list(range(len(b) + 1))
    for i, char_a in enumerate(a, 1):
        diagonal, dp[0] = dp[0], i
        for j, char_b in enumerate(b, 1):
            above = dp[j]
            if char_a == char_b:
                dp[j] = diagonal
            else:
                dp[j] = 1 + min(above, dp[j - 1], diagonal)
            diagonal = above
    return dp[-1]

​不變量​：above ​屬於上​一列​，left ​屬​於​目前​列​，diagonal ​屬於上​一列​的​前​一欄​。​此​模板​時間​ O(mn)、​空間​ O(n)。

​題型​ ​狀態​與​轉移​ ​初始化​或​方向​ ​最長​共同​子​序列​ D[i][j] ​是​兩前​綴​的​最佳​長​度​；​同字元取​對​角線​+1，​否則​ max(​上​,​左​)。 ​空前​綴​為​ 0；​由​左​往右​並​保存​對角線​。 ​編輯​距離​ D[i][j] ​是​最少​編輯數​；​不同​字元取​ 1+min(​刪除​,​插入​,​替換​)。 D[i][0]=i，D[0][j]=j。 ​交錯​字串​ D[i][j] ​表示​目標​前​ i+j ​字元​可​由​兩來源​各取​ i、j ​字元​組成​；​可取​任一​匹配​來源​。 D[0][0]=True；​先​排除​總長​不符​，​各來源​內部​順序​不能​改​。 ​相異子​序列​ D[i][j] ​計算​來源​前​ i ​字元​組出​目標​前​ j ​字元​的​方法​數​；​跳過​來源​，​字​元​相同​時​再加​取用​的​方法​。 ​空目​標有​一種​方法​；​壓縮​ j ​須從​右往​左​，​避免​同一​來源​字元重​複​使用​。 ​正規​表示​式​比​對​ D[i][j] ​表示​整個​前綴​匹配​；​一般​字元用​匹配​對角線​，​字元​加星號​可​跳過​兩個​模式​符號​，​或​從​上方​再​匹配​一個​來源​字​元​。 D[0][0]=True；​空輸入​可​匹配​連續​的​字​元​加星號​。​星號​修飾​前​一個​原子​，​必須​匹配​整串​。

​五種​題型​的​前綴​維度​都​使​時間​為​ O(mn)。​完整​表空間​ O(mn)，​單列​版本​ O(n)。​正規​表示​式​的點​消耗​一個​字​元​；​星號​與​ Word Dictionary ​的點​不是​同一​種萬用​規則​。

docs.title: 區間​動態​規劃
docs.text:
​若先​選動​作會​改變​鄰居​，​可改​選區間​內​最後一個​動作​。​開區間​端點​在​內部​元素​全部​移除​前​保持​固定​。

def balloon_score(nums):
    values = [1, *nums, 1]
    size = len(values)
    dp = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for gap in range(2, size):
        for left in range(size - gap):
            right = left + gap
            dp[left][right] = max(
                dp[left][last] + dp[last][right] + values[left] * values[last] * values[right]
                for last in range(left + 1, right)
            )
    return dp[0][-1]

​不變量​：​小開區​間​先​於​大​開區間​完成​。​若​ last ​最後被​戳破​，​它​的​鄰居​恰好​是​固定​端點​，​因此​左右​剩餘區間​獨立​。​時間​ O(n³)、​空間​ O(n²)。​兩端​哨兵​ 1 ​模擬​外側​邊界​，​不算​真正​氣球​。

docs.text:
​動作會​改變​有限​狀態​時​，​明確​命名​每個​合法​狀態​。​最多​兩筆​股票交易​可​追​蹤​第一次​買​／​賣​與​第二次​買​／​賣​。

def two_transaction_profit(prices):
    buy1 = buy2 = float("-inf")
    sell1 = sell2 = 0
    for price in prices:
        buy1, sell1, buy2, sell2 = (
            max(buy1, -price),
            max(sell1, buy1 + price),
            max(buy2, sell1 - price),
            max(sell2, buy2 + price),
        )
    return sell2

​不變量​：​每個​狀態​是​處​理完​目前​天數​後​，​以該​狀態​可達​的​最佳​現金餘額​。tuple ​同時​賦值​讓​所有​轉移​讀取​前一天​的​值​。​賣出​狀態​初值​為​ 0，​允許​少​於​兩筆​交易​；​買入​狀態​初始​不可​達​。​時間​ O(n)、​空間​ O(1)，​任一​時刻​不得​持有​超過​一股​。

docs.title: 位元​遮罩​動態​規劃
docs.text:
​元素​少時​，​用​遮罩​精確​記錄​已​使用​項目​。​正​整數​等​和​分​組中​，​已​用​遮罩​即可​決定​目前​桶​的​餘數​。

def equal_sum_groups(values, groups):
    total = sum(values)
    if total % groups:
        return False
    target = total // groups
    remainder = [-1] * (1 << len(values))
    remainder[0] = 0
    for mask in range(1 << len(values)):
        if remainder[mask] < 0:
            continue
        for index, value in enumerate(values):
            if mask & (1 << index) or remainder[mask] + value > target:
                continue
            following = mask | (1 << index)
            remainder[following] = (remainder[mask] + value) % target
    return remainder[-1] == 0

​不變量​：​可達​遮罩​對應​若干​完整​桶​，​加上​儲存​的​當前​餘數​。​元素​與​組數​均​為​正​，​可​整除​時​ target ​才​為​正​。​時間​ O(n×2^n)、​空間​ O(2^n)。​遮罩​標示​項目​身分​，​不同​索引​的​重​複​值​仍​是​不同​項目​。​子集合​和​可行性​也​可用​ Python ​整數​位元​集合​ bits |= bits << value，​成本​取決​於​位元​集合​長​度​。

docs.title: 矩陣​快速​冪
docs.text:
​固定​線性​轉移​反覆​更新​小型​計數​向量​，​且​重​複​次數​很多​時​適用​。transition[destination][source] ​表示​一步​從來源​到​目的​狀態​的​方法​數​。​矩陣須​為​方陣​、​大小​須​符合​ counts、steps ​非負​、modulus ​為​正​。

def advance_states(transition, counts, steps, modulus):
    size = len(counts)
    power = transition
    result = [count % modulus for count in counts]
    while steps:
        if steps & 1:
            result = [
                sum(power[row][col] * result[col] for col in range(size)) % modulus
                for row in range(size)
            ]
        power = [
            [
                sum(power[row][mid] * power[mid][col] for mid in range(size)) % modulus
                for col in range(size)
            ]
            for row in range(size)
        ]
        steps >>= 1
    return result

​不變量​：power ​表示​目前​ 2 ​的​冪次​數量​的​轉移​；result ​已​套用​消耗​過的​設​定位​元​所​對​應​的​冪​。​平方​讓​轉移長​度​加倍​，​設​定位​元則​把​該區​塊​套​到​目前​計數​。​不​修改​任何​輸入​串列​。

transition=[[1,1],[1,0]]、counts=[1,0]，​做​四步​得到​ [5,3]，​即​相鄰​費氏數​。​零步​回傳​初始​向量​各項​對​ modulus ​取模​。

d ​個​狀態​、t>0 ​步時​，​時間​ O(d³ log(t+1))、​空間​ O(d²)；​零步​成本​ O(d)。​這是​算術​操作​次數​；​模數​與​小型​ d ​固定​時​，​整數​大小​有​界​。t ​適中時​宜用​滾動​ DP，​因矩​陣​乘法​常數​較​大​。​確認​轉移​方向​是​目的​狀態​在​列​；​長​度​ 1 ​初始化​需​ n-1 ​次​延伸​，​空​字串​初始化​則需​ n ​次​。

docs.title: 前綴​和
docs.text:
​若區間​結束​處​的​前綴​和​為​ p，​目標​和​為​ k，​則需​找​更​早​的​前綴​和​ p-k。​輸入​可以​包含​負數​，​不​需要​滑動視​窗所​依賴​的​和​的​單​調性​。

def count_target_intervals(nums, target):
    seen = {0: 1}
    prefix = answer = 0
    for value in nums:
        prefix += value
        answer += seen.get(prefix - target, 0)
        seen[prefix] = seen.get(prefix, 0) + 1
    return answer

​不變量​：​查詢​時​，seen ​只​包含​目前​終點​之前​的​前綴​。​平均​時間​ O(n)，​空間​ O(n)。​求​最長​零和區​間​時​，​儲存​最早​索引​而​非​頻率​；​先​放入​ 0 ​對應​ -1，​且​不覆寫​首次​索引​。​把​二元​陣列​的​ 0 ​改視​為​ -1，​即可​尋找​ 0、1 ​數量​相同​的​區間​。
