docs.title: 1. ​依​高度​向​內​移動​的​雙指標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Inward height pointers
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def maxArea(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        left, right = 0, len(height) - 1
        best = 0
        while left < right:
            best = max(best, (right - left) * min(height[left], height[right]))
            if height[left] <= height[right]:
                left += 1
            else:
                right -= 1
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​列舉​牆壁配​對
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate wall pairs
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def maxArea(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        best = 0
        for left in range(len(height)):
            for right in range(left + 1, len(height)):
                best = max(best, (right - left) * min(height[left], height[right]))
        return best

docs.text:
​時間​： ​題目​有界​整數​範圍​內​為​ O(1)

​空間​： ​題目​有界​整數​範圍​內​為​ O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Descending token subtraction
    Time: O(1) for the stated bounded integer domain
    Space: O(1) for the stated bounded integer domain
    """

    def intToRoman(self, num: int) -> str:
        tokens = (
            (1000, "M"),
            (900, "CM"),
            (500, "D"),
            (400, "CD"),
            (100, "C"),
            (90, "XC"),
            (50, "L"),
            (40, "XL"),
            (10, "X"),
            (9, "IX"),
            (5, "V"),
            (4, "IV"),
            (1, "I"),
        )
        pieces = []
        for value, symbol in tokens:
            count, num = divmod(num, value)
            pieces.append(symbol * count)
        return "".join(pieces)

docs.title: 2. ​十進位​數位​查表
docs.text:
​時間​： ​題目​有界​整數​範圍​內​為​ O(1)

​空間​： ​題目​有界​整數​範圍​內​為​ O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Decimal place tables
    Time: O(1) for the stated bounded integer domain
    Space: O(1) for the stated bounded integer domain
    """

    def intToRoman(self, num: int) -> str:
        thousands = ("", "M", "MM", "MMM")
        hundreds = ("", "C", "CC", "CCC", "CD", "D", "DC", "DCC", "DCCC", "CM")
        tens = ("", "X", "XX", "XXX", "XL", "L", "LX", "LXX", "LXXX", "XC")
        ones = ("", "I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI", "VII", "VIII", "IX")
        return (
            thousands[num // 1000]
            + hundreds[num // 100 % 10]
            + tens[num // 10 % 10]
            + ones[num % 10]
        )

docs.text: ​排序​副本​。​對​每個​不同​的​首值​，​在後綴​上移​動雙​指標​。​找到​總​和​零​後​，​兩端​都​前進​並略​過重​複​端​點值​，​將​立方​列舉​改善​為​平方​掃描​。

​兩者​都​不​修改​原陣列​，sorted ​會​建立​副本​。left ​必須​從​錨點​之後開始​；​若​在​評​估配​對​前​就​把​所有​重​複​值​排除​，​可能​漏掉​ [-2,1,1] ​這類​需要​重​複​數值​的​合法​答案​。

docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​排序​搭配​雙指標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²)

​空間​： O(n) ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort with two pointers
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n) plus output
    """

    def threeSum(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        values = sorted(nums)
        result = []
        for i in range(len(values) - 2):
            if i and values[i] == values[i - 1]:
                continue
            left, right = i + 1, len(values) - 1
            while left < right:
                total = values[i] + values[left] + values[right]
                if total < 0:
                    left += 1
                elif total > 0:
                    right -= 1
                else:
                    result.append([values[i], values[left], values[right]])
                    left += 1
                    right -= 1
                    while left < right and values[left] == values[left - 1]:
                        left += 1
                    while left < right and values[right] == values[right + 1]:
                        right -= 1
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​每個​錨點​的​互補值​集合
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n) ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Per-anchor complement sets
    Time: O(n squared) expected
    Space: O(n) plus output
    """

    def threeSum(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        answers = set()
        for i, anchor in enumerate(nums):
            seen = set()
            for j in range(i + 1, len(nums)):
                value = nums[j]
                complement = -anchor - value
                if complement in seen:
                    answers.add(tuple(sorted((anchor, value, complement))))
                seen.add(value)
        return [list(values) for values in sorted(answers)]

docs.text: ​排序​副本​，​固定​每個​首值​，​從​剩餘後綴​的​兩端​掃​描並​記錄​更​接近​的​和​。​小​於​ target ​時移動​左端​，​大​於​時​移動​右端​；​完全​相等​已經​最佳​，​可​立即​回傳​。

docs.text: ​排序​副本​並​固定​前​兩個​索引​，​二分​搜尋​第三​個值​的​下界​位置​，​同時​檢查​該​位置​與​其前​一個​位置​。​此法​較慢​，​但​可示範​最​接近​值​的​二分​搜尋​。

docs.title: 排序​搭配​雙指標
docs.text: ​總​和​小​於​ target ​時​，​固定​同一​左端​、​改選​更​小右值​，​不會​比剛​檢查​的​總​和​更​接近​；​大​於​ target ​時​，​可​對​稱​排除​固定​右端​搭配​更大​左值​的​候選​。​這些​被​排除​的​候選​都​無法​改善​已​記錄​結果​。

docs.text: ​固定​一對​數值​後​，​絕對誤​差​最小​的​第三​個值​，​就是​最​接近​剩餘​目標​的​值​。​下界​位置​及其​前一個​位置​，​涵蓋​目標​兩側​最​接近​的​候選​。

docs.text:
​雙指標​需要​ O(n²) ​時間​、O(n) ​排序​副本​空間​；​逐對​二分​搜尋​需要​ O(n² log n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​，​代價​較​高​但​清楚​呈現​最​接近​第三​值​的​搜尋​。

​輸入​不變​。​以三個​真實​元素​的​總​和​初始化​最佳值​。​比較​絕對​距離​而​非​原始​總​和​；​回傳​的​是​總​和​，​不是​它​與​ target ​的​距離​。

docs.title: 1. ​排序​搭配​雙指標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort with two pointers
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def threeSumClosest(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        values = sorted(nums)
        best = sum(values[:3])
        for i in range(len(values) - 2):
            left, right = i + 1, len(values) - 1
            while left < right:
                total = values[i] + values[left] + values[right]
                if abs(total - target) < abs(best - target):
                    best = total
                if total == target:
                    return total
                if total < target:
                    left += 1
                else:
                    right -= 1
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​二分​搜尋最​接近​的​第三​個值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n² log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary-search nearest third value
    Time: O(n squared log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def threeSumClosest(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        values = sorted(nums)
        best = sum(values[:3])
        for i in range(len(values) - 2):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(values) - 1):
                left, right = j + 1, len(values)
                wanted = target - values[i] - values[j]
                while left < right:
                    middle = (left + right) // 2
                    if values[middle] < wanted:
                        left = middle + 1
                    else:
                        right = middle
                for index in (left - 1, left):
                    if j < index < len(values):
                        total = values[i] + values[j] + values[index]
                        if abs(total - target) < abs(best - target):
                            best = total
        return best

docs.title: 1. ​逐數​字​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(d*4^d) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(d) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

LETTERS = {
    "2": "abc",
    "3": "def",
    "4": "ghi",
    "5": "jkl",
    "6": "mno",
    "7": "pqrs",
    "8": "tuv",
    "9": "wxyz",
}


class Solution:
    """Approach: Digit-by-digit backtracking
    Time: O(d*4^d) loose bound
    Space: O(d) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def letterCombinations(self, digits: str) -> list[str]:
        if not digits:
            return []
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(index):
            if index == len(digits):
                result.append("".join(path))
                return
            for char in LETTERS[digits[index]]:
                path.append(char)
                visit(index + 1)
                path.pop()

        visit(0)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​混合​進​位列​舉
docs.text:
​時間​： O(d*4^d) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(d) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

LETTERS = {
    "2": "abc",
    "3": "def",
    "4": "ghi",
    "5": "jkl",
    "6": "mno",
    "7": "pqrs",
    "8": "tuv",
    "9": "wxyz",
}


class Solution:
    """Approach: Mixed-radix enumeration
    Time: O(d*4^d) loose bound
    Space: O(d) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def letterCombinations(self, digits: str) -> list[str]:
        if not digits:
            return []
        count = 1
        for digit in digits:
            count *= len(LETTERS[digit])
        result = []
        for number in range(count):
            chars = []
            for digit in reversed(digits):
                number, index = divmod(number, len(LETTERS[digit]))
                chars.append(LETTERS[digit][index])
            result.append("".join(reversed(chars)))
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​兩個​錨點​搭配​雙指標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n³)

​空間​： O(n) ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Two anchors and two pointers
    Time: O(n cubed)
    Space: O(n) plus output
    """

    def fourSum(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        values = sorted(nums)
        answer = []
        for i in range(len(values) - 3):
            if i and values[i] == values[i - 1]:
                continue
            for j in range(i + 1, len(values) - 2):
                if j > i + 1 and values[j] == values[j - 1]:
                    continue
                left, right = j + 1, len(values) - 1
                while left < right:
                    total = values[i] + values[j] + values[left] + values[right]
                    if total < target:
                        left += 1
                    elif total > target:
                        right -= 1
                    else:
                        answer.append([values[i], values[j], values[left], values[right]])
                        a, b = values[left], values[right]
                        while left < right and values[left] == a:
                            left += 1
                        while left < right and values[right] == b:
                            right -= 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​逐步​累積​不​重疊​的​配​對​和
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n⁴) ​最壞​情況​

​空間​： O(n²) ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Incremental disjoint pair sums
    Time: O(n to the fourth) worst case
    Space: O(n squared) plus output
    """

    def fourSum(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        pairs = {}
        answer = set()
        for third in range(2, len(nums) - 1):
            second = third - 1
            for first in range(second):
                pairs.setdefault(nums[first] + nums[second], []).append((nums[first], nums[second]))
            for fourth in range(third + 1, len(nums)):
                wanted = target - nums[third] - nums[fourth]
                for a, b in pairs.get(wanted, []):
                    answer.add(tuple(sorted((a, b, nums[third], nums[fourth]))))
        return [list(values) for values in sorted(answer)]

docs.text: ​快​、​慢指標​都​從​虛擬​表頭​出發​，​先將​快​指標​向​前移​ n ​步​。​接著​同時​移動​兩者​，​直到​ fast.next ​為空​。​此時​慢指​標位​於​目標​的​前​一個​節點​，​修改​一條​ next ​連結​即可​略過​目標​。

docs.text: ​第一趟​求​出​串列​長​度​ length，​第二趟​從虛擬​表頭​走​ length-n ​步到​目標​的​前​驅​，​再​把​它​的​ next ​接到​目標​之​後​。​這個​方法​使用​兩趟​走訪​，​狀態​簡單​。

docs.title: 固定​距離​雙指標
docs.text: ​共同​移動時​，​兩個​指標​的​距​離始​終是​ n。​快​指標​抵達​最後一個​節點​時​，​慢指標​便位​於​倒數​第​ n ​個​節點​的​前​驅​；​略過​其下​一個​節點​正好​刪除​目標​。

docs.title: 計數​後​移除
docs.text: ​倒數​第​ n ​個​節點​的​零​起始​索引​是​ length-n。​從虛擬​表頭​走​相同​步數​，​便會​到​達​它​的​前​驅​。​重新​連接​前​驅與後繼​只​移除​該​節點​，​其他​相對​順序​不變​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(length) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​，​會​修改​串列​連結​，​並​重用​所有​保留​節點​。​先走​ n ​步必須​搭配​ fast.next ​的​停止​條件​；​若​改成​ fast ​為​空才​停止​，​初始​距離​也須​相應​調整​。​單一節點​、n=1 ​時​，​結果​是​ None。

docs.title: 1. ​固定​距離​雙指標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Fixed pointer gap
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: ListNode, n: int) -> ListNode | None:
        dummy = ListNode(next=head)
        slow = fast = dummy
        for _ in range(n):
            fast = fast.next
        while fast.next:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next
        slow.next = slow.next.next
        return dummy.next

docs.title: 2. ​計數​後​移除
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Count then unlink
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: ListNode, n: int) -> ListNode | None:
        length = 0
        current = head
        while current:
            length += 1
            current = current.next
        dummy = ListNode(next=head)
        before = dummy
        for _ in range(length - n):
            before = before.next
        before.next = before.next.next
        return dummy.next

docs.title: Catalan ​串接​ DP
docs.text: ​與​第一​個​左括號​匹配​的​右括號​，​唯一​把​非空​合法​字串​分成​內部​與後綴​。​列舉​此​分割​，​恰產生​所有​平衡​字串​且​不重​複​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​平衡​限制​回溯​：​時間​ O(n*C_n)；​空間​ O(n) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​。

Catalan ​串接​ DP：​時間​ O(n^2C_n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​；​空間​ O(n^2C_n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​。

C_n ​是​平衡​字串​數​。​字串​與​路徑​ join ​的​複​製​成本​已​包含​在​上界​。DP ​保留​中間​字串​，DFS ​只​需一條​工作​路徑​。n<=8 ​使遞​迴​深度​有​界​。

docs.title: 1. ​平衡​限制​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*C_n)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Balance-constrained backtracking
    Time: O(n*C_n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def generateParenthesis(self, n: int) -> list[str]:
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(opened, closed):
            if closed == n:
                result.append("".join(path))
                return
            if opened < n:
                path.append("(")
                visit(opened + 1, closed)
                path.pop()
            if closed < opened:
                path.append(")")
                visit(opened, closed + 1)
                path.pop()

        visit(0, 0)
        return result

docs.title: 2. Catalan ​串接​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2*C_n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n^2*C_n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Catalan concatenation DP
    Time: O(n^2*C_n) loose bound
    Space: O(n^2*C_n) loose bound
    """

    def generateParenthesis(self, n: int) -> list[str]:
        values = [[""]]
        for size in range(1, n + 1):
            values.append(
                [
                    "(" + inside + ")" + after
                    for left in range(size)
                    for inside in values[left]
                    for after in values[size - left - 1]
                ]
            )
        return values[n]

docs.title: 串​列表​頭​最小​堆積
docs.text: ​將非​空表頭​建立​為​最小​堆積​。​每次​取出​最小​節點​，​接到​結果​尾端​，​再​把​同一​條​串列​的後繼​加入​堆積​。​堆積​項目​包含​來源​串列​索引​，​以便​數值​相等​時​不必​比較​節點​物件​。

docs.title: 成對合​併
docs.text: ​先​複​製​表​頭​參​考​陣​列​，​再將​相鄰​串列​兩兩合​併​，​逐輪​把​串列​數量​減半​。​每次​合​併​都​重新​連接​原節點​。​複​製​表​頭​陣​列​可​避免​改動​呼叫​端的​陣列​本身​。

docs.title: 串​列表​頭​最小​堆積
docs.text: ​每條​串列​的​目前​表頭​都​不​大​於​其​後​所有​節點​，​所以​所有​候選表頭​中​的​最小值​就是​全體​剩餘​節點​的​最小值​。​取出​後​以​同一​串列​的​後​繼補入​，​會維持​此​不​變量​。

docs.title: 成對合​併
docs.text: ​合​併​兩條​排序​串列​時​，​每次​選較​小​的​前端​節點​，​便​能產生​包含​兩者​全部​節點​的​排序​串列​。​逐輪​套用​此性質​，​最後一條​串列​即為​所有​輸入​的​排序​聯集​；​每個​節點​參​與​ O(log(k+1)) ​輪​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​令​ N ​為​總節​點數​，​兩者​時間​皆​為​ O(k+N log(k+1))，​空間​為​ O(k)。​兩者​重用​節點並​修改​ next，​因此​不是​保留​原​串列​的​複​製​合​併​。​只​使用​ (value,node) ​當堆​積項​目​，​會​在​數值​相同​時嘗試​比​較​不可​排序​的​節點​，​必須​加入​可比​較​的​平手​處理​欄位​。

docs.title: 1. ​串​列表​頭​最小​堆積
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k + N log(k+1))

​空間​： O(k)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap of list heads
    Time: O(k + N log(k+1))
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def mergeKLists(self, lists: list[ListNode | None]) -> ListNode | None:
        heap = [(node.val, i, node) for i, node in enumerate(lists) if node]
        heapify(heap)
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        while heap:
            _, i, node = heappop(heap)
            tail.next = node
            tail = node
            if node.next:
                heappush(heap, (node.next.val, i, node.next))
        return dummy.next

docs.title: 2. ​成對合​併
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k + N log(k+1))

​空間​： O(k)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Pairwise merging
    Time: O(k + N log(k+1))
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def mergeKLists(self, lists: list[ListNode | None]) -> ListNode | None:
        current = list(lists)
        while len(current) > 1:
            merged = []
            for i in range(0, len(current), 2):
                left = current[i]
                right = current[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(current) else None
                dummy = tail = ListNode()
                while left and right:
                    if left.val <= right.val:
                        tail.next, left = left, left.next
                    else:
                        tail.next, right = right, right.next
                    tail = tail.next
                tail.next = left if left else right
                merged.append(dummy.next)
            current = merged
        return current[0] if current else None

docs.title: 暫存​節點​順序

docs.text: ​局部​法為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​；​陣列法​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​。​兩者​修改​連結​而​非數值​，​重用​所有​節點​。​陣列法​須將​最後節點​的​ next ​設為​ None，​避免​保留​舊連結​造成​環​。​空串列​或單​一節點​不變​。

docs.title: 1. ​局部​成對​重接
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Local pair rewiring
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def swapPairs(self, head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
        dummy = ListNode(next=head)
        before = dummy
        while before.next and before.next.next:
            first = before.next
            second = first.next
            first.next = second.next
            second.next = first
            before.next = second
            before = first
        return dummy.next

docs.title: 2. ​暫存​節點​順序
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Buffered positional order
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def swapPairs(self, head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
        order = []
        while head:
            order.append(head)
            head = head.next
        for index in range(0, len(order) - 1, 2):
            order[index], order[index + 1] = order[index + 1], order[index]
        for index, node in enumerate(order):
            node.next = order[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(order) else None
        return order[0] if order else None

docs.title: 限定​範圍​的​指標​反轉
docs.text: ​從​組前​驅​找出​第​ k ​個​節點​，​保存​它的後繼​。​只​反轉​這​一段​，​讓​舊​組首​接到​下一組​，​再​把​組前​驅​接到​舊​組尾​。​下一輪​以舊​組首作​為​前​驅​；​找​不到​完整​一組​就​結束​。

docs.title: 每組​節點​堆疊
docs.text: ​逐組​收集​最​多​ k ​個​節點​。​若剛​好​收滿​，​就​依堆​疊​反向​取出​並連接​；​若​不足​ k ​個​，​則​按照​原順序​接回​尾端​。

docs.title: 限定​範圍​的​指標​反轉
docs.text: ​先確​認組​界限​，​保證​只​反轉​完整​組​。​反轉後舊​組首​指向​未處​理後綴​，​原前​綴則​接到​舊​組尾​，​因此​前綴​、​反轉​組與後綴​仍​形成​一條​完整​串列​。

docs.title: 每組​節點​堆疊
docs.text: ​每個​緩衝區​不是​完整​ k ​個​節點​，​就是​最​後​不足​ k ​個​的​後​綴​。​只​反向​輸出​完整​組​，​正好​符合​規則​；​每個​原節點​恰好​連接​一次​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(n) ​時間​。​指標法​使用​ O(1) ​空間​，​符合​常數額​外空​間​的​延伸​要求​；​堆疊法​使用​ O(k) ​空間​，​不​符合​該​延伸​要求​。​兩者​皆​修改​ next。​不能​先反轉​尾端​才​發現​節點​不足​；​應先確​認長​度​，​或將​不​完整​組​保留​原順序​。

docs.title: 1. ​限定​範圍​的​指標​反轉
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Bounded pointer reversal
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def reverseKGroup(self, head: ListNode, k: int) -> ListNode:
        dummy = ListNode(next=head)
        before = dummy
        while True:
            end = before
            for _ in range(k):
                end = end.next
                if end is None:
                    return dummy.next
            following = end.next
            current = before.next
            previous = following
            while current is not following:
                saved = current.next
                current.next = previous
                previous, current = current, saved
            old_first = before.next
            before.next = end
            before = old_first

docs.title: 2. ​每組​節點​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(k)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Per-group node stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def reverseKGroup(self, head: ListNode, k: int) -> ListNode:
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        current = head
        while current:
            group = []
            while current and len(group) < k:
                group.append(current)
                current = current.next
            if len(group) < k:
                tail.next = group[0]
                break
            while group:
                tail.next = group.pop()
                tail = tail.next
            tail.next = current
        return dummy.next

docs.title: 反覆​減去​最大​倍增​區塊
docs.text: ​對​每個​餘數​，​持續​倍增​除數​，​直到​再​倍增​會​超過​餘數​，​然後減​去​該​區塊並​加上​對應​的​商位​元​。

docs.title: 二進​位長​除法
docs.text: ​候選​商位​元​由​高往​低​掃​，​只要​左移​的​除數​能容​納​，​就​減去​它​。

docs.title: 反覆​減去​最大​倍增​區塊
docs.text: ​每次​相減​保持​ original_dividend = quotient*divisor + remainder。​移除​最大​可容納​二次​冪區​塊​後​，​餘數​至少​減半​，​直到​小​於​除數​。

docs.title: 二進​位長​除法
docs.text: ​處理​每個​位元前​，​更高​商位​元​都​已​確定​，​餘數​小​於​下​一個​更​高倍​數​。​恰在​目前​倍數​能容​納時​設定​該位​，​就​重現​整數長​除法​。

​二進​位長​除法​：​時間​ O(log V)；​空間​ O(1)。

​輸入​不變​，​除數​非​零​。V ​是​被​除​數絕​對值​加一​。​這些​實作​的​除法​過程​只​使用​位移​與​相減​。

docs.title: 1. ​反覆​減去​最大​倍增​區塊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log^2 V)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Repeated largest doubled subtraction
    Time: O(log squared V)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def divide(self, dividend: int, divisor: int) -> int:
        negative = (dividend < 0) != (divisor < 0)
        remaining, base = abs(dividend), abs(divisor)
        quotient = 0
        while remaining >= base:
            chunk, count = base, 1
            while chunk << 1 <= remaining:
                chunk <<= 1
                count <<= 1
            remaining -= chunk
            quotient += count
        if negative:
            quotient = -quotient
        return min((1 << 31) - 1, max(-(1 << 31), quotient))

docs.title: 2. ​二進​位長​除法
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log V)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary long division
    Time: O(log V)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def divide(self, dividend: int, divisor: int) -> int:
        remaining, base = abs(dividend), abs(divisor)
        quotient = 0
        for bit in range(remaining.bit_length() - 1, -1, -1):
            if base << bit <= remaining:
                remaining -= base << bit
                quotient |= 1 << bit
        if (dividend < 0) != (divisor < 0):
            quotient = -quotient
        return min((1 << 31) - 1, max(-(1 << 31), quotient))

docs.text: ​第一​個​改變​的​位置​必須​是​最右邊​能​增加​的​轉折點​。​選擇​最小​的​較​大​替代​值​，​再​排序​其餘​部分​，​就​能​讓後面​的​所有​位置​最小​。

​兩者​都​修改​原​串列​，​並​保留​物件​身分​。​尋找​後​繼值​時​必須​使用​嚴格​大​於​，​才能​正確​處理​相等值​。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Pivot swap and suffix reversal
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def nextPermutation(self, nums: list[int]) -> None:
        pivot = len(nums) - 2
        while pivot >= 0 and nums[pivot] >= nums[pivot + 1]:
            pivot -= 1
        if pivot >= 0:
            successor = len(nums) - 1
            while nums[successor] <= nums[pivot]:
                successor -= 1
            nums[pivot], nums[successor] = nums[successor], nums[pivot]
        left, right = pivot + 1, len(nums) - 1
        while left < right:
            nums[left], nums[right] = nums[right], nums[left]
            left += 1
            right -= 1

docs.title: 2. ​交換​轉折​點並​排序​後​綴
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Pivot swap and suffix sorting
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def nextPermutation(self, nums: list[int]) -> None:
        pivot = len(nums) - 2
        while pivot >= 0 and nums[pivot] >= nums[pivot + 1]:
            pivot -= 1
        if pivot < 0:
            nums.sort()
            return
        successor = min(
            (i for i in range(pivot + 1, len(nums)) if nums[i] > nums[pivot]), key=nums.__getitem__
        )
        nums[pivot], nums[successor] = nums[successor], nums[pivot]
        nums[pivot + 1 :] = sorted(nums[pivot + 1 :])

docs.title: 1. ​未​匹配​索引​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Stack of unmatched indices
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def longestValidParentheses(self, s: str) -> int:
        stack = [-1]
        best = 0
        for index, character in enumerate(s):
            if character == "(":
                stack.append(index)
            else:
                stack.pop()
                if not stack:
                    stack.append(index)
                else:
                    best = max(best, index - stack[-1])
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​正反​向​平衡​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward and backward balance counts
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def longestValidParentheses(self, s: str) -> int:
        best = 0
        for reverse in (False, True):
            opens = closes = 0
            for index in range(len(s) - 1, -1, -1) if reverse else range(len(s)):
                opens += s[index] == "("
                closes += s[index] == ")"
                if opens == closes:
                    best = max(best, opens + closes)
                elif opens > closes if reverse else closes > opens:
                    opens = closes = 0
        return best

docs.title: 辨識​有序​半段​的​二分​搜尋
docs.text: ​二分​搜尋含​兩​端的​區間​。​先檢查​中點​，​再辨識​有序​的​一半​；​只有​端點​不等式​包含​ target ​時才​保留​它​，​否則​搜尋​另一半​。

docs.title: 先找​轉折點​再​二分​搜尋
docs.text: ​找出​最小​元素​，​再​對​恢​復​排序​順序​的​虛擬​索引​二分​搜尋​。​使用​轉折​偏移量​，​把​虛擬​索引​轉回原​索引​。

docs.title: 辨識​有序​半段​的​二分​搜尋
docs.text: ​值​不同​且​只有​一個​旋轉​邊界​，​不​可能​兩半​都​無序​。​有序​半段​的​值域​精確​決定​ target ​是否​可能​在​其中​。​每次​保留​全部​可能​位置​，​並將​搜尋空間​減半​。

docs.title: 先找​轉折點​再​二分​搜尋
docs.text: ​轉折點​把​兩段​遞增​序列​分開​。​繞該​點旋​轉虛擬​索引​後​，​就​得到​原本​嚴格​有序​的​序列​，​因此​一般​二分​搜尋的​順序​不​變量​成立​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​兩者​皆​為​ O(log n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​，​不​修改​輸入​。​先找​轉折法​進行​兩次​對數​搜尋​，​透過​偏移量​映射​索引​。

​檢查​哪半​有序​時​，​要​包含​左端​點​，​尤其​是​兩​元素​區間​。​這些​推理​依賴​數值​互異​；​大量重​複​值​的​變​形題​需要​不同​論證​。

docs.title: 1. ​辨識​有序​半段​的​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted-half binary search
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def search(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        left, right = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while left <= right:
            middle = (left + right) // 2
            if nums[middle] == target:
                return middle
            if nums[left] <= nums[middle]:
                if nums[left] <= target < nums[middle]:
                    right = middle - 1
                else:
                    left = middle + 1
            elif nums[middle] < target <= nums[right]:
                left = middle + 1
            else:
                right = middle - 1
        return -1

docs.title: 2. ​先找​轉折點​再​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Find pivot then binary search
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def search(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        low, high = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if nums[middle] > nums[high]:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle
        pivot = low
        low, high = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while low <= high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            index = (middle + pivot) % len(nums)
            if nums[index] == target:
                return index
            if nums[index] < target:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle - 1
        return -1

docs.title: 兩次​下界​搜尋
docs.text: ​分別求​ target ​與​ target+1 ​的​ lower bound。​先確​認​ target ​存在​，​再將​第二​個​插入​位置​減一​，​轉成​最​後​索引​。

docs.title: 等值​時繼續​朝端點​搜尋
docs.text: ​搜尋​ target ​兩次​。​相等​時先​保存​索引​；​第一次​繼續​往​左​，​第二次​繼續​往右​。

docs.title: 兩次​下界​搜尋
docs.text: lower bound ​將小​於​查詢值​與​大​於​等​於​查詢值​的​元素​分開​。​陣列​已​排序​，​兩個​邊界​之間​恰好​包含​整段​ target。

docs.title: 等值​時繼續​朝端點​搜尋
docs.text: ​保存​的​匹配​始終​是​有效​候選​，​未解決​半段​則​仍​包含​所有​可能​更靠​端點​的​匹配​。​該​半段​搜尋完​畢​，​便​證明​保存​索引​是​所求​端點​。

docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(log n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​，​不​修改​輸入​。​空陣列​回傳​ [-1,-1]。​找到​一個​匹配​後​，​不要​改用​線性​掃描​整段​重​複​值​，​否則​最壞​會​變成​線性​時間​。

docs.title: 1. ​兩次​下界​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Two lower-bound searches
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def searchRange(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        def lower(value):
            left, right = 0, len(nums)
            while left < right:
                middle = (left + right) // 2
                if nums[middle] < value:
                    left = middle + 1
                else:
                    right = middle
            return left

        start = lower(target)
        if start == len(nums) or nums[start] != target:
            return [-1, -1]
        return [start, lower(target + 1) - 1]

docs.title: 2. ​等值​時繼續​朝端點​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Directional equality searches
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def searchRange(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        answer = []
        for first in (True, False):
            low, high, found = 0, len(nums) - 1, -1
            while low <= high:
                middle = (low + high) // 2
                if nums[middle] == target:
                    found = middle
                    if first:
                        high = middle - 1
                    else:
                        low = middle + 1
                elif nums[middle] < target:
                    low = middle + 1
                else:
                    high = middle - 1
            answer.append(found)
        return answer

docs.text:
​時間​： O(81)

​空間​： O(81)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sets of occupied digits
    Time: O(81)
    Space: O(81)
    """

    def isValidSudoku(self, board: list[list[str]]) -> bool:
        rows, cols, boxes = (
            [set() for _ in range(9)],
            [set() for _ in range(9)],
            [set() for _ in range(9)],
        )
        for r in range(9):
            for c in range(9):
                value = board[r][c]
                if value == ".":
                    continue
                box = r // 3 * 3 + c // 3
                if value in rows[r] or value in cols[c] or value in boxes[box]:
                    return False
                rows[r].add(value)
                cols[c].add(value)
                boxes[box].add(value)
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​已​使用​數字位​元​遮罩
docs.text:
​時間​： O(81)

​空間​： O(27)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bit masks for occupied digits
    Time: O(81)
    Space: O(27)
    """

    def isValidSudoku(self, board: list[list[str]]) -> bool:
        rows, cols, boxes = [0] * 9, [0] * 9, [0] * 9
        for r in range(9):
            for c in range(9):
                if board[r][c] == ".":
                    continue
                bit = 1 << (int(board[r][c]) - 1)
                box = r // 3 * 3 + c // 3
                if rows[r] & bit or cols[c] & bit or boxes[box] & bit:
                    return False
                rows[r] |= bit
                cols[c] |= bit
                boxes[box] |= bit
        return True

docs.text:
​迭代​連續​段​掃描​：​時間​ O(T)，T ​為​所有​產生項​的​長​度​總​和​；​空間​ O(L)，L ​為​最長​項長​度​。 ​遞​迴​建構​項目​：​時間​ O(T)，T ​為​所有​產生項​的​長​度​總​和​；​空間​ O(L+n)，​最長​項加​呼叫​框架​。

T ​為​到​ n ​為止​全部​產生項​的​長​度​總​和​，​時間​包含​串接​及段​計數​；L ​為​最長​項​。​遞​迴​有​ n ​個​等待​較小項​的​框架​，​但​較​早​字串​會​在​呼叫​回傳​時釋​放​，​所以​空間​為​ O(L+n)。n<=30 ​時​深度​安全​。​不要​逐字​元​串接​不可​變結果​。​整數​輸入​不變​，​回傳​字串​為​新建​構​。

docs.title: 1. ​迭代​連續​段​掃描
docs.text:
​時間​： O(T)，T ​為​所有​產生項​的​長​度​總​和​

​空間​： O(L)，L ​為​最長​項長​度​

from itertools import groupby


class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative run scanning
    Time: O(T), summed generated term lengths
    Space: O(L), largest term length
    """

    def countAndSay(self, n: int) -> str:
        term = "1"
        for _ in range(n - 1):
            parts = []
            start = 0
            while start < len(term):
                end = start + 1
                while end < len(term) and term[end] == term[start]:
                    end += 1
                parts.extend((str(end - start), term[start]))
                start = end
            term = "".join(parts)
        return term

docs.title: 2. ​遞​迴​建構​項目
docs.text:
​時間​： O(T)，T ​為​所有​產生項​的​長​度​總​和​

​空間​： O(L+n)，​最長​項加​呼叫​框架​

from itertools import groupby


class Solution:
    """Approach: Recursive term construction
    Time: O(T), summed generated term lengths
    Space: O(L+n), largest term plus call frames
    """

    def countAndSay(self, n: int) -> str:
        def term(index):
            if index == 1:
                return "1"
            previous = term(index - 1)
            pieces = []
            for digit, group in groupby(previous):
                pieces.extend((str(sum(1 for _ in group)), digit))
            return "".join(pieces)

        return term(n)

docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​非遞​減選擇​回溯​ O(C log C + C^D*(D+1)) ​寬​鬆​上​界​ O(C+D) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​ ​由小到大​建立​組合​串列​ O(C*T + ​所有​中間​路徑​的​複​製​工作量​) O(T + ​所有​中間​路徑​的​長​度​總​和​)

docs.title: 非遞​減選擇​回溯
docs.text: ​排序​候選值​的​副本​，​並以​起始​索引​及​剩餘​總​和​回溯​。​剩餘值​為​零時​儲存​路徑​副本​。​若​某候​選值​已​超過​剩餘​總​和​，​就​停止​掃描​，​因為後面​的​值​只會​更​大​。

docs.title: 由小到大​建立​組合​串列
docs.text: ​為​每個​小計​儲存​其​組合​串列​。​外層​依​排序​後​的​候選值​處理​，​內層​遞​增掃​描小計​，​將​目前​值​附加​到​「​小計​減去​目前​值​」​的​既有​組合​。​這會​保留​中間​答案​，​可能​比​回溯​使用​多得多​的​空間​。

docs.title: 非遞​減選擇​回溯
docs.text: ​所有​值​皆​為​正​，​因此​每​一步​都​嚴格​減少​剩餘值​，​搜尋​必定​結束​。​每個​合法​多重​集合​都​有​唯一​的​非​遞減​索引​序列​，​搜尋會​走​到​該​序列​。​限制​索引​可​排除​不同​排列​，​而​不會​遺漏​任何​組合​。

docs.title: 由小到大​建立​組合​串列
docs.text: ​處理值​ v ​時​，​每個​新​組合​都​是將​ v ​附加​到​只​含​已​處理值​的​組合​。​小計遞​增讓​同一​輪能​再次​使用​ v。​每個​組合​恰好​在​處理​其​最大值​時​建立​一次​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​預設​回溯​法令​ C ​為候​選值數​，D=target//min(candidates)。​包含​路徑​複​製​的​寬​鬆​時​間​界​為​ O(C log C + C^D * (D+1))，​輔助​空間​為​ O(C+D)，​另加​輸出​。​輸入​不變​。​選取​索引​ i ​後​，​應​從​ i ​而​非​ i+1 ​遞​迴​，​才能​重​複​使用​。​非正​數會​使​終止​論證​失效​，​題目​已​排除​此情​況​。

​組合​串列​ DP ​令​ T=target，​時間​為​ O(C*T + ​所有​中間​路徑​的​複​製​工作量​)，​空間​為​ O(T + ​所有​中間​路徑​的​長​度​總​和​)。​不能​只計​最終​答案​，​還須​計入​保留​的​中間​組合​。

docs.title: 1. ​非遞​減選擇​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(C log C + C^D*(D+1)) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(C+D) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Nondecreasing backtracking
    Time: O(C log C + C^D*(D+1)) loose bound
    Space: O(C+D) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def combinationSum(self, candidates: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        values = sorted(candidates)
        result = []
        path = []

        def visit(start, remaining):
            if remaining == 0:
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            for i in range(start, len(values)):
                value = values[i]
                if value > remaining:
                    break
                path.append(value)
                visit(i, remaining - value)
                path.pop()

        visit(0, target)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​由小到大​建立​組合​串列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(C*T + ​所有​中間​路徑​的​複​製​工作量​)

​空間​： O(T + ​所有​中間​路徑​的​長​度​總​和​)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bottom-up combination lists
    Time: O(C*T + total intermediate path-copy work)
    Space: O(T + total intermediate path lengths)
    """

    def combinationSum(self, candidates: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        combinations = [[] for _ in range(target + 1)]
        combinations[0] = [[]]
        for value in sorted(candidates):
            for total in range(value, target + 1):
                combinations[total].extend(path + [value] for path in combinations[total - value])
        return combinations[target]

docs.title: 1. ​排序​索引​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n + n*2^n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted index backtracking
    Time: O(n log n + n*2^n) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def combinationSum2(self, candidates: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        values = sorted(candidates)
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(start, remaining):
            if remaining == 0:
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            for index in range(start, len(values)):
                value = values[index]
                if value > remaining:
                    break
                if index > start and value == values[index - 1]:
                    continue
                path.append(value)
                visit(index + 1, remaining - value)
                path.pop()

        visit(0, target)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​有界​重數​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n + n*product(count+1)) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Bounded multiplicity search
    Time: O(n log n + n*product(count+1)) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def combinationSum2(self, candidates: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        groups = sorted(Counter(candidates).items())
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(index, remaining):
            if remaining == 0:
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            if index == len(groups):
                return
            value, count = groups[index]
            limit = min(count, remaining // value)
            for used in range(limit + 1):
                visit(index + 1, remaining - used * value)
                if used < limit:
                    path.append(value)
            if limit:
                del path[-limit:]

        visit(0, target)
        return result

docs.title: 兩側​累積​最高​邊界
docs.text: ​前綴​與後綴​最大值​陣列​已​可​在​線性​時間​求解​。​將其儲​存量​縮​減成​兩個​累積​最大值​：​處理​已知​最大值​較​小​的​一側​，​先​用​目前​柱子​更新​最大值​，​再​累加​它​與​柱​高​的​差​。

docs.title: 單調​盆地​堆疊
docs.text: ​儲存​高度​遞減​的​索引​。​新​柱子​較​高時​，​彈出​盆底​；​剩下​的​左牆​與​新進​的​右牆​，​決定​每​一層剛​被​封住​的​積水​。

docs.title: 前綴​與後綴​最大值​陣列
docs.text: ​明確​儲存​每根​柱子​兩側​的​最高​牆​。​水深​就是​較​短​邊界​減去​柱​高​；​比雙​指標​多用​空間​，​但​每個​位置​的​計算​更​直接​。

docs.title: 兩側​累積​最高​邊界
docs.text: ​目前​柱子​若​低​於​同側​最大值​，​另​一側​已知​邊界​至少​同高​，​因此​水位​已​可​確定​；​若​柱子​更高​，​它成​為​新​邊界​，​本身​不積​水​。​每根​柱子​只會​被​確定​一次​。

docs.title: 單調​盆地​堆疊
docs.text: ​每個​彈出​的​盆底​，​貢獻​由​兩側​較​短牆​限制​的​一層​水​。​這些​水層​在​高度​或​水平​位置​上​互不​重疊​，​而且​每層​受限​積水​只會​被​封住​一次​。

docs.title: 前綴​與後綴​最大值​陣列
docs.text: ​一格​的​水位​恰好​受​兩側​最高​牆中​較​低者​限制​。​前後綴​最大值​給出​這兩個​確切​邊界​，​將各​位置​受限​的​水深​相加​，​便​恰好​計算​所有​積水​一次​。

docs.text:
​兩側​累積​邊界​：O(n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​；​單調​堆​疊​與​前後綴​陣列​：​皆​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​。​堆疊​在​更​高右牆​出現​時​結算​水層​；​陣列​法則​明確​儲存​各​位置​兩側​最高值​。

​所有​方法​都​不​修改​輸入​。​累加​水量​之前​先​更新​該側​最大值​，​才​不會產​生負​貢獻​。​單看​柱​高​不是​水位​，​兩側​邊界​都​重要​；​只有​一根​柱子​時​水量​為​零​。

docs.title: 1. ​兩側​累積​最高​邊界
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Two running side maxima
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def trap(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        left, right = 0, len(height) - 1
        left_max = right_max = water = 0
        while left <= right:
            if left_max <= right_max:
                left_max = max(left_max, height[left])
                water += left_max - height[left]
                left += 1
            else:
                right_max = max(right_max, height[right])
                water += right_max - height[right]
                right -= 1
        return water

docs.title: 2. ​單調​盆地​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Monotonic basin stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def trap(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        stack = []
        water = 0
        for right, value in enumerate(height):
            while stack and height[stack[-1]] < value:
                bottom = stack.pop()
                if not stack:
                    break
                left = stack[-1]
                water += (min(height[left], value) - height[bottom]) * (right - left - 1)
            stack.append(right)
        return water

docs.title: 3. ​前綴​與後綴​最大值​陣列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix and suffix maximum arrays
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def trap(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        prefix, suffix = height[:], height[:]
        for i in range(1, len(height)):
            prefix[i] = max(prefix[i - 1], height[i])
        for i in range(len(height) - 2, -1, -1):
            suffix[i] = max(suffix[i + 1], height[i])
        return sum(min(prefix[i], suffix[i]) - value for i, value in enumerate(height))

docs.text: ​輸入​位置​ i、j ​的​數位​乘積​貢獻到​十進​位格​ i+j+1。​把​累積格​分成​數位​與​進位​不​改數值​，​每個​數位​配對​乘積​都​恰加​一次​。

docs.title: 部分​乘積​字串​與​加法
docs.text: ​單位​數帶​進位​乘法​精確​得到​各位​值​的​部分​乘積​。​依​位移​加總對​應​第二​輸入​的​分配律​展開​，​因此​最終​字串​就是​乘積​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​數位​陣列​直式​乘法​：​時間​ O(mn)；​空間​ O(m+n)。

​部分​乘積​字串​與​加法​：​時間​ O(mn+n^2)；​空間​ O(m+n)。

​輸入​不變​；m、n ​為​位數​。​允許​逐位數​的​整數​運算​，​但將​整個​輸入​轉成​ int，​或​回​傳多餘​前導​零​，​都​違反題​目意​圖​。

docs.title: 1. ​數位​陣列​直式​乘法
docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn)

​空間​： O(m+n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Digit-array grade-school multiplication
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(m+n)
    """

    def multiply(self, num1: str, num2: str) -> str:
        digits = [0] * (len(num1) + len(num2))
        for i in range(len(num1) - 1, -1, -1):
            for j in range(len(num2) - 1, -1, -1):
                total = digits[i + j + 1] + (ord(num1[i]) - 48) * (ord(num2[j]) - 48)
                digits[i + j + 1] = total % 10
                digits[i + j] += total // 10
        return "".join(map(str, digits)).lstrip("0") or "0"

docs.title: 2. ​部分​乘積​字串​與​加法
docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn+n^2)

​空間​： O(m+n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Partial-product strings and addition
    Time: O(mn+n squared)
    Space: O(m+n)
    """

    def multiply(self, num1: str, num2: str) -> str:
        def add(left, right):
            i, j, carry = len(left) - 1, len(right) - 1, 0
            digits = []
            while i >= 0 or j >= 0 or carry:
                total = carry
                if i >= 0:
                    total += ord(left[i]) - 48
                    i -= 1
                if j >= 0:
                    total += ord(right[j]) - 48
                    j -= 1
                carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)
                digits.append(str(digit))
            return "".join(reversed(digits))

        answer = "0"
        for shift, char in enumerate(reversed(num2)):
            carry = 0
            digits = []
            for other in reversed(num1):
                carry, digit = divmod((ord(char) - 48) * (ord(other) - 48) + carry, 10)
                digits.append(str(digit))
            if carry:
                digits.append(str(carry))
            partial = "".join(reversed(digits)) + "0" * shift
            answer = add(answer, partial)
        return answer.lstrip("0") or "0"

docs.title: 在​最近​星號​重試​的​貪婪​法
docs.text: ​普通​字元​盡​可能​先​匹配​，​記住​最近​星號​及​目前​吸收​至​哪個​文字​位置​。​遇​不​匹配​，​就​讓​該​星號​多​吸收​一字並​重試​它後面​的​模式​。

docs.title: 滾動​萬​用字​元前​綴​表
docs.text: ​每個​文字​前綴​計算​全部​模式​前綴​匹配​。​星號​可取​左方​表示​零字​，​或​上方​表示​多一字​；​普通​ token ​用​匹配​的​對​角狀態​。

docs.title: 在​最近​星號​重試​的​貪婪​法
docs.text: ​固定​星號​時​，​先試​短​分配​再​試長​分配​。​一旦​走到​更後面​的​星號​，​原先​星號​能​多​吸收​的​字​元​，​後​者​也​能​吸收​，​因此​只​需​保留​最近​的​重試點​。

docs.title: 滾動​萬​用字​元前​綴​表
docs.text: ​星號​依其​最​後​消耗​序列​是否​為空​，​把​匹配​分成​兩類​。​普通​ token ​恰​消耗​一字​，​因此​遞​推​完整​且​只​接受​合法​整​字串​匹配​。

docs.text: ​模式​ "a*b?" ​可​匹配​ "axxbz"；​最後問號​消耗​ z。

m、n ​分別​為​文字​與​模式​長​度​。​貪婪​重試​可能​反覆​掃描​很長​的​字面​後​綴​，​最差​情況​不是​線性​。​輸入​不變​；glob ​星號​和​正規​表示​式​星號​的​意義​不同​。

docs.title: 1. ​在​最近​星號​重試​的​貪婪​法
docs.text:
​時間​： O((m+1)*(n+1)) ​最差​情況​

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Greedy retry at the latest star
    Time: O((m+1)*(n+1)) worst case
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def isMatch(self, s: str, p: str) -> bool:
        i = j = 0
        star = -1
        consumed = 0
        while i < len(s):
            if j < len(p) and (p[j] == "?" or p[j] == s[i]):
                i += 1
                j += 1
            elif j < len(p) and p[j] == "*":
                star = j
                consumed = i
                j += 1
            elif star >= 0:
                consumed += 1
                i, j = consumed, star + 1
            else:
                return False
        while j < len(p) and p[j] == "*":
            j += 1
        return j == len(p)

docs.title: 2. ​滾動​萬​用字​元前​綴​表
docs.text:
​時間​： O((m+1)*(n+1))

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Rolling wildcard prefix table
    Time: O((m+1)*(n+1))
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def isMatch(self, s: str, p: str) -> bool:
        previous = [True] + [False] * len(p)
        for j, atom in enumerate(p, 1):
            previous[j] = previous[j - 1] and atom == "*"
        for character in s:
            current = [False] * (len(p) + 1)
            for j, atom in enumerate(p, 1):
                current[j] = (
                    current[j - 1] or previous[j]
                    if atom == "*"
                    else previous[j - 1] and atom in ("?", character)
                )
            previous = current
        return previous[-1]

docs.title: 貪婪​跳躍層​邊界
docs.text: ​掃描​目前​跳躍層​的​全部​位置​，​記錄​其中​任一​位置​能​到​的​最遠​索引​。​抵達​本層​終點​時​，​增加​一次​跳躍​，​並用​最遠​索引​作為​下​一層​邊界​。​不要​把​目的地​當成​還要​再​起跳​的​位置​。

docs.title: 對​目的​位置​做動態​規劃
docs.text: ​保存​到​各​位置​的​最小​跳數​，​並從​每個​索引​鬆​弛​所有​可達​目的​位置​。​對​很長​且​可​跳​範圍​密集​的​輸入​，​此教學​基準​可能​逾時​。

docs.title: 貪婪​跳躍層​邊界
docs.text: ​增加​跳數​之前​，​以​目前​跳數​可達​的​所有​位置​都​已​貢獻​它​的​向​外範圍​。​因此​新邊界​恰好​是​多​跳​一次​能​到​的​最遠處​；​首次​到​達​目的地​時​，​使用​的​層數​最少​。

docs.title: 對​目的​位置​做動態​規劃
docs.text: ​每次​跳躍只​會​進入​更​大​索引​，​因此​依​索引​遞增​處理​，​會​在​鬆​弛​向​外​邊​之前​先確定​全部​前驅​距離​。​取得​的​最小​距離​就是​最佳​跳數​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: [2,3,1,1,1] ​第一次​跳躍涵​蓋​索引​ 1、2；​它們​最遠​能​到​ 4，​因此​第二次​即可​到​達​目的地​，​回傳​ 2。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​層​邊界法​：O(n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​。​逐​目的​位置​ DP：O(n²) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​，​密集​跳躍​可能​逾時​。​兩者​都​不​修改​輸入​。

​迴​圈​只​跑​到​ n-2，​避免​在​目的地​多算​一次​跳躍​。​可達性​保證​很​重要​；​預設​方法​沒有​為​不可​達輸​入定​義失敗​回傳值​。

docs.title: 1. ​貪婪​跳躍層​邊界
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Greedy jump-layer frontier
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def jump(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        jumps = end = farthest = 0
        for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
            farthest = max(farthest, i + nums[i])
            if i == end:
                jumps += 1
                end = farthest
        return jumps

docs.title: 2. ​對​目的​位置​做動態​規劃
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dynamic programming over destinations
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def jump(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        distance = [len(nums)] * len(nums)
        distance[0] = 0
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            for destination in range(i + 1, min(len(nums), i + value + 1)):
                distance[destination] = min(distance[destination], distance[i] + 1)
        return distance[-1]

docs.title: 未​使用​索引​回溯
docs.text: ​維護​目前​路徑​與​已用​索引​集合​。​嘗試​每個​未用​索引​，​附加​其值後遞​迴​，​再​還原​路徑​與​已用​集合​。​只有​路徑​包含​所有​值時​才​儲存​副本​。

docs.title: 逐輪​插入​排列
docs.text: ​從空​排列​開始​。​每次​取下​一個值​，​將它​插入​每個​既有​排列​的​每個​可能​位置​。​各輪​都​建立​新​的​串列​，​因此​不必​記錄​及​撤銷​共用​路徑​的​修改​。

docs.title: 未​使用​索引​回溯
docs.text: ​深度​ d ​的​路徑​由​ d ​個​不同​輸入​位置​組成​。​嘗試​每個​未用​位置​，​就​涵蓋​所有​可能​的​下​一步​。​每個​完整​排列​都​有​唯一​的​選擇​序列​，​因此​全部​ n! ​個​排列​都​恰好​出現​一次​。

docs.title: 逐輪​插入​排列
docs.text: ​從​任意​排列​移除​最新​加入​的​值​，​會​得到​唯一​的​上​一輪​排列​及​插入​位置​。​這個​一一​對應​證明​每個​完整​排列​都​只會產生​一次​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​預設​回溯​法將​答案​複​製​及​候​選​掃​描​計​入​後​，​時間​為​ O(n * n!)，​輔助​空間​為​ O(n)，​輸出​空間​為​ O(n * n!)。​輸入​不變​。​每次​遞​迴​後​都​要​還原​已用​集合​。​若​限制​只能​選​起始​索引​之​後​的​位置​，​得到​的​是​組合​，​無法​涵蓋​所有​排列​；​本​解法​也​依賴輸​入值​互異​的​條件​。

​逐輪​插入法​時間​為​ O(nn!)，​儲存​新舊​排列​及輸出​的​空間​為​ O(nn!)。

docs.title: 1. ​未​使用​索引​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*n!)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​；O(n*n!) ​輸出​空間​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Unused-index backtracking
    Time: O(n*n!)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary; O(n*n!) output
    """

    def permute(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        path = []
        used = set()

        def visit():
            if len(path) == len(nums):
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            for i, value in enumerate(nums):
                if i in used:
                    continue
                used.add(i)
                path.append(value)
                visit()
                path.pop()
                used.remove(i)

        visit()
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​逐輪​插入​排列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*n!)

​空間​： O(n*n!)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative insertion
    Time: O(n*n!)
    Space: O(n*n!)
    """

    def permute(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = [[]]
        for value in nums:
            result = [
                path[:index] + [value] + path[index:]
                for path in result
                for index in range(len(path) + 1)
            ]
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​排序​後​搜​尋未用​索引
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*n!) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​；O(n*P) ​輸出​空間​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted unused-index search
    Time: O(n*n!) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary; O(n*P) output
    """

    def permuteUnique(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        values = sorted(nums)
        used = [False] * len(values)
        path, result = [], []

        def visit():
            if len(path) == len(values):
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            for index, value in enumerate(values):
                if used[index] or (index and value == values[index - 1] and not used[index - 1]):
                    continue
                used[index] = True
                path.append(value)
                visit()
                path.pop()
                used[index] = False

        visit()
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​剩餘​頻率​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*n!) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​；O(n*P) ​輸出​空間​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Remaining-frequency search
    Time: O(n*n!) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary; O(n*P) output
    """

    def permuteUnique(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        counts = Counter(nums)
        result, path = [], []

        def visit():
            if len(path) == len(nums):
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            for value in counts:
                if counts[value]:
                    counts[value] -= 1
                    path.append(value)
                    visit()
                    path.pop()
                    counts[value] += 1

        visit()
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​轉置​後​反轉​各列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Transpose then reverse rows
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def rotate(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> None:
        size = len(matrix)
        for row in range(size):
            for col in range(row + 1, size):
                matrix[row][col], matrix[col][row] = matrix[col][row], matrix[row][col]
        for row in matrix:
            row.reverse()

docs.title: 2. ​逐層​四格​循環
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Four-cell layer cycles
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def rotate(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> None:
        size = len(matrix)
        for first in range(size // 2):
            last = size - 1 - first
            for col in range(first, last):
                offset = col - first
                top = matrix[first][col]
                matrix[first][col] = matrix[last - offset][first]
                matrix[last - offset][first] = matrix[last][last - offset]
                matrix[last][last - offset] = matrix[col][last]
                matrix[col][last] = top

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​字元​頻率​特徵​ O(nL) O(nL) ​排序​後​的​字串​特徵​ O(nL log L) O(nL)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 字元​頻率​特徵
docs.text: ​逐一​比較​所有​單字會重​複​做工​。​統計​每個​單字​的​ 26 ​個​字母​次數​，​以次數​ tuple ​作為​字典​鍵​，​把​原單​字​附加​到​對​應​群組​。

docs.title: 排序​後​的​字串​特徵
docs.text: ​將每個​單字​的​字​元​排序​，​得到​標準​形式​，​再​依此​分組​。​此法​較​容易​支援​任意​字母表​，​但​每個​單字​都​要​付出​排序​成本​。

docs.title: 字元​頻率​特徵
docs.text: ​兩個​單字​互為​字母​異位​詞​，​若且唯若​全部​ 26 ​個次數​相等​。​因此​每個鍵​收集​完整​的​一組​異位​詞​，​不同​類別​也​不會​混​在​一起​。

docs.title: 排序​後​的​字串​特徵
docs.text: ​排序​後​的​字​元​序列​相等​，​若且唯若​每個​字​元​的​出​現次數​相等​。​因此​依​這個鍵​分組​，​恰好​得到​所有​異位​詞類​別​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ["ab", "ba", "bb"] ​的​前​兩個​單字​都​是​ a=1、b=1，​屬​於​同一​組​；​最後一個則​是​ b=2。​結果​為​ [["ab", "ba"], ["bb"]]。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​預設​的​字​元​頻率​法​：​令​ C ​為​總字元數​、n ​為​單字數​，​時間​為​ O(C + 26n)，​最壞​的​鍵​儲存​空間​為​ O(26n)，​另有​ O(n) ​個​輸出​參照​。​若以​最長​單字長​度​ L ​表示​，​寬​鬆​上​界​為​ O(nL) ​時間​與​空間​。

​排序​特徵法​為​ O(nL log L) ​時間​、O(nL) ​空間​；​對​任意​字母表​較​直接​，​但​必須​排序​每個​單字​。

​兩者​都​不​修改​輸入​。​鍵​必須​使用​ tuple，​不能​用​ list。​空單​字​共用​全零​的​鍵​；​只用​字母​集合​會​遺失出​現次數​。

docs.title: 1. ​字元​頻率​特徵
docs.text:
​時間​： O(nL)

​空間​： O(nL)

from collections import defaultdict


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency signatures
    Time: O(nL)
    Space: O(nL)
    """

    def groupAnagrams(self, strs: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for word in strs:
            counts = [0] * 26
            for char in word:
                counts[ord(char) - ord("a")] += 1
            groups[tuple(counts)].append(word)
        return list(groups.values())

docs.title: 2. ​排序​後​的​字串​特徵
docs.text:
​時間​： O(nL log L)

​空間​： O(nL)

from collections import defaultdict


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted signatures
    Time: O(nL log L)
    Space: O(nL)
    """

    def groupAnagrams(self, strs: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        groups = {}
        for word in strs:
            key = "".join(sorted(word))
            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(word)
        return list(groups.values())

​輸入​不變​。​浮點​捨​入屬​預期​現象​。Python ​可以​將​最小​帶號​ 32 ​位元​指數​取負​而​不溢位​。

docs.title: 1. ​迭代​二​進位​快速​冪
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log(abs(n)+1))

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative binary exponentiation
    Time: O(log(abs(n)+1))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def myPow(self, x: float, n: int) -> float:
        if n < 0:
            x, n = 1 / x, -n
        answer = 1.0
        while n:
            if n & 1:
                answer *= x
            x *= x
            n >>= 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​遞​迴​指數​減半
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log(abs(n)+1))

​空間​： O(log(abs(n)+1))

class Solution:
    """Approach: Recursive exponent halving
    Time: O(log(abs(n)+1))
    Space: O(log(abs(n)+1))
    """

    def myPow(self, x: float, n: int) -> float:
        if n < 0:
            x, n = 1 / x, -n

        def power(exponent):
            if exponent == 0:
                return 1.0
            half = power(exponent // 2)
            answer = half * half
            return answer * x if exponent % 2 else answer

        return power(n)

docs.title: 位移​攻擊​遮罩
docs.text: ​以位​元​遮罩​表示​下​一列​受到​的​欄​與​對​角線​攻擊​。​對​其​補數​與​ n ​欄​有效​遮罩​取​交集​，​取得​可​放​位置​，​再​逐次​取出​最低​設​定位​元​。​進入​下​一列​時​，​將兩個​對​角線​遮罩​往​相反​方向​位移​。

docs.title: 欄​與​對​角線​集合
docs.text: ​每列​一個​皇后​自動​滿足列​限制​，​三個​集合​則精確​排除​其餘​攻擊​。​每個​合法​棋盤​都​對​應​唯一​的​逐列​欄位​選擇​序列​，​因此​遞​迴​會​走訪​它​一次​。

docs.title: 位移​攻擊​遮罩
docs.text: ​皇后​對下​一列​的​兩種​對​角線​攻擊​，​會​分別​往​相反​方向​移動​一欄​。​位移​遮罩​可精確​維護​禁止​欄位​，​只選空​閒位​元​就​會將​每個​安全​棋盤枚舉​一次​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​預設​集合​法​的​寬​鬆​搜​尋​界​為​ O(n * n!)，​將​ S ​個​答案​實體​化成​棋盤​另​需​ O(S * n^2) ​時間​。​輔助​搜尋空間​為​ O(n)，​輸出​空間​為​ O(S * n^2)。​所有​狀態​都​由此​次呼叫​持有​。​遞​迴​後​必須​還原​三個​限制​；row+column ​與​ row-column ​屬​於​不同​對角線​家族​，​識別值​應分​開儲存​。

​位移​遮罩​法​的​寬​鬆​時​間​界​同​為​ O(nn! + Sn^2)，​輔助​空間​ O(n)，​輸出​空間​ O(S*n^2)。

docs.title: 1. ​欄​與​對​角線​集合
docs.text:
​時間​： O(nn! + Sn^2) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​；O(S*n^2) ​輸出​空間​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Column and diagonal sets
    Time: O(n*n! + S*n^2) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary; O(S*n^2) output
    """

    def solveNQueens(self, n: int) -> list[list[str]]:
        result = []
        path = []
        columns, ascending, descending = set(), set(), set()

        def visit(row):
            if row == n:
                result.append(["." * col + "Q" + "." * (n - col - 1) for col in path])
                return
            for col in range(n):
                if col in columns or row + col in ascending or row - col in descending:
                    continue
                columns.add(col)
                ascending.add(row + col)
                descending.add(row - col)
                path.append(col)
                visit(row + 1)
                path.pop()
                columns.remove(col)
                ascending.remove(row + col)
                descending.remove(row - col)

        visit(0)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​位移​攻擊​遮罩
docs.text:
​時間​： O(nn! + Sn^2) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​；O(S*n^2) ​輸出​空間​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Shifted attack masks
    Time: O(n*n! + S*n^2) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary; O(S*n^2) output
    """

    def solveNQueens(self, n: int) -> list[list[str]]:
        full = (1 << n) - 1
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(columns, left, right):
            if columns == full:
                result.append(["." * col + "Q" + "." * (n - col - 1) for col in path])
                return
            free = full & ~(columns | left | right)
            while free:
                bit = free & -free
                free -= bit
                path.append(bit.bit_length() - 1)
                visit(columns | bit, ((left | bit) << 1) & full, (right | bit) >> 1)
                path.pop()

        visit(0, 0, 0)
        return result

docs.title: 1. Kadane ​結尾​最佳​狀態
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Kadane ending-here states
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def maxSubArray(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        ending = answer = nums[0]
        for index in range(1, len(nums)):
            ending = max(nums[index], ending + nums[index])
            answer = max(answer, ending)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​依中點​分治
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(log n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Divide and conquer across a midpoint
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(log n)
    """

    def maxSubArray(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        def solve(left, right):
            if right - left == 1:
                return nums[left]
            middle = (left + right) // 2
            left_sum = right_sum = -float("inf")
            total = 0
            for index in range(middle - 1, left - 1, -1):
                total += nums[index]
                left_sum = max(left_sum, total)
            total = 0
            for index in range(middle, right):
                total += nums[index]
                right_sum = max(right_sum, total)
            return max(solve(left, middle), solve(middle, right), left_sum + right_sum)

        return solve(0, len(nums))

docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Shrinking rectangular boundaries
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def spiralOrder(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        top, bottom, left, right = 0, len(matrix) - 1, 0, len(matrix[0]) - 1
        answer = []
        while top <= bottom and left <= right:
            for col in range(left, right + 1):
                answer.append(matrix[top][col])
            top += 1
            for row in range(top, bottom + 1):
                answer.append(matrix[row][right])
            right -= 1
            if top <= bottom:
                for col in range(right, left - 1, -1):
                    answer.append(matrix[bottom][col])
                bottom -= 1
            if left <= right:
                for row in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
                    answer.append(matrix[row][left])
                left += 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​已訪​格子​與​方向​模擬
docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn)

​空間​： O(mn)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Direction simulation with visited cells
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(mn)
    """

    def spiralOrder(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        rows, cols = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
        visited = [[False] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
        directions = ((0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0))
        row = col = direction = 0
        answer = []
        for _ in range(rows * cols):
            answer.append(matrix[row][col])
            visited[row][col] = True
            dr, dc = directions[direction]
            nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc
            if not (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols) or visited[nr][nc]:
                direction = (direction + 1) % 4
                dr, dc = directions[direction]
            row, col = row + dr, col + dc
        return answer

docs.title: 向前​擴張​可達​邊界

docs.title: 1. ​向前​擴張​可達​邊界
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward reachable frontier
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def canJump(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        farthest = 0
        for i, distance in enumerate(nums):
            if i > farthest:
                return False
            farthest = max(farthest, i + distance)
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​由​後​往前​移動​目標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Backward goal movement
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def canJump(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        goal = len(nums) - 1
        for i in range(len(nums) - 2, -1, -1):
            if i + nums[i] >= goal:
                goal = i
        return goal == 0

docs.text: ​起點​排序​後​，​新區間​若​從​前​一個​合​併​終點​之後才​開始​，​就​建立​新輸出​；​否則視​需要​延伸​終點​。​每個​輸出​都​新建​串列​，​避免​修改​呼叫​端區間​。

docs.title: 掃​描端點​事件
docs.text: ​排序​起​終點​事件​，​相同​座標​先處理​起點​。​有效​覆蓋數​從​零變​正時​開始​輸出​區間​，​回到​零時​結束​。

docs.title: 依起點​排序​區間
docs.text: ​新起點​若​超出​目前​合​併​終點​，​更​晚起​點也​一樣​超出​，​因此​目前​區間​已​完成​。​重疊區​間​延伸​的​是​同一​個​連通​覆蓋區域​，​取​最大​終點​可​保存​完整​聯集​。

docs.title: 掃​描端點​事件
docs.text: ​有效​計數​就是​目前​掃描線​段​被​多少​區間​覆蓋​。​最大​的​正計​數線​段​恰好​構成合​併​聯集​；​相同​座標​先處理​起點​，​可合​併​相接​區間​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​兩者​皆​為​ O(n log n) ​時間​、O(n) ​輔助​排序​或​事件​空間​，​另加​輸出​。

​輸入​及其​內層​串列​不變​。​被​包含​的​區間​不能​把​合​併​終點​縮​短​。​本題​的​重疊​規則​與​「​不​重疊區​間​」​不同​；​後​者​允許​保留​端點​相接​的​兩段​。

​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n) ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort intervals by start
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n) plus output
    """

    def merge(self, intervals: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        for start, end in sorted(intervals):
            if result and start <= result[-1][1]:
                result[-1][1] = max(result[-1][1], end)
            else:
                result.append([start, end])
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​掃​描端點​事件
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n) ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sweep endpoint events
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n) plus output
    """

    def merge(self, intervals: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        events = [
            (point, kind) for start, end in intervals for point, kind in ((start, 1), (end, -1))
        ]
        events.sort(key=lambda event: (event[0], -event[1]))
        active = 0
        result = []
        for point, change in events:
            if active == 0:
                start = point
            active += change
            if active == 0:
                result.append([start, point])
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​三階段​區間​掃描
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Three-phase interval scan
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def insert(self, intervals: list[list[int]], newInterval: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        start, end = newInterval
        i = 0
        while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][1] < start:
            result.append(intervals[i][:])
            i += 1
        while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][0] <= end:
            start = min(start, intervals[i][0])
            end = max(end, intervals[i][1])
            i += 1
        result.append([start, end])
        while i < len(intervals):
            result.append(intervals[i][:])
            i += 1
        return result

​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n) ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort and merge all intervals
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n) plus output
    """

    def insert(self, intervals: list[list[int]], newInterval: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        for start, end in sorted([*intervals, newInterval]):
            if result and start <= result[-1][1]:
                result[-1][1] = max(result[-1][1], end)
            else:
                result.append([start, end])
        return result

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Layer boundary filling
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def generateMatrix(self, n: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        matrix = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        top, bottom, left, right, value = 0, n - 1, 0, n - 1, 1
        while top <= bottom and left <= right:
            for col in range(left, right + 1):
                matrix[top][col] = value
                value += 1
            top += 1
            for row in range(top, bottom + 1):
                matrix[row][right] = value
                value += 1
            right -= 1
            if top <= bottom:
                for col in range(right, left - 1, -1):
                    matrix[bottom][col] = value
                    value += 1
                bottom -= 1
            if left <= right:
                for row in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
                    matrix[row][left] = value
                    value += 1
                left += 1
        return matrix

docs.title: 2. ​以輸出​標記​的​方向​模擬
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Output-marked direction simulation
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def generateMatrix(self, n: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        matrix = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        directions = ((0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0))
        row = col = direction = 0
        for value in range(1, n * n + 1):
            matrix[row][col] = value
            dr, dc = directions[direction]
            nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc
            if not (0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < n) or matrix[nr][nc]:
                direction = (direction + 1) % 4
                dr, dc = directions[direction]
            row, col = row + dr, col + dc
        return matrix

docs.title: 1. ​階乘區​塊​選取
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Factorial block selection
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def getPermutation(self, n: int, k: int) -> str:
        factorials = [1] * (n + 1)
        for index in range(1, n + 1):
            factorials[index] = factorials[index - 1] * index
        available = list(map(str, range(1, n + 1)))
        k -= 1
        result = []
        for remaining in range(n, 0, -1):
            index, k = divmod(k, factorials[remaining - 1])
            result.append(available.pop(index))
        return "".join(result)

docs.title: 2. ​反覆​求下​一個​排列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k*n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Repeated next permutation
    Time: O(k*n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def getPermutation(self, n: int, k: int) -> str:
        values = list(range(1, n + 1))
        for _ in range(k - 1):
            pivot = n - 2
            while values[pivot] >= values[pivot + 1]:
                pivot -= 1
            successor = n - 1
            while values[successor] <= values[pivot]:
                successor -= 1
            values[pivot], values[successor] = values[successor], values[pivot]
            values[pivot + 1 :] = reversed(values[pivot + 1 :])
        return "".join(map(str, values))

docs.text: ​將​所有​原節點​收集​到​陣列​，​把​最​後​ k ​個​參考切​到​前面​，​再​按​新​順序​重新​連接​。​緩衝區​儲存​的​是​原節點​參考​，​不會​建立​替代​節點​。

docs.title: 接成​環後切​開
docs.text: ​旋轉​不​改變​節點​的​環狀​相對​順序​，​只​改變​起點​。​將切點​放在​最​後​ k ​個​節點​之前​，​就​會​依序​得到​這​ k ​個​節點​與​原本​的​前段​。

docs.title: 重排​節點​參考
docs.text: ​將最​後​ k ​個​參考​接到​前段​之前​，​直接​形成​旋轉​的​定義​，​且​兩段​內部​的​順序​都​保持​不變​。​重新​連接​後​即可​得到​相同​的​節點​排列​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​接環法​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​；​陣列法​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​。​兩者​都​修改​ next，​保留​節點​身份​和​值​。​空串列​必須​在​取餘數​前​處理​，​避免​除以​零​；​縮減​後​ k=0 ​時​可​直接​回傳​，​不必​重新​接線​。​暫時​建立​的​環必須​切斷​。

docs.title: 1. ​接成​環後切​開
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Circularize then cut
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def rotateRight(self, head: ListNode | None, k: int) -> ListNode | None:
        if head is None:
            return None
        tail, length = head, 1
        while tail.next:
            tail = tail.next
            length += 1
        k %= length
        if k == 0:
            return head
        tail.next = head
        before = head
        for _ in range(length - k - 1):
            before = before.next
        result = before.next
        before.next = None
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​重排​節點​參考
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Reorder node references
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def rotateRight(self, head: ListNode | None, k: int) -> ListNode | None:
        order = []
        while head:
            order.append(head)
            head = head.next
        if not order:
            return None
        k %= len(order)
        order = order[-k:] + order[:-k] if k else order
        for index, node in enumerate(order):
            node.next = order[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(order) else None
        return order[0]

docs.text: ​計算​ m ​列​ n ​欄無障礙​格子​中​，​從​左上​到​右​下​的​路​徑數​；​每步​只能​向​右​或​向下​一​格​。

  2. ​保留​前​一列​，​計算​新列時​重用​各項​。

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​壓縮​列路徑​計數​ O(m*n) O(min(m,n)) ​選擇​向下​步驟​的​位置​ O(min(m,n)) ​次算術​運算​ O(1) ​個​整數​物件​

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 壓縮​列路徑​計數
docs.text: ​把​較​小維度​當作列​寬​以省​記憶體​。​首列​每格​只有​一條​路徑​，​故​初值​皆​為​一​。​後​續​各列​由​左​往右​做​ dp[column] += dp[column-1]；​舊項​是​上方​貢獻​，​已​更新​左項​是​左方​貢獻​，​第一​欄維持​一​。

docs.title: 選擇​向下​步驟​的​位置
docs.text: ​每條​路​有​ m-1 ​次​向下​、n-1 ​次​向​右​。​以​精確​二項​係​數​，​選​固定​長​度​步驟​序列​中​哪些​ m-1 ​個​位置​向下​。​逐​因子​相乘​，​每次​做​整除​累積​係​數​。

docs.title: 壓縮​列路徑​計數
docs.text: ​最​後​一步​把​路徑​唯一​分成​上方​與​左方​兩組​，​兩組​互斥​，​相加​恰計數​一次​。​邊界​只有​一條​路​。​依列​與​欄歸納​，​各項​皆​正確​；​交換​兩個​維度​不​改變​右​／​下路​徑數​。

docs.title: 選擇​向下​步驟​的​位置
docs.text: ​路徑​與​向下​步驟​位置​的​子集​一一​對應​：​讀取​子集​可​還原​唯一​走法​，​記錄​走法​則得​該​子集​。​因此​數​子集​就​精確數​出路​徑​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​壓縮​列路徑​計數​：​時間​ O(m*n)；​空間​ O(min(m,n))。

​選擇​向下​步驟​的​位置​：​時間​ O(min(m,n)) ​次算術​運算​；​空間​ O(1) ​個​整數​物件​。

​預設法​ O(m*n) ​時間​、O(min(m,n)) ​輔助​空間​，​不​更​動維度​。​必須​由​左​往右​更新​，​才​會​使用​本列​的​左方​貢獻​。​單列​或​單欄​自然​只有​一條​路​；​每條​右​／​下​合法​路徑​同長​，​不需​ BFS。​組​合法​免去​格子​表​，​但​精確​乘除​使用​任意​精度​整數​，​位元​成本​與​整數儲​存量​隨結果​成長​。

docs.title: 1. ​壓縮​列路徑​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n)

​空間​： O(min(m,n))

class Solution:
    """Approach: Compressed row counts
    Time: O(m*n)
    Space: O(min(m,n))
    """

    def uniquePaths(self, m: int, n: int) -> int:
        width, height = min(m, n), max(m, n)
        dp = [1] * width
        for _ in range(1, height):
            for column in range(1, width):
                dp[column] += dp[column - 1]
        return dp[-1]

docs.title: 2. ​選擇​向下​步驟​的​位置
docs.text:
​時間​： O(min(m,n)) ​次算術​運算​

​空間​： O(1) ​個​整數​物件​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Choose the down-step positions
    Time: O(min(m,n)) arithmetic operations
    Space: O(1) integer objects
    """

    def uniquePaths(self, m: int, n: int) -> int:
        steps = m + n - 2
        chosen = min(m - 1, n - 1)
        result = 1
        for count in range(1, chosen + 1):
            result = result * (steps - count + 1) // count
        return result

docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Rolling obstacle-aware row
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(C)
    """

    def uniquePathsWithObstacles(self, obstacleGrid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        dp = [0] * len(obstacleGrid[0])
        dp[0] = 1
        for row in obstacleGrid:
            for column, blocked in enumerate(row):
                if blocked:
                    dp[column] = 0
                elif column:
                    dp[column] += dp[column - 1]
        return dp[-1]

docs.title: 2. ​補邊界​的​完整​路​徑表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Padded full path table
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def uniquePathsWithObstacles(self, obstacleGrid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, columns = len(obstacleGrid), len(obstacleGrid[0])
        table = [[0] * (columns + 1) for _ in range(rows + 1)]
        table[0][1] = 1
        for row in range(1, rows + 1):
            for column in range(1, columns + 1):
                if not obstacleGrid[row - 1][column - 1]:
                    table[row][column] = table[row - 1][column] + table[row][column - 1]
        return table[-1][-1]

docs.title: 1. ​壓縮​最小​成本​列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Compressed minimum-cost row
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(C)
    """

    def minPathSum(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        dp = [float("inf")] * len(grid[0])
        dp[0] = 0
        for row in grid:
            for column, value in enumerate(row):
                left = dp[column - 1] if column else float("inf")
                dp[column] = min(dp[column], left) + value
        return dp[-1]

docs.title: 2. ​加權​格子​最​短路​徑
docs.text:
​時間​： O(RC log(RC))

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Shortest path on weighted grid
    Time: O(R*C log(R*C))
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def minPathSum(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from heapq import heappop, heappush

        rows, columns = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        best = {(0, 0): grid[0][0]}
        heap = [(grid[0][0], 0, 0)]
        while heap:
            cost, row, column = heappop(heap)
            if best[(row, column)] != cost:
                continue
            if (row, column) == (rows - 1, columns - 1):
                return cost
            for nr, nc in ((row + 1, column), (row, column + 1)):
                if nr < rows and nc < columns:
                    following = cost + grid[nr][nc]
                    if following < best.get((nr, nc), float("inf")):
                        best[(nr, nc)] = following
                        heappush(heap, (following, nr, nc))
        return 0

docs.title: 切分​元件​後​歸​約
docs.text: ​以斜​線切​開路徑​，​將​元件​歸約成​目錄​堆疊​，​再接​回根​目錄​底下​的​路徑​。

docs.title: 逐字​元​串流​解析
docs.text: ​逐字​元​掃描​，​每​遇到​斜線​就​送​出​一個​元件​，​避免​另外​儲存​所有​切分​元件​的​陣列​。

docs.title: 切分​元件​後​歸​約
docs.text: ​處理​每個​元件​後​，​堆疊​都​是​截至​目前​的​標準​路徑​。​普通​名稱​向下​走​，. ​保持​原位​，.. ​則在​可能​時​移除​最​後​一次​向​下移​動​。

docs.title: 逐字​元​串流​解析

docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​，​輸入​不變​。​這是​詞法​層面​的​路​徑標​準化​，​不會​查詢​檔案​系統​或​解析​符號​連結​。​兩種​方法​都​保留​根目錄​斜線​。

docs.title: 1. ​切分​元件​後​歸​約
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Split components and reduce
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def simplifyPath(self, path: str) -> str:
        directories = []
        for part in path.split("/"):
            if part == "..":
                if directories:
                    directories.pop()
            elif part and part != ".":
                directories.append(part)
        return "/" + "/".join(directories)

docs.title: 2. ​逐字​元​串流​解析
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Streaming character parser
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def simplifyPath(self, path: str) -> str:
        directories, component = [], []
        for char in path + "/":
            if char != "/":
                component.append(char)
                continue
            name = "".join(component)
            component.clear()
            if name == "..":
                if directories:
                    directories.pop()
            elif name and name != ".":
                directories.append(name)
        return "/" + "/".join(directories)

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​把​一個​字串​轉成​另​一個​字串​，​求​單字元​插入​、​刪除​、​替換​的​最少​次數​；​每次​操作​成本​一​。

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​以一個​前綴​轉成​另​一個​前綴​定義狀態​。
  2. ​最​後​操作​取決​於​上方​、​左方​或​對​角前​綴​狀態​。
​展開​解法​、​複​雜度​比​較​、​證明​與​ Python ​程式​

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​滾動​編輯​距​離列​ O(m*n+m+n) O(min(m,n)+1) ​完整​前綴​編輯表​ O((m+1)*(n+1)) O((m+1)*(n+1))

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 滾動​編輯​距​離列
docs.text: ​編輯​距離​具對​稱性​，​故以​短​字串​為欄​。dp[j]=j ​代表​空來源​需​ j ​次​插入​；​來源​第​ i ​列設​ dp[0]=i ​表示​刪除​。​左​往右​時​保存​舊​對角​；​字​元​相同​沿用​對角​，​否則​取上​、​左​、​對角​最小值​加一​，​分別​代表​刪除​、​插入​、​替換​。

docs.title: 完整​前綴​編輯表
docs.text: ​儲存​所有​前綴​配對​距離​，​首列​為​插入​數​、​首欄​為​刪​除數​，​再​填​匹配​對角​或​最​便宜​編輯​前態​。

docs.title: 滾動​編輯​距​離列
docs.text: ​任何​最佳​轉換​不是​匹配​末字​，​就是​以三種​允許​編輯​之一​結束​。​移除​最後動作​後​，​就​留下​某個​前​驅前​綴​配​對​的​轉換​，​用​其​最優​成本​不會​更​差​。​試遍​最後動作​可得​最小值​，​每次​轉移​也​都​合法​。​邊界​涵蓋​空前​綴​，​故歸納​可證​整表正確​。

docs.title: 完整​前綴​編輯表
docs.text: ​每個​前態​恰​對​應​一種​合法​最後編輯​；​相等​字​元​可免​費同​時​消耗​。​取​最小值​涵蓋​全部​轉換​，​完整​表​保留​相同​遞​推而​不覆寫​相依​項​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: "cat" ​轉​ "cut"：​匹配​ c ​成本​零​，a ​換​ u ​成本​一​，​匹配​ t ​不​加​成本​，​距離​為​ 1。"cat" ​轉空​字串​的​初值​表示​三次​刪除​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​滾動​編輯​距​離列​：​時間​ O(m*n+m+n)；​空間​ O(min(m,n)+1)。

​完整​前綴​編輯表​：​時間​ O((m+1)(n+1))；​空間​ O((m+1)(n+1))。

​預設法​ O(m*n+m+n) ​時間​、O(min(m,n)+1) ​空間​，​字串​不變​。​覆寫​上方​值前​先​保存​，​供下​一次​對角​使用​。​匹配​字​元​成本​零​；​交換​位置​不是​允許​操作​，​互換​兩字​不​一定​只​需​一次​。​完整​表​加上​回溯​走訪​可​重建​編輯​，​本實作​仍​只​回傳​成本​。​兩法​均​支援​空​字串​。
