docs.title: 1. ​滾動​編輯​距​離列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n+m+n)

​空間​： O(min(m,n)+1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Rolling edit-distance row
    Time: O(m*n+m+n)
    Space: O(min(m,n)+1)
    """

    def minDistance(self, word1: str, word2: str) -> int:
        if len(word1) < len(word2):
            word1, word2 = word2, word1
        dp = list(range(len(word2) + 1))
        for row, first in enumerate(word1, 1):
            diagonal = dp[0]
            dp[0] = row
            for column, second in enumerate(word2, 1):
                above = dp[column]
                dp[column] = (
                    diagonal if first == second else 1 + min(above, dp[column - 1], diagonal)
                )
                diagonal = above
        return dp[-1]

docs.title: 2. ​完整​前綴​編輯表
docs.text:
​時間​： O((m+1)*(n+1))

​空間​： O((m+1)*(n+1))

class Solution:
    """Approach: Full prefix edit table
    Time: O((m+1)*(n+1))
    Space: O((m+1)*(n+1))
    """

    def minDistance(self, word1: str, word2: str) -> int:
        table = [[0] * (len(word2) + 1) for _ in range(len(word1) + 1)]
        for i in range(len(word1) + 1):
            table[i][0] = i
        for j in range(len(word2) + 1):
            table[0][j] = j
        for i, first in enumerate(word1, 1):
            for j, second in enumerate(word2, 1):
                table[i][j] = (
                    table[i - 1][j - 1]
                    if first == second
                    else 1 + min(table[i - 1][j], table[i][j - 1], table[i - 1][j - 1])
                )
        return table[-1][-1]

docs.title: 1. ​首列​與​首欄​標記
docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: First-row and first-column markers
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def setZeroes(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> None:
        rows, cols = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
        first_row = any(value == 0 for value in matrix[0])
        first_col = any(matrix[row][0] == 0 for row in range(rows))
        for row in range(1, rows):
            for col in range(1, cols):
                if matrix[row][col] == 0:
                    matrix[row][0] = matrix[0][col] = 0
        for row in range(1, rows):
            for col in range(1, cols):
                if matrix[row][0] == 0 or matrix[0][col] == 0:
                    matrix[row][col] = 0
        if first_row:
            for col in range(cols):
                matrix[0][col] = 0
        if first_col:
            for row in range(rows):
                matrix[row][0] = 0

docs.title: 2. ​明確​的​零列​與​零欄​集合
docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn)

​空間​： O(m+n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit zero row and column sets
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(m+n)
    """

    def setZeroes(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> None:
        rows, cols = set(), set()
        for row, values in enumerate(matrix):
            for col, value in enumerate(values):
                if value == 0:
                    rows.add(row)
                    cols.add(col)
        for row, values in enumerate(matrix):
            for col in range(len(values)):
                if row in rows or col in cols:
                    values[col] = 0

docs.title: 1. ​虛擬​攤平​的​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log(mn))

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Virtual flattened binary search
    Time: O(log(mn))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def searchMatrix(self, matrix: list[list[int]], target: int) -> bool:
        rows, cols = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
        low, high = 0, rows * cols - 1
        while low <= high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            row, col = divmod(middle, cols)
            if matrix[row][col] == target:
                return True
            if matrix[row][col] < target:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle - 1
        return False

docs.title: 2. ​先​找列​再​找欄
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log m+log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Row selection then column search
    Time: O(log m+log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def searchMatrix(self, matrix: list[list[int]], target: int) -> bool:
        low, high = 0, len(matrix)
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if matrix[middle][0] <= target:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle
        if low == 0:
            return False
        row = matrix[low - 1]
        left, right = 0, len(row)
        while left < right:
            middle = (left + right) // 2
            if row[middle] < target:
                left = middle + 1
            else:
                right = middle
        return left < len(row) and row[left] == target

docs.title: 荷蘭國旗​分割
docs.text: ​維護​ zero、scan、two ​三個​邊界​。​把​零移​到​左邊​，​二移​到​右邊​，​遇到​一​就​向前​掃描​。

docs.title: 計數後覆寫
docs.text: ​先統​計三種​顏色​，​再​依顏色​順序​覆寫​串列​。​需要​兩次​遍歷​，​但​狀態​較​簡單​。

docs.title: 荷蘭國旗​分割
docs.text: zero ​前面​都​是​ 0，zero ​到​ scan ​之間​都​是​ 1，two ​後​面​都​是​ 2。​每次​交換​都​維持​這些​已​完成​區域​，​並縮​小​尚未​分類​區域​。

docs.title: 計數後覆寫
docs.text: ​次數​保留​了​輸入​的​多重​集合​。​依遞​增順序​寫入​每個​顏色​的​正確​數量​，​便​得到​唯一​的​已​排序​陣列​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​，​並​原地​修改​串列​。​計數法​只​使用​固定​的​三​元素​陣列​，​不是​隨​ n ​增加​的​儲​存量​。

docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​荷蘭國旗​分割
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dutch national flag partition
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def sortColors(self, nums: list[int]) -> None:
        zero = scan = 0
        two = len(nums) - 1
        while scan <= two:
            if nums[scan] == 0:
                nums[zero], nums[scan] = nums[scan], nums[zero]
                zero += 1
                scan += 1
            elif nums[scan] == 2:
                nums[scan], nums[two] = nums[two], nums[scan]
                two -= 1
            else:
                scan += 1

docs.title: 2. ​計數後覆寫
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Count then overwrite
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def sortColors(self, nums: list[int]) -> None:
        counts = [0, 0, 0]
        for value in nums:
            counts[value] += 1
        index = 0
        for value, count in enumerate(counts):
            for _ in range(count):
                nums[index] = value
                index += 1

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​找出​ s ​中​包含​ t ​所有​必要​字​元​及其​重​複​次數​的​最​短子​字串​。​不​存在​時回​傳空​字串​。

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​計算​還缺​多少​次字元​出現​，​而​非​只算​缺幾種​字​元​。
  2. ​視窗​一旦​合法​，​就​縮​減到​再​移除​一個​字元會​破壞​合法性​為止​。

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​缺額​計數縮​減視​窗​ O(n+m) ​期望​ O(alphabet) ​過濾​相關​位置​的​視窗​ O(n+m) ​期望​ O(n+alphabet)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 缺額​計數縮​減視​窗
docs.text: ​保留​可帶​正​負號​的​剩餘​需求​次數​與​總​缺額​。​加入​必要​字元會​減少​ missing，​多餘字​元則​讓​其計數​變負​。​只要​沒有​缺額​，​就​記錄​視窗​並前​進​ left，​直到​視窗​不再​合法​。

docs.title: 過濾​相關​位置​的​視窗
docs.text: ​移除​文字​中不屬​於​模式​的​字​元​位置​，​只​在​剩下​的​ (​索引​, ​字​元​) ​配對​上​滑動​。​相關​字​元​稀疏​時​，​可​減少視​窗維護​工作​。

docs.title: 缺額​計數縮​減視​窗
docs.text: missing ​為​零​，​若且唯若​視窗​合法​。​對​每個​右端​點​，​縮​減過​程會​檢查​其​最​短​合法​視窗​。​被​移除​的​前綴​，​之​後​也​無法​比​已​記錄​、​使用​相同​左邊界​的​視窗​更​短​。

docs.title: 過濾​相關​位置​的​視窗
docs.text: ​最短​合法​視窗​的​兩端​必須​是​相關​字​元​，​否則​可​再​移除​無關​端點​。​因此​在​過濾​後​序列​維護​缺額​，​仍涵​蓋​所有​可能​最佳​的​邊界配​對​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: s="BAAC"、t="AAC" ​時​，​完整​字串​先變成​合法​；​移除​ B ​後​仍​合法​，​得到​ "AAC"。​再​移除​第一​個​ A ​就會​缺一個​ A，​故​答案​為​ "AAC"。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​缺額縮​窗法​：​期望​ O(len(s)+len(t)) ​時間​、O(​字母表​大小​) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​回傳子​字串​。​過濾​位置​法​：​期望​ O(n+m) ​時間​、O(n+​字母表​大小​) ​空間​，​為​相關​位置​多​保留​一份​序列​。

​輸入​不變​。​儲存​索引​，​最後只​切片​一次​；​每次​改善​答案​就​複​製​視​窗​，​可能​增加​平方​成本​。​負計數​表示​多出​的​字​元​，​不能​強制​歸​零​。

docs.title: 1. ​缺額​計數縮​減視​窗
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+m) ​期望​

​空間​： O(alphabet)

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Deficit-count shrinking window
    Time: O(n+m) expected
    Space: O(alphabet)
    """

    def minWindow(self, s: str, t: str) -> str:
        need = Counter(t)
        missing = len(t)
        left = best_start = 0
        best_length = len(s) + 1
        for right, char in enumerate(s):
            if need[char] > 0:
                missing -= 1
            need[char] -= 1
            while missing == 0:
                if right - left + 1 < best_length:
                    best_start, best_length = left, right - left + 1
                outgoing = s[left]
                need[outgoing] += 1
                if need[outgoing] > 0:
                    missing += 1
                left += 1
        return "" if best_length > len(s) else s[best_start : best_start + best_length]

docs.title: 2. ​過濾​相關​位置​的​視窗
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+m) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n+alphabet)

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Filtered relevant-position window
    Time: O(n+m) expected
    Space: O(n+alphabet)
    """

    def minWindow(self, s: str, t: str) -> str:
        need = {}
        for char in t:
            need[char] = need.get(char, 0) + 1
        filtered = [(i, char) for i, char in enumerate(s) if char in need]
        have = {}
        missing = len(t)
        left = 0
        best_start, best_size = 0, len(s) + 1
        for index, char in filtered:
            have[char] = have.get(char, 0) + 1
            if have[char] <= need[char]:
                missing -= 1
            while missing == 0:
                start, outgoing = filtered[left]
                if index - start + 1 < best_size:
                    best_start, best_size = start, index - start + 1
                have[outgoing] -= 1
                if have[outgoing] < need[outgoing]:
                    missing += 1
                left += 1
        return "" if best_size > len(s) else s[best_start : best_start + best_size]

docs.title: 剪枝​遞增​回溯
docs.text: ​逐步​建立​遞​增路徑​。​限制​每輪​迴​圈​的​上界​，​保證​仍​有​足夠​值​可​填滿​剩餘​位置​。​路徑​長​度​達​ k ​時儲存​副本​。

docs.title: 字典​序組​合後繼
docs.text: ​從​ [1,...,k] ​開始​。​反覆​找​最右邊​仍​可​增加​的​位置​，​將它​加一​，​再​將後綴​重設​為​緊接​在​後​的​連續值​。

docs.title: 剪枝​遞增​回溯
docs.text: ​遞​增選擇​使​每個​組合​只有​一種​表示​。​迴​圈​上界​只​排除​剩餘值​不足​的​前綴​，​因此​不會​失去​任何​合法​組合​。

docs.title: 字典​序組​合後繼
docs.text: ​增加​最右邊​可動​位置​，​只會​改動​必要​的​最小​後​綴​；​再​將後綴​填成​最小值​，​就​得到​字典​序​的​下​一個​組合​。​從​最小​組合​走​到​最大​組合​，​因此​所有​組合​都​恰好​出現​一次​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​剪枝​遞增​回溯​與​字典​序組​合後繼​的​時間​皆​為​ O(k*C(n,k))，​輔助​空間​皆​為​ O(k)，​另加​輸出​。​所有​狀態​都屬​於​本次​呼叫​。k=n ​時​只有​一個​答案​，​儲存​答案​副本​是​主要​的​空間​需求​。​後​繼法​在​零起​算​位置​ i ​的​上界​是​ n-k+i+1，​不能​將每個​位置​的​上界​都​設為​ n。

docs.title: 1. ​剪枝​遞增​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k*C(n,k))

​空間​： O(k) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Pruned increasing backtracking
    Time: O(k*C(n,k))
    Space: O(k) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def combine(self, n: int, k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(start):
            needed = k - len(path)
            if needed == 0:
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            for value in range(start, n - needed + 2):
                path.append(value)
                visit(value + 1)
                path.pop()

        visit(1)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​字典​序組​合後繼
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k*C(n,k))

​空間​： O(k) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Lexicographic combination successor
    Time: O(k*C(n,k))
    Space: O(k) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def combine(self, n: int, k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        current = list(range(1, k + 1))
        result = []
        while True:
            result.append(current.copy())
            index = k - 1
            while index >= 0 and current[index] == n - k + index + 1:
                index -= 1
            if index < 0:
                return result
            current[index] += 1
            for following in range(index + 1, k):
                current[following] = current[following - 1] + 1

docs.title: 遞增​索引​回溯
docs.text: ​從​指定​起始​索引​回溯​。​先記錄​目前​子集合​，​再​依序​選取​各個​剩餘值​，​從​該值​的​下​一個​索引​繼續​搜尋​，​最​後​撤銷​選擇​。​索引​保持​遞增​，​可​避免​同一​子集合​出現​不同​排列​表示​。

docs.title: 子集合​位元​遮罩
docs.text: ​枚​舉零到​ 2^n-1 ​的​遮罩​。​第​ i ​位​表示​是否​選取​輸入​位置​ i。​每個​遮罩​依設​定位​元​建立​新​的​串列​，​不​需要​共用​且​可​修改​的​遞​迴​路徑​。

docs.title: 遞增​索引​回溯
docs.text: ​每個​子集合​都​對​應​唯一​的​遞​增輸入​索引​序列​。​遞​迴​恰好​走訪​所有​這類​序列​，​包含​空​序列​，​因此​每個​子集合​都​會產生​一次​。

docs.title: 子集合​位元​遮罩
docs.text: ​每個​子集合​恰好​對應​一個​ n ​位元​的​成員​向量​。​將​所有​向量​各枚舉​一次​，​就會將​所有​子集合​各產生​一次​，​空​遮罩​則對​應​空集合​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​預設​回溯​法​包含​答案​複​製​的​時​間​為​ O(n * 2^n)，​路徑​與​遞​迴​的​輔助​空間​為​ O(n)，​輸出​儲​存量​為​ O(n * 2^n)。​輸入​不變​。​應​附加​ path.copy()，​不能​儲存​仍會​修改​的​ path ​本身​，​否則後續​撤銷會​連帶​改變​已​儲存​的​答案​。​選擇​後​索引​必須​前進​，​因為​每個​值​最​多​使用​一次​。

​位元​遮罩​法同樣​使用​ O(n2^n) ​時間​，​另​需​ O(n) ​暫存​空間​與​ O(n2^n) ​輸出​空間​。

docs.title: 1. ​遞增​索引​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*2^n)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​；O(n*2^n) ​輸出​空間​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Increasing-index backtracking
    Time: O(n*2^n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary; O(n*2^n) output
    """

    def subsets(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        path = []

        def visit(start):
            result.append(path.copy())
            for i in range(start, len(nums)):
                path.append(nums[i])
                visit(i + 1)
                path.pop()

        visit(0)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​子集合​位元​遮罩
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*2^n)

​空間​： O(n) ​暫存​空間​；O(n*2^n) ​輸出​空間​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Subset bitmasks
    Time: O(n*2^n)
    Space: O(n) temporary; O(n*2^n) output
    """

    def subsets(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        return [
            [value for index, value in enumerate(nums) if mask & (1 << index)]
            for mask in range(1 << len(nums))
        ]

docs.title: 路徑​集合​回溯
docs.text: ​以列​、​欄​與​已​匹配​單字​位置​回溯​。​超出​邊界​、​已​使用​或字元​不符​的​格子​都​拒絕​。​將​符合​的​格子​加入​目前​路徑​，​嘗試​四個​鄰居後再​移除​；​即使​某​分支​成功​，​也​要​還原​路徑​集合​。

docs.title: 迭代​路徑​位元​遮罩
docs.text: ​使用​明確​的​堆​疊​儲存候​選路徑​，​並以​位元​遮罩​記錄​已用​格子​。​每個​分​支持​有​自己​的​整數​遮罩​，​因此​不必​撤銷​共用​路徑​。​官方​網格​最多​ 36 ​格​，​整數​遮罩​的​大小​有​界​。

docs.title: 路徑​集合​回溯
docs.text: ​每次​遞​迴​都​新增​一個​字​元​符合​、​尚未​使用​的​相鄰​格子​，​因此​搜尋​恰好​產生​每個​起點​的​合法​單字​路徑​。​還原​路徑​狀態​，​讓​其他​分支​仍​可​使用​先前​分支​已放棄​的​格子​。

docs.title: 迭代​路徑​位元​遮罩
docs.text: ​遮罩​精確​記錄​某個​已​匹配​前綴​路徑​使用​的​格子​。​向​字​元​符合​且​未​使用​的​鄰居​延伸​，​恰好​產生​所有​合法​下​一步​。​枚舉​所有​起點​與​延伸​，​因此​不會​遺漏​答案​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​對​ board=[["A","B"],["C","D"]]，"ABDC" ​沿四個​格子​形成​合法​路徑​，​因此​成功​。"ABA" ​失敗​，​因為​回到​第一​個​ A ​會重​複​使用​同一​格​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​預設​回溯​法對​單字長​度​ L ​的​寬​鬆​時​間​界​為​ O(rows * cols * 4^L)，​路徑​與​遞​迴​空間​為​ O(L)。​不論​成功​或​失敗​，​都​不​修改​ board ​或​ word。​官方​單字長​度​上限​使遞​迴​深度​很小​。​全域​ visited ​集合​會​錯誤​排除​其他​候選路徑​仍​可​使用​的​格子​。

​迭代​遮罩​法​的​寬​鬆​時​間​界​同​為​ O(RC4^L)，​輔助​堆疊​空間​為​ O(L)。​每個​路徑​深度​只會​留下​有界​數量​的​待​處理​兄弟​狀態​，​且​每個​遮罩​都​限制​在​官方​最​多​ 36 ​格​的​範圍​內​。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(RC4^L) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(L)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Path-set backtracking
    Time: O(R*C*4^L) loose bound
    Space: O(L)
    """

    def exist(self, board: list[list[str]], word: str) -> bool:
        rows, cols = len(board), len(board[0])
        path = set()

        def visit(row, col, index):
            if not (0 <= row < rows and 0 <= col < cols):
                return False
            if (row, col) in path or board[row][col] != word[index]:
                return False
            if index == len(word) - 1:
                return True
            path.add((row, col))
            found = any(
                visit(row + dr, col + dc, index + 1)
                for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))
            )
            path.remove((row, col))
            return found

        return any(visit(row, col, 0) for row in range(rows) for col in range(cols))

docs.title: 2. ​迭代​路徑​位元​遮罩
docs.text:
​時間​： O(RC4^L) ​寬​鬆​上​界​，​採題​目的​有界​網格​大小​

​空間​： O(L)，​採題​目的​有界​網格​大小​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative path bitmasks
    Time: O(R*C*4^L) loose bound under bounded grid size
    Space: O(L) under the bounded grid size
    """

    def exist(self, board: list[list[str]], word: str) -> bool:
        rows, cols = len(board), len(board[0])
        for row in range(rows):
            for col in range(cols):
                if board[row][col] != word[0]:
                    continue
                stack = [(row, col, 0, 1 << (row * cols + col))]
                while stack:
                    r, c, index, mask = stack.pop()
                    if index == len(word) - 1:
                        return True
                    for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c), (r - 1, c), (r, c + 1), (r, c - 1)):
                        if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                            bit = 1 << (nr * cols + nc)
                            if not mask & bit and board[nr][nc] == word[index + 1]:
                                stack.append((nr, nc, index + 1, mask | bit))
        return False

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Two-slot output comparison
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def removeDuplicates(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        write = 0
        for value in nums:
            if write < 2 or value != nums[write - 2]:
                nums[write] = value
                write += 1
        return write

docs.title: 2. ​明確​計算​輸入​等值​區段
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit input-run counts
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def removeDuplicates(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        previous = None
        count = write = 0
        for read in range(len(nums)):
            value = nums[read]
            count = count + 1 if value == previous else 1
            previous = value
            if count <= 2:
                nums[write] = value
                write += 1
        return write

docs.text:
​時間​： ​最差​ O(n)；​切分​資訊​充分​時為​ O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Duplicate-aware sorted-half search
    Time: O(n) worst; O(log n) with informative splits
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def search(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> bool:
        low, high = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while low <= high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if nums[middle] == target:
                return True
            if nums[low] == nums[middle] == nums[high]:
                low += 1
                high -= 1
            elif nums[low] <= nums[middle]:
                if nums[low] <= target < nums[middle]:
                    high = middle - 1
                else:
                    low = middle + 1
            elif nums[middle] < target <= nums[high]:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle - 1
        return False

docs.title: 2. ​等值​段壓​縮後旋轉​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Run compression then rotated binary search
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def search(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> bool:
        values = []
        for value in nums:
            if not values or value != values[-1]:
                values.append(value)
        if len(values) > 1 and values[0] == values[-1]:
            values.pop()
        low, high = 0, len(values) - 1
        while low <= high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if values[middle] == target:
                return True
            if values[low] <= values[middle]:
                if values[low] <= target < values[middle]:
                    high = middle - 1
                else:
                    low = middle + 1
            elif values[middle] < target <= values[high]:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle - 1
        return False

docs.title: 1. ​略過​整段​重​複​值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

from collections import Counter


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Skip duplicate runs
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def deleteDuplicates(self, head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
        dummy = ListNode(next=head)
        before = dummy
        while head:
            end = head.next
            while end and end.val == head.val:
                end = end.next
            if head.next is end:
                before = head
            else:
                before.next = end
            head = end
        return dummy.next

docs.title: 2. ​計數​後​篩選
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import Counter


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Count then filter
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def deleteDuplicates(self, head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
        counts = Counter()
        current = head
        while current:
            counts[current.val] += 1
            current = current.next
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        while head:
            following = head.next
            if counts[head.val] == 1:
                tail.next = head
                tail = head
            head = following
        tail.next = None
        return dummy.next

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Increasing-height stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def largestRectangleArea(self, heights: list[int]) -> int:
        stack = []
        best = 0
        for i in range(len(heights) + 1):
            height = heights[i] if i < len(heights) else 0
            start = i
            while stack and stack[-1][1] > height:
                start, previous = stack.pop()
                best = max(best, previous * (i - start))
            stack.append((start, height))
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​最近​的​較​小​高度​邊界
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Nearest smaller boundaries
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def largestRectangleArea(self, heights: list[int]) -> int:
        size = len(heights)
        left, right = [-1] * size, [size] * size
        stack = []
        for i, value in enumerate(heights):
            while stack and heights[stack[-1]] >= value:
                stack.pop()
            if stack:
                left[i] = stack[-1]
            stack.append(i)
        stack.clear()
        for i in range(size - 1, -1, -1):
            while stack and heights[stack[-1]] >= heights[i]:
                stack.pop()
            if stack:
                right[i] = stack[-1]
            stack.append(i)
        return max(
            (height * (right[i] - left[i] - 1) for i, height in enumerate(heights)), default=0
        )

docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Histogram heights and monotone stack
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(C)
    """

    def maximalRectangle(self, matrix: list[list[str]]) -> int:
        heights = [0] * (len(matrix[0]) + 1)
        answer = 0
        for row in matrix:
            for column, value in enumerate(row):
                heights[column] = heights[column] + 1 if value == "1" else 0
            stack = [-1]
            for column, height in enumerate(heights):
                while len(stack) > 1 and heights[stack[-1]] > height:
                    top = stack.pop()
                    answer = max(answer, heights[top] * (column - stack[-1] - 1))
                stack.append(column)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​持續​收緊​左右​界線
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Persistent left and right limits
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(C)
    """

    def maximalRectangle(self, matrix: list[list[str]]) -> int:
        width = len(matrix[0])
        heights, left, right = [0] * width, [0] * width, [width] * width
        answer = 0
        for row in matrix:
            boundary = 0
            for c in range(width):
                if row[c] == "1":
                    heights[c] += 1
                    left[c] = max(left[c], boundary)
                else:
                    heights[c], left[c], right[c], boundary = 0, 0, width, c + 1
            boundary = width
            for c in range(width - 1, -1, -1):
                if row[c] == "1":
                    right[c] = min(right[c], boundary)
                    answer = max(answer, heights[c] * (right[c] - left[c]))
                else:
                    boundary = c
        return answer

docs.title: 1. ​兩條​穩定​節點​鏈
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Two stable linked chains
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def partition(self, head: ListNode | None, x: int) -> ListNode | None:
        small = small_tail = ListNode()
        large = large_tail = ListNode()
        while head:
            following = head.next
            if head.val < x:
                small_tail.next = head
                small_tail = head
            else:
                large_tail.next = head
                large_tail = head
            head = following
        large_tail.next = None
        small_tail.next = large.next
        return small.next

docs.title: 2. ​穩定​節點​參照​分組
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Stable node-reference partition
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def partition(self, head: ListNode | None, x: int) -> ListNode | None:
        small, large = [], []
        while head:
            (small if head.val < x else large).append(head)
            head = head.next
        ordered = small + large
        for index, node in enumerate(ordered):
            node.next = ordered[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(ordered) else None
        return ordered[0] if ordered else None

class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized substring-index split states
    Time: O(n^4)
    Space: O(n^3)
    """

    def isScramble(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
        from functools import cache

        def prefixes(text):
            table = [[0] * 26]
            for character in text:
                row = table[-1].copy()
                row[ord(character) - ord("a")] += 1
                table.append(row)
            return table

        first, second = prefixes(s1), prefixes(s2)

        @cache
        def solve(i, j, length):
            if all(s1[i + offset] == s2[j + offset] for offset in range(length)):
                return True
            if any(
                first[i + length][letter] - first[i][letter]
                != second[j + length][letter] - second[j][letter]
                for letter in range(26)
            ):
                return False
            for cut in range(1, length):
                if solve(i, j, cut) and solve(i + cut, j + cut, length - cut):
                    return True
                if solve(i, j + length - cut, cut) and solve(i + cut, j, length - cut):
                    return True
            return False

        return solve(0, 0, len(s1))

docs.title: 2. ​由下而上​長​度​與​位置​表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^4)

​空間​： O(n^3)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bottom-up length and position table
    Time: O(n^4)
    Space: O(n^3)
    """

    def isScramble(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
        n = len(s1)
        dp = [[[False] * n for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n + 1)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                dp[1][i][j] = s1[i] == s2[j]
        for length in range(2, n + 1):
            for i in range(n - length + 1):
                for j in range(n - length + 1):
                    dp[length][i][j] = any(
                        (dp[cut][i][j] and dp[length - cut][i + cut][j + cut])
                        or (dp[cut][i][j + length - cut] and dp[length - cut][i + cut][j])
                        for cut in range(1, length)
                    )
        return dp[n][0][0]

docs.title: 同​深度​略​過重​複​值

​兩法​都​保留​輸入​。​附加​新​子集合​前​，​先​保留​舊​結果​長​度​，​才能​界定​正確​的​來源區​塊​。​每個​儲存​的​子集合​都​必須​是​新​的​串列​，​答案​順序​不​需要​符合​特定​走訪​方式​。

docs.title: 1. ​同​深度​略​過重​複​值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*2^n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Depth-local duplicate skipping
    Time: O(n*2^n) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def subsetsWithDup(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        values = sorted(nums)
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(start):
            result.append(path.copy())
            for index in range(start, len(values)):
                if index > start and values[index] == values[index - 1]:
                    continue
                path.append(values[index])
                visit(index + 1)
                path.pop()

        visit(0)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​只​延伸​新​子集合​區塊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*2^n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n*2^n)，​包含​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Extend only the new subset block
    Time: O(n*2^n) loose bound
    Space: O(n*2^n) including output
    """

    def subsetsWithDup(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        values = sorted(nums)
        result = [[]]
        previous_start = 0
        for index, value in enumerate(values):
            start = previous_start if index and value == values[index - 1] else 0
            previous_start = len(result)
            result.extend(result[position] + [value] for position in range(start, previous_start))
        return result

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Rolling prefix decode counts
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def numDecodings(self, s: str) -> int:
        older, previous = 1, int(s[0] != "0")
        for index in range(1, len(s)):
            current = previous if s[index] != "0" else 0
            if s[index - 1] == "1" or (s[index - 1] == "2" and s[index] <= "6"):
                current += older
            older, previous = previous, current
        return previous

docs.title: 2. ​記憶​化後綴​解碼
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized suffix decoding
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def numDecodings(self, s: str) -> int:
        from functools import cache

        @cache
        def decode(index):
            if index == len(s):
                return 1
            if s[index] == "0":
                return 0
            answer = decode(index + 1)
            if index + 1 < len(s) and (
                s[index] == "1" or (s[index] == "2" and s[index + 1] <= "6")
            ):
                answer += decode(index + 2)
            return answer

        return decode(0)

docs.title: 1. ​區段​內頭​插法
docs.text:
​時間​： O(right)

​空間​： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Front insertion within segment
    Time: O(right)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def reverseBetween(self, head: ListNode, left: int, right: int) -> ListNode:
        dummy = ListNode(next=head)
        before = dummy
        for _ in range(left - 1):
            before = before.next
        tail = before.next
        for _ in range(right - left):
            moved = tail.next
            tail.next = moved.next
            moved.next = before.next
            before.next = moved
        return dummy.next

docs.title: 2. ​反轉​節點​參考​切片
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Reverse reference slice
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def reverseBetween(self, head: ListNode, left: int, right: int) -> ListNode:
        order = []
        while head:
            order.append(head)
            head = head.next
        order[left - 1 : right] = order[left - 1 : right][::-1]
        for index, node in enumerate(order):
            node.next = order[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(order) else None
        return order[0]

docs.title: 1. ​四段​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(3^4*n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Four-part backtracking
    Time: O(3^4*n) loose bound
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def restoreIpAddresses(self, s: str) -> list[str]:
        result, path = [], []

        def visit(start):
            missing = 4 - len(path)
            if not missing <= len(s) - start <= 3 * missing:
                return
            if missing == 0:
                result.append(".".join(path))
                return
            for length in range(1, 4):
                piece = s[start : start + length]
                if len(piece) != length or (length > 1 and piece[0] == "0") or int(piece) > 255:
                    continue
                path.append(piece)
                visit(start + length)
                path.pop()

        visit(0)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​列舉​前​三段​長​度
docs.text:
​時間​： O(27*n)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate the three cut lengths
    Time: O(27*n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def restoreIpAddresses(self, s: str) -> list[str]:
        result = []
        for first in range(1, 4):
            for second in range(1, 4):
                for third in range(1, 4):
                    a, b, c = first, first + second, first + second + third
                    pieces = [s[:a], s[a:b], s[b:c], s[c:]]
                    if all(
                        1 <= len(piece) <= 3
                        and (len(piece) == 1 or piece[0] != "0")
                        and int(piece) <= 255
                        for piece in pieces
                    ):
                        result.append(".".join(pieces))
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​記憶化​不可​變樹形
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*C_n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n*C_n) ​含輸出​

from functools import cache


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized immutable tree shapes
    Time: O(n*C_n) loose bound
    Space: O(n*C_n) including output
    """

    def generateTrees(self, n: int) -> list[TreeNode]:
        @cache
        def shapes(low, high):
            if low > high:
                return (None,)
            return tuple(
                (value, left, right)
                for value in range(low, high + 1)
                for left in shapes(low, value - 1)
                for right in shapes(value + 1, high)
            )

        def materialize(shape):
            if shape is None:
                return None
            value, left, right = shape
            return TreeNode(value, materialize(left), materialize(right))

        return [materialize(shape) for shape in shapes(1, n)]

docs.title: 2. ​自​底向上​的​區間​樹表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2*C_n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n^2*C_n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​ ​含輸出​

from functools import cache


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Bottom-up interval tree table
    Time: O(n^2*C_n) loose bound
    Space: O(n^2*C_n) loose bound including output
    """

    def generateTrees(self, n: int) -> list[TreeNode]:
        def clone(node):
            return TreeNode(node.val, clone(node.left), clone(node.right)) if node else None

        table = {(low, low - 1): [None] for low in range(1, n + 2)}
        for length in range(1, n + 1):
            for low in range(1, n - length + 2):
                high = low + length - 1
                table[low, high] = [
                    TreeNode(value, clone(left), clone(right))
                    for value in range(low, high + 1)
                    for left in table[low, value - 1]
                    for right in table[value + 1, high]
                ]
        return table[1, n]

docs.text: ​設​ count[0]=1，​每個​大小​對​全部​根​位置​加總​ count[left_size]*count[right_size]。

docs.title: Catalan ​卷積​ DP
docs.text: ​根把​ BST ​分成​互相​獨立​的​左右​子樹​。​不同​根或子​樹配​對會​形成​不同​樹​，​因此​同​分割​內​相乘​、​不同​分割​間​相加​恰正確​。

docs.text: ​由​ C_i=binomial(2*i,i)/(i+1) ​可得​相鄰​公式​的​比值​，​化​簡即​迴​圈​乘數​。​歸納​便​得到​和​組合遞​推​相同​的​計數​。

​輸入​不變​。​空子​樹​貢獻​一種​排列​，​不是​零​。​成本​利用​ n<=19 ​與​結果​有界​的​條件​；​若​ n ​不​受限​，Python ​整數​乘法​與​儲存​都​隨位​元數​成長​。

docs.title: 1. Catalan ​卷積​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Catalan convolution DP
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def numTrees(self, n: int) -> int:
        counts = [0] * (n + 1)
        counts[0] = 1
        for size in range(1, n + 1):
            counts[size] = sum(counts[left] * counts[size - 1 - left] for left in range(size))
        return counts[n]

docs.title: 2. Catalan ​乘法​遞​推
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​有​界​大小​ ​次算術​運算​

​空間​： O(1) ​有​界​大小​ ​個​整數​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Multiplicative Catalan recurrence
    Time: O(n) bounded-size arithmetic operations
    Space: O(1) bounded-size integers
    """

    def numTrees(self, n: int) -> int:
        count = 1
        for index in range(n):
            count = count * 2 * (2 * index + 1) // (index + 2)
        return count

docs.title: 滾動​交錯​狀態
docs.text: ​先​拒絕​總長​不同​者​，​以​短來源​作欄​。dp[j] ​表示​第一​來源​目前​前綴​，​加​第二​來源​前​ j ​字​元​，​是否​能​形成​對應​目標​前綴​。​先​初始化​只用​第二​來源​的​列​。​每個​第一​來源​字​元​由​左​往右​更新​：​可由舊​上方​接​第一​來源​字​元​，​或​新​左方​接​第二​來源​字​元​。

docs.title: 消耗​前綴​配對​的​ BFS
docs.text: ​只​走訪​可達​的​前綴​消耗​配對​。​從​ (i,j) ​消耗​任一​來源​下​一個​與​目標​匹配​的​字​元​，​以​已訪​集合​合​併​到​達​同一​狀態​的​路線​。

docs.title: 滾動​交錯​狀態
docs.text: ​目標​最後一字​必恰來​自一個​來源​，​移除​後​得到​兩個​較​小​前綴​狀態​之一​。​成功​轉移​匹配​目標且​保留​來源​順序​，​因此​合法​；​任何​合法​交錯​的​最後來源​選擇​也​都​被​測試​。​依​消耗​前綴​歸納​可證​完備​。

docs.text: ​每步​恰​消耗​一個​匹配​目標​下​一字​的​來源​字​元​。​每個​合法​交錯​都​遵循​這類​轉移​，​抵達​兩個​來源​末端​即為​完整​匹配​。

docs.text: ​來源​ "ab"、"ac" ​與​目標​ "aabc"，​依序​取​第一​來源​ a、​第二​來源​ a、​第一​來源​ b、​第二​來源​ c。​重​複​ a ​使​貪婪​選來源​有​歧義​，DP ​會​保留​兩種​可能​。

​滾動​交錯​狀態​：​時間​ O(m*n+m+n)；​空間​ O(min(m,n)+1)。

​消耗​前綴​配對​的​ BFS：​時間​ O((m+1)(n+1))；​空間​ O((m+1)(n+1))。

​預設​法時間​ O(m*n+m+n)，​含空​來源​初始化​，​滾動列​空間​依比​較表為​ O(min(m,n)+1)。​不​改輸入​，​須左​往右​更新​並​使用​目標​索引​ i+j-1。​只​比​較​字​元​頻率​不夠​，​因來源​順序​也​重要​。BFS ​可略過​不可​達​表格​，​但​需要​佇列​與​集合​；​兩​模型​皆​須檢查​總長​。

docs.title: 1. ​滾動​交錯​狀態
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n+m+n)

​空間​： O(min(m,n)+1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Rolling interleaving states
    Time: O(m*n+m+n)
    Space: O(min(m,n)+1)
    """

    def isInterleave(self, s1: str, s2: str, s3: str) -> bool:
        if len(s1) + len(s2) != len(s3):
            return False
        if len(s1) < len(s2):
            s1, s2 = s2, s1
        dp = [False] * (len(s2) + 1)
        dp[0] = True
        for column in range(1, len(s2) + 1):
            dp[column] = dp[column - 1] and s2[column - 1] == s3[column - 1]
        for row, first in enumerate(s1, 1):
            dp[0] = dp[0] and first == s3[row - 1]
            for column, second in enumerate(s2, 1):
                target = s3[row + column - 1]
                dp[column] = (dp[column] and first == target) or (
                    dp[column - 1] and second == target
                )
        return dp[-1]

docs.title: 2. ​消耗​前綴​配對​的​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O((m+1)*(n+1))

​空間​： O((m+1)*(n+1))

class Solution:
    """Approach: BFS over consumed-prefix pairs
    Time: O((m+1)*(n+1))
    Space: O((m+1)*(n+1))
    """

    def isInterleave(self, s1: str, s2: str, s3: str) -> bool:
        from collections import deque

        if len(s1) + len(s2) != len(s3):
            return False
        queue = deque([(0, 0)])
        seen = {(0, 0)}
        while queue:
            i, j = queue.popleft()
            if i + j == len(s3):
                return True
            for ni, nj, matches in (
                (i + 1, j, i < len(s1) and s1[i] == s3[i + j]),
                (i, j + 1, j < len(s2) and s2[j] == s3[i + j]),
            ):
                if matches and (ni, nj) not in seen:
                    seen.add((ni, nj))
                    queue.append((ni, nj))
        return False

docs.title: 嚴格遞​增中序​走訪
docs.text: ​使用​明確​堆疊​進行​迭代​中序​走訪​，​保存​上​一個​輸​出值​。​若​目前​值不大​於​上​一個值​，​立即​回傳​ False；​完成​走​訪則​合法​。

docs.title: 祖先​開區間​界限
docs.text: ​堆疊​項目​保存​節點​與​允許​的​開區間​。​左子​節點​繼承原​下界​，​以上​層節​點值​作為​上界​；​右子​節點則​以​父節​點值​作為​下界​，​並繼承原​上界​。​任何​節點​落​在​區間​外​或​等​於​邊界​，​就​拒絕​。

docs.title: 嚴格遞​增中序​走訪
docs.text: ​中序​順序​是​整個​左子​樹​、​節點​、​整個​右子​樹​。​若​序列​嚴格​遞增​，​左子​樹​的​每個​值​都​小​於​節點​，​右子​樹​的​每個​值​都​大​於​節點​，​且​同樣​性質​遞​迴​適用​所有​子樹​；​反之​合法​樹必產生​嚴格​遞增​序列​。

docs.title: 祖先​開區間​界限
docs.text: ​每個​區間​表示​沿根路徑​累積​的​所有​祖先​限制​之​交集​。​子節點​繼承原​限制​並​加入​父節點​的​新​限制​，​因此​每次​檢查​都​涵蓋​所有​祖先​，​而​不​只是​直接​父節點​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​根為​ 5、​左子​節點​ 1、​右子​節點​ 7，​而​ 7 ​的​左子​節點​是​ 4。​局部​比較​看似​合理​，​中序​卻​是​ [1,5,4,7]，​在​ 5 ​到​ 4 ​時​下降​，​因此​不是​合法​二元​搜尋樹​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(h) ​空間​，​不​修改​樹​。​重​複​值​不​合法​。​迭代​寫法​可​處理​超過​ Python ​遞​迴​深度​限制​的​長​鏈​。​上​一個​值尚​不​存在​時應用​明確​狀態​表示​，​不要​猜一個​可能​與​合法​值衝突​的​數字​哨兵​。

docs.title: 1. ​嚴格遞​增中序​走訪
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Increasing inorder
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def isValidBST(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> bool:
        stack = []
        current = root
        previous = None
        while current or stack:
            while current:
                stack.append(current)
                current = current.left
            current = stack.pop()
            if previous is not None and current.val <= previous:
                return False
            previous = current.val
            current = current.right
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​祖先​開區間​界限
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Ancestor bounds
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def isValidBST(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> bool:
        stack = [(root, float("-inf"), float("inf"))] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, low, high = stack.pop()
            if not low < node.val < high:
                return False
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, node.val, high))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, low, node.val))
        return True

docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​逐層​廣度​優先​搜尋​ O(n) O(w) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​ ​依​深度​分組​的​深度​優先​搜尋​ O(n) O(h) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

docs.title: 逐層​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​佇列​先放根​節點​。​每輪​固定​起始​佇列長​度​，​只​取出​這麼​多​節點​作為​本層​；​逐一​收集​值​，​並按​左​、​右順序​加入​子節點​。

docs.title: 依​深度​分組​的​深度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​用明​確堆​疊​保存​ (node,depth)，​首次​遇到​新​深度​時​新增​結果​列​，​再​把​值​加入​該列​。​堆疊先​推右子​樹​再​推​左子​樹​，​使​實際​走訪​順序​是​先​左後右​。

docs.title: 逐層​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​每輪​開始​時​，​佇列​恰好​包含​目前​層​的​節點​，​順序​為​由​左到​右​。​固定​次數​的​取出​操作​只​處理​這一層​；​依​左​、​右順序​加入​的​子​節點則​正好​形成​下一層​，​故不變量​逐層​成立​。

docs.title: 依​深度​分組​的​深度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​每個​節點​的​ depth ​正確​指定​結果​列​。​先​完整​走訪​左子​樹​，​再​走​訪右子​樹​，​使同​深度​的​節點​仍​按​由​左到​右​的​順序​抵達​，​即使​不同​深度​交錯​被​處理​也​不​影響​分組​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(n) ​時間​，​另​需​ O(n) ​輸出​。​廣度​優先法​的​佇列​為​ O(w)，w ​是​最大​層​寬​；​深度​優先法​的​堆​疊​為​ O(h)，h ​是​樹高​。​兩者​都​不​修改​樹​。​使用​ deque.popleft()，​避免​ list.pop(0) ​的​線性​搬移​成本​；​一層​的​迴​圈​不能​連新​加入​的​子​節點​也​全部​取完​。

docs.title: 1. ​逐層​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(w) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Breadth-first levels
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(w) auxiliary; O(n) output
    """

    def levelOrder(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[list[int]]:
        if root is None:
            return []
        queue = deque([root])
        result = []
        while queue:
            level = []
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node = queue.popleft()
                level.append(node.val)
                if node.left:
                    queue.append(node.left)
                if node.right:
                    queue.append(node.right)
            result.append(level)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​依​深度​分組​的​深度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Depth-indexed DFS
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary; O(n) output
    """

    def levelOrder(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        stack = [(root, 0)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, depth = stack.pop()
            if depth == len(result):
                result.append([])
            result[depth].append(node.val)
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, depth + 1))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, depth + 1))
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​廣度​優先並​交替​反轉​結果​列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(w) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Breadth-first alternating rows
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(w) auxiliary; O(n) output
    """

    def zigzagLevelOrder(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        queue = deque([root]) if root else deque()
        while queue:
            level = []
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node = queue.popleft()
                level.append(node.val)
                if node.left:
                    queue.append(node.left)
                if node.right:
                    queue.append(node.right)
            if len(result) % 2:
                level.reverse()
            result.append(level)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​依​深度​分組後反​轉奇​數層
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Depth-indexed DFS
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary; O(n) output
    """

    def zigzagLevelOrder(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[list[int]]:
        result = []
        stack = [(root, 0)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, depth = stack.pop()
            if depth == len(result):
                result.append([])
            result[depth].append(node.val)
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, depth + 1))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, depth + 1))
        for depth in range(1, len(result), 2):
            result[depth].reverse()
        return result

解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​祖先​堆疊​重建​ O(n) O(h) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​ ​帶​索引​的​區間​任務​ O(n) O(n)

docs.title: 祖先​堆疊​重建
docs.text: ​堆疊​保存​目前​前序​路徑​上​的​祖先​，​另用​索引​追​蹤​下​一​個​中​序​值​。​在​堆​疊​頂端​尚未​等​於​該​中序值​之前​，​新​的​前序​值接​為​頂端​節點​的​左子​節點​。​一旦​相符​，​就​連續​彈出​所有​已​完成​的​祖先​，​再​把​新值​接為​最後彈​出​節點​的​右子​節點​。

docs.title: 帶​索引​的​區間​任務
docs.text: ​先​建立​值到​中序​索引​的​對​照表​，​再以​明確​的​子​樹區間​任務​消耗​前序​根節點​。​每個​任務​知道​節點​應​接到​哪個​父節點​。​先​推右​任務​再​推​左​任務​，​使​實際​處理​順序​維持​根​、​左​、​右​。

docs.title: 祖先​堆疊​重建
docs.text: ​前序​決​定下​一個​必須​建立​的​節點​。​在​某​祖先​尚未​於​中序​出現​之前​，​下一個​節點​仍屬​於​未​完成​的​左側​下降​路徑​。​與​中序​相符​時​，​表示​對應​左側​已​結束​；​最後結束​的​祖先​正是​即將​開始​右子​樹​的​父節點​。​值互異​使配​對​沒​有​歧義​。

docs.title: 帶​索引​的​區間​任務
docs.text: ​下一個​前序​值​就是​待建​子樹​的​根​，​它​的​中序​索引​唯一​地將​區間​分成​左右​後​代​。​對區間​大小​歸納​即可​證明​所有​子樹​都​重建​正確​，​而且​不​需遞​迴​或​複​製​切片​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​祖先​堆疊法​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(h) ​輔助​空間​，​另​需​ O(n) ​輸出​節點​；​每個​節點​入棧​、​出棧​各​一次​。​區間​法為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​，​其中​索引​表​即使​在​淺樹​中​也​需要​線性​儲存​。​兩者​不​修改​輸入​，​避免​遞​迴​切片​與​偏斜​樹​的​遞​迴​深度​問題​。

docs.title: 1. ​祖先​堆疊​重建
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Ancestor-stack reconstruction
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary; O(n) output
    """

    def buildTree(self, preorder: list[int], inorder: list[int]) -> TreeNode:
        values = iter(preorder)
        root = TreeNode(next(values))
        stack = [root]
        index = 0
        for value in values:
            node = stack[-1]
            child = TreeNode(value)
            if node.val != inorder[index]:
                node.left = child
            else:
                while stack and stack[-1].val == inorder[index]:
                    node = stack.pop()
                    index += 1
                node.right = child
            stack.append(child)
        return root

docs.title: 2. ​帶​索引​的​區間​任務
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Indexed interval tasks
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def buildTree(self, preorder: list[int], inorder: list[int]) -> TreeNode:
        positions = {value: index for index, value in enumerate(inorder)}
        dummy = TreeNode()
        tasks = [(0, len(inorder), dummy, "left")]
        values = iter(preorder)
        while tasks:
            low, high, parent, side = tasks.pop()
            if low == high:
                continue
            node = TreeNode(next(values))
            setattr(parent, side, node)
            middle = positions[node.val]
            tasks.append((middle + 1, high, node, "right"))
            tasks.append((low, middle, node, "left"))
        return dummy.left

        self.left = left

class Solution:

    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary; O(n) output

    def buildTree(self, inorder: list[int], postorder: list[int]) -> TreeNode:

                    node = stack.pop()
                    index -= 1
                node.left = child
            stack.append(child)
        return root

docs.title: 1. ​依子​樹​大小​模擬​中序
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(log n) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Inorder simulation by subtree size
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(log n) auxiliary; O(n) output
    """

    def sortedListToBST(self, head: ListNode | None) -> TreeNode | None:
        current, count = head, 0
        while current:
            count += 1
            current = current.next
        current = head

        def build(size):
            nonlocal current
            if size == 0:
                return None
            left = build(size // 2)
            root = TreeNode(current.val)
            current = current.next
            root.left = left
            root.right = build(size - size // 2 - 1)
            return root

        return build(count)

docs.title: 2. ​陣列​快照​與​中點​分割
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​ ​及輸出​

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Array snapshot and middle splits
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary and output
    """

    def sortedListToBST(self, head: ListNode | None) -> TreeNode | None:
        values = []
        while head:
            values.append(head.val)
            head = head.next

        def build(low, high):
            if low == high:
                return None
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            return TreeNode(values[middle], build(low, middle), build(middle + 1, high))

        return build(0, len(values))

docs.title: 1. ​帶​復​原​框架​的​明確​深度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n + ​輸出​大小​)

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit DFS undo frames
    Time: O(n + output size)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def pathSum(self, root: TreeNode | None, targetSum: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        result, path = [], []
        stack = [(root, 0, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, total, exiting = stack.pop()
            if exiting:
                path.pop()
                continue
            total += node.val
            path.append(node.val)
            stack.append((node, total, True))
            if node.left is None and node.right is None and total == targetSum:
                result.append(path.copy())
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, total, False))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, total, False))
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​累積​和​與​父節​點表​的​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n + ​輸出​大小​)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Breadth-first sums and parent map
    Time: O(n + output size)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def pathSum(self, root: TreeNode | None, targetSum: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        if root is None:
            return []
        parents = {root: None}
        queue = deque([(root, root.val)])
        result = []
        while queue:
            node, total = queue.popleft()
            if node.left is None and node.right is None and total == targetSum:
                path, current = [], node
                while current:
                    path.append(current.val)
                    current = parents[current]
                result.append(path[::-1])
            for child in (node.left, node.right):
                if child:
                    parents[child] = node
                    queue.append((child, total + child.val))
        return result

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​原地​將​二元​樹展​開為​符合​前序​順序​的​右子​節點​鏈​。​每個​ left ​都​必須​變成​ None，​所有​原節點​都​必須​保留​在​鏈​中​。

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​在​修改​連結前​，​前序​走訪​已經​決定​所​需節點​順序​。
  2. ​左子​樹​的​最右​節點​可以​接上​原本​的​右子​樹​。
​展開​解法​、​複​雜度​比​較​、​證明​與​ Python ​程式​

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​明確​前序​堆疊​ O(n) O(h) ​原地​子樹​接合​ O(n) O(1)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 明確​前序​堆疊
docs.text: ​使用​堆疊​走訪​節點​，​在​修改​上​一個​節點​的​連結前​，​先​保存​目前​節點​的​左右​子節點​。​將每個​走訪​節點​接到​前一個​節點​之​後​，​並​清除​左連結​。

docs.title: 原地​子樹​接合
docs.text: ​若​目前​節點​有​左子​樹​，​將原​右子​樹​接到​左子​樹​的​最右​節點​之​後​；​再​把​左子​樹​搬​到​右側​、​清空​ left，​然後沿​右連​結繼續​。

docs.title: 明確​前序​堆疊
docs.text: ​修改​連結前​已​保存​子節點​，​所以​堆疊​仍​按​原樹​的​前序​順序​產生​節點​。​將相鄰​的​走訪​節點​依序​連接​，​就​能​實現​指定​鏈​，​而且​不會​遺失​任何​子樹​。

docs.title: 原地​子樹​接合
docs.text: ​前序​要求​整個​左子​樹先​於​原右子​樹​。​接合​保留​這個​順序​，​並讓​目前​ right ​指向​下一個​前序​節點​。​每條​尋找​前​驅​的​邊只​被​掃​描常​數次​，​因此​總​工作量​仍為​線性​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​根​ 4 ​的​左子​樹​是​ 2，​且​ 2 ​的​右子​節點​是​ 3；​右側​是​葉節點​ 7。​最後右​鏈為​ 4->2->3->7。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​堆疊法​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(h) ​空間​；​原地​接​合法​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​。​兩者​修改​並​重用​原樹​，​不​建立​替代​輸出​節點​。​堆疊法​不​符合​常數​空間​的​延伸​要求​，​接​合法​符合​。​重寫​連結​前務必​保存​尚需​使用​的​子​節點​參考​。

docs.title: 1. ​明確​前序​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit preorder stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def flatten(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> None:
        stack = [root] if root else []
        previous = None
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            if node.right:
                stack.append(node.right)
            if node.left:
                stack.append(node.left)
            if previous:
                previous.left = None
                previous.right = node
            previous = node
        if previous:
            previous.left = previous.right = None

docs.title: 2. ​原地​子樹​接合
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: In-place subtree splicing
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def flatten(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> None:
        current = root
        while current:
            if current.left:
                last = current.left
                while last.right:
                    last = last.right
                last.right = current.right
                current.right = current.left
                current.left = None
            current = current.right

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​計算​從​來源​字串​選取​位置​，​使字元​依序​組成​目標​字串​的​方法​數​。​位置​不同​就​分別​計數​，​即使​選出​的​字​元​完全相同​。

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​來源​字元​可略過​，​也​可用​來​匹配​目標​的​下​一字​。
  2. ​計算目​標前​綴數​，​反向​更新​以免​同一​來源​字​元​使用​兩次​。
​展開​解法​、​複​雜度​比​較​、​證明​與​ Python ​程式​

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​反向​更新​目標​前綴​計數​ O(m*n) ​次​加法​ O(n) ​個​整數​項目​ ​以來源​位置​索引​的​匹配​計數​ O(m*n) ​次​加法​ O(m) ​個​整數​項目​

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 反向​更新​目標​前綴​計數
docs.text: dp[j] ​表示​已處​理來源​前綴​匹配​目標​前​ j ​字元​的​方法​數​。dp[0]=1，​代表​不選字​元​的​一種​方法​，​其餘為​零​。​每個​來源​字​元​由​右往​左掃​目標​；​若​匹配​ target[j-1]，​把​ dp[j-1] ​加入​ dp[j]，​否則​保留​略過​它​的​原計數​。

docs.title: 以來源​位置​索引​的​匹配​計數
docs.text: ​將計​數表​轉置​：​列​消耗​目標​字​元​，​欄​消耗​來源​前綴​。​空目標​在​每個​來源​前綴​中​都​有​一種​匹配​，​非空​目標​在​空來源​中則​為​零​。

docs.title: 反向​更新​目標​前綴​計數
docs.text: ​每個​匹配​不是​排除​目前​來源​位置​，​就是​包含​它​，​兩組​互斥​。​排除​保留​原計數​；​包含​則在​字​元​相等​時​延伸​短一字​的​目標​前綴​。​反向​更新​使​兩個​計數​都​來​自上​一來源​前綴​，​因此​每種​位置​選擇​只數​一次​，​也​不​重用​位置​。

docs.title: 以來源​位置​索引​的​匹配​計數
docs.text: ​每個​來源​端點​的​匹配​分成​略過​該點​，​或​使用​它​延伸​前​一目​標前​綴​。​兩組​互斥​，​得到​ current[left]+previous[diagonal]。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​反向​更新​目標​前綴​計數​：​時間​ O(m*n) ​次​加法​；​空間​ O(n) ​個​整數​項目​。

​以來源​位置​索引​的​匹配​計數​：​時間​ O(m*n) ​次​加法​；​空間​ O(m) ​個​整數​項目​。

​預設法​需​ O(source_length*target_length) ​次​加法​、O(target_length) ​個​整數​項目​，​輸入​不變​。Python ​整數​不溢位​，​但​中間​計數​可能​很大​，​算術​與​儲存​成本​仍​取決​於​位元長​度​。​由​左​往右​更新​會​讓​同一​來源​字元​貢獻​多次​；​將​相同​結果​字串​去​重則​是​另​一種​計數​問題​。​轉置​法以​來源長​度​儲存​，​向前​寫入​新列​；​兩法皆須​考慮​任意​精度​中間​計數​的​位元​成本​。

docs.title: 1. ​反向​更新​目標​前綴​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n) ​次​加法​

​空間​： O(n) ​個​整數​項目​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Backward target-prefix counts
    Time: O(m*n) additions
    Space: O(n) integer entries
    """

    def numDistinct(self, s: str, t: str) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (len(t) + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        for character in s:
            for end in range(len(t), 0, -1):
                if character == t[end - 1]:
                    dp[end] += dp[end - 1]
        return dp[-1]

docs.title: 2. ​以來源​位置​索引​的​匹配​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n) ​次​加法​

​空間​： O(m) ​個​整數​項目​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Counts indexed by matching source positions
    Time: O(m*n) additions
    Space: O(m) integer entries
    """

    def numDistinct(self, s: str, t: str) -> int:
        previous = [1] * (len(s) + 1)
        for target in t:
            current = [0] * (len(s) + 1)
            for end, character in enumerate(s, 1):
                current[end] = current[end - 1]
                if character == target:
                    current[end] += previous[end - 1]
            previous = current
        return previous[-1]

docs.title: 完美​樹鄰​居連結
docs.text: ​用​已​建立​的​ next ​走訪​每層​。​把​父節點​左子​連到​右子​，​再​把​右子​連到​下​一父​節點​的​左子​。

docs.title: 廣度​優先​逐層​連結
docs.text: ​每次​固定​處理​佇列​一層​，​把​前​一​取出​節點​連到​目前​節點​；​層末​ next ​結束​，​孩子​入下​一層​佇列​。

docs.title: 完美​樹鄰​居連結
docs.text: ​完美​樹​的​每層​父節點​都​有​左右​孩子​。​這兩種​連結​恰連好​下​一層​全部​相鄰配​對​，​維持層​鏈結​不​變量​。

docs.title: 廣度​優先​逐層​連結
docs.text: BFS ​恰由​左​往右​訪問​一層​，​連接​相鄰訪​問者​就​恰是​直接​右鄰​。​按​固定​層​大小​結束​，​可​避免​跨層​連結​。

docs.text: ​根​ 1 ​有​孩子​ 2、3，​設​ 2.next=3、3.next=None，​根​的​ next ​維持​ None。

docs.text:

​廣度​優先​逐層​連結​：​時間​ O(n)；​空間​ O(w)。

​兩法​只​改​ next，​保留​節點​身分​並回傳​原根​；left、right ​邊不變​。​佇列版​未達常數​空間​進階​要求​。​空樹​回傳​ None。

docs.title: 1. ​完美​樹鄰​居連結
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

from collections import deque


class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None, next=None):
        self.val, self.left, self.right, self.next = val, left, right, next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Perfect-tree neighbor links
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def connect(self, root: Node | None) -> Node | None:
        if root is None:
            return None
        root.next = None
        level = root
        while level.left:
            parent = level
            while parent:
                parent.left.next = parent.right
                parent.right.next = parent.next.left if parent.next else None
                parent = parent.next
            level = level.left
        return root

docs.title: 2. ​廣度​優先​逐層​連結
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(w)

from collections import deque


class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None, next=None):
        self.val, self.left, self.right, self.next = val, left, right, next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Breadth-first level linking
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(w)
    """

    def connect(self, root: Node | None) -> Node | None:
        queue = deque([root]) if root else deque()
        while queue:
            previous = None
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node = queue.popleft()
                if previous:
                    previous.next = node
                previous = node
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        queue.append(child)
            previous.next = None
        return root

docs.title: 1. ​下一層​鏈​結建​構器
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

from collections import deque


class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None, next=None):
        self.val, self.left, self.right, self.next = val, left, right, next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Next-level chain builder
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def connect(self, root: Node | None) -> Node | None:
        if root:
            root.next = None
        level = root
        while level:
            dummy = tail = Node()
            current = level
            while current:
                for child in (current.left, current.right):
                    if child:
                        tail.next = child
                        tail = child
                current = current.next
            tail.next = None
            level = dummy.next
        return root

docs.title: 2. ​廣度​優先​逐層​連結
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(w)

from collections import deque


class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None, next=None):
        self.val, self.left, self.right, self.next = val, left, right, next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Breadth-first level linking
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(w)
    """

    def connect(self, root: Node | None) -> Node | None:
        queue = deque([root]) if root else deque()
        while queue:
            previous = None
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node = queue.popleft()
                if previous:
                    previous.next = node
                previous = node
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        queue.append(child)
            previous.next = None
        return root

​時間​： O(N)

​空間​： O(h)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bottom-up suffix costs
    Time: O(N)
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def minimumTotal(self, triangle: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        dp = triangle[-1].copy()
        for row in range(len(triangle) - 2, -1, -1):
            for column, value in enumerate(triangle[row]):
                dp[column] = value + min(dp[column], dp[column + 1])
        return dp[0]

docs.title: 2. ​自頂​向下​的​前綴​前緣
docs.text:
​時間​： O(N)

​空間​： O(h)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Top-down prefix frontier
    Time: O(N)
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def minimumTotal(self, triangle: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        previous = [0]
        for row in triangle:
            current = [float("inf")] * len(row)
            for column, value in enumerate(row):
                if column < len(previous):
                    current[column] = min(current[column], previous[column] + value)
                if column:
                    current[column] = min(current[column], previous[column - 1] + value)
            previous = current
        return min(previous)

docs.text: ​合法​動作​依買​、​賣​、​買​、​賣​排列​，​最多​兩次​的​限制​允許​省略​動作​。​每個​狀態​不是​今日​不動​，​就是​由​前態​加上​今日​買賣​而​來​，​涵蓋​全部​合法​轉移​。​賣出​初值​零​也​允許​較​少​交易​，​逐階段​保留​最大​餘額​不會​損失​未來​可能​利潤​。

docs.title: 1. ​四個​現金餘額​狀態
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Four cash-balance states
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def maxProfit(self, prices: list[int]) -> int:
        buy1 = buy2 = -float("inf")
        sell1 = sell2 = 0
        for price in prices:
            sell2 = max(sell2, buy2 + price)
            buy2 = max(buy2, sell1 - price)
            sell1 = max(sell1, buy1 + price)
            buy1 = max(buy1, -price)
        return sell2

docs.title: 2. ​分界​兩側​各​一次​最佳​交易
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Best single trade on each side
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxProfit(self, prices: list[int]) -> int:
        left = [0] * len(prices)
        minimum = prices[0]
        for index, price in enumerate(prices):
            minimum = min(minimum, price)
            left[index] = max(left[index - 1] if index else 0, price - minimum)
        maximum = prices[-1]
        right = answer = 0
        for index in range(len(prices) - 1, -1, -1):
            maximum = max(maximum, prices[index])
            right = max(right, maximum - prices[index])
            answer = max(answer, left[index] + right)
        return answer

docs.title: 向下​增益​動態​規劃
docs.text: ​使用​迭代​後​序​走訪​，​取得​左右​子節點​的​向下​增益​，​負​增益​一律​視為​零​。​在​目前​節點​以​ node.val+left+right ​更新​全域​答案​，​再​保存​ node.val+max(left,right) ​作為​可​向​父節點​提供​的​增益​。

docs.title: 列舉​所有​路徑​起點
docs.text: ​把​樹​轉成​無向​鄰接​結構​，​從​每個​節點​出發​走訪​所有​路​徑並​累加​。​樹中​只​需​避免​立即​走​回父​節點​，​即可​避免​重​複​節點​。​這是​便​於​驗證​的​小型​輸入​基準法​，​平方​時間​可能​超時​。

docs.title: 向下​增益​動態​規劃
docs.text: ​任何​簡單​路徑​都​有​唯一​最高​節點​；​在​該​處​最多取​左右​各一個​向下​分支​，​因此​完整​路​徑候​選涵​蓋​所有​可能​最​優解​。​提供​給父​節點​時若同​時取​兩支​，​會​形成​分叉​而​不是​一條​路徑​，​所以​只能​保留​較​好​的​單支​。

docs.title: 列舉​所有​路徑​起點
docs.text: ​樹中​任意​兩個​節點​之間​只有​一條​簡單​路徑​。​從​所有​起點​走​到​所有​終點​，​就​涵蓋​每條​非空路徑​，​其​最大​和​必定​是​答案​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​根為​ -5，​左右​子節點​為​ 4、7。​經過​根​的​完整​路徑​和​為​ 4-5+7=6，​但​單節​點路徑​ 7 ​更大​，​因此​答案​是​ 7。​若​全為​負數​，​也​必須​選一個​節點​，​不能​回傳​空路徑​的​零​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​動態​規劃​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​，​不​修改​樹​；​明確後序​框架​可處​理長​鏈​。​全域​答案​應​從​負無限大​開始​，​而​不是​零​。​列舉​法為​ O(n²) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​，​是​可能​超時​的​教學​基準法​。

docs.title: Python ​實作
docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​向下​增益​動態​規劃
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Downward gain DP
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxPathSum(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        gains = {}
        stack = [(root, False)]
        best = float("-inf")
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                left = max(0, gains.get(node.left, 0))
                right = max(0, gains.get(node.right, 0))
                best = max(best, node.val + left + right)
                gains[node] = node.val + max(left, right)
                continue
            stack.append((node, True))
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, False))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, False))
        return int(best)

docs.title: 2. ​列舉​所有​路徑​起點
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2); ​教學​基準法​，​可能​超時​

​空間​： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate all path starts
    Time: O(n^2); educational baseline may time out
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxPathSum(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        adjacency = {}
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            adjacency.setdefault(node, [])
            for child in (node.left, node.right):
                if child:
                    adjacency[node].append(child)
                    adjacency.setdefault(child, []).append(node)
                    stack.append(child)
        best = float("-inf")
        for start in adjacency:
            pending = [(start, None, 0)]
            while pending:
                node, previous, total = pending.pop()
                total += node.val
                best = max(best, total)
                pending.extend(
                    (child, node, total) for child in adjacency[node] if child is not previous
                )
        return int(best)

docs.text: BFS ​距離​最​短​，​保留​邊恰​讓​距​離加​一​，​因此​重建​路徑​都​最​短且​無環​。​每條​最​短路​徑​都​提供​這些​前​驅邊​，​故必​被​列舉​。

docs.text: ​整層​結束​才​刪除​，​可​保留​到​同一​單字​的​不同​最​短路​線​。​更後層​不能​改善​距離​，​因此​第一​個目​標層​恰含​全部​最​短路​線​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​從​ "hit" ​經​ ["hot","dot","dog","lot","log","cog"] ​到​ "cog"，​兩條​最​短路​線分別​走​ dot/dog ​與​ lot/log ​分支​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
BFS ​前驅​ DAG ​與​迭代​重建​：​時間​ O(26NL^2 + PD^2)；​空間​ O(NL+E+P*D^2)。

​完整​部分​路線​的​分層​佇列​：​時間​ O(H26L^2 + HD)；​空間​ O(HD+N*L)。

N ​個​單字​各長​ L；D ​是​最​短路​線字數​、P ​是​輸​出路​線數​、E ​是​最​短前​驅邊數​、H ​是​產生​的​部分​路線數​。​每次​延伸​複​製​路​徑​需​ O(D) ​個​參照​。​完整​路線​基準​可能​多用​指數​倍​時間​／​記憶體​並逾時​，​建議​用​ DAG ​預設法​。​輸入​不變​。

docs.title: 1. BFS ​前驅​ DAG ​與​迭代​重建
docs.text:
​時間​： O(26NL^2 + P*D^2)

​空間​： O(NL+E+PD^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: BFS predecessor DAG and iterative reconstruction
    Time: O(26*N*L^2 + P*D^2)
    Space: O(N*L+E+P*D^2)
    """

    def findLadders(self, beginWord: str, endWord: str, wordList: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        from collections import deque
        from string import ascii_lowercase

        words = set(wordList)
        if endWord not in words:
            return []
        distance = {beginWord: 0}
        parents = {}
        queue = deque([beginWord])
        while queue:
            word = queue.popleft()
            if endWord in distance and distance[word] >= distance[endWord]:
                continue
            for index in range(len(word)):
                for letter in ascii_lowercase:
                    other = word[:index] + letter + word[index + 1 :]
                    if other not in words:
                        continue
                    if other not in distance:
                        distance[other] = distance[word] + 1
                        queue.append(other)
                    if distance[other] == distance[word] + 1:
                        parents.setdefault(other, []).append(word)
        if endWord not in distance:
            return []
        answers = []
        stack = [(endWord, [endWord])]
        while stack:
            word, path = stack.pop()
            if word == beginWord:
                answers.append(path[::-1])
            else:
                stack.extend((parent, path + [parent]) for parent in parents[word])
        return answers

docs.title: 2. ​完整​部分​路線​的​分層​佇列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(H26L^2 + H*D)

​空間​： O(HD+NL)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Layered queues of complete partial routes
    Time: O(H*26*L^2 + H*D)
    Space: O(H*D+N*L)
    """

    def findLadders(self, beginWord: str, endWord: str, wordList: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        from string import ascii_lowercase

        unused = set(wordList)
        if endWord not in unused:
            return []
        unused.discard(beginWord)
        frontier = [[beginWord]]
        while frontier:
            answers = [path for path in frontier if path[-1] == endWord]
            if answers:
                return answers
            following, discovered = [], set()
            for path in frontier:
                word = path[-1]
                for index in range(len(word)):
                    for letter in ascii_lowercase:
                        other = word[:index] + letter + word[index + 1 :]
                        if other in unused:
                            following.append(path + [other])
                            discovered.add(other)
            unused.difference_update(discovered)
            frontier = following
        return []

docs.title: 萬​用字​元分桶​ BFS
docs.text: ​為​字典​與​起點​建立​萬​用字​元桶​。BFS ​記錄​序列​長​度​，​起點長​度​為​一​。​對​出隊​單字​的​每個​模式​，​走訪​桶​內​尚未​見過​的​單字​，​接著​移除​該桶​。​目標​不​在​字典​中時​直接​拒絕​。

docs.title: 雙向​字元​替換​ BFS
docs.text: ​從​兩個​端點​同時​搜尋​，​每次​擴展​目前​較​小​的​一整​層​。​直接​產生​只​改一個​字母​的​單字​，​不儲存​萬​用字​元桶​，​並在​發現​字典​單字​時將​它​移出​未訪​集合​。

docs.title: 萬​用字​元分桶​ BFS
docs.text: ​兩個​不同​單字​共用​一個​模式​，​恰好​表示​它們​只​在​該​位置​不同​，​因此​桶​可​提供​所有​合法​鄰居​。BFS ​第一次​抵達​每個​單字時​，​使用​的​是​最​短​序列​。​擴展​桶​時​，​已​在​最早​可能​的​下​一層​發現​所有​成員​，​後​續​掃​描該​桶​不​可能​改善​距離​。

docs.title: 雙向​字元​替換​ BFS
docs.text: ​兩邊​的​前緣​都​按​完整​的​單位​距​離層​前進​。​第一​條連接​兩邊​已​探索​層的邊​，​形成​最短連​接路徑​。​從​字典​移除​已​發現​單字​可​避免​重​複​探索​，​但​仍​保留​與​對側​前緣​相遇​的​檢查​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​起點​為​ "cat"、​目標​為​ "dog"，​字典​為​ ["cot","cog","dog"] ​時​，​依序​為​ cat、cot、cog、dog。​回傳​ 4，​因為​起點​也​計入​單字數​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​預設​分桶​法令​ N ​為​不同​單字數​、L ​為​單字長​度​。Python ​切片​與​字串​雜湊​使​時間​與​最壞​桶​鍵儲​存量​為​ O(N * L^2)，​桶​中​的​項目​本身​另​使用​ O(N * L) ​個​參照​。​輸入​不變​。​若重​複​掃​描同​一桶​，​時間​可能​對​ N ​呈​平方​成長​。​回傳邊​數則​會​比題​目​要求​的​序列​長​度​少​一​。

​萬​用字​元分桶​ BFS：​時間​ O(NL^2)，​空間​ O(NL^2)。​雙向​字元​替換​ BFS：​時間​ O(26NL^2)，​空間​ O(N*L)。​此處​ N ​為​字典​大小​、L ​為​單字長​度​；​每個​替換​單字​的​切片​、​串接​與​雜湊​都​花​ O(L)，​並明確​保留​字母表​大小​ 26 ​的​因子​。​兩法​都​不​修改​原單​字​串列​。

docs.title: 1. ​萬​用字​元分桶​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(N*L^2)

​空間​： O(N*L^2)

from collections import defaultdict, deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Wildcard-bucket BFS
    Time: O(N*L^2)
    Space: O(N*L^2)
    """

    def ladderLength(self, beginWord: str, endWord: str, wordList: list[str]) -> int:
        words = set(wordList)
        if endWord not in words:
            return 0
        words.add(beginWord)
        length = len(beginWord)
        buckets = defaultdict(list)
        for word in words:
            for index in range(length):
                pattern = word[:index] + "*" + word[index + 1 :]
                buckets[pattern].append(word)
        queue = deque([(beginWord, 1)])
        visited = {beginWord}
        while queue:
            word, distance = queue.popleft()
            if word == endWord:
                return distance
            for index in range(length):
                pattern = word[:index] + "*" + word[index + 1 :]
                for neighbor in buckets.pop(pattern, ()):
                    if neighbor not in visited:
                        visited.add(neighbor)
                        queue.append((neighbor, distance + 1))
        return 0

docs.title: 2. ​雙向​字元​替換​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(26NL^2)

​空間​： O(N*L)

from collections import defaultdict, deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Bidirectional character-mutation BFS
    Time: O(26*N*L^2)
    Space: O(N*L)
    """

    def ladderLength(self, beginWord: str, endWord: str, wordList: list[str]) -> int:
        from string import ascii_lowercase

        unused = set(wordList)
        if endWord not in unused:
            return 0
        front, back = {beginWord}, {endWord}
        unused.discard(beginWord)
        unused.discard(endWord)
        distance = 1
        while front and back:
            if len(front) > len(back):
                front, back = back, front
            following = set()
            for word in front:
                for index in range(len(word)):
                    for letter in ascii_lowercase:
                        candidate = word[:index] + letter + word[index + 1 :]
                        if candidate in back:
                            return distance + 1
                        if candidate in unused:
                            unused.remove(candidate)
                            following.add(candidate)
            front = following
            distance += 1
        return 0

docs.title: 從雜​湊​集合​的​序列​起點​掃描
docs.text: ​排序​需要​ O(n log n)。​改為​建立​集合​，​只​從​前​一個​整數​不​存在​的​值​向前​掃描​；​這個值​就是​該​序列​的​起點​。

docs.title: 排序​後​掃描
docs.text: ​排序​輸入​副本​，​略​過重​複​值​，​並在​相鄰​不同​值​相差​一時​延長​序列​。​這個確​定性​的​基準​作法​易​於​理解​，​但​不​符合​題目​要求​的​線性​時間​。

docs.title: 從雜​湊​集合​的​序列​起點​掃描
docs.text: ​每段​非空​連續​序列​恰有​一個​最小值​，​只有​它會​啟動​掃描​。​因此​每個​不同​數值​只會​在​一段​序列​內​被​拜訪​一次​，​取​最大​長​度​就​不會重​複​計算​。

docs.title: 排序​後​掃描
docs.text: ​排序​後​，​每段​連續​整數​都​位​於​連續​的​位置​。​忽略​相等​的​鄰值​，​可​避免​重​複​值​錯誤​地​結束​或​延長​序列​。

docs.text:
​集合​起點法​的​期望​時間​為​ O(n)，​輔助​空間​ O(n)，​依賴雜​湊​操作​的​期望​常數​時間​。​必須​遍歷​集合​，​而​非​原陣列​；​否則​重​複​的​起點​可能​觸發​多次​長​掃描​。​空輸入​回傳​ 0。

​排序​法​需要​ O(n log n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​。​它​排序​副本​、​跳過​重​複​值​，​是​有用​的確​定性​基準​，​但​未達題​目的​線性​時間​要求​。​兩者​都​不​修改​輸入​。

docs.title: 1. ​從雜​湊​集合​的​序列​起點​掃描
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Hash-set run starts
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def longestConsecutive(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        values = set(nums)
        best = 0
        for value in values:
            if value - 1 in values:
                continue
            end = value
            while end in values:
                end += 1
            best = max(best, end - value)
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​排序​後​掃描
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort and scan
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def longestConsecutive(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        previous = None
        run = best = 0
        for value in sorted(nums):
            if value == previous:
                continue
            run = run + 1 if previous is not None and value == previous + 1 else 1
            best = max(best, run)
            previous = value
        return best

docs.title: 部分​數字​堆疊
docs.text: ​堆疊​保存​節點​及​抵達該​節點​前​的​部分​數字​。​取出​後​加入​目前​數字​；​若為​葉節點​，​就​把​完整​數字​加入​答案​，​否則將​更新​的​前綴​傳給子​節點​。

docs.title: Morris ​十進位​回溯
docs.text: ​建立​並​移除​暫時​的​中序​前​驅線索​，​以常​數額​外空​間​走訪​。​向下​時​更新​十進位​數字​；​沿線索​返回​時​，​根據​已​完成​的​左側​下降​長​度​移除​對應​位數​，​恢​復​祖先​前綴​。​藉由​前驅​的​結構​辨認​完成​的​葉路徑​。

docs.title: 部分​數字​堆疊
docs.text: ​由根​開始​歸納​，​乘​ 10 ​再​加​目前​數字​，​恰好​產​生根​到​目前​節點​所​表示​的​整數​。​每個​葉節點​只​處理​一次​，​故​所有​根到​葉數​字​各加​一次​。

docs.title: Morris ​十進位​回溯
docs.text: ​暫時​線索​只​負責​返回​已知​祖先​；​前​驅路​徑長​度​指出​返回​時需​移除​的​十進位​數字​個數​。​還原​後​的​前綴​與​再次​從根​走​到​祖先​相同​，​而葉​節點​的​完整​數字​恰好​各​累加​一次​。​所有​線索​最後都會​移除​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​堆疊法​為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(h) ​空間​，​不​修改​樹​。Morris ​法為​ O(n) ​時間​、O(1) ​額​外空​間​，​會​暫時​修改​連結​，​結束​時​必須​完整​恢​復​。​十進位​回溯​不能​少除​或​多​除​位數​。​以上​採用題​目數值​範圍​下​的​運算​成本​；​若​允許​無界長​路徑​與​大​整數​，​還需​計入​整數​位元​成本​。
