docs.title: 1. ​選取​與​略​過狀態​配對
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Take and skip state pairs
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def rob(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> int:
        values = {None: (0, 0)}
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                left, right = values[node.left], values[node.right]
                values[node] = (node.val + left[1] + right[1], max(left) + max(right))
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        stack.append((child, False))
        return max(values[root])

docs.title: 2. ​以孫​節點​遞​推​最佳值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Best value with grandchild recurrence
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def rob(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> int:
        best = {None: 0}
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                take = node.val
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        take += best[child.left] + best[child.right]
                best[node] = max(take, best[node.left] + best[node.right])
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        stack.append((child, False))
        return best[root]

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​子​迭代​器​的​延遲​堆疊​：​時間​ O(T) ​總走訪​; O(1) next ​在​ hasNext ​之​後​；​空間​ O(depth)。

​預先​攤平​的​快照​：​時間​ O(T) ​建構​; O(1) next/hasNext；​空間​ O(T)。

​巢狀​輸入​不變​。T ​包含​整數​與​巢狀​容器​。​延遲法​建構​為​常數​時間​，​但​一次​ hasNext ​可能​走過​很多​空​容器​。​本地​ NestedInteger ​輔助​類別​模擬​面試​提供​的​介面​，​供獨立​測試​。

docs.title: 1. ​子​迭代​器​的​延遲​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(T) ​總走訪​; O(1) next ​在​ hasNext ​之​後​

​空間​： O(depth)

class NestedInteger:
    """Standalone value container implementing the supplied nested-list interface."""

    def __init__(self, value=None):
        self._integer = value if isinstance(value, int) else None
        self._list = None if isinstance(value, int) else list(value or [])

    def isInteger(self):
        return self._integer is not None

    def getInteger(self):
        return self._integer

    def getList(self):
        return self._list

    def add(self, value):
        self._list.append(value)


class NestedIterator:
    """Approach: Lazy stack of child iterators
    Time: O(T) total traversal; O(1) next after hasNext
    Space: O(depth)
    """

    def __init__(self, nestedList: list["NestedInteger"]):
        self.stack = [iter(nestedList)]
        self.pending = None

    def hasNext(self) -> bool:
        if self.pending is not None:
            return True
        while self.stack:
            try:
                value = next(self.stack[-1])
            except StopIteration:
                self.stack.pop()
                continue
            if value.isInteger():
                self.pending = value.getInteger()
                return True
            self.stack.append(iter(value.getList()))
        return False

    def next(self) -> int:
        if not self.hasNext():
            raise StopIteration
        value, self.pending = self.pending, None
        return value

docs.title: 2. ​預先​攤平​的​快照
docs.text:
​時間​： O(T) ​建構​; O(1) next/hasNext

​空間​： O(T)

class NestedInteger:
    """Standalone value container implementing the supplied nested-list interface."""

    def __init__(self, value=None):
        self._integer = value if isinstance(value, int) else None
        self._list = None if isinstance(value, int) else list(value or [])

    def isInteger(self):
        return self._integer is not None

    def getInteger(self):
        return self._integer

    def getList(self):
        return self._list

    def add(self, value):
        self._list.append(value)


class NestedIterator:
    """Approach: Eager flattened snapshot
    Time: O(T) constructor; O(1) next/hasNext
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def __init__(self, nestedList: list["NestedInteger"]):
        self.values = []
        self.index = 0
        stack = list(reversed(nestedList))
        while stack:
            value = stack.pop()
            if value.isInteger():
                self.values.append(value.getInteger())
            else:
                stack.extend(reversed(value.getList()))

    def hasNext(self) -> bool:
        return self.index < len(self.values)

    def next(self) -> int:
        value = self.values[self.index]
        self.index += 1
        return value

docs.title: 依總​和​計算​最佳​乘積
docs.text: ​每個​總和試​第一段​，​餘數​可​保持​一段​或取​其​最佳​拆分​。​外層​一定​先切​一段​，​因此​至少​得到​兩段​。

docs.title: 優先​因子​三​並調​整餘數
docs.text: ​盡量​拆成​三​，​但​最​後​的​ 3+1 ​改成​ 2+2。n=2、3 ​須​另外​處理​，​因為​題目​要求​確實​拆分​。

docs.title: 依總​和​計算​最佳​乘積
docs.text: ​每個​拆分​都​有​第一段​，​其餘​不是​單段​就是​另​一個​拆分​。​試遍​第一段​值​就​涵蓋​每個​合法​拆分​。

docs.title: 優先​因子​三​並調​整餘數
docs.text: ​任何​至少​為​五​的​整段​，​改成​三​與​餘數​可​改善​乘積​。​一會​降低​乘積​，​三個​二​又​可​改善​成兩個​三​。​因此​最優​形式​只​含​三​和​至多​兩個​二​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​依總​和​計算​最佳​乘積​：​時間​ O(n^2)；​空間​ O(n)。

​優先​因子​三​並調​整餘數​：​時間​ O(log n) ​次算術​運算​；​空間​ O(1) ​個​整數​物件​。

​不​改動​輸入​。​冪次​運算​的​整數會​變大​，​位元​成本​須另計​，​不能​只​看算術​操作​次數​。n=2 ​或​ n=3 ​時​直接​回傳​ n，​會​違反​至少​兩段​的​要求​。

docs.title: 1. ​依總​和​計算​最佳​乘積
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Best product by total
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def integerBreak(self, n: int) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        for total in range(2, n + 1):
            dp[total] = max(
                first * max(total - first, dp[total - first]) for first in range(1, total)
            )
        return dp[n]

docs.title: 2. ​優先​因子​三​並調​整餘數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n) ​次算術​運算​

​空間​： O(1) ​個​整數​物件​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Factors of three with a remainder adjustment
    Time: O(log n) arithmetic operations
    Space: O(1) integer objects
    """

    def integerBreak(self, n: int) -> int:
        if n <= 3:
            return n - 1
        threes, remainder = divmod(n, 3)
        if remainder == 1:
            return 3 ** (threes - 1) * 4
        return 3**threes * (2 if remainder else 1)

docs.text:

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 頻率​桶
docs.text: ​先​建立​頻率​表​，​將每個​不同​值​放入​對應​頻率​的​桶​，​再​由​高​頻往​低頻​掃描​，​收集​到​ k ​個值​即​停止​。​這​避免​排序​所有​不同​值​。

docs.title: 大小​ K ​的​頻率​堆積
docs.text: ​計數​後​，​以​最小​堆積​保留​最大​的​ k ​組​ (frequency,value)。​它​不必​建立​ n ​個​頻率​桶​，​但​ k ​隨​ n ​增大​時​，​無法​保證​線性​時間​的​延伸​要求​。

docs.title: 頻率​桶
docs.text: ​每個值​恰好​位​於​自己​的​頻率​桶​。​由高往​低​掃​描會​按​不遞​增頻​率​處理值​，​故前​ k ​個​正是​高頻​集合​。​答案​唯一​的​保證​消除​了​截斷​位置​的​歧義​。

docs.title: 大小​ K ​的​頻率​堆積
docs.text: ​每處理​一個​不同​值​，​堆積​都​保留​目前​最大​的​ k ​個​頻率​配對​。​截斷點​的​集合​保證​唯一​，​因此​相同​頻率​的​內部​排序​不影響​答案​集合​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​頻率​桶​法為​期望​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​輔助​空間​，​另​需​ O(k) ​輸出​，​符合​優​於​ O(n log n) ​的​延伸​要求​。​建立​桶​時​要​用​推導式​配置​獨立​串列​，​不能​重​複​同一​串列​參考​。​堆積​法為​ O(n+u log(k+1)) ​時間​、O(u+k) ​空間​，u ​為​不同​值數量​；​最壞​情況​不​符合​線性​時間​，​但​可​避免​ n ​個​空桶​。​兩者​都​不​修改​輸入​。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency buckets
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        frequencies = Counter(nums)
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(nums) + 1)]
        for number, count in frequencies.items():
            buckets[count].append(number)
        result = []
        for count in range(len(nums), 0, -1):
            for number in buckets[count]:
                result.append(number)
                if len(result) == k:
                    return result
        raise ValueError("k must not exceed the distinct value count")

docs.title: 2. ​大小​ K ​的​頻率​堆積
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n + u log(k+1)); ​最壞​情況​ ​不​符合​線性​時間​的​延伸​要求​

​空間​： O(u+k)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Size-k frequency heap
    Time: O(n + u log(k+1)); worst misses linear follow-up
    Space: O(u+k)
    """

    def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        heap = []
        for value, count in Counter(nums).items():
            heappush(heap, (count, value))
            if len(heap) > k:
                heappop(heap)
        return [value for _, value in heap]

docs.title: 1. ​排序​區間​插入​與​鄰居合​併
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k) ​新增​; O(k) ​讀取​

​空間​： O(k)

from bisect import bisect_left


class SummaryRanges:
    """Approach: Sorted interval insertion and neighbor merging
    Time: O(k) add; O(k) get
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.intervals = []

    def addNum(self, value: int) -> None:
        index = bisect_left(self.intervals, [value])
        start = end = value
        if index and self.intervals[index - 1][1] + 1 >= value:
            index -= 1
            start, end = self.intervals.pop(index)
            end = max(end, value)
        while index < len(self.intervals) and self.intervals[index][0] <= end + 1:
            following = self.intervals.pop(index)
            end = max(end, following[1])
        self.intervals.insert(index, [start, end])

    def getIntervals(self) -> list[list[int]]:
        return [interval[:] for interval in self.intervals]

docs.title: 2. ​不重​複​值​集合​與​讀​取時​壓縮
docs.text:
​時間​： O(1) ​期望​ ​新增​; O(u log u) ​讀取​

​空間​： O(u)

from bisect import bisect_left


class SummaryRanges:
    """Approach: Distinct-value set with read-time compression
    Time: O(1) expected add; O(u log u) get
    Space: O(u)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.values = set()

    def addNum(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.values.add(value)

    def getIntervals(self) -> list[list[int]]:
        answer = []
        for value in sorted(self.values):
            if answer and value == answer[-1][1] + 1:
                answer[-1][1] = value
            else:
                answer.append([value, value])
        return answer

docs.text: ​同寬​高度​遞減​使​ LIS ​不​可能​選到​兩個​同​寬項​。​不同​寬時​，​高度​遞​增恰​對​應​合法​套疊​，​最小​尾值​不​變量​給出​最長​鏈​。

docs.title: 全部​前驅​的​套​疊​ DP
docs.text: ​任一​目前​結尾鏈​的​最後前​驅​，​兩座標​都​必​更​小​。​這些​候選​排序​後​都​在​前面​，​其​最佳​長​度​便​形成​精確​遞​推​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​寬​排序​與​高度​ LIS：​時間​ O(n log n)；​空間​ O(n)。

​全部​前驅​的​套​疊​ DP：​時間​ O(n^2)；​空間​ O(n)。

​排序​副本​保留​輸入​，​但​需​ O(n) ​個​參照​。​平方​基準​在​ n=100000 ​可能​逾時​，​完整​限制​請用​預設法​。bisect_left ​確保​高度​嚴格​增加​。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Width sort and height LIS
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxEnvelopes(self, envelopes: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from bisect import bisect_left

        ordered = sorted(envelopes, key=lambda pair: (pair[0], -pair[1]))
        tails = []
        for _, height in ordered:
            position = bisect_left(tails, height)
            if position == len(tails):
                tails.append(height)
            else:
                tails[position] = height
        return len(tails)

docs.title: 2. ​全部​前驅​的​套​疊​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: All-predecessor nesting DP
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxEnvelopes(self, envelopes: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        ordered = sorted(envelopes)
        dp = [1] * len(ordered)
        for i, (width, height) in enumerate(ordered):
            for j in range(i):
                if ordered[j][0] < width and ordered[j][1] < height:
                    dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)
        return max(dp)

docs.text:
​時間​： O(1) ​發文​／​追​蹤​／​取消​追​蹤​ ​期望​; O(f + 10 log(f+1)) ​取得​動態​消息​

​空間​： O(T+F) ​儲存​; O(f) ​查詢​

from collections import defaultdict
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Twitter:
    """Approach: Heap merge of user timelines
    Time: O(1) post/follow/unfollow expected; O(f + 10 log(f+1)) feed
    Space: O(T+F) stored; O(f) query
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.clock = 0
        self.posts = defaultdict(list)
        self.following = defaultdict(set)

    def postTweet(self, userId: int, tweetId: int) -> None:
        self.posts[userId].append((self.clock, tweetId))
        self.clock += 1

    def getNewsFeed(self, userId: int) -> list[int]:
        heap = []
        for user in self.following.get(userId, set()) | {userId}:
            posts = self.posts.get(user)
            if posts:
                index = len(posts) - 1
                heap.append((-posts[index][0], user, index))
        heapify(heap)
        result = []
        while heap and len(result) < 10:
            _, user, index = heappop(heap)
            result.append(self.posts[user][index][1])
            if index:
                heappush(heap, (-self.posts[user][index - 1][0], user, index - 1))
        return result

    def follow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        self.following[followerId].add(followeeId)

    def unfollow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        followees = self.following.get(followerId)
        if followees is not None:
            followees.discard(followeeId)
            if not followees:
                del self.following[followerId]

from collections import defaultdict
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Twitter:
    """Approach: Scan global timeline
    Time: O(1) post/follow/unfollow expected; O(T) feed
    Space: O(T+F)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.timeline = []
        self.following = defaultdict(set)

    def postTweet(self, userId: int, tweetId: int) -> None:
        self.timeline.append((userId, tweetId))

    def getNewsFeed(self, userId: int) -> list[int]:
        visible = self.following.get(userId, set()) | {userId}
        result = []
        for user, tweet in reversed(self.timeline):
            if user in visible:
                result.append(tweet)
                if len(result) == 10:
                    break
        return result

    def follow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        self.following[followerId].add(followeeId)

    def unfollow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        followees = self.following.get(followerId)
        if followees is not None:
            followees.discard(followeeId)
            if not followees:
                del self.following[followerId]

class Solution:
    """Approach: Count by significant length
    Time: O(min(n,10))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countNumbersWithUniqueDigits(self, n: int) -> int:
        answer = 1
        ways = 9
        for length in range(1, min(n, 10) + 1):
            if length > 1:
                ways *= 11 - length
            answer += ways
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​數位​遮罩​ DP ​與​前導​填補
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n102^10)

​空間​： O(2^10)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Digit-mask DP with leading padding
    Time: O(n*10*2^10)
    Space: O(2^10)
    """

    def countNumbersWithUniqueDigits(self, n: int) -> int:
        counts = {(0, False): 1}
        for _ in range(n):
            following = {}
            for (mask, started), count in counts.items():
                for digit in range(10):
                    if not started and digit == 0:
                        state = (0, False)
                    elif mask & (1 << digit):
                        continue
                    else:
                        state = (mask | (1 << digit), True)
                    following[state] = following.get(state, 0) + count
            counts = following
        return sum(counts.values())

docs.title: 1. ​長​度​與​前​驅連結
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Lengths and predecessor links
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def largestDivisibleSubset(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        ordered = sorted(nums)
        lengths, previous = [1] * len(nums), [-1] * len(nums)
        best = 0
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            for j in range(i):
                if ordered[i] % ordered[j] == 0 and lengths[j] + 1 > lengths[i]:
                    lengths[i], previous[i] = lengths[j] + 1, j
            if lengths[i] > lengths[best]:
                best = i
        result = []
        while best >= 0:
            result.append(ordered[best])
            best = previous[best]
        return result[::-1]

docs.title: 2. ​明確​保留​各端點​最佳​鏈
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit best chains by endpoint
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def largestDivisibleSubset(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        ordered = sorted(nums)
        chains = []
        for i, value in enumerate(ordered):
            best = []
            for j in range(i):
                if value % ordered[j] == 0 and len(chains[j]) > len(best):
                    best = chains[j]
            chains.append(best + [value])
        return max(chains, key=len)

docs.title: 平行​進位​傳播
docs.text: ​在​ 32 ​位元​遮罩​下​，​反覆​求​ XOR ​部分​和​與​左移​的​ AND ​進位​，​最後解讀​符號位​。

docs.title: 逐位​全加器
docs.text: ​逐一​處理​ 32 ​個​位置​與​一位​進位​，​以​全加器​真值表​算出​和​位元及​向​外​進位​。

docs.title: 平行​進位​傳播
docs.text: ​每​一位​的​ XOR ​加上​移位​進位​，​模​ 2^32 ​後​仍​表示​同一​總值​。​進位​每輪​向​左移​，​最終​消失​；​題目​保證​的​和​落​在​解碼​後​帶號​範圍​內​。

docs.title: 逐位​全加器
docs.text: ​和​位元​為​ x XOR y XOR carry；​三個​輸入​至少​兩個​為​一時​產生​進位​。​對位​元​位置​歸納​，​就​能​不​使用​算術​加減​重現​二​進位​加法​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: 1 ​與​ 3 ​首先​得到​ XOR 2、​進位​ 2；​後​續​把​進位​左移​，​最​後​得到​二​進位​ 100，​即​ 4。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​平行​進位​傳播​：​時間​ O(W) ​最差​情況​；​空間​ O(1)。

​逐位​全加器​：​時間​ O(W)；​空間​ O(1)。

​輸入​不變​，W=32。Python ​負整​數有​無限​符號​延伸​；​平行​進位​若​省去​遮罩​，​可能​無法​終止​。

docs.title: 1. ​平行​進位​傳播
docs.text:
​時間​： O(W) ​最差​情況​

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Parallel carry propagation
    Time: O(W) worst case
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def getSum(self, a: int, b: int) -> int:
        mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
        a &= mask
        b &= mask
        while b:
            a, b = (a ^ b) & mask, ((a & b) << 1) & mask
        return a if a <= 0x7FFFFFFF else ~(a ^ mask)

docs.title: 2. ​逐位​全加器
docs.text:
​時間​： O(W)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bit-by-bit full adder
    Time: O(W)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def getSum(self, a: int, b: int) -> int:
        answer = carry = 0
        for bit in range(32):
            x, y = (a >> bit) & 1, (b >> bit) & 1
            answer |= (x ^ y ^ carry) << bit
            carry = (x & y) | (x & carry) | (y & carry)
        return answer if answer <= 0x7FFFFFFF else ~(answer ^ 0xFFFFFFFF)

docs.title: 配對​和​排​序列​的​堆​積合​併
docs.text: ​從​第一​個​陣列​最多​ k ​個​位置​建立​列首​ (i,0)。​每次​取出​和​最小​的​配​對​，​只將​同一​列​的​下​一組​ (i,j+1) ​加入​堆積​。

docs.title: 二維​最佳​優先​搜尋前​緣
docs.text: ​從​ (0,0) ​開始​，​每次​取出​最小​配對​，​再​加入​尚未​見過​的​右側​與​下方​鄰居​。​用​索引​配對​集合​記錄​已​加入​項目​。

docs.title: 配對​和​排​序列​的​堆​積合​併
docs.text: ​每列​皆​已​排序​，​堆積​保存​每列​尚未​輸出​的​最小​配對​。​第​ k ​列以​後​的​列首​，​不​可能​早​於​前​ k ​個​列首​被​需要​，​因此​只​加入​前​ k ​列已​足夠​產生​ k ​個​最小​配對​。

docs.title: 二維​最佳​優先​搜尋前​緣
docs.text: ​列​與​欄​皆​單調​，​任何​尚未​發現​的​最小​候選​，​都​有​一個​不大​於​它​的​前​驅​。​持續​展開​最小​前緣點​，​因此​能​按配​對​和​不​遞減​的​順序​發現​所有​配對​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​列合​併​法時間​為​ O(min(k,m)+k log(min(k,m)+1))，​輔助​空間​ O(min(k,m))，​另加​輸出​；​二維前​緣法​時間​ O(k log(k+1))，​輔助​空間​ O(k)，​另加​輸出​。​此處​堆積​界限​中​的​ k ​可取​實際​回傳數​，​最​多​ m*n。​兩個​輸入​都​不變​。​不同​索引​上​的​相同​值​仍​是​不同​配對​；​向​兩個​方向​展開​時​，​一定​要​有​ seen ​集合​避免​重​複​。

docs.title: 1. ​配對​和​排​序列​的​堆​積合​併
docs.text:
​時間​： O(min(k,m) + k log(min(k,m)+1))

​空間​： O(min(k,m)) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap merge of sum rows
    Time: O(min(k,m) + k log(min(k,m)+1))
    Space: O(min(k,m)) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def kSmallestPairs(self, nums1: list[int], nums2: list[int], k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        if not nums1 or not nums2:
            return []
        heap = [(nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0) for i in range(min(k, len(nums1)))]
        heapify(heap)
        result = []
        while heap and len(result) < k:
            _, i, j = heappop(heap)
            result.append([nums1[i], nums2[j]])
            if j + 1 < len(nums2):
                heappush(heap, (nums1[i] + nums2[j + 1], i, j + 1))
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​二維​最佳​優先​搜尋前​緣
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k log(k+1))

​空間​： O(k) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Two-dimensional best-first frontier
    Time: O(k log(k+1))
    Space: O(k) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def kSmallestPairs(self, nums1: list[int], nums2: list[int], k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        if not nums1 or not nums2:
            return []
        heap = [(nums1[0] + nums2[0], 0, 0)]
        seen = {(0, 0)}
        result = []
        while heap and len(result) < k:
            _, i, j = heappop(heap)
            result.append([nums1[i], nums2[j]])
            for row, col in ((i + 1, j), (i, j + 1)):
                if row < len(nums1) and col < len(nums2) and (row, col) not in seen:
                    seen.add((row, col))
                    heappush(heap, (nums1[row] + nums2[col], row, col))
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​壓縮​的​上升​／​下降​貪婪​狀態
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Compressed up/down greedy states
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def wiggleMaxLength(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        up = down = 1
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            if nums[i] > nums[i - 1]:
                up = down + 1
            elif nums[i] < nums[i - 1]:
                down = up + 1
        return max(up, down)

docs.title: 2. ​逐​索引​交替​子​序列​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n squared)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Per-index alternating-subsequence DP
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def wiggleMaxLength(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        up = [1] * len(nums)
        down = [1] * len(nums)
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            for j in range(i):
                if nums[j] < value:
                    up[i] = max(up[i], down[j] + 1)
                elif nums[j] > value:
                    down[i] = max(down[i], up[j] + 1)
        return max(max(up), max(down))

docs.title: 1. ​最​後​元素​金額​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*T)

​空間​： O(T)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Final-element amount DP
    Time: O(n*T)
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def combinationSum4(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (target + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        for total in range(1, target + 1):
            dp[total] = sum(dp[total - value] for value in nums if value <= total)
        return dp[target]

docs.title: 2. ​正向​路徑​傳播
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*T)

​空間​： O(T)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward path propagation
    Time: O(n*T)
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def combinationSum4(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        ways = {0: 1}
        for total in range(target + 1):
            count = ways.get(total, 0)
            if not count:
                continue
            for value in nums:
                following = total + value
                if following <= target:
                    ways[following] = ways.get(following, 0) + count
        return ways.get(target, 0)

docs.text: ​在​最小值​到​最大值​之間​二分​。​每個​中點​從​左下角​開始​走​：​目前​值若​不大​於​中點​，​整個​上方​欄前​綴​皆​可計入​，​然後向​右​；​否則​向上​縮小候​選​。

docs.title: 堆積合​併​排​序列
docs.text: ​將每列​第一​個​項目​建立​最小​堆積​，​取出​ k ​次​，​每次​用​同一​列​的​下​一個​項目​補入​。

docs.title: 二分​搜尋​值域
docs.text: ​階梯​計數​精確​涵蓋​所有​不大​於​中點​的​項目​。​計數​隨候​選值​單調​不減​，​因此​使計數​至少​為​ k ​的​最小值​，​就是​包含​重​複​值​排名​後​的​第​ k ​小​。

docs.title: 堆積合​併​排​序列
docs.text: ​每列​的​目前​前端​是​該列​剩餘項​目的​最小值​。​反覆​選全體​列首​最小​者​，​就​能​按​排序​後​的​多重​集合​順序​產生​矩陣​項目​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​值域​二分​為​ O(n log(W+1)) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​，W=max-min。​列堆​積法​為​ O(n+k log(n+1)) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​。​矩陣​不變​。​二分​搜尋回​傳​的​是​數值​，​不是​矩陣​索引​；k ​很小​時堆​積法​可能​更合適​，​值域​搜尋則​不​需要​與​ n ​成​比例​的​儲存​。

​時間​： O(n log(W+1))

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search the value range
    Time: O(n log(W+1))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def kthSmallest(self, matrix: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(matrix)
        low, high = matrix[0][0], matrix[-1][-1]
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            row, col, count = n - 1, 0, 0
            while row >= 0 and col < n:
                if matrix[row][col] <= middle:
                    count += row + 1
                    col += 1
                else:
                    row -= 1
            if count < k:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle
        return low

docs.title: 2. ​堆積合​併​排​序列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n + k log(n+1))

​空間​： O(n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap merge sorted rows
    Time: O(n + k log(n+1))
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def kthSmallest(self, matrix: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
        heap = [(row[0], index, 0) for index, row in enumerate(matrix)]
        heapify(heap)
        for _ in range(k):
            value, row, col = heappop(heap)
            if col + 1 < len(matrix):
                heappush(heap, (matrix[row][col + 1], row, col + 1))
        return value

from random import choice


class RandomizedSet:
    """Approach: Dense array and index map
    Time: O(1) expected per operation
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.values = []
        self.indices = {}

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val in self.indices:
            return False
        self.indices[val] = len(self.values)
        self.values.append(val)
        return True

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val not in self.indices:
            return False
        index = self.indices[val]
        last = self.values[-1]
        self.values[index] = last
        self.indices[last] = index
        self.values.pop()
        del self.indices[val]
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return choice(self.values)

from random import choice


class RandomizedSet:
    """Approach: Set with random snapshots
    Time: O(1) expected insert/remove; O(n) getRandom; misses required O(1)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.values = set()

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val in self.values:
            return False
        self.values.add(val)
        return True

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val not in self.values:
            return False
        self.values.remove(val)
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return choice(tuple(self.values))

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class RandomizedCollection:
    """Approach: Dense occurrences and index sets
    Time: O(1) expected per operation
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.values = []
        self.positions = defaultdict(set)

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        absent = not self.positions[val]
        self.positions[val].add(len(self.values))
        self.values.append(val)
        return absent

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val not in self.positions:
            return False
        index = self.positions[val].pop()
        last_index = len(self.values) - 1
        last = self.values[-1]
        if index != last_index:
            self.values[index] = last
            self.positions[last].remove(last_index)
            self.positions[last].add(index)
        self.values.pop()
        if not self.positions[val]:
            del self.positions[val]
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return choice(self.values)

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class RandomizedCollection:
    """Approach: Frequency map and weighted scan
    Time: O(1) expected insert/remove; O(u) getRandom; misses required O(1)
    Space: O(u)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.counts = {}
        self.total = 0

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        absent = val not in self.counts
        self.counts[val] = self.counts.get(val, 0) + 1
        self.total += 1
        return absent

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val not in self.counts:
            return False
        self.counts[val] -= 1
        self.total -= 1
        if self.counts[val] == 0:
            del self.counts[val]
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        index = randrange(self.total)
        for value, count in self.counts.items():
            if index < count:
                return value
            index -= count
        raise AssertionError("Unreachable for a nonempty collection")

​時間​： O(1) ​建構​; O(n) ​讀取​Random

​空間​： O(1)

from random import choice, randrange


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Reservoir sampling
    Time: O(1) constructor; O(n) getRandom
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def __init__(self, head: ListNode):
        self.head = head

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        current = self.head
        count = 0
        selected = current.val
        while current:
            count += 1
            if randrange(count) == 0:
                selected = current.val
            current = current.next
        return selected

from random import choice, randrange


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Value snapshot and random indexing
    Time: O(n) constructor; O(1) getRandom
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, head: ListNode):
        self.values = []
        while head:
            self.values.append(head.val)
            head = head.next

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return choice(self.values)

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​保留​自有​的​原始​快照​。
  2. ​每步​在​該​項​仍​可​使用​的​位置​中均勻​選取​。

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​正向​ Fisher-Yates ​交換​ O(n) ​建構​/reset/shuffle O(n) ​由內​向​外建構​排列​ O(n) ​建構​/reset/shuffle O(n)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 正向​ Fisher-Yates ​交換
docs.text: ​複​製​原值​，​每次​ shuffle ​再取​新​副本​；​對​索引​ i，​均​勻選​ i ​到​ n-1 ​的​位置​並交換​到​ i。

docs.title: 由內​向​外建構​排列
docs.text: ​逐項​建立​新陣列​。​第​ i ​個​原值​隨機選​ 0..i ​的​位置​，​將該​位置​舊項​搬​到​新​尾端​，​再​把​新值​放在​那裡​。

docs.title: 正向​ Fisher-Yates ​交換
docs.text: ​每個​下​一​位置​都​均​勻​選自​剩餘值​，​每個​排列​的​機率​為​ 1/n ​乘​ 1/(n-1) ​一直​到​ 1，​即​ 1/n!。

docs.title: 由內​向​外建構​排列
docs.text: ​歸納假​設舊​前綴​均​勻​。​新項​以​等​機率​插入​ i+1 ​個​位置​，​就​讓​每個​較​大​排列​仍​等​機率​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: [2,4,6] ​的​六個​排列​皆​等​機率​；​做​任意​次​ shuffle ​後​，reset ​都​回傳​ [2,4,6]。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​正向​ Fisher-Yates ​交換​：​時間​ O(n) ​建構​/reset/shuffle；​空間​ O(n)。

​由內​向​外建構​排列​：​時間​ O(n) ​建構​/reset/shuffle；​空間​ O(n)。

​建構​會​複​製​輸​入​，​每次​回傳​陣列​也​全新​，​所以​呼叫者​改值​不​影響​保存​原件​。​兩法​用線​性輸出​記憶體​及​精確​均​勻​整數​抽取​，​不是​排序​近似​亂​數鍵​。

docs.title: 1. ​正向​ Fisher-Yates ​交換
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​建構​/reset/shuffle

​空間​： O(n)

from random import randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward Fisher-Yates swaps
    Time: O(n) constructor/reset/shuffle
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.original = tuple(nums)

    def reset(self) -> list[int]:
        return list(self.original)

    def shuffle(self) -> list[int]:
        result = list(self.original)
        for index in range(len(result)):
            chosen = randrange(index, len(result))
            result[index], result[chosen] = result[chosen], result[index]
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​由內​向​外建構​排列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​建構​/reset/shuffle

​空間​： O(n)

from random import randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Inside-out permutation construction
    Time: O(n) constructor/reset/shuffle
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.original = tuple(nums)

    def reset(self) -> list[int]:
        return list(self.original)

    def shuffle(self) -> list[int]:
        result = []
        for index, value in enumerate(self.original):
            chosen = randrange(index + 1)
            result.append(value)
            result[index] = result[chosen]
            result[chosen] = value
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​暫存​外層​輸​出區​塊​的​堆​疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+L*d) ​最壞​情況​

​空間​： O(n+L*d) ​最壞​情況​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Stack of suspended output chunks
    Time: O(n+L*d) worst case
    Space: O(n+L*d) worst case
    """

    def decodeString(self, s: str) -> str:
        stack = []
        chunks = []
        count = 0
        for char in s:
            if char.isdigit():
                count = count * 10 + int(char)
            elif char == "[":
                stack.append((chunks, count))
                chunks, count = [], 0
            elif char == "]":
                text = "".join(chunks)
                chunks, repetitions = stack.pop()
                chunks.append(text * repetitions)
            else:
                chunks.append(char)
        return "".join(chunks)

docs.title: 2. ​依括​號範圍​遞​迴​下降​解析
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+L*d) ​最壞​情況​

​空間​： O(n+L*d) ​最壞​情況​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Recursive descent by bracket scope
    Time: O(n+L*d) worst case
    Space: O(n+L*d) worst case
    """

    def decodeString(self, s: str) -> str:
        index = 0

        def parse():
            nonlocal index
            pieces = []
            while index < len(s) and s[index] != "]":
                if s[index].isdigit():
                    count = 0
                    while s[index].isdigit():
                        count = count * 10 + int(s[index])
                        index += 1
                    index += 1
                    inner = parse()
                    index += 1
                    pieces.append(inner * count)
                else:
                    pieces.append(s[index])
                    index += 1
            return "".join(pieces)

        return parse()

docs.title: 匹配​索引​蓄水池
docs.text: ​保留​輸入​參照​，​每次​查詢​掃描​匹配​位置​，​以​目前​匹配​數的​倒數​機率​取代​樣本​。

docs.title: 匹配​索引​蓄水池
docs.text: ​蓄水池​不變量​使​每個​前綴​內​的​匹配​位置​等​機率​。​不​匹配​位置​不​進樣​本​，​因此​最終​各​匹配​位置​機率​為​匹配​總數​的​倒數​。

​兩法​不​改輸入​。​蓄水池​保留​參照​並假​設值​穩定​；​索引​法擁​有​索引​快照​。​應比較​合法​支援​範圍​與​分布​，​不​要求​相同​亂數​序列​。

docs.title: 1. ​匹配​索引​蓄水池
docs.text:
​時間​： O(1) ​建構​; O(n) pick

​空間​： O(1)

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Matching-index reservoir
    Time: O(1) constructor; O(n) pick
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.values = nums

    def pick(self, target: int) -> int:
        matches = 0
        selected = -1
        for index, value in enumerate(self.values):
            if value == target:
                matches += 1
                if randrange(matches) == 0:
                    selected = index
        return selected

docs.title: 2. ​目標值​到​索引​串列​映射
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​建構​; O(1) ​期望​ pick

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Target-to-indices map
    Time: O(n) constructor; O(1) expected pick
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.indices = defaultdict(list)
        for index, value in enumerate(nums):
            self.indices[value].append(index)

    def pick(self, target: int) -> int:
        return choice(self.indices[target])

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​比例​乘積​圖​搜尋​ O(E+Q*(V+E)) O(V+E) ​帶​比例​權重​的​並查集​ O((E+Q)*alpha(V)) ​期望​ O(V)

docs.title: 比例​乘積​圖​搜尋
docs.text: ​每個​等式​加入​一條​比例​邊​及其​倒​數邊​。​對​每個​查詢​，​從​起點​搜尋​，​沿路​累乘邊​權重​；​到​達​終點​時​，​乘積​就是​所求​比例​。

docs.title: 帶​比例​權重​的​並查集
docs.text: ​保存​變數​與​父節點​的​比例​，​並以​集合​大小​決定​分量​根​的​合​併​方向​。​迭代​壓縮​路徑​時​，​同時​累​乘​比例​；​加入​新​等式​時​，​推導​連接​兩個​根所​需​的​權重​，​讓​等式​仍​成立​。

docs.title: 比例​乘積​圖​搜尋
docs.text: ​路徑​上​的​中間​變數會​在​乘積​中​相消​，​只​留下​起點​與​終點​的​比例​。​等式​一致​保證​不同​路徑​得到​相同​結果​；​若​找​不到​路徑​，​就​無法​由​已知​等式​決定​比例​。

docs.title: 帶​比例​權重​的​並查集
docs.text: ​不變量​ weight[x]=x/parent[x] ​使​沿​祖先​鏈​的​乘積​等​於​ x/root；​路徑​壓縮​後​仍​保有​這個​比例​。​以​推導出​的​比例​連接​兩個​根​，​可​保留​每個​等式​。​查詢​兩個​相連變​數時​，​將它​們​相​對​於​共同​根​的​權重​相除​，​即​得到​兩者​比例​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​令​ V ​為​變數​數量​、E ​為​等式​數量​、Q ​為​查詢​數量​。​圖​搜尋為​ O(E+Q*(V+E)) ​時間​、O(V+E) ​空間​；​帶權​並查​集為​期望​ O((E+Q)*alpha(V)) ​時間​、O(V) ​空間​。​輸入​不變​。​未知​變數​的​自身​查詢​，​與​已知​變數​的​自身​查詢​不同​。​浮點​乘積​依題​目容​許誤​差​比​較​；​倒​數邊​要求​等式​值為​正且​非​零​。

docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​比例​乘積​圖​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(E+Q*(V+E))

​空間​： O(V+E)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Ratio-product graph search
    Time: O(E+Q*(V+E))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def calcEquation(self, equations, values, queries):
        graph = {}
        for (a, b), value in zip(equations, values, strict=True):
            graph.setdefault(a, []).append((b, value))
            graph.setdefault(b, []).append((a, 1 / value))
        answers = []
        for start, end in queries:
            if start not in graph or end not in graph:
                answers.append(-1.0)
                continue
            stack, seen = [(start, 1.0)], {start}
            answer = -1.0
            while stack:
                node, ratio = stack.pop()
                if node == end:
                    answer = ratio
                    break
                for other, factor in graph[node]:
                    if other not in seen:
                        seen.add(other)
                        stack.append((other, ratio * factor))
            answers.append(answer)
        return answers

​空間​： O(V)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Weighted union-find ratios
    Time: O((E+Q)*alpha(V)) expected
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def calcEquation(self, equations, values, queries):
        parent, weight, size = {}, {}, {}

        def find(node):
            trail = []
            root = node
            while parent[root] != root:
                trail.append(root)
                root = parent[root]
            ratio = 1.0
            for item in reversed(trail):
                ratio *= weight[item]
                parent[item], weight[item] = root, ratio
            return root, weight[node]

        for (a, b), value in zip(equations, values, strict=True):
            for node in (a, b):
                if node not in parent:
                    parent[node], weight[node], size[node] = node, 1.0, 1
            ra, wa = find(a)
            rb, wb = find(b)
            if ra == rb:
                continue
            if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                parent[ra], weight[ra] = rb, value * wb / wa
                size[rb] += size[ra]
            else:
                parent[rb], weight[rb] = ra, wa / (value * wb)
                size[ra] += size[rb]
        answers = []
        for a, b in queries:
            if a not in parent or b not in parent:
                answers.append(-1.0)
                continue
            ra, wa = find(a)
            rb, wb = find(b)
            answers.append(wa / wb if ra == rb else -1.0)
        return answers

​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(log n) ​用​於​ ​十進位​轉換​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Subtract complete digit-width blocks
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(log n) for decimal conversion
    """

    def findNthDigit(self, n: int) -> int:
        width, start, count = 1, 1, 9
        while n > width * count:
            n -= width * count
            width += 1
            start *= 10
            count *= 10
        number = start + (n - 1) // width
        return int(str(number)[(n - 1) % width])

docs.title: 2. ​二分​搜尋​所在​整數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log^2 n)

​空間​： O(log n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search containing integer
    Time: O(log squared n)
    Space: O(log n)
    """

    def findNthDigit(self, n: int) -> int:
        def digits_through(value):
            total, start, width = 0, 1, 1
            while start <= value:
                end = min(value, start * 10 - 1)
                total += (end - start + 1) * width
                start *= 10
                width += 1
            return total

        low, high = 1, n
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if digits_through(middle) >= n:
                high = middle
            else:
                low = middle + 1
        offset = n - digits_through(low - 1) - 1
        return int(str(low)[offset])

class Solution:
    """Approach: Monotonic digit stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def removeKdigits(self, num: str, k: int) -> str:
        stack = []
        for char in num:
            while k and stack and stack[-1] > char:
                stack.pop()
                k -= 1
            stack.append(char)
        if k:
            del stack[-k:]
        return "".join(stack).lstrip("0") or "0"

docs.title: 2. ​貪婪​選擇​下​一個​數字
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Greedy next-digit selection
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def removeKdigits(self, num: str, k: int) -> str:
        keep = len(num) - k
        start = 0
        answer = []
        while keep:
            end = len(num) - keep
            index = min(range(start, end + 1), key=num.__getitem__)
            answer.append(num[index])
            start = index + 1
            keep -= 1
        return "".join(answer).lstrip("0") or "0"

docs.title: 1. ​依石頭​位置​的​稀疏​跳長​集合
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)，​期望值​

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sparse jump-length sets by stone position
    Time: O(n^2) expected
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def canCross(self, stones: list[int]) -> bool:
        jumps = {position: set() for position in stones}
        jumps[0].add(0)
        for position in stones:
            for previous in jumps[position]:
                for following in (previous - 1, previous, previous + 1):
                    target = position + following
                    if following > 0 and target in jumps:
                        jumps[target].add(following)
        return bool(jumps[stones[-1]])

docs.title: 2. ​稠密​抵達​索引​與​末​跳表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dense arrival-index and last-jump table
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def canCross(self, stones: list[int]) -> bool:
        n = len(stones)
        dp = [[False] * (n + 1) for _ in stones]
        dp[0][0] = True
        for end in range(1, n):
            for previous in range(end):
                jump = stones[end] - stones[previous]
                if jump > n:
                    continue
                dp[end][jump] = (
                    dp[end][jump]
                    or dp[previous][jump - 1]
                    or dp[previous][jump]
                    or (jump < n and dp[previous][jump + 1])
                )
        return any(dp[-1])

class Solution:
    """Approach: Descending heights and list insertion
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def reconstructQueue(self, people: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        queue = []
        for height, count in sorted(people, key=lambda person: (-person[0], person[1])):
            queue.insert(count, [height, count])
        return queue

docs.title: 2. ​身高​遞增​與​ Fenwick ​空位​選取
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Ascending heights and Fenwick free-slot selection
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def reconstructQueue(self, people: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        size = len(people)
        bit = [0] + [i & -i for i in range(1, size + 1)]
        queue = [None] * size
        for height, count in sorted(people, key=lambda person: (person[0], -person[1])):
            rank = count + 1
            index = 0
            step = 1 << (size.bit_length() - 1)
            while step:
                following = index + step
                if following <= size and bit[following] < rank:
                    rank -= bit[following]
                    index = following
                step >>= 1
            queue[index] = [height, count]
            update = index + 1
            while update <= size:
                bit[update] -= 1
                update += update & -update
        return queue

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search a feasible maximum sum
    Time: O(n log(S+1))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def splitArray(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        low, high = max(nums), sum(nums)
        while low < high:
            limit = (low + high) // 2
            pieces, total = 1, 0
            for value in nums:
                if total + value > limit:
                    pieces += 1
                    total = 0
                total += value
            if pieces <= k:
                high = limit
            else:
                low = limit + 1
        return low

docs.title: 2. ​精確​段​數動態​規劃
docs.text:
​時間​： O(k*n squared)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Exact-piece dynamic programming
    Time: O(k*n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def splitArray(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        previous = [0] + [float("inf")] * len(nums)
        for pieces in range(1, k + 1):
            current = [float("inf")] * (len(nums) + 1)
            for end in range(pieces, len(nums) + 1):
                current[end] = min(
                    max(previous[start], prefix[end] - prefix[start])
                    for start in range(pieces - 1, end)
                )
            previous = current
        return int(previous[-1])

class Solution:
    """Approach: Count arithmetic suffixes ending here
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        ending = answer = 0
        for index in range(2, len(nums)):
            ending = (
                ending + 1
                if nums[index] - nums[index - 1] == nums[index - 1] - nums[index - 2]
                else 0
            )
            answer += ending
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​加總​最長​同​差區​段
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sum maximal equal-difference runs
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        answer = run = 0
        previous = None
        for index in range(1, len(nums)):
            difference = nums[index] - nums[index - 1]
            if difference != previous:
                answer += run * (run - 1) // 2
                run = 0
            run += 1
            previous = difference
        return answer + run * (run - 1) // 2

docs.title: 位元​集合​的​子集​可達性
docs.text: ​第​ k ​位元​代表​可達​總​和​ k。​左移​目前​值會​把​它​加到​所有​舊​子集​，​再​與​略過​它​的​狀態​做​ OR，​並遮掉​超過​目標​的​位元​。

docs.title: 1. ​位元​集合​的​子集​可達性
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*T/w) ​個​機器​字​的​運算​

​空間​： O(T/w) machine ​個​機器​字​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bitset subset reachability
    Time: O(n*T/w) machine-word work
    Space: O(T/w) machine words
    """

    def canPartition(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        total = sum(nums)
        if total % 2:
            return False
        target = total // 2
        bits = 1
        mask = (1 << (target + 1)) - 1
        for value in nums:
            bits = (bits | (bits << value)) & mask
        return bool(bits & (1 << target))

docs.title: 2. ​明確​儲存​可達​總​和​集合
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*T) ​期望​

​空間​： O(T)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit set of achievable sums
    Time: O(n*T) expected
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def canPartition(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        total = sum(nums)
        if total % 2:
            return False
        target = total // 2
        reachable = {0}
        for value in nums:
            following = {previous + value for previous in reachable if previous + value <= target}
            reachable.update(following)
        return target in reachable

docs.text: ​分別​以​兩個​海洋​的​邊界​格子​為​起點​，​進行​迭代​走訪​。​逆向​水流​只​可​抵達​高度​大​於​等​於​目前​格子​的​鄰居​。​各次​走訪​記錄​自己​的​可達​集合​，​最後依列​順序​回傳​交集​。

docs.text: ​使用​一個​佇列​，​攜帶​新​得知​的​太平洋​或​大西洋​位元標​籤​。​先標​記邊界​格子​，​再將​各​海洋​位元​傳給​等​高​或​更​高​的​鄰居​，​最後回​傳同時​具備​兩個​位元​的​格子​。

docs.text: ​反轉邊​後​，​原本​向​下流​到​海洋​的​路徑​，​會​變成​從​海洋​向上​走​的​路徑​。​因此​各次​走訪​恰好​找到​能流​到​該​海洋​的​所有​格子​。​屬​於​兩個​集合​的​格子​，​各有​一條​到​達​對​應​海洋​的​路徑​；​兩條​路徑​不必​相同​。

​兩次​逆向​水流​ DFS ​與​合​併​海洋​標​籤​傳播​的​時間​皆​為​ O(RC)，​空間​皆​為​ O(RC)。​合​併​版用​一個​小​整數​遮罩​網格​，​取代​兩個​座標​集合​。​兩法​都​以​迭代​實作​、​保留​高度​，​也​都​必須​允許​通過​等​高邊​。

class Solution:
    """Approach: Two reversed-flow DFS traversals
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def pacificAtlantic(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        rows, cols = len(heights), len(heights[0])

        def reach(starts):
            visited = set(starts)
            stack = list(visited)
            while stack:
                row, col = stack.pop()
                for nr, nc in ((row + 1, col), (row - 1, col), (row, col + 1), (row, col - 1)):
                    if (
                        0 <= nr < rows
                        and 0 <= nc < cols
                        and heights[nr][nc] >= heights[row][col]
                        and (nr, nc) not in visited
                    ):
                        visited.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            return visited

        pacific = reach([(0, col) for col in range(cols)] + [(row, 0) for row in range(rows)])
        atlantic = reach(
            [(rows - 1, col) for col in range(cols)] + [(row, cols - 1) for row in range(rows)]
        )
        return [
            [row, col]
            for row in range(rows)
            for col in range(cols)
            if (row, col) in pacific and (row, col) in atlantic
        ]

docs.title: 2. ​合​併​海洋​標​籤​傳播
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Fused ocean-label propagation
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def pacificAtlantic(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        from collections import deque

        rows, columns = len(heights), len(heights[0])
        masks = [[0] * columns for _ in range(rows)]
        queue = deque()

        def add(row, column, bit):
            if not masks[row][column] & bit:
                masks[row][column] |= bit
                queue.append((row, column, bit))

        for row in range(rows):
            add(row, 0, 1)
            add(row, columns - 1, 2)
        for column in range(columns):
            add(0, column, 1)
            add(rows - 1, column, 2)
        while queue:
            row, column, bit = queue.popleft()
            for nr, nc in (
                (row - 1, column),
                (row + 1, column),
                (row, column - 1),
                (row, column + 1),
            ):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns and heights[nr][nc] >= heights[row][column]:
                    add(nr, nc, bit)
        return [[r, c] for r in range(rows) for c in range(columns) if masks[r][c] == 3]

docs.text:
​時間​： O(26n)

​空間​： O(26)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Exact-frequency window
    Time: O(26n)
    Space: O(26)
    """

    def characterReplacement(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        counts = [0] * 26
        left = best = 0
        for right, char in enumerate(s):
            counts[ord(char) - ord("A")] += 1
            while right - left + 1 - max(counts) > k:
                counts[ord(s[left]) - ord("A")] -= 1
                left += 1
            best = max(best, right - left + 1)
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​二分​搜尋​可行​長​度
docs.text:
​時間​： O(26n log n)

​空間​： O(26)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search a feasible length
    Time: O(26n log n)
    Space: O(26)
    """

    def characterReplacement(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        def feasible(width):
            counts = [0] * 26
            for right, char in enumerate(s):
                counts[ord(char) - ord("A")] += 1
                if right >= width:
                    counts[ord(s[right - width]) - ord("A")] -= 1
                if right >= width - 1 and width - max(counts) <= k:
                    return True
            return False

        low, high = 0, len(s)
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high + 1) // 2
            if feasible(middle):
                low = middle
            else:
                high = middle - 1
        return low

docs.title: 1. ​明確​保存​延​後​ next ​的​堆​疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： ​最差​ O(n)

class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, prev=None, next=None, child=None):
        self.val, self.prev, self.next, self.child = val, prev, next, child


class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit deferred-next stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n) worst
    """

    def flatten(self, head: "Node | None") -> "Node | None":
        stack = [head] if head else []
        previous = None
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            if node.next:
                stack.append(node.next)
            if node.child:
                stack.append(node.child)
            node.prev = previous
            if previous:
                previous.next = node
            node.child = None
            previous = node
        if previous:
            previous.next = None
        return head

docs.title: 2. ​原地​插接​ child ​串列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)，​攤銷​界限​

​空間​： O(1)

class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, prev=None, next=None, child=None):
        self.val, self.prev, self.next, self.child = val, prev, next, child


class Solution:
    """Approach: Splice child lists in place
    Time: O(n) amortized
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def flatten(self, head: "Node | None") -> "Node | None":
        if head:
            head.prev = None
        current = head
        while current:
            if current.child:
                first = current.child
                last = first
                while last.next:
                    last = last.next
                last.next = current.next
                if current.next:
                    current.next.prev = last
                current.next = first
                first.prev = current
                current.child = None
            current = current.next
        return head

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Keep earliest finishing intervals
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def eraseOverlapIntervals(self, intervals: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        end = float("-inf")
        kept = 0
        for start, finish in sorted(intervals, key=lambda interval: interval[1]):
            if start >= end:
                kept += 1
                end = finish
        return len(intervals) - kept

docs.title: 2. ​依起點​替換​重疊候​選
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Start-order overlap replacement
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def eraseOverlapIntervals(self, intervals: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        end = float("-inf")
        removed = 0
        for start, finish in sorted(intervals):
            if start < end:
                removed += 1
                end = min(end, finish)
            else:
                end = finish
        return removed

docs.text: ​把​每個​節點​各當​一次​起點​，​再​往下走​訪​所有​後​代並​累加​路徑​和​。​這個​基準法​不​需要​前綴​次​數表​，​但會重​複​走​過子​樹​。

docs.title: 目前​祖先​路徑​的​前綴​頻率
docs.text: ​次​數表中​的​每個​前綴​都​對​應​目前​節點​的​一個​合法​祖先​切點​。​兩個​前綴​的​差​等​於​向下​路徑​和​，​所以​符合​差值​的​次數​恰好​是​以​目前​節點​為​終點​的​合法​路​徑數​。​離開​時​復​原​，​便​不會​把​不同​兄弟​子樹錯​接成​路徑​。

docs.title: 列舉​向下​路徑​起點
docs.text: ​每條​向下​路徑​有​唯一​的​起點​與​終點​。​外層​恰好​選到​其​起點​一次​，​內層​也​恰好​走到​其​終點​一次​，​因此​每條​符合​總​和​的​路徑​計數​一次​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​一條值​為​ [1,1,1] ​的​鏈​，targetSum=2。​有​「​上方​到​中間​」​與​「​中間​到​下方​」​兩條​合法​路徑​，​答案​為​ 2。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​前綴​法​的​期望​時間​為​ O(n)，​輔助​空間​為​ O(h)。​列舉​法為​ O(nh) ​時間​，​最壞​為​ O(n²)，​輔助​空間​ O(h)，​長​鏈​上​可能​很​慢​。​兩者​都​不​修改​樹​。​前綴​表​初始​需有​零​的​次數​ 1，​才能​計入​從​根開始​的​路徑​；​必須​記錄​頻率​而​非​只記​集合​，​因為​零值​與​重​複​前綴​會產生​多條​合法​路徑​。

docs.title: 1. ​目前​祖先​路徑​的​前綴​頻率
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(h)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Active prefix frequencies
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def pathSum(self, root: TreeNode | None, targetSum: int) -> int:
        counts = {0: 1}
        result = 0
        stack = [(root, 0, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, prefix, exiting = stack.pop()
            if exiting:
                counts[prefix] -= 1
                if counts[prefix] == 0:
                    del counts[prefix]
                continue
            prefix += node.val
            result += counts.get(prefix - targetSum, 0)
            counts[prefix] = counts.get(prefix, 0) + 1
            stack.append((node, prefix, True))
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, prefix, False))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, prefix, False))
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​列舉​向下​路徑​起點
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*h), O(n^2) ​最壞​情況​

​空間​： O(h)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate downward starts
    Time: O(n*h), O(n^2) worst
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def pathSum(self, root: TreeNode | None, targetSum: int) -> int:
        result = 0
        starts = [root] if root else []
        while starts:
            start = starts.pop()
            if start.left:
                starts.append(start.left)
            if start.right:
                starts.append(start.right)
            pending = [(start, 0)]
            while pending:
                node, total = pending.pop()
                total += node.val
                result += total == targetSum
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        pending.append((child, total))
        return result

docs.title: 1. ​固定​次數​向量
docs.text:
​時間​： O(26n+m)

​空間​： O(26) ​另加​輸出​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Fixed count vectors
    Time: O(26n+m)
    Space: O(26) plus output
    """

    def findAnagrams(self, s: str, p: str) -> list[int]:
        need, have = [0] * 26, [0] * 26
        for char in p:
            need[ord(char) - 97] += 1
        answer = []
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            have[ord(char) - 97] += 1
            if i >= len(p):
                have[ord(s[i - len(p)]) - 97] -= 1
            if i >= len(p) - 1 and have == need:
                answer.append(i - len(p) + 1)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​缺額式​視窗
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+m) ​期望​

​空間​： O(alphabet) ​另加​輸出​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Deficit-based window
    Time: O(n+m) expected
    Space: O(alphabet) plus output
    """

    def findAnagrams(self, s: str, p: str) -> list[int]:
        need = Counter(p)
        missing = len(p)
        answer = []
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            if need[char] > 0:
                missing -= 1
            need[char] -= 1
            if i >= len(p):
                outgoing = s[i - len(p)]
                need[outgoing] += 1
                if need[outgoing] > 0:
                    missing += 1
            if i >= len(p) - 1 and missing == 0:
                answer.append(i - len(p) + 1)
        return answer

docs.title: 1. ​原地​讀寫​指標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​空間​

from itertools import groupby


class Solution:
    """Approach: In-place read and write pointers
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary
    """

    def compress(self, chars: list[str]) -> int:
        read = write = 0
        while read < len(chars):
            end = read + 1
            while end < len(chars) and chars[end] == chars[read]:
                end += 1
            chars[write] = chars[read]
            write += 1
            count = end - read
            if count > 1:
                place = 1
                while place * 10 <= count:
                    place *= 10
                while place:
                    digit, count = divmod(count, place)
                    chars[write] = chr(ord("0") + digit)
                    write += 1
                    place //= 10
            read = end
        return write

docs.title: 2. ​緩衝區​游程​編碼
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)；​教學​基準​超過​ O(1) ​輔助​空間​目標​

from itertools import groupby


class Solution:
    """Approach: Buffered run encoding
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n); educational baseline exceeding the O(1) auxiliary-space goal
    """

    def compress(self, chars: list[str]) -> int:
        output = []
        for char, group in groupby(chars):
            count = sum(1 for _ in group)
            output.append(char)
            if count > 1:
                output.extend(str(count))
        chars[:] = output
        return len(output)

​兩法​保留​ nums，​支援​負​公差​及重​複​值​。​明確​數對​基準​在​ n=1000 ​附近​可能​逾時​，​尤其​全​等值​時​，​應​使用​平方​級​預設法​。​字典​查詢​為​期望​固定​時間​。

docs.title: 1. ​以​公差​為鍵​的​終點表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)，​期望值​

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Endpoint maps keyed by common difference
    Time: O(n^2) expected
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        ending = [{} for _ in nums]
        answer = 0
        for end, value in enumerate(nums):
            for previous in range(end):
                difference = value - nums[previous]
                extensions = ending[previous].get(difference, 0)
                answer += extensions
                ending[end][difference] = ending[end].get(difference, 0) + extensions + 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​明確​最後數​對​遞​推
docs.text:
​時間​： ​最差​ O(n^3)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit final-pair recurrence
    Time: O(n^3) worst case
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        positions = {}
        for index, value in enumerate(nums):
            positions.setdefault(value, []).append(index)
        pairs = [[0] * len(nums) for _ in nums]
        answer = 0
        for end in range(len(nums)):
            for previous in range(end):
                required = 2 * nums[previous] - nums[end]
                for earlier in positions.get(required, ()):
                    if earlier >= previous:
                        break
                    pairs[previous][end] += 1 + pairs[earlier][previous]
                answer += pairs[previous][end]
        return answer

docs.text: ​迭代​序列化​根​、​左​、​右值​。​依該​順序​解碼​：​較小值​接​左​，​較大值​先彈​出​已​完成​祖先​，​再​接右​。

docs.text: ​迭代​序列化​左​、​右​、​根​，​反向​解碼​時交換​前序​的​左右​角色​。​格式​由​各​ codec ​自行​配對​使用​。

docs.title: 前序​值​與​祖先​堆疊
docs.text: ​首值​確定​根​；​嚴格​ BST ​值域​決定後續​每值​位置​。​彈出​較​小​祖先​，​恰能​找出​右子​樹​包含​新值​的​最近​祖先​。

docs.title: 後​序值​與​反向​堆疊
docs.text: ​反向​後​序​為​根​、​右​、​左​。​較大值​往右​下行​，​較小值​結束​已​完成​的​右側​祖先​並開始​合適​左子​樹​，​是​對​稱​的​ BST ​建構​。

docs.text:
​前序​值​與​祖先​堆疊​：​時間​ O(n)；​空間​ O(n)。

​後​序值​與​反向​堆疊​：​時間​ O(n)；​空間​ O(n)。

​序列化​保留​輸入​，​反​序列化​配置​新節點​。​往返​需​使用​同一​變體​。​切分​字串​及​儲存​數值​需線性​空間​；​迭代​可​支援​很深​的​ BST。

docs.title: 1. ​前序​值​與​祖先​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Codec:
    """Approach: Preorder values and ancestor stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def serialize(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> str:
        result = []
        stack = [root] if root else []
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            result.append(str(node.val))
            if node.right:
                stack.append(node.right)
            if node.left:
                stack.append(node.left)
        return ",".join(result)

    def deserialize(self, data: str) -> TreeNode | None:
        if not data:
            return None
        values = list(map(int, data.split(",")))
        root = TreeNode(values[0])
        stack = [root]
        for value in values[1:]:
            node = TreeNode(value)
            if value < stack[-1].val:
                stack[-1].left = node
            else:
                parent = stack[-1]
                while stack and value > stack[-1].val:
                    parent = stack.pop()
                parent.right = node
            stack.append(node)
        return root

docs.title: 2. ​後​序值​與​反向​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Codec:
    """Approach: Postorder values and reversed stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def serialize(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> str:
        result = []
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                result.append(str(node.val))
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                if node.right:
                    stack.append((node.right, False))
                if node.left:
                    stack.append((node.left, False))
        return ",".join(result)

    def deserialize(self, data: str) -> TreeNode | None:
        if not data:
            return None
        values = list(map(int, data.split(",")))
        root = TreeNode(values[-1])
        stack = [root]
        for value in reversed(values[:-1]):
            node = TreeNode(value)
            if value > stack[-1].val:
                stack[-1].right = node
            else:
                parent = stack[-1]
                while stack and value < stack[-1].val:
                    parent = stack.pop()
                parent.left = node
            stack.append(node)
        return root

  2. ​有​兩個子​節點​時​，​可以​提升​中序後繼​，​也​可​把​右子​樹​接到​左子​樹​最大​節點​之​後​。

docs.title: 實體​提升​後​繼節點
docs.text: ​迭代​找到​目標​及其​父節點​。​若目​標有​兩個子​節點​，​就​把​右子​樹​最小​節點​從​原​位置​拆​下​，​將這個​原節點​實際​搬​到​目標​位置​，​而​不是​覆寫​其他​節點​的​值​。

docs.title: 提升​左子​樹並​嫁接
docs.text: ​目標​有​兩個子​節點​時​，​提升​整棵​左子​樹​，​並將​原右子​樹​接到​左子​樹​最大​節點​的​ right。

docs.title: 實體​提升​後​繼節點
docs.text: ​後​繼大​於​所有​左子​樹值​，​且​不​大​於​其餘右子​樹值​，​因此​可​合法​取代​目標​。​後​繼原​位置​沒有​左子​節點​，​拆下​時​只​需​提升​其​可能​存在​的​右子​節點​，​就​能​保留​原​排序​。

docs.title: 提升​左子​樹並​嫁接
docs.text: ​右子​樹​所有​值​都​大​於​目標​，​因此​也​大​於​左子​樹​所有​值​。​將它​接​在​左子​樹​最大值​之​後​，​不​違反​任何​二元​搜尋樹​界限​，​且​所有​剩餘​節點​仍​可​抵達​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​刪​除根​ 4，​其​左側​為​葉節點​ 2，​右子​樹​根為​ 7 ​且​左子​節點​為​ 5。​可​提升​ 5 ​取代​ 4；​也​可​提升​ 2，​再​把​原右子​樹​接到​ 2 ​之​後​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(h) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​，​修改​指標​、​保留​所有​剩餘​節點​的​身份​與​數值​，​並​避免​遞​迴​。​合法​結果​的​樹形​不​一定​唯一​。​刪除​原根時​可能​產生​新​的​根​參考​，​所以​必須​回傳​更新​後​的​根​。

docs.title: 1. ​實體​提升​後​繼節點
docs.text:
​時間​： O(h)

​空間​： O(1)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Physical successor promotion
    Time: O(h)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def deleteNode(self, root: TreeNode | None, key: int) -> TreeNode | None:
        parent, node = None, root
        while node and node.val != key:
            parent = node
            node = node.left if key < node.val else node.right
        if node is None:
            return root
        if node.left and node.right:
            successor_parent, successor = node, node.right
            while successor.left:
                successor_parent, successor = successor, successor.left
            if successor_parent is not node:
                successor_parent.left = successor.right
                successor.right = node.right
            successor.left = node.left
            replacement = successor
        else:
            replacement = node.left or node.right
        if parent is None:
            return replacement
        if parent.left is node:
            parent.left = replacement
        else:
            parent.right = replacement
        return root

docs.title: 2. ​提升​左子​樹並​嫁接
docs.text:
​時間​： O(h)

​空間​： O(1)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Left-subtree promotion and graft
    Time: O(h)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def deleteNode(self, root: TreeNode | None, key: int) -> TreeNode | None:
        dummy = TreeNode(right=root)
        parent, node = dummy, root
        while node and node.val != key:
            parent = node
            node = node.left if key < node.val else node.right
        if node is None:
            return root
        replacement = node.right
        if node.left:
            replacement = node.left
            maximum = replacement
            while maximum.right:
                maximum = maximum.right
            maximum.right = node.right
        if parent.left is node:
            parent.left = replacement
        else:
            parent.right = replacement
        return dummy.right

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+u)

​空間​： O(n+u)，​包含​輸出​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency buckets
    Time: O(n+u)
    Space: O(n+u), including output
    """

    def frequencySort(self, s: str) -> str:
        counts = Counter(s)
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(s) + 1)]
        for char, count in counts.items():
            buckets[count].append(char)
        return "".join(char * count for count in range(len(s), 0, -1) for char in buckets[count])

docs.title: 2. ​排序​頻率​項目
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+u log u)

​空間​： O(n+u) ​包含​輸出​；O(u) ​其他​儲存​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted frequency entries
    Time: O(n+u log u)
    Space: O(n+u) including output; O(u) other storage
    """

    def frequencySort(self, s: str) -> str:
        entries = sorted(Counter(s).items(), key=lambda item: -item[1])
        return "".join(char * count for char, count in entries)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Earliest-end arrow placement
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findMinArrowShots(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        arrows = 0
        position = float("-inf")
        for start, end in sorted(points, key=lambda point: point[1]):
            if start > position:
                arrows += 1
                position = end
        return arrows

class Solution:
    """Approach: Start-order intersection groups
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findMinArrowShots(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        end = float("-inf")
        arrows = 0
        for start, finish in sorted(points):
            if start > end:
                arrows += 1
                end = finish
            else:
                end = min(end, finish)
        return arrows

    Time: O(n squared) expected

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted pair sums with run counting
    Time: O(n squared log n)
    Space: O(n squared)
    """

    def fourSumCount(self, nums1, nums2, nums3, nums4) -> int:
        left = sorted(a + b for a in nums1 for b in nums2)
        right = sorted(c + d for c in nums3 for d in nums4)
        i, j, answer = 0, len(right) - 1, 0
        while i < len(left) and j >= 0:
            total = left[i] + right[j]
            if total < 0:
                i += 1
            elif total > 0:
                j -= 1
            else:
                start, end = i, j
                a, b = left[i], right[j]
                while i < len(left) and left[i] == a:
                    i += 1
                while j >= 0 and right[j] == b:
                    j -= 1
                answer += (i - start) * (end - j)
        return answer

class Solution:
    """Approach: Reverse monotonic stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def find132pattern(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        stack = []
        third = float("-inf")
        for value in reversed(nums):
            if value < third:
                return True
            while stack and stack[-1] < value:
                third = stack.pop()
            stack.append(value)
        return False

from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix minima with sorted suffix
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def find132pattern(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        if len(nums) < 3:
            return False
        suffix = sorted(nums[1:])
        smallest = nums[0]
        for j in range(1, len(nums) - 1):
            suffix.pop(bisect_left(suffix, nums[j]))
            index = bisect_right(suffix, smallest)
            if index < len(suffix) and suffix[index] < nums[j]:
                return True
            smallest = min(smallest, nums[j])
        return False

docs.text:
​時間​： O(1) ​期望​ ​每次​操作​

​空間​： O(capacity)

from collections import OrderedDict


class LFUCache:
    """Approach: Frequency buckets with ordered recency
    Time: O(1) expected per operation
    Space: O(capacity)
    """

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.values = {}
        self.buckets = {}
        self.minimum = 0

    def _touch(self, key):
        value, frequency = self.values[key]
        bucket = self.buckets[frequency]
        del bucket[key]
        if not bucket:
            del self.buckets[frequency]
            if self.minimum == frequency:
                self.minimum += 1
        frequency += 1
        self.values[key] = (value, frequency)
        self.buckets.setdefault(frequency, OrderedDict())[key] = None
        return value

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        return self._touch(key) if key in self.values else -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if self.capacity == 0:
            return
        if key in self.values:
            self.values[key] = (value, self.values[key][1])
            self._touch(key)
            return
        if len(self.values) == self.capacity:
            bucket = self.buckets[self.minimum]
            victim, _ = bucket.popitem(last=False)
            del self.values[victim]
            if not bucket:
                del self.buckets[self.minimum]
        self.values[key] = (value, 1)
        self.buckets.setdefault(1, OrderedDict())[key] = None
        self.minimum = 1

from collections import OrderedDict


class LFUCache:
    """Approach: Timestamped entries and eviction scan
    Time: O(1) get/update; O(capacity) eviction; misses required O(1)
    Space: O(capacity)
    """

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.clock = 0
        self.entries = {}

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        if key not in self.entries:
            return -1
        self.clock += 1
        value, frequency, _ = self.entries[key]
        self.entries[key] = (value, frequency + 1, self.clock)
        return value

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if self.capacity == 0:
            return
        self.clock += 1
        if key in self.entries:
            frequency = self.entries[key][1] + 1
        else:
            frequency = 1
            if len(self.entries) == self.capacity:
                victim = min(self.entries, key=lambda candidate: self.entries[candidate][1:])
                del self.entries[victim]
        self.entries[key] = (value, frequency, self.clock)

docs.text: ​可選​ 1..10、​目標​ 11 ​時​，​對手​可用​補到​ 11 ​的​數回應​每個​首選​，​因此​先手​輸​。

M<=20。​兩法​保留​輸入​，​先​排除​全域​不可​達​目標​；​目標​零視​為​已達成​。​記憶化​深度​受​ M ​限制​，​稠密​法則​固定​配置​兩個​ 2^M ​陣列​，​可能​做明顯​更​多​工作​。

docs.title: 1. ​記憶化​已選​遮罩​極小極​大​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(M*2^M)

​空間​： O(2^M)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized chosen-mask minimax
    Time: O(M*2^M)
    Space: O(2^M)
    """

    def canIWin(self, maxChoosableInteger: int, desiredTotal: int) -> bool:
        from functools import cache

        maximum = maxChoosableInteger
        if desiredTotal <= 0:
            return True
        if maximum * (maximum + 1) // 2 < desiredTotal:
            return False

        @cache
        def winning(mask, needed):
            for value in range(1, maximum + 1):
                bit = 1 << (value - 1)
                if not mask & bit and (value >= needed or not winning(mask | bit, needed - value)):
                    return True
            return False

        return winning(0, desiredTotal)

docs.title: 2. ​遮罩​遞減​的​逆向​博弈​表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(M*2^M)

​空間​： O(2^M)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Descending-mask retrograde game table
    Time: O(M*2^M)
    Space: O(2^M)
    """

    def canIWin(self, maxChoosableInteger: int, desiredTotal: int) -> bool:
        maximum = maxChoosableInteger
        if desiredTotal <= 0:
            return True
        if maximum * (maximum + 1) // 2 < desiredTotal:
            return False
        size = 1 << maximum
        totals = [0] * size
        for mask in range(1, size):
            bit = mask & -mask
            totals[mask] = totals[mask ^ bit] + bit.bit_length()
        wins = [False] * size
        for mask in range(size - 1, -1, -1):
            if totals[mask] >= desiredTotal:
                continue
            for value in range(1, maximum + 1):
                bit = 1 << (value - 1)
                if not mask & bit and (
                    totals[mask] + value >= desiredTotal or not wins[mask | bit]
                ):
                    wins[mask] = True
                    break
        return wins[0]

docs.title: 1. ​各結尾​字母​最長​合法​段
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(26)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Longest valid run per ending letter
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(26)
    """

    def findSubstringInWraproundString(self, s: str) -> int:
        best = [0] * 26
        run = 0
        for index, character in enumerate(s):
            run = run + 1 if index and (ord(character) - ord(s[index - 1])) % 26 == 1 else 1
            letter = ord(character) - ord("a")
            best[letter] = max(best[letter], run)
        return sum(best)

docs.title: 2. ​各​起始​字母​最長​合法​段
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(26)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Longest valid run per starting letter
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(26)
    """

    def findSubstringInWraproundString(self, s: str) -> int:
        best = [0] * 26
        run = 0
        for index in range(len(s) - 1, -1, -1):
            run = (
                run + 1
                if index + 1 < len(s) and (ord(s[index + 1]) - ord(s[index])) % 26 == 1
                else 1
            )
            letter = ord(s[index]) - ord("a")
            best[letter] = max(best[letter], run)
        return sum(best)
