docs.title: 1. ​遞減​數值​分桶​配置
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n + k^n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n+k)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Descending bucket assignment
    Time: O(n log n + k^n) loose bound
    Space: O(n+k)
    """

    def makesquare(self, matchsticks: list[int]) -> bool:
        k = 4
        values = sorted(matchsticks, reverse=True)
        total = sum(values)
        if total % k:
            return False
        target = total // k
        if values[0] > target:
            return False
        loads = [0] * k

        def place(index):
            if index == len(values):
                return True
            tried = set()
            for bucket, load in enumerate(loads):
                if load in tried or load + values[index] > target:
                    continue
                tried.add(load)
                loads[bucket] += values[index]
                if place(index + 1):
                    return True
                loads[bucket] -= values[index]
                if load == 0:
                    break
            return False

        return place(0)

docs.title: 2. ​已​用​遮罩​餘數​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*2^n)

​空間​： O(2^n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Used-mask remainder DP
    Time: O(n*2^n)
    Space: O(2^n)
    """

    def makesquare(self, matchsticks: list[int]) -> bool:
        k = 4
        values = matchsticks
        total = sum(values)
        if total % k:
            return False
        target = total // k
        if target == 0:
            return True
        remainders = [-1] * (1 << len(values))
        remainders[0] = 0
        for mask, remainder in enumerate(remainders):
            if remainder < 0:
                continue
            for index, value in enumerate(values):
                bit = 1 << index
                if not mask & bit and remainder + value <= target:
                    remainders[mask | bit] = (remainder + value) % target
        return remainders[-1] == 0

docs.title: 1. ​逐位​統計​一​的​數量
docs.text:
​時間​： O(30n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Per-bit population counts
    Time: O(30n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def totalHammingDistance(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        answer = 0
        for bit in range(30):
            ones = sum((value >> bit) & 1 for value in nums)
            answer += ones * (len(nums) - ones)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​直接​ XOR ​列舉配​對
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Direct XOR pair enumeration
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def totalHammingDistance(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        answer = 0
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(nums)):
                answer += (value ^ nums[j]).bit_count()
        return answer

​兩法​保留​ nums。​滾動法​複​製​輸​入​成​自有​分差​狀態​，​右端​點必須​向前​更新​。​平手​算先​手贏​，​所以​最後比​較​不可​使用​嚴格​大​於​。

​時間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Rolling interval score differences
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def predictTheWinner(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        dp = nums.copy()
        for left in range(len(nums) - 2, -1, -1):
            for right in range(left + 1, len(nums)):
                dp[right] = max(nums[left] - dp[right], nums[right] - dp[right - 1])
        return dp[-1] >= 0

docs.title: 2. ​絕對​最佳​分​與​區間​總​和
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Absolute best score and interval totals
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def predictTheWinner(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        dp = [[0] * len(nums) for _ in nums]
        for left in range(len(nums) - 1, -1, -1):
            dp[left][left] = nums[left]
            for right in range(left + 1, len(nums)):
                total = prefix[right + 1] - prefix[left]
                dp[left][right] = total - min(dp[left + 1][right], dp[left][right - 1])
        return 2 * dp[0][-1] >= prefix[-1]

​空間​： O(S)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Signed-sum frequency frontier
    Time: O(n*S)
    Space: O(S)
    """

    def findTargetSumWays(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        counts = {0: 1}
        for value in nums:
            following = {}
            for total, count in counts.items():
                for signed in (total + value, total - value):
                    following[signed] = following.get(signed, 0) + count
            counts = following
        return counts.get(target, 0)

docs.title: 2. ​負號​子集​計數​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*S)

​空間​： O(S)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Negative-subset count DP
    Time: O(n*S)
    Space: O(S)
    """

    def findTargetSumWays(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        total = sum(nums)
        if abs(target) > total or (total - target) % 2:
            return 0
        goal = (total - target) // 2
        dp = [0] * (goal + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        for value in nums:
            for subtotal in range(goal, value - 1, -1):
                dp[subtotal] += dp[subtotal - value]
        return dp[goal]

docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Diagonal coordinate bounds
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def findDiagonalOrder(self, mat: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        rows, cols = len(mat), len(mat[0])
        answer = []
        for diagonal in range(rows + cols - 1):
            low, high = max(0, diagonal - cols + 1), min(rows - 1, diagonal)
            indices = range(high, low - 1, -1) if diagonal % 2 == 0 else range(low, high + 1)
            for row in indices:
                answer.append(mat[row][diagonal - row])
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​依對​角線​分組
docs.text:
​時間​： O(mn)

​空間​： O(mn)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Group cells by diagonal
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(mn)
    """

    def findDiagonalOrder(self, mat: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(mat) + len(mat[0]) - 1)]
        for row, values in enumerate(mat):
            for col, value in enumerate(values):
                buckets[row + col].append(value)
        answer = []
        for diagonal, values in enumerate(buckets):
            answer.extend(reversed(values) if diagonal % 2 == 0 else values)
        return answer

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(w) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Breadth-first row processing
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(w) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def findBottomLeftValue(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        queue = deque([root])
        answer = root.val
        while queue:
            answer = queue[0].val
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node = queue.popleft()
                if node.left:
                    queue.append(node.left)
                if node.right:
                    queue.append(node.right)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​附​深度​的​迭代​ DFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Depth-indexed iterative DFS
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def findBottomLeftValue(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        stack = [(root, 0)]
        deepest = -1
        answer = root.val
        while stack:
            node, depth = stack.pop()
            if depth > deepest:
                deepest, answer = depth, node.val
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, depth + 1))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, depth + 1))
        return answer

class Solution:

    def largestValues(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[int]:

        queue = deque([root]) if root else deque()
        while queue:
            maximum = float("-inf")
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node = queue.popleft()
                maximum = max(maximum, node.val)
                if node.left:
                    queue.append(node.left)
                if node.right:
                    queue.append(node.right)
            result.append(maximum)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​附​深度​的​迭代​ DFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Depth-indexed iterative DFS
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def largestValues(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[int]:
        result = []
        stack = [(root, 0)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, depth = stack.pop()
            if depth == len(result):
                result.append(node.val)
            else:
                result[depth] = max(result[depth], node.val)
            for child in (node.left, node.right):
                if child:
                    stack.append((child, depth + 1))
        return result

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Interval palindrome table
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def longestPalindromeSubseq(self, s: str) -> int:
        dp = [[0] * len(s) for _ in s]
        for left in range(len(s) - 1, -1, -1):
            dp[left][left] = 1
            for right in range(left + 1, len(s)):
                dp[left][right] = (
                    2 + dp[left + 1][right - 1]
                    if s[left] == s[right]
                    else max(dp[left + 1][right], dp[left][right - 1])
                )
        return dp[0][-1]

docs.title: 2. ​與​反轉​字串​求​ LCS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: LCS against the reversed string
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def longestPalindromeSubseq(self, s: str) -> int:
        reverse = s[::-1]
        dp = [0] * (len(s) + 1)
        for first in s:
            diagonal = 0
            for column, second in enumerate(reverse, 1):
                above = dp[column]
                dp[column] = diagonal + 1 if first == second else max(above, dp[column - 1])
                diagonal = above
        return dp[-1]

docs.text:
​時間​： O(C*A)

​空間​： O(A)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Denomination-first rolling counts
    Time: O(C*A)
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def change(self, amount: int, coins: list[int]) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (amount + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        for coin in coins:
            for total in range(coin, amount + 1):
                dp[total] += dp[total - coin]
        return dp[amount]

docs.title: 2. ​面額​前綴​與​金額表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(C*A)

​空間​： O(C*A+C+A)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Coin-prefix and amount table
    Time: O(C*A)
    Space: O(C*A+C+A)
    """

    def change(self, amount: int, coins: list[int]) -> int:
        dp = [[0] * (amount + 1) for _ in range(len(coins) + 1)]
        dp[0][0] = 1
        for count, coin in enumerate(coins, 1):
            for total in range(amount + 1):
                dp[count][total] = dp[count - 1][total]
                if total >= coin:
                    dp[count][total] += dp[count][total - coin]
        return dp[-1][-1]

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(min(n,k))

class Solution:
    """Approach: Earliest index per remainder
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(min(n,k))
    """

    def checkSubarraySum(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> bool:
        first = {0: -1}
        remainder = 0
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            remainder = (remainder + value) % k
            if remainder in first:
                if i - first[remainder] >= 2:
                    return True
            else:
                first[remainder] = i
        return False

docs.title: 2. ​延遲​加入​的​前綴​餘數​集合
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(min(n,k))

class Solution:
    """Approach: Delayed prefix-remainder set
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(min(n,k))
    """

    def checkSubarraySum(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> bool:
        eligible = set()
        previous = current = 0
        for value in nums:
            current = (current + value) % k
            if current in eligible:
                return True
            eligible.add(previous)
            previous = current
        return False

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: First index per balance
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findMaxLength(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        first = {0: -1}
        balance = best = 0
        for i, number in enumerate(nums):
            balance += 1 if number else -1
            if balance in first:
                best = max(best, i - first[balance])
            else:
                first[balance] = i
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​排序​相同​的​前綴​平衡​值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort equal prefix balances
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findMaxLength(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        prefixes = [(0, -1)]
        balance = 0
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            balance += 1 if value else -1
            prefixes.append((balance, i))
        prefixes.sort()
        first = 0
        best = 0
        for i, (balance, index) in enumerate(prefixes):
            if i == 0 or balance != prefixes[i - 1][0]:
                first = index
            best = max(best, index - first)
        return best

docs.title: 偶數配​對​邊界​二分​搜尋
docs.text: ​比較​偶數​索引​中點​與​其後繼​；​配對​完整​就​把​搜尋​移至​配對​之​後​，​配對斷​裂則​保留​左半​。

docs.title: XOR ​抵消​基準
docs.text: ​將​全部​值​做​ XOR，​讓​相等​配對​抵消​。​這個​獨立且​簡單​的​基準​不​使用​排序​性質​，​也​不​符合​必要​的​對數​時間​界限​。

docs.title: 偶數配​對​邊界​二分​搜尋
docs.text: ​單一值​之前​，​相等值​佔據​偶數​／​奇數​索引​；​之後對​齊​方式​改變​。​因此​第一​個​斷裂​的​偶數配​對​就是​單一值​位置​，​每次​比較​都​保留​此邊界​。

docs.title: XOR ​抵消​基準
docs.text: XOR ​具結​合律​，​每個​相等​配對​都​貢獻​零​；​唯一​未​抵消​的​值​就是​單一​元素​。

docs.text:
​偶數配​對​邊界​二分​搜尋​：​時間​ O(log n)；​空間​ O(1)。 XOR ​抵消​基準​：​時間​ O(n)；​空間​ O(1)。

​輸入​不變​。​陣列長​度​為​奇數且​至少​一​。​讀​ middle+1 ​以前​先對​齊中點​，​可確​保該​讀取​留在​目前​搜尋區​間​內​。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Even-pair boundary binary search
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def singleNonDuplicate(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        low, high = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            middle -= middle % 2
            if nums[middle] == nums[middle + 1]:
                low = middle + 2
            else:
                high = middle
        return nums[low]

docs.title: 2. XOR ​抵消​基準
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: XOR cancellation baseline
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def singleNonDuplicate(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        answer = 0
        for value in nums:
            answer ^= value
        return answer

docs.title: 以​所有​零為​起點​的​多源​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​將​所有​零​的​距離​初始化​為​零​，​並一​併​加入​佇列​。​第一次​發現​值​為​一​的​格子​時​，​將其距​離設​為​目前​相鄰​格子​的​距​離加​一​。

docs.title: 正向​與​反向​距離​掃描
docs.text: ​建立​獨立​的​距​離矩​陣​。​先​從​左上​往右​下​掃描​，​使用​上方​與​左方​鄰居​更新​最小​距離​；​再​反向​掃描​，​使用​下方​與​右方​鄰居​更新​。

docs.title: 以​所有​零為​起點​的​多源​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​廣度​優先​搜尋會​依照​到​整組​起點​的​距​離遞​增處理​。​任一​最​短路​徑​，​都​會​先經過​距離​零​更​近​一步​的​前​驅​，​所以​第一次​發現​格子​時​得到​的​距離​就是​全域​最短​。

docs.title: 正向​與​反向​距離​掃描
docs.text: ​沒有​障礙​物時​，​到​某個​零​的​最​短距​離​就是​曼哈頓​距離​。​不論​零​與​目標​格子​的​相​對​方向​如何​，​都​能​選擇​一條​最​短單​調路徑​，​使​它​先​沿​正向​掃描​可​傳播​的​區段​，​再​沿​反向​掃描​可​傳播​的​區段​。​因此​兩次​掃​描能​傳播​每個​所​需​的​最小值​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​令矩​陣有​ R ​列​、C ​欄​，​兩者​皆​為​ O(RC) ​時間​、O(RC) ​空間​，​且​輸出​儲存​已主導​空間​上界​。​兩者​都​回傳​新矩​陣​，​保留​ mat ​不變​。​兩次​掃描​的​證明​依賴​沒有​障礙物​的​網格​，​不能​原封​不動​套用​到​有​牆壁​的​迷宮​。

docs.title: 1. ​以​所有​零為​起點​的​多源​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Multi-source zero BFS
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def updateMatrix(self, mat: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        from collections import deque

        rows, columns = len(mat), len(mat[0])
        distance = [[-1] * columns for _ in range(rows)]
        queue = deque()
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(columns):
                if mat[r][c] == 0:
                    distance[r][c] = 0
                    queue.append((r, c))
        while queue:
            r, c = queue.popleft()
            for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns and distance[nr][nc] < 0:
                    distance[nr][nc] = distance[r][c] + 1
                    queue.append((nr, nc))
        return distance

docs.title: 2. ​正向​與​反向​距離​掃描
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward and backward distance sweeps
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def updateMatrix(self, mat: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        rows, columns = len(mat), len(mat[0])
        distance = [[0 if value == 0 else rows + columns for value in row] for row in mat]
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(columns):
                if r:
                    distance[r][c] = min(distance[r][c], distance[r - 1][c] + 1)
                if c:
                    distance[r][c] = min(distance[r][c], distance[r][c - 1] + 1)
        for r in range(rows - 1, -1, -1):
            for c in range(columns - 1, -1, -1):
                if r + 1 < rows:
                    distance[r][c] = min(distance[r][c], distance[r + 1][c] + 1)
                if c + 1 < columns:
                    distance[r][c] = min(distance[r][c], distance[r][c + 1] + 1)
        return distance

docs.title: 1. ​迭代​鄰接​矩陣​ DFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative adjacency-matrix DFS
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findCircleNum(self, isConnected: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        seen = set()
        count = 0
        for start in range(len(isConnected)):
            if start in seen:
                continue
            count += 1
            seen.add(start)
            stack = [start]
            while stack:
                node = stack.pop()
                for other, connected in enumerate(isConnected[node]):
                    if connected and other not in seen:
                        seen.add(other)
                        stack.append(other)
        return count

docs.title: 2. ​聯集矩​陣上​三角
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2*alpha(n))

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Union the upper matrix triangle
    Time: O(n^2*alpha(n))
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findCircleNum(self, isConnected: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(isConnected)
        parent, size = list(range(n)), [1] * n

        def find(node):
            while parent[node] != node:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        count = n
        for a in range(n):
            for b in range(a + 1, n):
                if isConnected[a][b]:
                    ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
                    if ra != rb:
                        if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                            ra, rb = rb, ra
                        parent[rb] = ra
                        size[ra] += size[rb]
                        count -= 1
        return count

docs.title: 1. ​六個​滾動​出勤​狀態
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Six rolling attendance states
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def checkRecord(self, n: int) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        counts = [[1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]
        for _ in range(n):
            following = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(2)]
            for absences in range(2):
                for late in range(3):
                    count = counts[absences][late]
                    following[absences][0] = (following[absences][0] + count) % modulus
                    if absences == 0:
                        following[1][0] = (following[1][0] + count) % modulus
                    if late < 2:
                        following[absences][late + 1] = (
                            following[absences][late + 1] + count
                        ) % modulus
            counts = following
        return sum(map(sum, counts)) % modulus

docs.title: 2. ​六狀態​轉移​快速​冪
docs.text:
​時間​： O(6^3*log n)

​空間​： O(6^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Six-state transition exponentiation
    Time: O(6^3*log n)
    Space: O(6^2)
    """

    def checkRecord(self, n: int) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        transition = [[0] * 6 for _ in range(6)]
        for absences in range(2):
            for late in range(3):
                source = absences * 3 + late
                transition[absences * 3][source] += 1
                if absences == 0:
                    transition[3][source] += 1
                if late < 2:
                    transition[source + 1][source] += 1
        counts = [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

        def square(matrix):
            return [
                [sum(matrix[r][k] * matrix[k][c] for k in range(6)) % modulus for c in range(6)]
                for r in range(6)
            ]

        power = n
        while power:
            if power & 1:
                counts = [
                    sum(transition[r][c] * counts[c] for c in range(6)) % modulus for r in range(6)
                ]
            transition = square(transition)
            power >>= 1
        return sum(counts) % modulus

docs.title: 560 ​和​為​ K ​的​子​陣列
docs.text:

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​計算​總​和​等​於​ k ​的​非空​連續子​陣列數​。​元素​可以​是​負數​，​因此​移動視​窗邊界​時​，​總​和​不​一定​單調​變化​。

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​把子​陣列​和​表示​成兩個​前綴​和​的​差​。
  2. ​需要​儲存​最早​的​相符​前綴​，​還是​相符​前綴​的​數量​？
​展開​解法​、​複​雜度​比​較​、​證明​與​ Python ​程式​

​上​一題​: 003 · #128 · ​下一題​: 005 · #525

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​即時​計數​前綴​和​ O(n) ​期望​ O(n) ​列舉​起點​ O(n²) O(1)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 即時​計數​前綴​和
docs.text: ​平方​時間​的​基準​會​檢查​所有​起​終點​。​改為​維護​目前​前綴​和​，​以及​先前​各前​綴​和​的​次數​。​若​目前​為​ p，​每個​值​為​ p-k ​的​先前​前綴​都​貢獻​一個​答案​。​先查​詢次數​，​再​記錄​ p。

docs.title: 列舉​起點
docs.text: ​固定​每個​起點​，​延伸​至​所有​終點​並累積​總​和​。​這個​教學​基準​直接​呈​現子​陣列定​義​，​但​在​最大​陣列​上​可能​逾時​。

docs.title: 即時​計數​前綴​和
docs.text: ​以​目前​位置​結尾​的​子​陣列​和​為​ k，​若且唯若​它​之前​的​前綴​和​為​ p-k。​每個​合法​起點​只​在​其​終點​被​計算​一次​。​將前​綴​和​ 0 ​的​次數​初始化​為​ 1，​代表​陣列​開始​前​的​邊界​。

docs.title: 列舉​起點
docs.text: ​每個​非​空子​陣列​都​有​唯一​的​起點​與​終點​。​巢狀​迴​圈​恰好​拜訪​它​一次​，​並維持​包含​負數​在​內​的​正確​總​和​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​前綴​次​數法​為​期望​ O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​空間​。​一定​要​先計數​再​記錄​目前​前綴​；​反過​來​會​在​ k=0 ​時計入​空子​陣列​。​必須​儲存次數​，​不能​只記​是否​存在​；​一般​針對​正數​的​滑動視​窗​不​適用​。

​起點​列舉​法為​ O(n²) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​；​逐一​延伸​終點​很​直接​，​但​大型​輸入​可能​逾時​。​兩者​都​不​修改​輸入​。

docs.title: Python ​實作
docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​即時​計數​前綴​和
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Online prefix frequencies
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def subarraySum(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        frequencies = {0: 1}
        prefix = result = 0
        for number in nums:
            prefix += number
            result += frequencies.get(prefix - k, 0)
            frequencies[prefix] = frequencies.get(prefix, 0) + 1
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​列舉​起點
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate start positions
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def subarraySum(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        answer = 0
        for start in range(len(nums)):
            total = 0
            for end in range(start, len(nums)):
                total += nums[end]
                answer += total == k
        return answer

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​固定​頻率​向量​視窗​ O(26n) O(26) ​缺額​計數​視窗​ O(n+m) ​期望​ O(alphabet)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 固定​頻率​向量​視窗
docs.text: ​建立​第一​個​字串​的​ 26 ​個次數​，​在​第二​個​字串​上​滑動​等​長​視窗​，​加入​新字​元並​移除​離開​的​字​元​。​每當​完整​視窗​形成​，​就​比​較​兩個​次​數陣列​。

docs.title: 缺額​計數​視窗
docs.text: ​維護字元​缺額​與​總共​還缺​的​字元數​。​視窗​寬度​正​確且​缺額​為​零時​，​就是​一個​排列​；​這個​表示法​也​能​支援​任意​字母表​。

docs.title: 固定​頻率​向量​視窗
docs.text: ​長​度​ m ​的​子​字串​是​某​排列​，​若且唯若​所有​字母​次數​相同​。​維護​的​次​數始終​代表​目前​長​度​ m ​視窗​，​且​每個​這樣​的​視窗​都​會​被​檢查​。

docs.title: 缺額​計數​視窗
docs.text: ​只有​新​加入​的​字​元​仍​有​需求​時​，missing ​才​減一​；​只有​移除​導致​缺額​時​才​加一​。​視窗​與​模式​長​度​相等​，​因此​完整​涵蓋​所​需次數​，​就​等價​於​次數​完全一致​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: s1="aab"、s2="cbaad" ​的​視窗​依序​為​ "cba"、"baa"、"aad"。​第二​個​有​兩個​ a ​與​一個​ b，​因此​回傳​ True。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​固定​向量​：O(m + 26n)=O(m+n) ​時間​、O(26) ​空間​，m、n ​為​兩個​字串​長​度​；​比較​視窗​本身​的​部分​也​可​寫成​ O(26n)。​缺額法​：​期望​ O(n+m) ​時間​、O(​字母表​大小​) ​空間​。

​輸入​不變​。​若​ m>n，​回傳​ False；​移除​ right-m ​的​字​元​才能​維​持正​確寬度​。​集合​無法區​分​ "aab" ​與​ "abb"，​必須​計數​。

docs.title: Python ​實作
docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​固定​頻率​向量​視窗
docs.text:
​時間​： O(26n)

​空間​： O(26)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Fixed frequency-vector window
    Time: O(26n)
    Space: O(26)
    """

    def checkInclusion(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
        width = len(s1)
        if width > len(s2):
            return False
        need, window = [0] * 26, [0] * 26
        for char in s1:
            need[ord(char) - ord("a")] += 1
        for right, char in enumerate(s2):
            window[ord(char) - ord("a")] += 1
            if right >= width:
                window[ord(s2[right - width]) - ord("a")] -= 1
            if right >= width - 1 and window == need:
                return True
        return False

docs.title: 2. ​缺額​計數​視窗
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+m) ​期望​

​空間​： O(alphabet)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Deficit-count window
    Time: O(n+m) expected
    Space: O(alphabet)
    """

    def checkInclusion(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
        need = {}
        for char in s1:
            need[char] = need.get(char, 0) + 1
        missing = len(s1)
        left = 0
        for right, char in enumerate(s2):
            if need.get(char, 0) > 0:
                missing -= 1
            need[char] = need.get(char, 0) - 1
            if right - left + 1 > len(s1):
                outgoing = s2[left]
                need[outgoing] = need.get(outgoing, 0) + 1
                if need[outgoing] > 0:
                    missing += 1
                left += 1
            if right - left + 1 == len(s1) and missing == 0:
                return True
        return False

docs.title: 向前​格內路​徑計​數層
docs.text: ​來源​先放​一條​路徑​，​每層​計數​傳到​四鄰​；​出格​貢獻​立即​累加​，​只​傳播​仍​在​內​的​狀態​。

docs.title: 剩餘​移動​出界​數記憶化
docs.text: ​記憶化​某格​與​剩餘​預算​的​出界​完成​數​；​已​在外​貢獻​一​，​仍​在​內​但​沒步​數則​零​。

docs.title: 向前​格內路​徑計​數層
docs.text: ​每條​路徑​依​最​後​一步​分類​，​第一次​出界​時恰計​一次​，​之​後​不再​延伸​，​所以​各層​相加​恰是​預算內​離開​的​路​徑數​。

docs.title: 剩餘​移動​出界​數記憶化
docs.text: ​下​一​方向​將​全部​出界​路徑​分成​四個​互斥​選擇​。​先處理​外部​狀態​再測​零​預算​，​就​能​包含​最後允許​一步​才​出界​的​路徑​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: 1x1 ​格網且​可​走​一步​時​，​四​方向​都​離開​，​答案​為​ 4。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​向前​格內路​徑計​數層​：​時間​ O((M+1)RC)；​空間​ O(R*C)。 ​剩餘​移動​出界​數記憶化​：​時間​ O((M+1)RC)；​空間​ O((M+1)RC)。

M=maxMove、R=m、C=n，​輸入​不變​。​記憶化​深度​受​ maxMove<=50 ​限制​，​快取​也​包含​步數​；​向前​預設法​只​留​兩層​格網​。​零步​回傳​零​。

docs.title: Python ​實作
docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​向前​格內路​徑計​數層
docs.text:
​時間​： O((M+1)RC)

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward in-grid path-count layers
    Time: O((M+1)*R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def findPaths(self, m: int, n: int, maxMove: int, startRow: int, startColumn: int) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        current = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        current[startRow][startColumn] = 1
        answer = 0
        for _ in range(maxMove):
            following = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
            for r in range(m):
                for c in range(n):
                    count = current[r][c]
                    for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                        if 0 <= nr < m and 0 <= nc < n:
                            following[nr][nc] = (following[nr][nc] + count) % modulus
                        else:
                            answer = (answer + count) % modulus
            current = following
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​剩餘​移動​出界​數記憶化
docs.text:
​時間​： O((M+1)RC)

​空間​： O((M+1)RC)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized remaining-move exits
    Time: O((M+1)*R*C)
    Space: O((M+1)*R*C)
    """

    def findPaths(self, m: int, n: int, maxMove: int, startRow: int, startColumn: int) -> int:
        from functools import cache

        modulus = 1_000_000_007

        @cache
        def exits(row, column, remaining):
            if not (0 <= row < m and 0 <= column < n):
                return 1
            if remaining == 0:
                return 0
            return (
                sum(
                    exits(row + dr, column + dc, remaining - 1)
                    for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))
                )
                % modulus
            )

        return exits(startRow, startColumn, maxMove)

​內容​字典​分組​：​時間​ O(L)，​期望值​，​包含​字串​雜湊​；​空間​ O(L)，​包含​回傳路徑​。 ​紀錄​排序​後​分組​：​時間​ O(L+fClog f)，f ​為​檔​案數​、C ​為​最長​內容長​度​；​空間​ O(L+f)，​包含​回傳路徑​。

L ​是​解析​內容​與​完整​路徑​的​字​元​總數​，f ​為​檔​案數​，C ​為​最長​內容​。​排序​的​最差​界限​納入​字典​序比較​；​這些​界限​也​計入​字串​雜湊​，​而​非​假設​任意​長​鍵​大小​固定​。​解析​遵循​題​目的​無​空格​紀錄​文法​。​輸入​不變​，​比較​的​是​提供​的​內容​，​不會​讀取​磁碟​檔案​。

docs.title: 1. ​內容​字典​分組
docs.text:
​時間​： O(L)，​期望值​，​包含​字串​雜湊​

​空間​： O(L)，​包含​回傳路徑​

from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import groupby


def _files(paths):
    for entry in paths:
        directory, *records = entry.split()
        for record in records:
            name, _, content = record.partition("(")
            yield content[:-1], directory + "/" + name


class Solution:
    """Approach: Content dictionary
    Time: O(L) expected, including string hashing
    Space: O(L), including returned paths
    """

    def findDuplicate(self, paths: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for content, path in _files(paths):
            groups[content].append(path)
        return [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]

docs.title: 2. ​紀錄​排序​後​分組
docs.text:
​時間​： O(L+fClog f)，f ​為​檔​案數​、C ​為​最長​內容長​度​

​空間​： O(L+f)，​包含​回傳路徑​

from collections import defaultdict
from itertools import groupby


def _files(paths):
    for entry in paths:
        directory, *records = entry.split()
        for record in records:
            name, _, content = record.partition("(")
            yield content[:-1], directory + "/" + name


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort and group records
    Time: O(L+f*C*log f), with f files and longest content C
    Space: O(L+f), including returned paths
    """

    def findDuplicate(self, paths: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        records = sorted(_files(paths), key=lambda record: record[0])
        answer = []
        for _, group in groupby(records, key=lambda record: record[0]):
            paths_in_group = [path for _, path in group]
            if len(paths_in_group) > 1:
                answer.append(paths_in_group)
        return answer

docs.title: 頻率​排列​下界
docs.text: ​令​ f ​為​最高​次數​，c ​為​具有​該次數​的​任務種​類數​。​回傳​任務​總數​與​ (f-1)(n+1)+c ​中較​大者​。

docs.title: 可用​任務​堆積​與​冷​卻​佇列
docs.text: ​優先選​剩餘次數​最多​、​目前​可​執行​的​任務​，​再​放入​依時間​排序​的​冷​卻​佇列​。​沒有​可用​任務時​，​直接​跳到​下​一個​解鎖​時間​。

docs.title: 頻率​排列​下界
docs.text: ​最高​頻任務​的​ f ​份​需要​ f-1 ​個​分隔​區塊​，c ​個​並列​最高​頻任務則​占​最後區​塊​的​尾端​。​其他​任務​填補​閒置​位置​；​若數量​超出​此​下界​，​就​能​不​閒置​地​排滿​全部​時段​。

docs.title: 可用​任務​堆積​與​冷​卻​佇列
docs.text: ​先​執行​較​高頻​的​可用​種類​，​能替​它​之​後​的​副本​留下​最多​空間​；​與​較​低頻​的​可用​種類​交換​，​不會​增加​閒置​需求​。​佇列則​精確​實現​每個​冷​卻​解除​時間​。

​時間​： O(T+A)

​空間​： O(A)

from collections import Counter, deque
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency packing bound
    Time: O(T+A)
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def leastInterval(self, tasks: list[str], n: int) -> int:
        counts = Counter(tasks)
        frequency = max(counts.values())
        tied = sum(count == frequency for count in counts.values())
        return max(len(tasks), (frequency - 1) * (n + 1) + tied)

docs.title: 2. ​可用​任務​堆積​與​冷​卻​佇列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(T log A)

​空間​： O(A)

from collections import Counter, deque
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Available-task heap with cooldown queue
    Time: O(T log A)
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def leastInterval(self, tasks: list[str], n: int) -> int:
        heap = [-count for count in Counter(tasks).values()]
        heapify(heap)
        cooling = deque()
        time = 0
        while heap or cooling:
            if not heap:
                time = max(time, cooling[0][0])
            while cooling and cooling[0][0] <= time:
                _, count = cooling.popleft()
                heappush(heap, count)
            count = heappop(heap) + 1
            time += 1
            if count:
                cooling.append((time + n, count))
        return time

docs.title: 1. ​固定​環狀​緩衝區
docs.text:
​時間​： O(1) ​每次​操作​

​空間​： O(k)

class QueueNode:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None


class MyCircularQueue:
    """Approach: Fixed circular buffer
    Time: O(1) per operation
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def __init__(self, k: int):
        self.values = [0] * k
        self.capacity = k
        self.head = 0
        self.size = 0

    def enQueue(self, value: int) -> bool:
        if self.isFull():
            return False
        self.values[(self.head + self.size) % self.capacity] = value
        self.size += 1
        return True

    def deQueue(self) -> bool:
        if self.isEmpty():
            return False
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.capacity
        self.size -= 1
        return True

    def Front(self) -> int:
        return self.values[self.head] if self.size else -1

    def Rear(self) -> int:
        return self.values[(self.head + self.size - 1) % self.capacity] if self.size else -1

    def isEmpty(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == 0

    def isFull(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == self.capacity

docs.title: 2. ​限​容量​鏈結​佇列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(1) ​每次​操作​

​空間​： O(k)

class QueueNode:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None


class MyCircularQueue:
    """Approach: Capacity-limited linked queue
    Time: O(1) per operation
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def __init__(self, k: int):
        self.capacity = k
        self.size = 0
        self.head = self.tail = None

    def enQueue(self, value: int) -> bool:
        if self.isFull():
            return False
        node = QueueNode(value)
        if self.tail:
            self.tail.next = node
        else:
            self.head = node
        self.tail = node
        self.size += 1
        return True

    def deQueue(self) -> bool:
        if self.isEmpty():
            return False
        self.head = self.head.next
        self.size -= 1
        if self.head is None:
            self.tail = None
        return True

    def Front(self) -> int:
        return self.head.value if self.head else -1

    def Rear(self) -> int:
        return self.tail.value if self.tail else -1

    def isEmpty(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == 0

    def isFull(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == self.capacity

class DequeEntry:
    def __init__(self, value=0):
        self.value = value
        self.previous = self.next = None


class MyCircularDeque:
    """Approach: Head-indexed circular array
    Time: O(1) per operation
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def __init__(self, k: int):
        self.values = [0] * k
        self.capacity, self.head, self.size = k, 0, 0

    def insertFront(self, value: int) -> bool:
        if self.isFull():
            return False
        self.head = (self.head - 1) % self.capacity
        self.values[self.head] = value
        self.size += 1
        return True

    def insertLast(self, value: int) -> bool:
        if self.isFull():
            return False
        self.values[(self.head + self.size) % self.capacity] = value
        self.size += 1
        return True

    def deleteFront(self) -> bool:
        if self.isEmpty():
            return False
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.capacity
        self.size -= 1
        return True

    def deleteLast(self) -> bool:
        if self.isEmpty():
            return False
        self.size -= 1
        return True

    def getFront(self) -> int:
        return self.values[self.head] if self.size else -1

    def getRear(self) -> int:
        return self.values[(self.head + self.size - 1) % self.capacity] if self.size else -1

    def isEmpty(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == 0

    def isFull(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == self.capacity

docs.title: 2. ​哨兵​雙向​鏈結​雙端​佇列
docs.text:
​時間​： ​每次​操作​ O(1)

​空間​： O(k)

class DequeEntry:
    def __init__(self, value=0):
        self.value = value
        self.previous = self.next = None


class MyCircularDeque:
    """Approach: Sentinel doubly linked deque
    Time: O(1) per operation
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def __init__(self, k: int):
        self.capacity, self.size = k, 0
        self.left, self.right = DequeEntry(), DequeEntry()
        self.left.next = self.right
        self.right.previous = self.left

    def _insert(self, before, after, value):
        node = DequeEntry(value)
        node.previous, node.next = before, after
        before.next = after.previous = node
        self.size += 1
        return True

    def _delete(self, node):
        node.previous.next = node.next
        node.next.previous = node.previous
        self.size -= 1
        return True

    def insertFront(self, value: int) -> bool:
        return False if self.isFull() else self._insert(self.left, self.left.next, value)

    def insertLast(self, value: int) -> bool:
        return False if self.isFull() else self._insert(self.right.previous, self.right, value)

    def deleteFront(self) -> bool:
        return False if self.isEmpty() else self._delete(self.left.next)

    def deleteLast(self) -> bool:
        return False if self.isEmpty() else self._delete(self.right.previous)

    def getFront(self) -> int:
        return self.left.next.value if self.size else -1

    def getRear(self) -> int:
        return self.right.previous.value if self.size else -1

    def isEmpty(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == 0

    def isFull(self) -> bool:
        return self.size == self.capacity

docs.text: ​依結尾​排序​複​本​，​當數​對​起點​大​於​上​一個​接受​結尾時​就​接受​。

docs.text: ​依起點​排序​，​對​每​對​測試​所有​較​早且​嚴格​相容​的​數對​，​計算以​它​結尾​的​最佳​鏈​。

docs.text: ​以​最早​結束​且​相容​的​數對​替換​最佳​剩餘鏈​的​首​對​，​不會​使​任何​後​續數​對​失效​。​重​複​交換​便​證明​每次​貪婪​接受​都​保留​最佳解​。

docs.title: 全部​前​驅數​對​鏈​ DP
docs.text: ​前驅​起點​必較​早​，​因​每​對​起點​小​於​自身​結尾​。​所以​排序​給出​依賴​順序​，​列舉​全部​最後前​驅​就​得到​精確​最長​鏈遞​推​。

​兩法​建立​排序​參照​串列​，​原​ pairs ​不變​；​即使​貪婪​法​的​空間​界限​也​納入​ O(n) ​配置​。​端點​相碰​不能​成鏈​。​平方​級​方案​以明​確遞​推​取代​交換​證明​。

docs.title: 1. ​最早​結束​區間​貪婪
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Earliest-finish interval greedy
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findLongestChain(self, pairs: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        end = -float("inf")
        answer = 0
        for start, finish in sorted(pairs, key=lambda pair: pair[1]):
            if start > end:
                answer += 1
                end = finish
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​全部​前​驅數​對​鏈​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: All-predecessor pair-chain DP
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findLongestChain(self, pairs: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        ordered = sorted(pairs)
        lengths = [1] * len(ordered)
        for end in range(len(ordered)):
            for previous in range(end):
                if ordered[previous][1] < ordered[end][0]:
                    lengths[end] = max(lengths[end], lengths[previous] + 1)
        return max(lengths)

docs.title: 1. ​展開​所有​中心
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Expand around all centers
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countSubstrings(self, s: str) -> int:
        answer = 0
        for center in range(2 * len(s) - 1):
            left, right = center // 2, (center + 1) // 2
            while left >= 0 and right < len(s) and s[left] == s[right]:
                answer += 1
                left -= 1
                right += 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. Manacher ​奇偶​半徑
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Manacher odd and even radii
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSubstrings(self, s: str) -> int:
        odd = [0] * len(s)
        left, right = 0, -1
        for i in range(len(s)):
            radius = 1 if i > right else min(odd[left + right - i], right - i + 1)
            while i - radius >= 0 and i + radius < len(s) and s[i - radius] == s[i + radius]:
                radius += 1
            odd[i] = radius
            if i + radius - 1 > right:
                left, right = i - radius + 1, i + radius - 1
        even = [0] * len(s)
        left, right = 0, -1
        for i in range(len(s)):
            radius = 0 if i > right else min(even[left + right - i + 1], right - i + 1)
            while (
                i - radius - 1 >= 0 and i + radius < len(s) and s[i - radius - 1] == s[i + radius]
            ):
                radius += 1
            even[i] = radius
            if i + radius - 1 > right:
                left, right = i - radius, i + radius - 1
        return sum(odd) + sum(even)

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​詞根​ ["a", "ab", "cat"] ​與​句子​ "about cattle dog" ​得到​ "a cat dog"。a、ab ​都​符合​ about，​但​只​選​最​短者​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​前綴​樹​：​時間​ O(D+L)；​空間​ O(D+L)，​包含​切分​單字​與​輸出​。 ​依長​度​排序​掃描​詞根​：​時間​ O(R log R+W*D+L)；​較慢​的​字典​掃描​基準​；​空間​ O(R+L)，​包含​輸出​。

D ​為​字典​總字元數​，R ​為​詞​根數​，W ​為​單字數​，L ​為句​長​。​長​度​排序​的​鍵​大小​固定​，​但​每次​ startswith ​可能​讀​完整​詞根​，​因此​掃描​時間​為​最差​界限​。​字典​與​句子​不變​。​嘗試​更長​詞根前​先檢查​終止​標記​，​任意​匹配​前綴​並​不足​夠​。

docs.title: 1. ​前綴​樹
docs.text:
​時間​： O(D+L)

​空間​： O(D+L)，​包含​切分​單字​與​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix trie
    Time: O(D+L)
    Space: O(D+L), including split words and output
    """

    def replaceWords(self, dictionary: list[str], sentence: str) -> str:
        trie = {}
        for root in dictionary:
            node = trie
            for char in root:
                node = node.setdefault(char, {})
            node[""] = True
        result = []
        for word in sentence.split():
            node = trie
            replacement = word
            for end, char in enumerate(word, 1):
                if char not in node:
                    break
                node = node[char]
                if "" in node:
                    replacement = word[:end]
                    break
            result.append(replacement)
        return " ".join(result)

docs.title: 2. ​依長​度​排序​掃描​詞根
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R log R+W*D+L)；​較慢​的​字典​掃描​基準​

​空間​： O(R+L)，​包含​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Length-ordered root scan
    Time: O(R log R+W*D+L); slower dictionary-scan baseline
    Space: O(R+L), including output
    """

    def replaceWords(self, dictionary: list[str], sentence: str) -> str:
        roots = sorted(dictionary, key=len)
        words = sentence.split()
        for index, word in enumerate(words):
            for root in roots:
                if len(root) > len(word):
                    break
                if word.startswith(root):
                    words[index] = root
                    break
        return " ".join(words)

docs.title: 1. ​競爭​的​未來​回合​索引​佇列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Competing queues of future turn indices
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def predictPartyVictory(self, senate: str) -> str:
        radiant = deque(i for i, party in enumerate(senate) if party == "R")
        dire = deque(i for i, party in enumerate(senate) if party == "D")
        while radiant and dire:
            r, d = radiant.popleft(), dire.popleft()
            if r < d:
                radiant.append(r + len(senate))
            else:
                dire.append(d + len(senate))
        return "Radiant" if radiant else "Dire"

docs.title: 2. ​單一​回合​佇列​與​延後封​鎖數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: One turn queue with deferred ban counts
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def predictPartyVictory(self, senate: str) -> str:
        queue = deque(senate)
        alive = {"R": senate.count("R"), "D": senate.count("D")}
        bans = {"R": 0, "D": 0}
        while alive["R"] and alive["D"]:
            party = queue.popleft()
            if bans[party]:
                bans[party] -= 1
                alive[party] -= 1
            else:
                opponent = "D" if party == "R" else "R"
                bans[opponent] += 1
                queue.append(party)
        return "Radiant" if alive["R"] else "Dire"

docs.title: 1. ​駐留​結構​ ID
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import Counter


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Interned structural IDs
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findDuplicateSubtrees(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[TreeNode]:
        identifiers = {None: 0}
        interned, counts, result = {}, Counter(), []
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                key = (node.val, identifiers[node.left], identifiers[node.right])
                if key not in interned:
                    interned[key] = len(interned) + 1
                identifier = identifiers[node] = interned[key]
                counts[identifier] += 1
                if counts[identifier] == 2:
                    result.append(node)
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        stack.append((child, False))
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​完整​子樹​簽章
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2) ​最差​情況​ ​因​複​製​結​構​簽​章​

​空間​： O(n^2) ​最差​情況​

from collections import Counter


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Full subtree signatures
    Time: O(n^2) worst due to copied signatures
    Space: O(n^2) worst
    """

    def findDuplicateSubtrees(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> list[TreeNode]:
        signatures = {None: "#"}
        counts, result = Counter(), []
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                signature = f"{node.val}({signatures[node.left]})({signatures[node.right]})"
                signatures[node] = signature
                counts[signature] += 1
                if counts[signature] == 2:
                    result.append(node)
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        stack.append((child, False))
        return result

docs.title: 遞減​ Cartesian ​樹堆​疊
docs.text: ​每個值​建立​一個​節點​，​彈出​所有​比​它​小​的​堆​疊​節點​，​將最後彈​出​的​子樹設​為​新​節點​的​左子​樹​。​如果​仍​有​較​大​的​堆​疊​祖先​，​就​把​該​祖先​的​右子​節點​接到​新節點​。

docs.text: ​使用​明確​的​區間​任務​，​掃描​每個​區間​找出​最大值​、​建立​根​，​再​安排​左右​區間​。​這個​直接​的​基準法​，​在​排序​陣列​上會重​複​掃描​大量​元素​。

docs.text: ​堆疊​代表​已處​理樹​的​遞​減右側​骨幹​。​被​彈出​的​後​綴​值​都​位​於​新​最大值​之前​，​應成​為​其​左子​樹​；​未彈​出​的​較​大​祖先​仍​合法​地​限制​新​的​右​側後代​。

docs.title: 重​複​搜​尋區間​最大值
docs.text: ​選取​區間​最大值​正是​題​目的​遞​迴​定義​。​左右​剩餘區​間​完整​分割​其他​值並​保留​相對​位置​，​因此​對區間​大小​歸納​，​可知​整棵​樹​符合​定義​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​堆疊法​為​ O(n) ​時間​，​輔助​與​輸出​空間​為​ O(n)；​每個​節點​入棧​、​出棧​各​一次​。​區間​掃​描法​最壞​為​ O(n²) ​時間​、O(h) ​輔助​空間​，​另​需​ O(n) ​輸出​節點​，​大型​排序​輸入​可能​很​慢​。​兩者​皆​不​修改​輸入​陣列​，​並​避免​深樹​的​遞​迴​限制​。

docs.title: 1. ​遞減​ Cartesian ​樹堆​疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​與​輸出​

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Decreasing Cartesian-tree stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary and output
    """

    def constructMaximumBinaryTree(self, nums: list[int]) -> TreeNode:
        stack = []
        for value in nums:
            node = TreeNode(value)
            while stack and stack[-1].val < value:
                node.left = stack.pop()
            if stack:
                stack[-1].right = node
            stack.append(node)
        return stack[0]

docs.title: 2. ​重​複​搜​尋區間​最大值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2) ​最壞​情況​

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​; O(n) ​輸出​

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Repeated interval maxima
    Time: O(n^2) worst
    Space: O(h) auxiliary; O(n) output
    """

    def constructMaximumBinaryTree(self, nums: list[int]) -> TreeNode:
        dummy = TreeNode()
        stack = [(0, len(nums), dummy, "left")]
        while stack:
            low, high, parent, side = stack.pop()
            if low == high:
                continue
            middle = max(range(low, high), key=nums.__getitem__)
            node = TreeNode(nums[middle])
            setattr(parent, side, node)
            stack.extend(((middle + 1, high, node, "right"), (low, middle, node, "left")))
        return dummy.left

docs.title: 1. ​二分​搜尋選​取視​窗起點
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log(n-k+1)+k)

​空間​： O(k) ​輸出​；O(1) ​輔助​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search the chosen window start
    Time: O(log(n-k+1)+k)
    Space: O(k) output; O(1) auxiliary
    """

    def findClosestElements(self, arr: list[int], k: int, x: int) -> list[int]:
        low, high = 0, len(arr) - k
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if x - arr[middle] > arr[middle + k] - x:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle
        return arr[low : low + k]

docs.title: 2. ​丟棄​較​遠端點
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(k) ​輸出​；O(1) ​輔助​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Discard the farther endpoint
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(k) output; O(1) auxiliary
    """

    def findClosestElements(self, arr: list[int], k: int, x: int) -> list[int]:
        left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
        while right - left + 1 > k:
            if abs(arr[left] - x) > abs(arr[right] - x):
                left += 1
            else:
                right -= 1
        return arr[left : right + 1]

docs.title: 正規化​位置​的​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​佇列​保存​節點​與​位置​。​每層​以​第一​個​索引​作為​基準​，​將該​層​位置​都​減去​此值​；​用​最右​與​最​左​位置​之​差加​一​更新​寬度​，​再​由​正​規化​位置​計​算子​節點​索引​。

docs.title: 每層​最​左​索引​的​深度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​以先​左後右​的​迭代​深度​優先​搜尋​，​記錄​每個​深度​首次​遇到​的​索引​。​每個​節點​以​該層​基準​正​規化後計算​寬度​，​並從​正規化​偏移量​推算​子節點​位置​。

docs.title: 正規化​位置​的​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​完整​樹​索引​保留​所有​缺口​，​因此​最右減​最​左​再​加一​就是​正確​寬度​。​對​同一​層​全部​索引​減去​相同​常數​，​不​改變​任意​兩點​距離​；​子節點​公式​也​保留​下一層​的​相對間​隔​。

docs.title: 每層​最​左​索引​的​深度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​先​左後右​保證​某​深度​首次​抵達​的​節點​就是​該層​最​左​節點​。​同一​深度​使用​共同​基準​，​其​偏移量​恰好​量​出到​最​左​位置​的​距離​，​因此​取​最大​偏移​加一​即可​取得​層​寬​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​根為​ 1，​左右​子節點​為​ 2、3；2 ​只有​左子​節點​，3 ​只有​右子​節點​。​最後一層​的​兩個​實際節​點位​於​索引​ 0、3，​寬度​為​ 4，​而​不是​佇列​中​的​節點數​ 2。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​兩者​皆​為​ O(n) ​時間​，​不​修改​樹​。​廣度​優先法​需要​ O(w) ​輔助​空間​，​深度​優先法​需要​ O(h)。​佇列長​度​不能​代表​含​缺口​的​寬度​。​位置​正規化​能​避免​深窄​鏈產生​不必要​的​大​整數​；​題目​保證​答案​可​放入​ 32 ​位元​有號​整數​。

docs.title: 1. ​正規化​位置​的​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(w)

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Normalized breadth-first positions
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(w)
    """

    def widthOfBinaryTree(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        queue = deque([(root, 0)])
        best = 0
        while queue:
            first = queue[0][1]
            width = queue[-1][1] - first + 1
            best = max(best, width)
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node, index = queue.popleft()
                index -= first
                if node.left:
                    queue.append((node.left, 2 * index))
                if node.right:
                    queue.append((node.right, 2 * index + 1))
        return best

docs.title: 2. ​每層​最​左​索引​的​深度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h)

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Leftmost index per depth
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def widthOfBinaryTree(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        first = {}
        stack = [(root, 0, 0)]
        best = 0
        while stack:
            node, depth, index = stack.pop()
            first.setdefault(depth, index)
            offset = index - first[depth]
            best = max(best, offset + 1)
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, depth + 1, 2 * offset + 1))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, depth + 1, 2 * offset))
        return best

docs.title: 1. ​壓縮​後​左端​區間​由下而上​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^3)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Compressed bottom-up left-end intervals
    Time: O(n^3)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def strangePrinter(self, s: str) -> int:
        text = "".join(
            character
            for index, character in enumerate(s)
            if index == 0 or character != s[index - 1]
        )
        n = len(text)
        dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        for left in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            dp[left][left] = 1
            for right in range(left + 1, n):
                dp[left][right] = 1 + dp[left + 1][right]
                for same in range(left + 1, right + 1):
                    if text[same] == text[left]:
                        middle = dp[left + 1][same - 1] if same > left + 1 else 0
                        dp[left][right] = min(dp[left][right], middle + dp[same][right])
        return dp[0][-1]

docs.title: 2. ​記憶化​右端​印刷​合​併
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^3)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized right-end turn merging
    Time: O(n^3)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def strangePrinter(self, s: str) -> int:
        from functools import cache

        @cache
        def turns(left, right):
            if left > right:
                return 0
            answer = turns(left, right - 1) + 1
            for same in range(left, right):
                if s[same] == s[right]:
                    answer = min(answer, turns(left, same) + turns(same + 1, right - 1))
            return answer

        return turns(0, len(s) - 1)

docs.title: 1. ​端點長​度​與​重數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Endpoint lengths and multiplicities
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findNumberOfLIS(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        lengths, counts = [1] * len(nums), [1] * len(nums)
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            for j in range(i):
                if nums[j] >= nums[i]:
                    continue
                candidate = lengths[j] + 1
                if candidate > lengths[i]:
                    lengths[i], counts[i] = candidate, counts[j]
                elif candidate == lengths[i]:
                    counts[i] += counts[j]
        longest = max(lengths)
        return sum(
            count for length, count in zip(lengths, counts, strict=True) if length == longest
        )

docs.title: 2. ​座標​壓縮​ Fenwick ​最大值​與​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Coordinate-compressed Fenwick maxima and counts
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findNumberOfLIS(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        ranks = {value: index + 1 for index, value in enumerate(sorted(set(nums)))}
        tree = [(0, 0)] * (len(ranks) + 1)

        def merge(first, second):
            if first[0] != second[0]:
                return max(first, second, key=lambda pair: pair[0])
            return first[0], first[1] + second[1]

        answer = (0, 0)
        for value in nums:
            rank = ranks[value]
            index, best = rank - 1, (0, 0)
            while index:
                best = merge(best, tree[index])
                index -= index & -index
            candidate = (best[0] + 1, best[1] if best[0] else 1)
            answer = merge(answer, candidate)
            index = rank
            while index < len(tree):
                tree[index] = merge(tree[index], candidate)
                index += index & -index
        return answer[1]

​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Interval of possible opening counts
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def checkValidString(self, s: str) -> bool:
        low = high = 0
        for char in s:
            if char == "(":
                low += 1
                high += 1
            elif char == ")":
                low -= 1
                high -= 1
            else:
                low -= 1
                high += 1
            if high < 0:
                return False
            low = max(0, low)
        return low == 0

docs.title: 2. ​左括​號與​星號​位置​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Opening and star position stacks
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def checkValidString(self, s: str) -> bool:
        openings = []
        stars = []
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            if char == "(":
                openings.append(i)
            elif char == "*":
                stars.append(i)
            elif openings:
                openings.pop()
            elif stars:
                stars.pop()
            else:
                return False
        while openings and stars:
            if openings.pop() > stars.pop():
                return False
        return not openings

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​在​樹​中額​外​加入​一條邊​形成​無向​圖​。​回傳​一條​移除​後​可​恢​復​成樹的邊​；​若有​多個​答案​，​選輸入​中​最後出​現者​。

1. ​新增​邊的​兩端​已​連通時​，​恰好​會​形成​環​。
  2. ​依輸入​順序​處理邊​，​以聯集​查找​維護​連通​分量​。

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​按​大小​合​併​的​聯集​查找​ O(E*alpha(V)) O(V) ​每次​加邊​前​檢查​可達性​ O(E*(V+E)) O(V+E)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 按​大小​合​併​的​聯集​查找
docs.text: ​起初​每個​頂點​各自​成​集合​。​對​每​條邊​找​兩端​根​；​同根​即​是​多餘邊​，​否則​將小​分量​接到​大​分量​根下​，​查找​時壓​縮路徑​。​連結​的​聯集​查找​範本​也​示範​按​秩合​併​：​比較​根​的​秩​，​將低​秩​接到​高​秩​，​只有​同​秩合​併​才​增加​秩​。​秩​界定​歷史​樹高​，​大小​則計算​頂點數​；​兩者​配合​路徑​壓縮​都​有​相同​攤銷界​。

docs.title: 每次​加邊​前​檢查​可達性
docs.text: ​明確​儲存​已​接受​的​森林​。​加邊​前​從​第一​個​端點​搜尋​，​若​已​能​到​第二​端點​，​就​拒絕​這條​閉環邊​。

docs.title: 按​大小​合​併​的​聯集​查找
docs.text: ​已​接受​的​邊維持​森林​，​每次​接受​都​合​併​端點​分量​，​因此​集合​恰是​森林​的​連通​分量​。​同​分量​內加邊​才​會​成環​。​題目​保證​只有​一個環​，​其​最後出​現的邊​正是​第一​條被​拒​絕的邊​，​也​就是​最晚​可​移除​者​。

docs.title: 每次​加邊​前​檢查​可達性
docs.text: ​森林​新增​一條​兩端​原本​有路​徑的邊​，​恰好​會​形成​環​。​依序​處理會​拒絕​唯一​環中​最後出​現的邊​，​符合​題​目的​同解​選擇​規則​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​按​大小​合​併​的​聯集​查找​：​時間​ O(E*alpha(V))；​空間​ O(V)。

​每次​加邊​前​檢查​可達性​：​時間​ O(E*(V+E))；​空間​ O(V+E)。

​預設​法時間​ O(E * alpha(V)) ​為​攤​銷界​，alpha ​是​反​ Ackermann ​函數​。​樹加​一邊​的​條件​保證​頂點​標號​在​ 1 ​到​ E。​合​併​前​必須​先​找​根​，​直接​連端​點會​破壞​分量​表示​。​重​複​搜尋是​較慢​的​教學​基準​，​雖然​本題​最多​ 1000 ​條邊​。​兩法​都​不​改動邊​的​內容​或​順序​。

docs.title: 1. ​按​大小​合​併​的​聯集​查找
docs.text:
​時間​： O(E*alpha(V))

​空間​： O(V)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Size-weighted union-find
    Time: O(E*alpha(V))
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def findRedundantConnection(self, edges: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        parent = list(range(len(edges) + 1))
        size = [1] * len(parent)

        def find(node):
            while node != parent[node]:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        for left, right in edges:
            left_root, right_root = find(left), find(right)
            if left_root == right_root:
                return [left, right]
            if size[left_root] < size[right_root]:
                left_root, right_root = right_root, left_root
            parent[right_root] = left_root
            size[left_root] += size[right_root]
        return []

docs.title: 2. ​每次​加邊​前​檢查​可達性
docs.text:
​時間​： O(E*(V+E))

​空間​： O(V+E)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Check reachability before each insertion
    Time: O(E*(V+E))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def findRedundantConnection(self, edges: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        graph = [[] for _ in range(len(edges) + 1)]
        for left, right in edges:
            seen = {left}
            stack = [left]
            while stack:
                node = stack.pop()
                for other in graph[node]:
                    if other not in seen:
                        seen.add(other)
                        stack.append(other)
            if right in seen:
                return [left, right]
            graph[left].append(right)
            graph[right].append(left)
        return []

​快速​複​習​：​前綴​函數​（KMP） · Z ​函數​

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​求非空​ a ​最少​重​複​幾次​後​，​其​串接​包含​非空​ b ​作為子​字串​；​無論​重​複​幾次​都​不​成立​則​ -1。

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​匹配​總可​整體​左移​，​令起​點位​於​第一份​ a ​內​。
  2. ​前綴​函數​或​ Z ​函數​可​避免​重​複​比​較候​選​。
​展開​解法​、​複​雜度​比​較​、​證明​與​ Python ​程式​

​上​一題​: 287 · #648 · ​下一題​: 289 · #791

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​虛擬​重​複​字串​上​的​ KMP O(A+B) O(B) ​有​界​文字​上​的​ Z ​函數​ O(A+B) O(A+B)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 虛擬​重​複​字串​上​的​ KMP
docs.text: ​建立​ b ​的​前綴​函數​。​用​ a[index % len(a)] ​掃​描虛擬​週期​字串​，​保留​ b ​已​匹配​前綴​長​度​，​失配​沿前​綴​表​回退​。​只​掃​ len(a)+len(b)-1 ​個字元​；​完整​匹配​結尾​的​ ceil((end+1)/len(a)) ​即重​複​次數​。

docs.title: 有​界​文字​上​的​ Z ​函數
docs.text: ​建​出​相同​有界長​度​的​重​複​文字​，​計算​ b+'#'+text ​的​ Z ​值​；# ​不會​出現​在​小​寫​輸入​中​。​第一​個​ Z ​值​至少​ len(b) ​的​文字​位置​開始​完整​匹配​，​再將​結尾換​算​成份​數​。

docs.title: 虛擬​重​複​字串​上​的​ KMP
docs.text: ​無限​週期​字串​中​的​匹配​可​整份​ a ​左移​，​直到​起點​小​於​ len(a)，​終點​因而​在​有界​掃​描內​。KMP ​找到​精確​匹配​且​無​碰撞​；​全部​匹配​等長​，​所以​第一​個​結束​者​最小化​所​需​完整​份數​。​掃​完整​界限​仍​無​匹配​即可​證明​無解​。

docs.title: 有​界​文字​上​的​ Z ​函數
docs.text: ​週期​移位​保證​所有​可能​匹配​都​可​在​界限​內​找到​。Z ​函數​精確​辨認​相等​前綴​，​不​需雜​湊​；​第一​個​匹配​的​結尾​也​最早​，​因此​所​需​完整​份數​最少​，​耗盡​界限​即​代表​不​可能​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: a="abc"、b="cabca" ​的​最早​匹配​在​ "abcabcabc" ​中​從​位置​ 2 ​到​ 6，​七個​所​需字元​要​三份​。a="ab"、b="ac" ​則重​複​任意​次​都​無解​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​虛擬​重​複​字串​上​的​ KMP：​時間​ O(A+B)；​空間​ O(B)。 ​有​界​文字​上​的​ Z ​函數​：​時間​ O(A+B)；​空間​ O(A+B)。

A=len(a)、B=len(b)。KMP ​只用​ O(B) ​前綴​表​，​從​不​建重​複​文字​；Z ​法​配置​ O(A+B) ​文字​與表​。​回退​及​重用​ Z ​區間​，​使​高度​重​複​字串​也​只有​攤銷線​性比​較​。​輸入​不變​。​匹配​可​跨​副本​邊界​，​只測​一份​或​恰​ ceil(B/A) ​份會​漏解​。

docs.title: Python ​實作
docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​虛擬​重​複​字串​上​的​ KMP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(A+B)

​空間​： O(B)

class Solution:
    """Approach: KMP over virtual repetitions
    Time: O(A+B)
    Space: O(B)
    """

    def repeatedStringMatch(self, a: str, b: str) -> int:
        prefix = [0] * len(b)
        matched = 0
        for index in range(1, len(b)):
            while matched and b[index] != b[matched]:
                matched = prefix[matched - 1]
            if b[index] == b[matched]:
                matched += 1
            prefix[index] = matched
        matched = 0
        for index in range(len(a) + len(b) - 1):
            char = a[index % len(a)]
            while matched and char != b[matched]:
                matched = prefix[matched - 1]
            if char == b[matched]:
                matched += 1
            if matched == len(b):
                return (index + len(a)) // len(a)
        return -1

docs.title: 2. ​有​界​文字​上​的​ Z ​函數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(A+B)

​空間​： O(A+B)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Z-function over a bounded text
    Time: O(A+B)
    Space: O(A+B)
    """

    def repeatedStringMatch(self, a: str, b: str) -> int:
        length = len(a) + len(b) - 1
        text = (a * ((length + len(a) - 1) // len(a)))[:length]
        combined = b + "#" + text
        offset = len(b) + 1
        z = [0] * len(combined)
        left = right = 0
        for index in range(1, len(combined)):
            if index < right:
                z[index] = min(right - index, z[index - left])
            while (
                index + z[index] < len(combined)
                and combined[z[index]] == combined[index + z[index]]
            ):
                z[index] += 1
            if index + z[index] > right:
                left, right = index, index + z[index]
            if index >= offset and z[index] >= len(b):
                end_exclusive = index - offset + len(b)
                return (end_exclusive + len(a) - 1) // len(a)
        return -1

docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​向前​騎士​機率​分層
docs.text:
​時間​： O((k+1)*n^2)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward knight probability layers
    Time: O((k+1)*n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def knightProbability(self, n: int, k: int, row: int, column: int) -> float:
        moves = ((1, 2), (2, 1), (-1, 2), (-2, 1), (1, -2), (2, -1), (-1, -2), (-2, -1))
        current = [[0.0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        current[row][column] = 1.0
        for _ in range(k):
            following = [[0.0] * n for _ in range(n)]
            for r in range(n):
                for c in range(n):
                    for dr, dc in moves:
                        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < n:
                            following[nr][nc] += current[r][c] / 8
            current = following
        return sum(map(sum, current))

docs.title: 2. ​反向​存活​機率
docs.text:
​時間​： O((k+1)*n^2)

​空間​： O((k+1)*n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Backward survival probabilities
    Time: O((k+1)*n^2)
    Space: O((k+1)*n^2)
    """

    def knightProbability(self, n: int, k: int, row: int, column: int) -> float:
        from functools import cache

        moves = ((1, 2), (2, 1), (-1, 2), (-2, 1), (1, -2), (2, -1), (-1, -2), (-2, -1))

        @cache
        def survive(r, c, remaining):
            if not (0 <= r < n and 0 <= c < n):
                return 0.0
            if remaining == 0:
                return 1.0
            return sum(survive(r + dr, c + dc, remaining - 1) for dr, dc in moves) / 8

        return survive(row, column, k)

docs.title: 迭代​洪水​填充​計算​面積
docs.text: ​對​每個​尚未​見過​的​一​格子​啟動​堆疊​走訪​，​發現​時​就​標記​，​取出​時累​計面積​。​每個​分量​結束​後​，​更新​最大​面積​。

docs.title: 依​大小​合​併​陸地
docs.text: ​每個​位置​配置​一個​並查​集欄位​，​遇到​陸地​時合​併​其​上方​與​左方​陸地​鄰居​。​只​在​根​保存​分量​大小​，​並在​處理​每個​陸地格​後​更新​最大值​。

docs.title: 迭代​洪水​填充​計算​面積
docs.text: ​每次​走訪​恰好​抵達​起點​所屬​的​連通​分量​，​且​每個​成員​只​計數​一次​。​不同​起點​對​應​互不​重疊​的​分量​，​因此​所有​面積​的​最大值​就是​答案​。

docs.title: 依​大小​合​併​陸地
docs.text: ​每個​陸地​單點​的​根​大小​從​一開始​；​合​併​不同​分量​時​相加​，​精確​得到​合​併​後​的​格子​數​。​處理​所有​陸地​相鄰關​係​後​，​分量​恰好​就是​各座​島嶼​，​其根​大小​就是​面積​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text: ​令​網格​有​ R ​列​、C ​欄​。​洪水​填充​為​ O(RC) ​時間​、O(RC) ​空間​；​並查​集為​ O(RCalpha(RC)) ​時間​、O(RC) ​空間​。​兩者​都​保留​輸入​網格​，​且​避免​遞​迴​深度​限制​。​全為​水時​回傳​零​；​對角線​相鄰​不會​連成​同​一座​島​。

docs.title: 1. ​迭代​洪水​填充​計算​面積
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative area flood-fill
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def maxAreaOfIsland(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, columns = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        seen = set()
        answer = 0
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(columns):
                if not grid[r][c] or (r, c) in seen:
                    continue
                stack, area = [(r, c)], 0
                seen.add((r, c))
                while stack:
                    row, column = stack.pop()
                    area += 1
                    for nr, nc in (
                        (row - 1, column),
                        (row + 1, column),
                        (row, column - 1),
                        (row, column + 1),
                    ):
                        if (
                            0 <= nr < rows
                            and 0 <= nc < columns
                            and grid[nr][nc]
                            and (nr, nc) not in seen
                        ):
                            seen.add((nr, nc))
                            stack.append((nr, nc))
                answer = max(answer, area)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​依​大小​合​併​陸地
docs.text:
​時間​： O(RCalpha(R*C))

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Size-weighted land unions
    Time: O(R*C*alpha(R*C))
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def maxAreaOfIsland(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, columns = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        parent = list(range(rows * columns))
        size = [1] * len(parent)

        def find(node):
            while node != parent[node]:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        answer = 0
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(columns):
                if not grid[r][c]:
                    continue
                root = find(r * columns + c)
                for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r, c - 1)):
                    if nr >= 0 and nc >= 0 and grid[nr][nc]:
                        other = find(nr * columns + nc)
                        root = find(root)
                        if root != other:
                            if size[root] < size[other]:
                                root, other = other, root
                            parent[other] = root
                            size[root] += size[other]
                answer = max(answer, size[find(root)])
        return answer

docs.title: 1. ​遞減​數值​分桶​配置
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n + k^n) ​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(n*k)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Descending bucket assignment
    Time: O(n log n + k^n) loose bound
    Space: O(n*k)
    """

    def canPartitionKSubsets(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> bool:
        values = sorted(nums, reverse=True)
        total = sum(values)
        if total % k:
            return False
        target = total // k
        if values[0] > target:
            return False
        loads = [0] * k

        def place(index):
            if index == len(values):
                return True
            tried = set()
            for bucket, load in enumerate(loads):
                if load in tried or load + values[index] > target:
                    continue
                tried.add(load)
                loads[bucket] += values[index]
                if place(index + 1):
                    return True
                loads[bucket] -= values[index]
                if load == 0:
                    break
            return False

        return place(0)

docs.title: 2. ​已​用​遮罩​餘數​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n*2^n)

​空間​： O(2^n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Used-mask remainder DP
    Time: O(n*2^n)
    Space: O(2^n)
    """

    def canPartitionKSubsets(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> bool:
        values = nums
        total = sum(values)
        if total % k:
            return False
        target = total // k
        if target == 0:
            return True
        remainders = [-1] * (1 << len(values))
        remainders[0] = 0
        for mask, remainder in enumerate(remainders):
            if remainder < 0:
                continue
            for index, value in enumerate(values):
                bit = 1 << index
                if not mask & bit and remainder + value <= target:
                    remainders[mask | bit] = (remainder + value) % target
        return remainders[-1] == 0

docs.title: 1. ​雙向​鏈結​哨兵
docs.text:
​時間​： ​端點​插入​ O(1)；​索引​操作​ O(min(i,n-i)+1)

​空間​： O(n)

class ListEntry:
    def __init__(self, value=0):
        self.value = value
        self.previous = self.next = None


class MyLinkedList:
    """Approach: Doubly linked sentinels
    Time: O(1) end insertion; O(min(i,n-i)+1) indexed operations
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.head, self.tail = ListEntry(), ListEntry()
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.previous = self.head
        self.size = 0

    def _node(self, index):
        if index < self.size // 2:
            node = self.head.next
            for _ in range(index):
                node = node.next
        else:
            node = self.tail.previous
            for _ in range(self.size - index - 1):
                node = node.previous
        return node

    def get(self, index: int) -> int:
        return self._node(index).value if 0 <= index < self.size else -1

    def addAtHead(self, val: int) -> None:
        self.addAtIndex(0, val)

    def addAtTail(self, val: int) -> None:
        self.addAtIndex(self.size, val)

    def addAtIndex(self, index: int, val: int) -> None:
        index = max(index, 0)
        if index > self.size:
            return
        after = self.tail if index == self.size else self._node(index)
        before = after.previous
        node = ListEntry(val)
        node.previous, node.next = before, after
        before.next = after.previous = node
        self.size += 1

    def deleteAtIndex(self, index: int) -> None:
        if not 0 <= index < self.size:
            return
        node = self._node(index)
        node.previous.next = node.next
        node.next.previous = node.previous
        self.size -= 1

docs.title: 2. ​虛擬頭​單向​鏈結​串列
docs.text:
​時間​： ​索引​及尾​操作​ O(n)；​頭​插入​ O(1)

​空間​： O(n)

class ListEntry:
    def __init__(self, value=0):
        self.value = value
        self.previous = self.next = None


class MyLinkedList:
    """Approach: Dummy-headed singly linked list
    Time: O(n) indexed/tail operations; O(1) head insertion
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.head = ListEntry()
        self.size = 0

    def get(self, index: int) -> int:
        if not 0 <= index < self.size:
            return -1
        node = self.head.next
        for _ in range(index):
            node = node.next
        return node.value

    def addAtHead(self, val: int) -> None:
        self.addAtIndex(0, val)

    def addAtTail(self, val: int) -> None:
        self.addAtIndex(self.size, val)

    def addAtIndex(self, index: int, val: int) -> None:
        index = max(index, 0)
        if index > self.size:
            return
        before = self.head
        for _ in range(index):
            before = before.next
        node = ListEntry(val)
        node.next = before.next
        before.next = node
        self.size += 1

    def deleteAtIndex(self, index: int) -> None:
        if not 0 <= index < self.size:
            return
        before = self.head
        for _ in range(index):
            before = before.next
        before.next = before.next.next
        self.size -= 1

docs.title: 1. ​滾動​最小​刪除​前綴​成本
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n+m+n)

​空間​： O(min(m,n)+1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Rolling minimum-deletion prefix costs
    Time: O(m*n+m+n)
    Space: O(min(m,n)+1)
    """

    def minimumDeleteSum(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> int:
        if len(s1) < len(s2):
            s1, s2 = s2, s1
        dp = [0]
        for character in s2:
            dp.append(dp[-1] + ord(character))
        for first in s1:
            diagonal = dp[0]
            dp[0] += ord(first)
            for j, second in enumerate(s2, 1):
                above = dp[j]
                dp[j] = (
                    diagonal
                    if first == second
                    else min(above + ord(first), dp[j - 1] + ord(second))
                )
                diagonal = above
        return dp[-1]

docs.title: 2. ​最大​權重​共同​子​序列
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n+m+n)

​空間​： O(n+1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Maximum-weight common subsequence
    Time: O(m*n+m+n)
    Space: O(n+1)
    """

    def minimumDeleteSum(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (len(s2) + 1)
        for first in s1:
            diagonal = 0
            for j, second in enumerate(s2, 1):
                above = dp[j]
                dp[j] = diagonal + ord(first) if first == second else max(above, dp[j - 1])
                diagonal = above
        return sum(map(ord, s1)) + sum(map(ord, s2)) - 2 * dp[-1]

docs.text: ​對​正​的​前綴​乘積​ P，P[end]/P[start] < k ​等價​於​ P[start] > P[end]//k。​即使​包含​ 1，​前綴​乘積​仍​非​遞減​，​因此​ upper bound ​能​精確​計數​所有​合格​起點​。

docs.title: 1. ​乘法​滑動視​窗
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​次算術​運算​

​空間​： O(1) ​個​整數​變數​

from bisect import bisect_right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Multiplicative sliding window
    Time: O(n) arithmetic operations
    Space: O(1) integer variables
    """

    def numSubarrayProductLessThanK(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        if k <= 1:
            return 0
        product = 1
        left = answer = 0
        for right, value in enumerate(nums):
            product *= value
            while product >= k:
                product //= nums[left]
                left += 1
            answer += right - left + 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​精確​前綴​乘積​搭配​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n) ​次大整​數運算​

​空間​： O(n² log M) ​位元​ ​最壞​情況​

from bisect import bisect_right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Exact prefix products with binary search
    Time: O(n log n) big-integer operations
    Space: O(n squared log M) bits worst case
    """

    def numSubarrayProductLessThanK(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        if k <= 1:
            return 0
        prefix = [1]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] * value)
        answer = 0
        for end in range(1, len(prefix)):
            first = bisect_right(prefix, prefix[end] // k, 0, end)
            answer += end - first
        return answer
