docs.title: 1. ​反向​更新​匹配​後​綴​長​度
docs.text:
​時間​： O(m*n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Backward-updated matching suffix lengths
    Time: O(m*n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def findLength(self, nums1: list[int], nums2: list[int]) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (len(nums2) + 1)
        answer = 0
        for first in nums1:
            for j in range(len(nums2), 0, -1):
                dp[j] = dp[j - 1] + 1 if first == nums2[j - 1] else 0
                answer = max(answer, dp[j])
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​精確​ tuple ​視窗​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O((m+n)Llog(L+1))，​期望值​

​空間​： O(m*L)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary-search exact tuple windows
    Time: O((m+n)*L*log(L+1)) expected
    Space: O(m*L)
    """

    def findLength(self, nums1: list[int], nums2: list[int]) -> int:
        def possible(length):
            windows = {
                tuple(nums1[start : start + length]) for start in range(len(nums1) - length + 1)
            }
            return any(
                tuple(nums2[start : start + length]) in windows
                for start in range(len(nums2) - length + 1)
            )

        low, high = 0, min(len(nums1), len(nums2)) + 1
        while low + 1 < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if possible(middle):
                low = middle
            else:
                high = middle
        return low

docs.title: 1. ​二分​搜尋數​對計​數門檻
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n+n log(W+1))

​空間​： O(n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search a pair-count threshold
    Time: O(n log n+n log(W+1))
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def smallestDistancePair(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        values = sorted(nums)
        low, high = 0, values[-1] - values[0]
        while low < high:
            distance = (low + high) // 2
            left = count = 0
            for right, value in enumerate(values):
                while value - values[left] > distance:
                    left += 1
                count += right - left
            if count >= k:
                high = distance
            else:
                low = distance + 1
        return low

docs.title: 2. ​固定​左端​距離​串流​的​堆​積合​併
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n+k log n)

​空間​： O(n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap merge of fixed-left distance streams
    Time: O(n log n+k log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def smallestDistancePair(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        values = sorted(nums)
        heap = [(values[i + 1] - values[i], i, i + 1) for i in range(len(values) - 1)]
        heapify(heap)
        for _ in range(k):
            distance, left, right = heappop(heap)
            if right + 1 < len(values):
                heappush(heap, (values[right + 1] - values[left], left, right + 1))
        return distance

docs.title: 未​排序​區間​掃描
docs.text: ​兩半​開區間​重疊​恰等價​於​ max(starts) < min(ends)。​逐一​檢查​既有​區間​，​可​拒絕​所有​衝突並​接受​全部​無​交集​請求​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: book(10,20) ​成功​，book(15,25) ​失敗​，book(20,30) ​成功​，​因半開​端點​相接​不算​重疊​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​排序​預約​與​鄰居​檢查​：​時間​ O(n) ​每次​預約​；​空間​ O(n)。

​未​排序​區間​掃描​：​時間​ O(n) ​每次​預約​；​空間​ O(n)。

​物件​擁有​已​接受​的​預約​。​排序​查找​雖為​對數​時間​，Python ​串列​插入​仍​需線性​時間​，​因此​不能​宣稱​整次​預約​只花​ O(log n)。

docs.title: 1. ​排序​預約​與​鄰居​檢查
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​每次​預約​

​空間​： O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left


class MyCalendar:
    """Approach: Sorted bookings with neighbor checks
    Time: O(n) per book
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.bookings = []

    def book(self, startTime: int, endTime: int) -> bool:
        index = bisect_left(self.bookings, (startTime, endTime))
        if index and self.bookings[index - 1][1] > startTime:
            return False
        if index < len(self.bookings) and self.bookings[index][0] < endTime:
            return False
        self.bookings.insert(index, (startTime, endTime))
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​未​排序​區間​掃描
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​每次​預約​

​空間​： O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left


class MyCalendar:
    """Approach: Unsorted interval scan
    Time: O(n) per book
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.bookings = []

    def book(self, startTime: int, endTime: int) -> bool:
        for start, end in self.bookings:
            if max(start, startTime) < min(end, endTime):
                return False
        self.bookings.append((startTime, endTime))
        return True

docs.title: 保留​預約​與​雙重​交集
docs.text: ​先​拒絕​與​任何​既有​雙重區​段​重疊​的​請求​；​通過​後​，​將它​與​全部​舊​預約​的​交集​記為​新雙​重區​段​，​再​加入​預約​。

docs.title: 掃描​事件​計數​並回​復
docs.text: ​暫時​將起點​事件​加一​、​終點​減一​，​依​排序​座標​掃描​；​活動​覆蓋​達三時​，​反轉​這兩個​更新​。

docs.title: 保留​預約​與​雙重​交集
docs.text: ​新區間​與​已​覆蓋​兩次​的點​相交​，​恰會​造成​三重​覆蓋​。​此檢查​通過​後​，​新區間​與​單個​舊​預約​的​每個​交集​都​可​安全​記為​雙重區​段​。

docs.title: 掃描​事件​計數​並回​復
docs.text: ​端點​增減​的​前綴​和​等​於​各半​開區​段​覆蓋數​。​最大值​超過​二恰​是​禁止​的​三​重重​疊​，​回​復​後​恢​復​先前​合法​事件​表​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​保留​預約​與​雙重​交集​：​時間​ O(n^2) ​最差​情況​ ​每次​預約​；​空間​ O(n^2)。

​掃描​事件​計數​並回​復​：​時間​ O(n log n) ​每次​預約​；​空間​ O(n)。

​兩種​物件​都​擁有​自身​狀態​。​相同​座標​的​端點​差量​先合​併​再​測覆蓋數​。​交集​串列​使用​允許​平方​儲存​的​保守​上​界​；​掃描​表示​只​保留​端點​。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2) ​最差​情況​ ​每次​預約​

​空間​： O(n^2)

class MyCalendarTwo:
    """Approach: Store bookings and double intersections
    Time: O(n squared) worst case per book
    Space: O(n squared)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.bookings = []
        self.doubles = []

    def book(self, startTime: int, endTime: int) -> bool:
        if any(max(start, startTime) < min(end, endTime) for start, end in self.doubles):
            return False
        for start, end in self.bookings:
            left, right = max(start, startTime), min(end, endTime)
            if left < right:
                self.doubles.append((left, right))
        self.bookings.append((startTime, endTime))
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​掃描​事件​計數​並回​復
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n) ​每次​預約​

​空間​： O(n)

class MyCalendarTwo:
    """Approach: Sweep event counts with rollback
    Time: O(n log n) per book
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.events = {}

    def book(self, startTime: int, endTime: int) -> bool:
        self.events[startTime] = self.events.get(startTime, 0) + 1
        self.events[endTime] = self.events.get(endTime, 0) - 1
        active = 0
        for point in sorted(self.events):
            active += self.events[point]
            if active > 2:
                self.events[startTime] -= 1
                self.events[endTime] += 1
                if self.events[startTime] == 0:
                    del self.events[startTime]
                if self.events.get(endTime) == 0:
                    del self.events[endTime]
                return False
        return True

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n) ​每次​預約​

​空間​： O(n)

class MyCalendarThree:
    """Approach: Endpoint sweep after each insertion
    Time: O(n log n) per book
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.events = {}

    def book(self, startTime: int, endTime: int) -> int:
        self.events[startTime] = self.events.get(startTime, 0) + 1
        self.events[endTime] = self.events.get(endTime, 0) - 1
        active = answer = 0
        for point in sorted(self.events):
            active += self.events[point]
            answer = max(answer, active)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​稀疏​延遲線​段​樹
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log U) ​每次​預約​

​空間​： O(n log U)

class MyCalendarThree:
    """Approach: Sparse lazy segment tree
    Time: O(log U) per book
    Space: O(n log U)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.maximum = {}
        self.lazy = {}

    def book(self, startTime: int, endTime: int) -> int:
        def add(node, left, right):
            if endTime <= left or right < startTime:
                return
            if startTime <= left and right < endTime:
                self.maximum[node] = self.maximum.get(node, 0) + 1
                self.lazy[node] = self.lazy.get(node, 0) + 1
                return
            middle = (left + right) // 2
            add(node * 2, left, middle)
            add(node * 2 + 1, middle + 1, right)
            self.maximum[node] = self.lazy.get(node, 0) + max(
                self.maximum.get(node * 2, 0), self.maximum.get(node * 2 + 1, 0)
            )

        add(1, 0, 10**9 - 1)
        return self.maximum[1]

docs.text: ​使用​ (position,previous_digit,tight) ​狀態​，​在​非​遞減​與​上界​限制​內​，​由大到​小嘗試​下​一位​，​保留​第一​個​可行​後​綴​。

docs.text: ​下降​處若​保持​前綴​不變​，​就​不​可能​產生​合法​後​綴​。​減少​最晚​可減​的​違規位​，​使​必要​減量​最小​；​後​面​填九則​使​結果​最大​。​由右向左​掃描​可繼續​處理​新產生​的​下降​。

docs.text: ​狀態​涵蓋後綴​全部​約束​。​候選遞​減順序​會​選到​最大​的​可行​首個​相異位​，​再​以​最佳​後​綴​完成​最大​合法​數字​。​前置​零​自然​代表​較​短數​字​，​不需​特例​。

​輸入​不變​。L ​是​十進位​位數​，​在​題目​上界​內​最​多​ 10，​所以​數位​ DP ​遞​迴​很​淺​。​將含​前置​零​的​結果​轉為​整數​，​即​得到​標準​數值​形式​。

docs.title: 1. ​由右向左​遞​減並​填九後綴
docs.text:
​時間​： O(L)

​空間​： O(L)

from functools import cache


class Solution:
    """Approach: Right-to-left decrement and nine suffix
    Time: O(L)
    Space: O(L)
    """

    def monotoneIncreasingDigits(self, n: int) -> int:
        digits = list(str(n))
        boundary = len(digits)
        for i in range(len(digits) - 1, 0, -1):
            if digits[i] < digits[i - 1]:
                digits[i - 1] = str(int(digits[i - 1]) - 1)
                boundary = i
        for i in range(boundary, len(digits)):
            digits[i] = "9"
        return int("".join(digits))

docs.title: 2. ​記憶化​上界​數位​建構
docs.text:
​時間​： O(100L)

​空間​： O(10L)

from functools import cache


class Solution:
    """Approach: Memoized upper-bound digit construction
    Time: O(100L)
    Space: O(10L)
    """

    def monotoneIncreasingDigits(self, n: int) -> int:
        digits = tuple(map(int, str(n)))

        @cache
        def build(position, previous, tight):
            if position == len(digits):
                return 0
            limit = digits[position] if tight else 9
            for digit in range(limit, previous - 1, -1):
                suffix = build(position + 1, digit, tight and digit == limit)
                if suffix is not None:
                    return digit * 10 ** (len(digits) - position - 1) + suffix
            return None

        return build(0, 0, True)

docs.title: 尚未​解決​日期​的​堆​疊
docs.text: ​維護​溫度​非​遞增​的​未​解決​索引​堆疊​。​新​的​一天​更暖時​，​彈出​所有​較​冷​的​頂端​索引​，​填入​等待​距離​；​解決​後​再​加入​目前​日期​。

docs.title: 反向​跳躍指標
docs.text: ​由​後​往前​掃描​，​利用​已計算​的​「​下一個​更​暖​日​」​連結​跳躍​，​直到​遇到​更​暖​日​。​可​省去​獨立​堆疊​，​但​其​保守​最壞​上界​為​平方​時間​，​完整​限制​下​可能​逾時​。

docs.title: 尚未​解決​日期​的​堆​疊
docs.text: ​一個​索引​會​保持​未解決​，​直到​第一​個後續​較​暖​日出​現​。​若​更​早已​有​較​暖​日​，​它​早就​該​被​彈出​，​因此​填入​的​一定​是​最早​合法​暖​日​的​距離​。

docs.title: 反向​跳躍指標
docs.text: ​若​某個​未來​日​不夠​暖​，​它​到​自身​下一個​暖​日​之前​所​跳過​的​日期​，​也​都​不​比​它​暖​，​無法​回答​目前​查詢​。​沿著​該​連結​跳躍​，​不會​跳過​第一​個​可能​答案​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​堆疊法​：O(n) ​時間​、O(n) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​ O(n) ​輸出​；​每個​索引​至多​入堆​疊​與​出堆​疊​一次​。​跳躍法​：​最壞​ O(n²) ​時間​、O(1) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​ O(n) ​輸出​，​省下​堆​疊​但​可能​較慢​。

​輸入​不變​。​相等​溫度​不算​更​暖​，​只有​嚴格​上升​才​彈出​。​必須​存​索引​，​光有​溫度值​無法​取得​等待​距離​。

docs.title: 1. ​尚未​解決​日期​的​堆​疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Unresolved-day stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def dailyTemperatures(self, temperatures: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        result = [0] * len(temperatures)
        waiting = []
        for day, temperature in enumerate(temperatures):
            while waiting and temperatures[waiting[-1]] < temperature:
                previous = waiting.pop()
                result[previous] = day - previous
            waiting.append(day)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​反向​跳躍指標
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n²) ​最壞​情況​

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​, O(n) ​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Reverse jump pointers
    Time: O(n squared) worst case
    Space: O(1) auxiliary, O(n) output
    """

    def dailyTemperatures(self, temperatures: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        result = [0] * len(temperatures)
        for i in range(len(temperatures) - 2, -1, -1):
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(temperatures) and temperatures[j] <= temperatures[i]:
                if result[j] == 0:
                    j = len(temperatures)
                else:
                    j += result[j]
            if j < len(temperatures):
                result[i] = j - i
        return result

docs.title: 稀疏​排序​值​的​選取​與​略過
docs.text: ​用​字典​彙​整​收益​，​依互​異值​順序​處理​。​相鄰值​的​選取​必接​前​一略過​狀態​；​跨​缺口​則可​接任​一​先前​最佳​。

docs.title: 稠密​數值軸​打家劫舍​ DP
docs.text: ​從​零到​最大值​為​每個值​配置​收益​桶​，​再​以​一般​兩前​綴​打家劫舍​遞​推處理​。

docs.title: 稀疏​排序​值​的​選取​與​略過
docs.text: ​選定​ x ​後​，​拿​全部​相同​副本​會​增加​收益​且​不​新增​衝突​。​只有​相鄰​整數值​衝突​，​因此​選取​／​略過​的​路徑​遞​推​完整​涵蓋​可能​。

docs.title: 稠密​數值軸​打家劫舍​ DP
docs.text: ​相鄰​桶​恰​表示​一對​禁止​同選​的​值​。​對​每桶​選​或​不選​，​便​描述​全部​合法​值​集合​，​空桶​也​自然​處理​數值間​缺口​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​稀疏​排序​值​的​選取​與​略過​：​時間​ O(n+u log u)，​期望值​；​空間​ O(u)。 ​稠密​數值軸​打家劫舍​ DP：​時間​ O(n+U)；​空間​ O(U)。

u ​為​不同​值數​，U=max(nums)+1。​兩者​不​改變​ nums。​官方​最大值​ 10000 ​時​稠密​法​很​合適​，​稀疏​法則​不必​為​大​而​多​空缺​的​值域​付出​成本​。

docs.title: 1. ​稀疏​排序​值​的​選取​與​略過
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+u log u)，​期望值​

​空間​： O(u)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sparse sorted-value take and skip
    Time: O(n+u log u) expected
    Space: O(u)
    """

    def deleteAndEarn(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        points = {}
        for value in nums:
            points[value] = points.get(value, 0) + value
        take = skip = 0
        previous = None
        for value in sorted(points):
            best = max(take, skip)
            take, skip = (
                (skip if previous is not None and value == previous + 1 else best) + points[value],
                best,
            )
            previous = value
        return max(take, skip)

docs.title: 2. ​稠密​數值軸​打家劫舍​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+U)

​空間​： O(U)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dense value-axis robber DP
    Time: O(n+U)
    Space: O(U)
    """

    def deleteAndEarn(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        points = [0] * (max(nums) + 1)
        for value in nums:
            points[value] += value
        older = previous = 0
        for gain in points:
            older, previous = previous, max(previous, older + gain)
        return previous

docs.title: 題目
docs.text: ​訊號​從​節點​ k ​沿非負​旅行​時間​的​有​向邊​傳播​。​回傳​所有​節點​都​收到​訊號​的​最早​時間​；​有​任一​節點​不可​達則​回傳​ -1。

docs.title: 提示
docs.text:
1. ​每個​節點​的​最早​到​達​時間​就是​源點​到​它​的​最​短距​離​。
  2. ​使用​最小​堆積​，​優先展​開​目前​已知​到​達​時間​最小​的​節點​。
​展開​解法​、​複​雜度​比​較​、​證明​與​ Python ​程式​

docs.title: 解法​比較
docs.text:
解法​ ​時間​ ​空間​ ​堆積式​ Dijkstra ​到​達​時間​ O((V+E) log V) O(V+E) ​反覆​鬆​弛​有​向​邊​ O(V*E) O(V)

​請先​閱讀​各​解法​的​限制​與​輸入​修改​說明​。​教學​基準​解法​可能​超過​題目​要求​的​成本​上限​；​第一​種為​預設​實作​。

docs.title: 堆積式​ Dijkstra ​到​達​時間
docs.text: ​建立​出邊​鄰接​串列​；​源點​距離​為​零​，​其餘為​無限大​。​取出​與​目前​最佳​距離​相符​的​堆積​項目​，​鬆​弛​出​邊​並​加入​改善​結果​，​略過​過期​項目​。​若全​可達​，​回傳​最大​距離​。

docs.title: 反覆​鬆​弛​有​向​邊
docs.text: ​源點​以外​距離​設無限大​，​最多​掃描​並​鬆​弛​所有​邊​ V-1 ​輪​；​一輪​沒有​改變​就​提前​結束​。

docs.title: 堆積式​ Dijkstra ​到​達​時間
docs.text: ​最小​未定​距離​不能​透過​其他​未定​節點​再​降低​，​因為​到​其他​節點​已​至少​同樣​昂貴​，​且邊​不會​降低成本​。​因此​展開​時​的​距離​已​是​最早​到​達​時間​；​鬆​弛​將​改善​沿出邊​傳播​。​最大​最早​到​達​時間​就是​全網​收到​訊號​的​時刻​。

docs.title: 反覆​鬆​弛​有​向​邊
docs.text: ​完整​掃描​ r ​輪​後​，​所有​至多​ r ​條邊​的​最​短路​徑​都​已​涵蓋​；​原地​傳播​可能​更​早​得到​結果​。​非負​權重​的​最​短​簡單​路徑​最​多​有​ V-1 ​條邊​，​故輪​數足夠​。

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​堆積式​ Dijkstra ​到​達​時間​：​時間​ O((V+E) log V)；​空間​ O(V+E)。

​反覆​鬆​弛​有​向​邊​：​時間​ O(V*E)；​空間​ O(V)。

​預設法​對​本題​不重​複​的​有​向邊​需​ O((V + E) log V) ​時間​、O(V + E) ​空間​。FIFO BFS ​無法​處理​不同​權重​。​答案​是​最​短距​離​的​最大值​，​不是​邊權​或​到​達​時間​的​總​和​。Bellman-Ford ​不用​堆積​，​只留​距離​陣列​，​但重​複​掃邊​；​最後的​距離​切片​另​配置​ O(V) ​暫存​空間​。​兩法​皆​保留​輸入​。

docs.title: 1. ​堆積式​ Dijkstra ​到​達​時間
docs.text:
​時間​： O((V+E) log V)

​空間​： O(V+E)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap Dijkstra arrival times
    Time: O((V+E) log V)
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def networkDelayTime(self, times: list[list[int]], n: int, k: int) -> int:
        outgoing = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
        for source, target, weight in times:
            outgoing[source].append((target, weight))
        distances = [float("inf")] * (n + 1)
        distances[k] = 0
        queue = [(0, k)]
        while queue:
            distance, node = heappop(queue)
            if distance != distances[node]:
                continue
            for target, weight in outgoing[node]:
                candidate = distance + weight
                if candidate < distances[target]:
                    distances[target] = candidate
                    heappush(queue, (candidate, target))
        delay = max(distances[1:])
        return -1 if delay == float("inf") else int(delay)

docs.title: 2. ​反覆​鬆​弛​有​向​邊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V*E)

​空間​： O(V)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Repeated directed-edge relaxation
    Time: O(V*E)
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def networkDelayTime(self, times: list[list[int]], n: int, k: int) -> int:
        distance = [float("inf")] * (n + 1)
        distance[k] = 0
        for _ in range(n - 1):
            changed = False
            for source, target, weight in times:
                if distance[source] + weight < distance[target]:
                    distance[target] = distance[source] + weight
                    changed = True
            if not changed:
                break
        answer = max(distance[1:])
        return -1 if answer == float("inf") else answer

docs.title: 單源鎖​狀態​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​用​佇列​保存​鎖狀態​與​步數​。​將​禁止​狀態​預先​放入​ visited，​新狀態​在​加入​佇列時​就​標記​，​避免​重​複​加入​。

docs.title: 雙前​緣距​離表
docs.text: ​分別​維護​從​起點​與​終點​出發​的​距​離表​。​每次​選擇​較​小​的​完整​前緣​展開​；​產生​的​鄰居若​已​存在​另​一側​距​離表​，​就​把​兩段​距離​接起​來​。

docs.title: 單源鎖​狀態​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text: ​每條邊​恰好​代表​轉動​一步​，​廣度​優先​搜尋按​步數​不​遞減​的​順序​處理​。​禁止​狀態​永遠​不會​進入​佇列​，​因此​第一次​抵達​目標​就是​最短​合法​路徑​。

docs.title: 雙前​緣距​離表
docs.text: ​每張​距​離表​記錄​從​自身​端點​出發​的​最​短距​離​。​逐層​推進​時​第一次​交會​，​接合​的​是​兩段​最​短​前綴​；​若​存在​更​短​完整​路徑​，​必然​會​更​早交會​，​因此​這個​接合​得到​最短​答案​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​沒有​禁止​狀態​時​，​從​ "0000" ​到​ "0009" ​只​需將​最後一個​轉輪​往後轉​一步​。

docs.text: ​兩者​最多​處理​ O(10^4) ​個​狀態​，​四位​數鄰​居​生成​的​工作量​固定​，​空間​皆​為​ O(10^4)。​輸入​不變​。​字串​切片​與​雜湊​需​ O(4) ​成本​，​已納入​固定​寬度​的​工作​。​若​起始​狀態​是​禁止​狀態​，​即使​它剛​好​等​於​ target，​也​仍​不可​使用​。

docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​單源鎖​狀態​廣度​優先​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(10^4) ​個​狀態​，​每個​狀態​的​四位​數處​理為​固定成本​

​空間​： O(10^4)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Single-source lock BFS
    Time: O(10^4) states with fixed four-digit work
    Space: O(10^4)
    """

    def openLock(self, deadends: list[str], target: str) -> int:
        from collections import deque

        seen = set(deadends)
        if "0000" in seen:
            return -1
        seen.add("0000")
        queue = deque([("0000", 0)])
        while queue:
            state, steps = queue.popleft()
            if state == target:
                return steps
            for index in range(4):
                for change in (-1, 1):
                    following = (
                        state[:index] + str((int(state[index]) + change) % 10) + state[index + 1 :]
                    )
                    if following not in seen:
                        seen.add(following)
                        queue.append((following, steps + 1))
        return -1

docs.title: 2. ​雙前​緣距​離表
docs.text:
​時間​： O(10^4) ​個​狀態​，​每個​狀態​的​四位​數處​理為​固定成本​

​空間​： O(10^4)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Two frontier distance maps
    Time: O(10^4) states with fixed four-digit work
    Space: O(10^4)
    """

    def openLock(self, deadends: list[str], target: str) -> int:
        blocked = set(deadends)
        if "0000" in blocked or target in blocked:
            return -1
        if target == "0000":
            return 0
        front, back = {"0000"}, {target}
        first, second = {"0000": 0}, {target: 0}
        while front and back:
            if len(front) > len(back):
                front, back, first, second = back, front, second, first
            following = set()
            for state in front:
                for index in range(4):
                    for change in (-1, 1):
                        other = (
                            state[:index]
                            + str((int(state[index]) + change) % 10)
                            + state[index + 1 :]
                        )
                        if other in blocked or other in first:
                            continue
                        if other in second:
                            return first[state] + 1 + second[other]
                        first[other] = first[state] + 1
                        following.add(other)
            front = following
        return -1

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n) ​期望​

​空間​： O(A)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Greedy last-occurrence boundary
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def partitionLabels(self, s: str) -> list[int]:
        last = {char: i for i, char in enumerate(s)}
        start = end = 0
        answer = []
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            end = max(end, last[char])
            if i == end:
                answer.append(i - start + 1)
                start = i + 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​合​併​字​元​跨度​區間
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+A log A)

​空間​： O(A)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Merge character-span intervals
    Time: O(n+A log A)
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def partitionLabels(self, s: str) -> list[int]:
        spans = {}
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            if char not in spans:
                spans[char] = [i, i]
            spans[char][1] = i
        answer = []
        start = end = -1
        for left, right in sorted(spans.values()):
            if left > end:
                if end >= 0:
                    answer.append(end - start + 1)
                start, end = left, right
            else:
                end = max(end, right)
        if end >= 0:
            answer.append(end - start + 1)
        return answer

docs.title: 1. ​延後一個​字​元​的​堆積
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log(u+1))

​空間​： O(n+u)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap with one delayed character
    Time: O(n log(u+1))
    Space: O(n+u)
    """

    def reorganizeString(self, s: str) -> str:
        counts = Counter(s)
        if max(counts.values(), default=0) > (len(s) + 1) // 2:
            return ""
        heap = [(-count, char) for char, count in counts.items()]
        heapify(heap)
        previous_count, previous_char = 0, ""
        result = []
        while heap:
            count, char = heappop(heap)
            result.append(char)
            if previous_count < 0:
                heappush(heap, (previous_count, previous_char))
            previous_count, previous_char = count + 1, char
        return "".join(result)

docs.title: 2. ​先填​偶數​位置​再​填奇數​位置
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n + u log u)

​空間​： O(n+u)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Fill even then odd positions
    Time: O(n + u log u)
    Space: O(n+u)
    """

    def reorganizeString(self, s: str) -> str:
        counts = Counter(s)
        if max(counts.values(), default=0) > (len(s) + 1) // 2:
            return ""
        result = [""] * len(s)
        index = 0
        for char, count in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: -item[1]):
            for _ in range(count):
                if index >= len(s):
                    index = 1
                result[index] = char
                index += 2
        return "".join(result)

docs.title: 1. ​高度​瓶頸​ Dijkstra
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2 log n)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Minimax elevation Dijkstra
    Time: O(n^2 log n)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def swimInWater(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from heapq import heappop, heappush

        n = len(grid)
        best = {(0, 0): grid[0][0]}
        heap = [(grid[0][0], 0, 0)]
        while heap:
            level, r, c = heappop(heap)
            if level != best[(r, c)]:
                continue
            if (r, c) == (n - 1, n - 1):
                return level
            for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if 0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < n:
                    candidate = max(level, grid[nr][nc])
                    if candidate < best.get((nr, nc), float("inf")):
                        best[(nr, nc)] = candidate
                        heappush(heap, (candidate, nr, nc))
        return -1

docs.title: 2. ​水位​二分​搜尋與​填充​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2 log n)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary-search water level and flood-fill
    Time: O(n^2 log n)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def swimInWater(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(grid)

        def reachable(level):
            seen, stack = {(0, 0)}, [(0, 0)]
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                if (r, c) == (n - 1, n - 1):
                    return True
                for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                    if (
                        0 <= nr < n
                        and 0 <= nc < n
                        and grid[nr][nc] <= level
                        and (nr, nc) not in seen
                    ):
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            return False

        low = max(grid[0][0], grid[-1][-1]) - 1
        high = n * n - 1
        while low + 1 < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if reachable(middle):
                high = middle
            else:
                low = middle
        return high

​逐連通​分量​雙色​ BFS：​時間​ O(V+E)；​空間​ O(V)。 ​含​相反​副本​的​並查集​：​時間​ O((V+E)*alpha(V))；​空間​ O(V)。

​圖不變​。​每個​不連通​分量​都​要​啟動​，​不可​只​處理​零頂點​。​並查​集為​每點​使用​兩個​副本​；alpha ​是​反​阿克曼​函數​。​迭代​避免​深層​遞​迴​走訪​。

docs.title: 1. ​逐連通​分量​雙色​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V+E)

​空間​： O(V)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Component-wise two-color BFS
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def isBipartite(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
        colors = [-1] * len(graph)
        for start in range(len(graph)):
            if colors[start] != -1:
                continue
            colors[start] = 0
            queue = deque([start])
            while queue:
                node = queue.popleft()
                for neighbor in graph[node]:
                    if colors[neighbor] == -1:
                        colors[neighbor] = 1 - colors[node]
                        queue.append(neighbor)
                    elif colors[neighbor] == colors[node]:
                        return False
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​含​相反​副本​的​並查集
docs.text:
​時間​： O((V+E)*alpha(V))

​空間​： O(V)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Union-find with opposite copies
    Time: O((V+E)*alpha(V))
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def isBipartite(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
        n = len(graph)
        parent = list(range(2 * n))
        size = [1] * (2 * n)

        def find(node):
            while parent[node] != node:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        def union(left, right):
            left, right = find(left), find(right)
            if left == right:
                return
            if size[left] < size[right]:
                left, right = right, left
            parent[right] = left
            size[left] += size[right]

        for node, neighbors in enumerate(graph):
            for neighbor in neighbors:
                union(node, neighbor + n)
                union(node + n, neighbor)
        return all(find(node) != find(node + n) for node in range(n))

docs.text:
​時間​： O((k+1)*(V+E))

​空間​： O(V)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bounded-edge Bellman-Ford rows
    Time: O((k+1)*(V+E))
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def findCheapestPrice(
        self, n: int, flights: list[list[int]], src: int, dst: int, k: int
    ) -> int:
        costs = [float("inf")] * n
        costs[src] = 0
        for _ in range(k + 1):
            following = costs.copy()
            for a, b, price in flights:
                following[b] = min(following[b], costs[a] + price)
            costs = following
        return -1 if costs[dst] == float("inf") else costs[dst]

docs.title: 2. ​城市​與​已用​航班​數的​ Dijkstra
docs.text:
​時間​： O((k+1)*(V+E)*log((k+1)*V+1))

​空間​： O((k+1)*(V+E))

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dijkstra on node and flights-used states
    Time: O((k+1)*(V+E)*log((k+1)*V+1))
    Space: O((k+1)*(V+E))
    """

    def findCheapestPrice(
        self, n: int, flights: list[list[int]], src: int, dst: int, k: int
    ) -> int:
        from heapq import heappop, heappush

        graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for a, b, price in flights:
            graph[a].append((b, price))
        best = {(src, 0): 0}
        heap = [(0, src, 0)]
        while heap:
            cost, node, used = heappop(heap)
            if best[(node, used)] != cost:
                continue
            if node == dst:
                return cost
            if used == k + 1:
                continue
            for other, price in graph[node]:
                candidate = cost + price
                if candidate < best.get((other, used + 1), float("inf")):
                    best[(other, used + 1)] = candidate
                    heappush(heap, (candidate, other, used + 1))
        return -1

docs.text:

​空間​： O(n+u)，​包含​輸出​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency emission
    Time: O(n+r) expected
    Space: O(n+u), including output
    """

    def customSortString(self, order: str, s: str) -> str:
        counts = Counter(s)
        pieces = []
        for char in order:
            count = counts.pop(char, 0)
            if count:
                pieces.append(char * count)
        pieces.extend(char * count for char, count in counts.items())
        return "".join(pieces)

docs.text:
​時間​： O(r+n log n)

​空間​： O(r+n)，​包含​輸出​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Rank-key sorting
    Time: O(r+n log n)
    Space: O(r+n), including output
    """

    def customSortString(self, order: str, s: str) -> str:
        rank = {char: index for index, char in enumerate(order)}
        return "".join(sorted(s, key=lambda char: rank.get(char, len(order))))

docs.title: 1. ​路徑​局部​ DAG ​回溯
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V*2^V)，​寬​鬆​上​界​

​空間​： O(V) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Path-local DAG backtracking
    Time: O(V*2^V) loose bound
    Space: O(V) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def allPathsSourceTarget(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        path, result = [0], []

        def visit(node):
            if node == len(graph) - 1:
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            for neighbor in graph[node]:
                path.append(neighbor)
                visit(neighbor)
                path.pop()

        visit(0)
        return result

docs.title: 2. ​拓撲後綴​路徑​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V+E+​複​製​後​綴​總​長​度​)

​空間​： O(V+E+​儲存後綴​總長​度​)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Topological suffix-path DP
    Time: O(V+E+total copied suffix lengths)
    Space: O(V+E+total stored suffix lengths)
    """

    def allPathsSourceTarget(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        indegree = [0] * len(graph)
        for neighbors in graph:
            for neighbor in neighbors:
                indegree[neighbor] += 1
        queue = deque(node for node, count in enumerate(indegree) if count == 0)
        order = []
        while queue:
            node = queue.popleft()
            order.append(node)
            for neighbor in graph[node]:
                indegree[neighbor] -= 1
                if indegree[neighbor] == 0:
                    queue.append(neighbor)
        paths = [[] for _ in graph]
        paths[-1] = [[len(graph) - 1]]
        for node in reversed(order):
            if node != len(graph) - 1:
                paths[node] = [
                    [node] + suffix for neighbor in graph[node] for suffix in paths[neighbor]
                ]
        return paths[0]

docs.title: 反轉​邊並​移除​終端層
docs.text: ​從​終端​節點​開始​，​遞減​其前​驅​剩餘出​邊數​。​當前​驅​全部​出邊​都​指向​已​移除​安全​點​，​就釋​出為​安全​。

docs.text: ​以明​確子​迭代​器維護​未見​、​活動​、​安全​、​不​安全​狀態​。​活動​框架​碰到​活動​祖先​或​已知​不​安全​點時​，​將整條​目前​路徑​標為​不​安全​，​否則​完成​為​安全​。

docs.title: 反轉​邊並​移除​終端層
docs.text: ​每個釋​出點​都​只能​經已​安全​後​繼終​止​。​未釋​出點​在​剩餘圖​仍​有​出邊​，​沿​這些​邊走​最​終會​進入環​。

docs.text: ​全部​孩子​都​安全​後​完成​，​足以​證明​安全​。​回邊​通往​環​，​而​活動​路徑​上​每​框架​都​能​到​它​；​到​不​安全​孩子​也​同樣​。​因此​這些​結果​可​正確​分類​每個​訪​問點​。

docs.title: 1. ​反轉​邊並​移除​終端層
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V+E)

​空間​： O(V+E)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Reverse edges and remove terminal layers
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def eventualSafeNodes(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        from collections import deque

        reverse = [[] for _ in graph]
        remaining = [len(edges) for edges in graph]
        for node, edges in enumerate(graph):
            for other in edges:
                reverse[other].append(node)
        queue = deque(node for node, count in enumerate(remaining) if count == 0)
        safe = [False] * len(graph)
        while queue:
            node = queue.popleft()
            safe[node] = True
            for parent in reverse[node]:
                remaining[parent] -= 1
                if remaining[parent] == 0:
                    queue.append(parent)
        return [node for node, good in enumerate(safe) if good]

docs.title: 2. ​迭代​ DFS ​的​安全​與​不​安全​結果
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V+E)

​空間​： O(V)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative DFS with safe and unsafe outcomes
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def eventualSafeNodes(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        state = [0] * len(graph)
        for start in range(len(graph)):
            if state[start]:
                continue
            state[start] = 1
            stack = [(start, iter(graph[start]))]
            while stack:
                node, children = stack[-1]
                other = next(children, None)
                if other is None:
                    state[node] = 2
                    stack.pop()
                elif state[other] in (1, 3):
                    for active, _ in stack:
                        state[active] = 3
                    stack.clear()
                elif state[other] == 0:
                    state[other] = 1
                    stack.append((other, iter(graph[other])))
        return [node for node, status in enumerate(state) if status == 2]

docs.text: ​正規化​ m=ceil(n/25)。A ​空而​ B ​未空​為​一​，​只有​ B ​空為​零​，​兩者​皆空​為​一半​；​每步​都​減少​ A，​所以​依​ A ​遞增​填表​。m>=480 ​時回​傳一​。

docs.title: 反向​剩餘​湯量​機率​表
docs.text: ​以首個​分湯​選項​為​條件​，​答案​為​四個​ A ​較小狀態​的​平均​，​所以​ A ​遞​增順序​能解​精確​遞​推​。​每次​要求​移除​量​都​是​ 25 ​的​倍數​，​且​只​在意​剩量​是否​為​正​，​因此​向上​取整​精確​。

docs.title: 向前​未​完成​狀態​機率​前緣

docs.title: 複​雜度​與​常見​錯誤
docs.text:
​反向​剩餘​湯量​機率​表​：​時間​ ​門檻​以下​ O(m^2)；​以上​ O(1)；​空間​ ​門檻​以下​ O(m^2)；​以上​ O(1)。 ​向前​未​完成​狀態​機率​前緣​：​時間​ ​門檻​以下​ O(m^2)；​以上​ O(1)；​空間​ ​門檻​以下​ O(m)；​以上​ O(1)。

​兩法​保留​ n。​門檻​證明​：​預先取​獨立​的​ B ​移除​量​ Y∈{0,1,2,3}，​平均​ 1.5。​每個​未​結束​回合​共移​四​單位​，​所以​程序​至多​ T=ceil(m/2) ​輪​結束​。​若​ B ​不晚​於​ A ​空​，​必有​ sum(Y_1..Y_T)>=m。Hoeffding ​因而​將回​傳一​的​誤差界​為​ exp(-2*(m-1.5T)^2/(9T))，​至多​ exp(-(m-3)^2/(36*(m+1)))，m>=480 ​時小​於​ 1.97e-6，​低​於​官方​ 1e-5 ​容差​，​並​保留​浮點​捨​入餘裕​。​來源​：​官方​規則​與​容差​ ​與​ Hoeffding ​不等式​，​定理​ 2。​此處​是​不等式​推導出​的​界限​，​不是​宣稱​官方​網頁​指定​此門檻​。

docs.text:
​時間​： ​門檻​以下​ O(m^2)；​以上​ O(1)

​空間​： ​門檻​以下​ O(m^2)；​以上​ O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Backward remaining-soup probability table
    Time: O(m^2) below cutoff; O(1) above
    Space: O(m^2) below cutoff; O(1) above
    """

    def soupServings(self, n: int) -> float:
        size = (n + 24) // 25
        if size >= 480:
            return 1.0
        dp = [[0.0] * (size + 1) for _ in range(size + 1)]
        dp[0] = [1.0] * (size + 1)
        dp[0][0] = 0.5
        for a in range(1, size + 1):
            for b in range(1, size + 1):
                dp[a][b] = (
                    sum(
                        dp[max(0, a - da)][max(0, b - db)]
                        for da, db in ((4, 0), (3, 1), (2, 2), (1, 3))
                    )
                    / 4
                )
        return dp[size][size]

docs.title: 2. ​向前​未​完成​狀態​機率​前緣
docs.text:
​時間​： ​門檻​以下​ O(m^2)；​以上​ O(1)

​空間​： ​門檻​以下​ O(m)；​以上​ O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward unfinished-state probability frontiers
    Time: O(m^2) below cutoff; O(1) above
    Space: O(m) below cutoff; O(1) above
    """

    def soupServings(self, n: int) -> float:
        size = (n + 24) // 25
        if size >= 480:
            return 1.0
        if size == 0:
            return 0.5
        frontier = {(size, size): 1.0}
        answer = 0.0
        while frontier:
            following = {}
            for (a, b), probability in frontier.items():
                for da, db in ((4, 0), (3, 1), (2, 2), (1, 3)):
                    na, nb = a - da, b - db
                    mass = probability / 4
                    if na <= 0:
                        answer += mass * (0.5 if nb <= 0 else 1.0)
                    elif nb > 0:
                        state = (na, nb)
                        following[state] = following.get(state, 0.0) + mass
            frontier = following
        return answer

docs.text: ​列出​兩​影像​的​一格​座標​，​計算​每​對​座標​的​位移​，​其出​現次數​就是​該​平移​量​的​重疊數​。

docs.text: ​每列​編成​一個​整數​。​逐一​測試​垂直​與​水平​平移​，​對列​遮罩​位移​後​計算位​元​交集​。

docs.text: ​固定​平移​量​時​，​每個​重疊格​恰​對​應​一​對​位移​相等​的​座標​。​因此​票數​就是​重疊數​，​最大​票數​即​最優​。

docs.title: 1. ​一格配​對​的​平移​投票
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2+a*b)

​空間​： O(n^2)

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Translation votes from one-cell pairs
    Time: O(n squared+a*b)
    Space: O(n squared)
    """

    def largestOverlap(self, img1: list[list[int]], img2: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        first = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(img1) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value]
        second = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(img2) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value]
        votes = Counter((r2 - r1, c2 - c1) for r1, c1 in first for r2, c2 in second)
        return max(votes.values(), default=0)

docs.title: 2. ​平移​列位​元​遮罩
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^3) ​次​機器​字​運算​ ​用​於​ n<=30

​空間​： O(n) ​個​機器​字​

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Shifted row bit masks
    Time: O(n cubed) word operations for n<=30
    Space: O(n) words
    """

    def largestOverlap(self, img1: list[list[int]], img2: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        size = len(img1)
        first = [sum(value << col for col, value in enumerate(row)) for row in img1]
        second = [sum(value << col for col, value in enumerate(row)) for row in img2]
        best = 0
        for dr in range(1 - size, size):
            for dc in range(1 - size, size):
                overlap = 0
                for row in range(size):
                    other = row + dr
                    if 0 <= other < size:
                        shifted = first[row] << dc if dc >= 0 else first[row] >> -dc
                        overlap += (shifted & second[other]).bit_count()
                best = max(best, overlap)
        return best

docs.title: 1. ​迭代​鑰匙​可達性​ DFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V+E)

​空間​： O(V)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Iterative key-reachability DFS
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def canVisitAllRooms(self, rooms: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
        seen = {0}
        stack = [0]
        while stack:
            room = stack.pop()
            for key in rooms[room]:
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    stack.append(key)
        return len(seen) == len(rooms)

docs.title: 2. ​分層​鑰匙​可達性​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V+E)

​空間​： O(V)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Layered key-reachability BFS
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def canVisitAllRooms(self, rooms: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
        unlocked = [False] * len(rooms)
        unlocked[0] = True
        queue = deque([0])
        while queue:
            room = queue.popleft()
            for key in rooms[room]:
                if not unlocked[key]:
                    unlocked[key] = True
                    queue.append(key)
        return all(unlocked)

docs.title: 1. ​排序​後​消耗​次數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n+n*g) ​最壞​情況​

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import Counter, deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted frequency consumption
    Time: O(n log n+n*g) worst case
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def isNStraightHand(self, hand: list[int], groupSize: int) -> bool:
        if len(hand) % groupSize:
            return False
        counts = Counter(hand)
        for start in sorted(counts):
            count = counts[start]
            if not count:
                continue
            for value in range(start, start + groupSize):
                if counts[value] < count:
                    return False
                counts[value] -= count
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​掃描​尚未​完成​的​連續​牌組
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+u log u)

​空間​： O(u)

from collections import Counter, deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sweep active consecutive groups
    Time: O(n+u log u)
    Space: O(u)
    """

    def isNStraightHand(self, hand: list[int], groupSize: int) -> bool:
        if len(hand) % groupSize:
            return False
        counts = Counter(hand)
        opened = deque()
        active = 0
        previous = None
        for value in sorted(counts):
            if active and previous is not None and value != previous + 1:
                return False
            if counts[value] < active:
                return False
            opened.append(counts[value] - active)
            active = counts[value]
            if len(opened) == groupSize:
                active -= opened.popleft()
            previous = value
        return active == 0

docs.title: 1. ​多源​已訪​遮罩​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O((V+E)*2^V)

​空間​： O(V*2^V)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Multi-source visited-mask BFS
    Time: O((V+E)*2^V)
    Space: O(V*2^V)
    """

    def shortestPathLength(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from collections import deque

        full = (1 << len(graph)) - 1
        queue = deque((node, 1 << node, 0) for node in range(len(graph)))
        seen = {(node, 1 << node) for node in range(len(graph))}
        while queue:
            node, mask, steps = queue.popleft()
            if mask == full:
                return steps
            for other in graph[node]:
                following = mask | (1 << other)
                if (other, following) not in seen:
                    seen.add((other, following))
                    queue.append((other, following, steps + 1))
        return -1

docs.title: 2. ​度量​閉包​與​子集​端點​ DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V*(V+E)+V^2*2^V)

​空間​： O(V*2^V+V^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Metric closure and subset endpoint DP
    Time: O(V*(V+E)+V^2*2^V)
    Space: O(V*2^V+V^2)
    """

    def shortestPathLength(self, graph: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from collections import deque

        n = len(graph)
        distance = [[n] * n for _ in graph]
        for start in range(n):
            distance[start][start] = 0
            queue = deque([start])
            while queue:
                node = queue.popleft()
                for other in graph[node]:
                    if distance[start][other] == n:
                        distance[start][other] = distance[start][node] + 1
                        queue.append(other)
        dp = [[float("inf")] * n for _ in range(1 << n)]
        for node in range(n):
            dp[1 << node][node] = 0
        for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
            for last in range(n):
                if not mask & (1 << last):
                    continue
                for other in range(n):
                    if not mask & (1 << other):
                        following = mask | (1 << other)
                        dp[following][other] = min(
                            dp[following][other], dp[mask][last] + distance[last][other]
                        )
        return min(dp[-1])

docs.title: 1. ​斜率​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary slope search
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def peakIndexInMountainArray(self, arr: list[int]) -> int:
        low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if arr[middle] < arr[middle + 1]:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle
        return low

docs.title: 2. ​山形​三分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Ternary mountain search
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def peakIndexInMountainArray(self, arr: list[int]) -> int:
        low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
        while high - low > 2:
            left = low + (high - low) // 3
            right = high - (high - low) // 3
            if arr[left] < arr[right]:
                low = left + 1
            elif arr[left] > arr[right]:
                high = right - 1
            else:
                low, high = left + 1, right - 1
        return max(range(low, high + 1), key=arr.__getitem__)

docs.title: 依​位置​遞增​的​車隊​堆疊
docs.text: ​由​最遠往​最近​掃描​，​堆疊​存候​選車隊​的​抵達​時間​分數​。​較近​的​慢車會​吸收​所有​自由​抵達​時間​不​比​它​晚​的​後​方快​車隊​。

docs.title: 依​位置​遞減​比較​抵達​時間
docs.text: ​一台​車​不能​越過​前方​最近​的​車隊​。​若​自由​行駛時​不​比該​車隊​晚​抵達​，​它們​必會​在​終點​之前​或​恰​於​終點​相遇​；​否則​它​一直​在後面​，​成為​獨立​車隊​。

docs.title: 依​位置​遞增​的​車隊​堆疊
docs.text: ​後​方車隊​追得​上下​一隊​，​若且唯若​其​自由​抵達​時間​不大​於​前隊​。​彈出​所有​這樣​的​後​隊並​保留​較近​車隊​時間​，​便​得到​道路​順序​上​的​存活​車隊​。

docs.title: 1. ​依​位置​遞減​比較​抵達​時間
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Descending-position fleet times
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def carFleet(self, target: int, position: list[int], speed: list[int]) -> int:
        fleets = 0
        fleet_distance, fleet_speed = -1, 1
        for start, velocity in sorted(zip(position, speed, strict=True), reverse=True):
            distance = target - start
            if distance * fleet_speed > fleet_distance * velocity:
                fleets += 1
                fleet_distance, fleet_speed = distance, velocity
        return fleets

docs.title: 2. ​依​位置​遞增​的​車隊​堆疊
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Ascending-position fleet stack
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def carFleet(self, target: int, position: list[int], speed: list[int]) -> int:
        fleets = []
        for start, velocity in sorted(zip(position, speed, strict=True)):
            distance = target - start
            while fleets and fleets[-1][0] * velocity <= distance * fleets[-1][1]:
                fleets.pop()
            fleets.append((distance, velocity))
        return len(fleets)

docs.title: 比率​掃描​與​最大​品質​堆積
docs.text: ​依​必要​比率​排序​工人​。​用​最大​堆積​保留​目前​見過​的​ k ​個​最​小品​質​，​並評​估其​品質​總​和​乘​目前​比率​。

docs.title: 列舉​精確​費率​門檻
docs.text: ​將​每位​工人​的​比率​當候​選費率​，​以​精確​交叉​相乘​判斷​資格​，​排序​合格品​質​並取​最小​ k ​個​總​和​。​此教學​基準​在​完整​限制​下​可能​逾時​。

docs.title: 比率​掃描​與​最大​品質​堆積
docs.text: ​任何​最佳​群組​都​含​一名​最高​比率​成員​。​掃到​他​時​，​群組​全部​成員​都​已​可選​；​該費率​下選​ k ​個​最​小品​質使​成本​最小​。​因此​評估​每個​比率​，​必​包含​不比​最佳解​更差​的​群組​。

docs.title: 列舉​精確​費率​門檻
docs.text: ​最佳​費率​必​等​於​某位​工人​的​最低​比率​。​對​每個​候選​，​精確​資格​檢查​包含​且​只​包含​要求​已​滿足者​；​取​最小​ k ​個​品質​可​使​共同​費率​下​的​總額​最小​。

docs.text:
​比率​掃描​與​最大​品質​堆積​：​時間​ O(n log n+n log k)；​空間​ O(n+k)。 ​列舉​精確​費率​門檻​：​時間​ O(n squared log n)；​空間​ O(n)。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n+n log k)

​空間​： O(n+k)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Ratio sweep with a largest-quality heap
    Time: O(n log n+n log k)
    Space: O(n+k)
    """

    def mincostToHireWorkers(self, quality: list[int], wage: list[int], k: int) -> float:
        workers = sorted(
            (required / amount, amount) for amount, required in zip(quality, wage, strict=True)
        )
        heap = []
        total = 0
        answer = float("inf")
        for ratio, amount in workers:
            heappush(heap, -amount)
            total += amount
            if len(heap) > k:
                total += heappop(heap)
            if len(heap) == k:
                answer = min(answer, ratio * total)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​列舉​精確​費率​門檻
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n squared log n)

​空間​： O(n)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate exact rate thresholds
    Time: O(n squared log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def mincostToHireWorkers(self, quality: list[int], wage: list[int], k: int) -> float:
        answer = float("inf")
        for denominator, numerator in zip(quality, wage, strict=True):
            eligible = sorted(
                amount
                for amount, required in zip(quality, wage, strict=True)
                if required * denominator <= numerator * amount
            )
            if len(eligible) >= k:
                cost = sum(eligible[:k]) * numerator / denominator
                answer = min(answer, cost)
        return answer

​樹不變​，​值​相等​不能​代替​目標​物件​身分​。​祖先​法​省去​完整​父節​點表​；​被​分派​搜尋的子​樹區域​互不​重疊​，​總​工作​仍為​線性​。​距離​超出​樹直​徑時​，​回傳​無​任何​值​。

docs.title: 1. ​父節​點表​與​距離​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Parent map and distance BFS
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def distanceK(self, root: TreeNode, target: TreeNode, k: int) -> list[int]:
        parents = {root: None}
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            for child in (node.left, node.right):
                if child:
                    parents[child] = node
                    stack.append(child)
        queue = deque([target])
        seen = {target}
        for _ in range(k):
            if not queue:
                return []
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                node = queue.popleft()
                for neighbor in (node.left, node.right, parents[node]):
                    if neighbor and neighbor not in seen:
                        seen.add(neighbor)
                        queue.append(neighbor)
        return [node.val for node in queue]

docs.title: 2. ​祖先​路徑​與​排除​分支​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(h) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

from collections import deque


class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Ancestor path and excluded-branch searches
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(h) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def distanceK(self, root: TreeNode, target: TreeNode, k: int) -> list[int]:
        path = []
        stack = [(root, False)]
        while stack:
            node, exiting = stack.pop()
            if exiting:
                path.pop()
                continue
            path.append(node)
            if node is target:
                break
            stack.append((node, True))
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, False))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, False))
        result = []
        excluded = None
        for upward, ancestor in enumerate(reversed(path)):
            remaining = k - upward
            if remaining < 0:
                break
            pending = [(ancestor, remaining)]
            while pending:
                node, depth = pending.pop()
                if depth == 0:
                    result.append(node.val)
                    continue
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child and child is not excluded:
                        pending.append((child, depth - 1))
            excluded = ancestor
        return result

docs.text: ​每個​已​定案​鑰匙​端點​狀態​，​用​ BFS ​走​目前​可通​過格​，​遇未​收集​鑰匙​便​停​。​把​這些​距離​作為​上層​ Dijkstra ​的​加權​轉移​。

docs.text: ​遮罩​記錄​未來​合法​移動​需要​的​全部​歷史​。​每邊​一步​，​因此​首次​達到​全鑰匙​遮罩​，​就是​最短​收集​路徑​。

docs.text:
​格子​與​鑰匙​遮罩​ BFS：​時間​ O(RC2^K)；​空間​ O(RC2^K)。

​新​收集​鑰匙​間​的​ Dijkstra：​時間​ O(K2^KRC + K^22^Klog(K2^K+1))；​空間​ O(RC+K^22^K)。

K ​是​鑰匙數​，​最多​六​，​輸入​不變​。​已​持有​鑰匙​的​格​仍​可​走​；​未​收集​鑰匙​必先​更新​狀態​才能​繼續​。​壓縮​法端點​狀態​較​少​，​但會​反覆​搜尋​格子​。

docs.text: ​每個​程式​區塊​都​能​獨立​使用​，​並採用​ LeetCode ​的​類別​名稱​。​選一個​貼入​ Python3 ​編輯器​；​需要​時​已​附​共用​節點​定義​。​兩種​語言​共用​完全相同​的​程式​。

docs.title: 1. ​格子​與​鑰匙​遮罩​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(RC2^K)

​空間​： O(RC2^K)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Cell and key-mask BFS
    Time: O(R*C*2^K)
    Space: O(R*C*2^K)
    """

    def shortestPathAllKeys(self, grid: list[str]) -> int:
        from collections import deque

        rows, columns = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        goal = 0
        start = None
        for r, row in enumerate(grid):
            for c, char in enumerate(row):
                if char == "@":
                    start = (r, c)
                elif "a" <= char <= "z":
                    goal |= 1 << (ord(char) - ord("a"))
        queue = deque([(*start, 0, 0)])
        seen = {(*start, 0)}
        while queue:
            r, c, mask, steps = queue.popleft()
            if mask == goal:
                return steps
            for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if not (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns) or grid[nr][nc] == "#":
                    continue
                char = grid[nr][nc]
                if "A" <= char <= "Z" and not mask & (1 << (ord(char) - ord("A"))):
                    continue
                following = mask | (1 << (ord(char) - ord("a"))) if "a" <= char <= "z" else mask
                if (nr, nc, following) not in seen:
                    seen.add((nr, nc, following))
                    queue.append((nr, nc, following, steps + 1))
        return -1

docs.title: 2. ​新​收集​鑰匙​間​的​ Dijkstra
docs.text:
​時間​： O(K2^KRC + K^22^Klog(K2^K+1))

​空間​： O(RC+K^22^K)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dijkstra between newly collected keys
    Time: O(K*2^K*R*C + K^2*2^K*log(K*2^K+1))
    Space: O(R*C+K^2*2^K)
    """

    def shortestPathAllKeys(self, grid: list[str]) -> int:
        from collections import deque
        from heapq import heappop, heappush

        rows, columns = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        start = next((r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(columns) if grid[r][c] == "@")
        goal = 0
        for row in grid:
            for char in row:
                if "a" <= char <= "z":
                    goal |= 1 << (ord(char) - ord("a"))
        best = {(*start, 0): 0}
        heap = [(0, *start, 0)]
        while heap:
            cost, r, c, mask = heappop(heap)
            if cost != best[(r, c, mask)]:
                continue
            if mask == goal:
                return cost
            queue, seen = deque([(r, c, 0)]), {(r, c)}
            while queue:
                row, column, steps = queue.popleft()
                for nr, nc in (
                    (row - 1, column),
                    (row + 1, column),
                    (row, column - 1),
                    (row, column + 1),
                ):
                    if (
                        not (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns)
                        or (nr, nc) in seen
                        or grid[nr][nc] == "#"
                    ):
                        continue
                    char = grid[nr][nc]
                    if "A" <= char <= "Z" and not mask & (1 << (ord(char) - ord("A"))):
                        continue
                    seen.add((nr, nc))
                    bit = 1 << (ord(char) - ord("a")) if "a" <= char <= "z" else 0
                    if bit and not mask & bit:
                        state, candidate = (nr, nc, mask | bit), cost + steps + 1
                        if candidate < best.get(state, float("inf")):
                            best[state] = candidate
                            heappush(heap, (candidate, *state))
                    else:
                        queue.append((nr, nc, steps + 1))
        return -1

docs.title: 二分​搜尋​可行​速度
docs.text: ​在​ 1 ​到​最大​香蕉​堆之間​二分​答案​。​各堆​向上​取整​的​小​時數​之​和​ <=h，​就算​可行​；​可行​保留​較​低​半段​，​否則​保留​較​高​半段​。

docs.text: ​依遞​增順序​測試​速度​，​回傳​第一​個​符合​時間​預算​的​值​。​它​直接​顯示​二分​搜尋的​單調​條件​，​但​堆​大小​很大​時​，​這個​教學​基準​可能​逾時​。

docs.title: 二分​搜尋​可行​速度
docs.text: ​提高​速度​不會​增加​小時數​，​因此​可行性​至多​從​ False ​轉為​ True ​一次​。​區間​始終​包含​首個​可行​速度​；max(piles) ​保證​可行​，​因為​每堆​可​在​一小​時內​吃​完​。

docs.title: 列舉候​選​速度
docs.text: ​每個候​選所​需時間​都​是​各堆​向上​取整​的​商​之​和​。​回傳前​已​測過​全部​較​小​速度​，​因此​第一​個​可​行者​必定​最小​。

​二分​搜尋​：O(n log M) ​時間​、O(1) ​輔助​空間​，M ​為​最大​堆​大小​。​逐速​列舉​：O(nM) ​時間​、O(1) ​空間​，​大堆​值​可能​逾時​。

​輸入​不變​。​用​ (pile+speed-1)//speed ​取得​精確​整數​上界​。​直接​把​全部​香蕉​平均分配​到​小時​，​會​忽略​同一​小時​不能​跨堆​的​限制​。

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log M)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search feasible speed
    Time: O(n log M)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def minEatingSpeed(self, piles: list[int], h: int) -> int:
        left, right = 1, max(piles)
        while left < right:
            speed = (left + right) // 2
            hours = sum((pile + speed - 1) // speed for pile in piles)
            if hours <= h:
                right = speed
            else:
                left = speed + 1
        return left

docs.title: 2. ​列舉候​選​速度
docs.text:
​時間​： O(nM)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate candidate speeds
    Time: O(nM)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def minEatingSpeed(self, piles: list[int], h: int) -> int:
        for speed in range(1, max(piles) + 1):
            if sum((pile + speed - 1) // speed for pile in piles) <= h:
                return speed
        raise ValueError("The problem guarantees enough hours")

docs.title: 1. ​稠密​截斷​獲利​背包
docs.text:
​時間​： O(CnP)

​空間​： O(n*P)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dense capped-profit knapsack
    Time: O(C*n*P)
    Space: O(n*P)
    """

    def profitableSchemes(self, n: int, minProfit: int, group: list[int], profit: list[int]) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        dp = [[0] * (minProfit + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
        dp[0][0] = 1
        for people, gain in zip(group, profit, strict=True):
            for used in range(n - people, -1, -1):
                for earned in range(minProfit, -1, -1):
                    following = min(minProfit, earned + gain)
                    dp[used + people][following] = (
                        dp[used + people][following] + dp[used][earned]
                    ) % modulus
        return sum(row[minProfit] for row in dp) % modulus

docs.title: 2. ​稀疏​複​製​狀​態​前​緣
docs.text:
​時間​： O(CnP)，​期望值​

​空間​： O(n*P)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sparse copied state frontier
    Time: O(C*n*P) expected
    Space: O(n*P)
    """

    def profitableSchemes(self, n: int, minProfit: int, group: list[int], profit: list[int]) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        counts = {(0, 0): 1}
        for people, gain in zip(group, profit, strict=True):
            following = counts.copy()
            for (used, earned), count in counts.items():
                if used + people <= n:
                    state = (used + people, min(minProfit, earned + gain))
                    following[state] = (following.get(state, 0) + count) % modulus
            counts = following
        return sum(count for (_, earned), count in counts.items() if earned == minProfit) % modulus

docs.title: 1. ​排序​後​配對​兩端
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort and pair extremes
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def numRescueBoats(self, people: list[int], limit: int) -> int:
        weights = sorted(people)
        left, right, boats = 0, len(weights) - 1, 0
        while left <= right:
            if left < right and weights[left] + weights[right] <= limit:
                left += 1
            right -= 1
            boats += 1
        return boats

docs.title: 2. ​依體​重次​數配​對
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+limit)

​空間​： O(limit)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Weight-frequency pairing
    Time: O(n+limit)
    Space: O(limit)
    """

    def numRescueBoats(self, people: list[int], limit: int) -> int:
        counts = [0] * (limit + 1)
        for weight in people:
            counts[weight] += 1
        light, heavy, remaining, boats = 1, limit, len(people), 0
        while remaining:
            while counts[heavy] == 0:
                heavy -= 1
            counts[heavy] -= 1
            remaining -= 1
            boats += 1
            if not remaining:
                break
            while counts[light] == 0:
                light += 1
            if light + heavy <= limit:
                counts[light] -= 1
                remaining -= 1
        return boats

docs.title: 1. ​擴張​步長​模擬
docs.text:
​時間​： O(R^2), R=max(rows,cols)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​ ​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Expanding step simulation
    Time: O(R squared), R=max(rows,cols)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def spiralMatrixIII(self, rows: int, cols: int, rStart: int, cStart: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        answer = [[rStart, cStart]]
        row, col, length, direction = rStart, cStart, 1, 0
        directions = ((0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0))
        while len(answer) < rows * cols:
            for _ in range(2):
                dr, dc = directions[direction % 4]
                for _ in range(length):
                    row, col = row + dr, col + dc
                    if 0 <= row < rows and 0 <= col < cols:
                        answer.append([row, col])
                direction += 1
            length += 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​依​正方形​環​螺旋​排名​排序
docs.text:

​空間​： O(rows*cols)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sort by square-ring spiral rank
    Time: O(rows*cols log(rows*cols))
    Space: O(rows*cols)
    """

    def spiralMatrixIII(self, rows: int, cols: int, rStart: int, cStart: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        def rank(cell):
            dr, dc = cell[0] - rStart, cell[1] - cStart
            ring = max(abs(dr), abs(dc))
            if ring == 0:
                return 0
            if dc == ring and dr > -ring:
                offset = dr + ring - 1
            elif dr == ring:
                offset = 2 * ring + ring - 1 - dc
            elif dc == -ring:
                offset = 4 * ring + ring - 1 - dr
            else:
                offset = 6 * ring + dc + ring - 1
            return (2 * ring - 1) ** 2 + offset

        cells = [[row, col] for row in range(rows) for col in range(cols)]
        cells.sort(key=rank)
        return cells

​時間​： O(V+E)

​空間​： O(V+E)

class Solution:
    """Approach: BFS two-coloring
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def possibleBipartition(self, n: int, dislikes: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
        from collections import deque

        graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for a, b in dislikes:
            graph[a - 1].append(b - 1)
            graph[b - 1].append(a - 1)
        color = [-1] * n
        for start in range(n):
            if color[start] >= 0:
                continue
            color[start] = 0
            queue = deque([start])
            while queue:
                node = queue.popleft()
                for other in graph[node]:
                    if color[other] == color[node]:
                        return False
                    if color[other] < 0:
                        color[other] = color[node] ^ 1
                        queue.append(other)
        return True

docs.title: 2. ​聯集​相反​鄰居群
docs.text:
​時間​： O((V+E)*alpha(V))

​空間​： O(V+E)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Union opposite-neighbor groups
    Time: O((V+E)*alpha(V))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def possibleBipartition(self, n: int, dislikes: list[list[int]]) -> bool:
        graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for a, b in dislikes:
            graph[a - 1].append(b - 1)
            graph[b - 1].append(a - 1)
        parent, size = list(range(n)), [1] * n

        def find(node):
            while node != parent[node]:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        for node, others in enumerate(graph):
            if not others:
                continue
            for other in others:
                if find(node) == find(other):
                    return False
                a, b = find(others[0]), find(other)
                if a != b:
                    if size[a] < size[b]:
                        a, b = b, a
                    parent[b] = a
                    size[a] += size[b]
        return True

​物件​擁有​狀態​，pop ​只會​在​非空時​呼叫​。n ​是​存活​ push ​數量​的​歷史​峰值​。​可​移除​零次​數值​與​空頻​率桶​。​堆積​保存​每次​出現​的​中​繼資料​，​不​符合​固定​時間​操作​。

docs.text:
​時間​： ​每次​操作​期望​ O(1)

​空間​： O(n)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class FreqStack:
    """Approach: Frequency-level stacks
    Time: O(1) expected per operation
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.counts = {}
        self.levels = {}
        self.maximum = 0

    def push(self, val: int) -> None:
        frequency = self.counts.get(val, 0) + 1
        self.counts[val] = frequency
        self.levels.setdefault(frequency, []).append(val)
        self.maximum = max(self.maximum, frequency)

    def pop(self) -> int:
        value = self.levels[self.maximum].pop()
        self.counts[value] -= 1
        if self.counts[value] == 0:
            del self.counts[value]
        if not self.levels[self.maximum]:
            del self.levels[self.maximum]
            self.maximum -= 1
        return value

docs.title: 2. ​出現​項​優先​堆積
docs.text:
​時間​： ​每次​操作​ O(log(n+1))

​空間​： O(n)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class FreqStack:
    """Approach: Occurrence-priority heap
    Time: O(log(n+1)) per operation
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.counts = {}
        self.heap = []
        self.clock = 0

    def push(self, val: int) -> None:
        frequency = self.counts.get(val, 0) + 1
        self.counts[val] = frequency
        heappush(self.heap, (-frequency, -self.clock, val))
        self.clock += 1

    def pop(self) -> int:
        _, _, value = heappop(self.heap)
        self.counts[value] -= 1
        if self.counts[value] == 0:
            del self.counts[value]
        return value

class StockSpanner:
    """Approach: Monotonic price-span stack
    Time: O(1) amortized per next
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = []

    def next(self, price: int) -> int:
        span = 1
        while self.stack and self.stack[-1][0] <= price:
            span += self.stack.pop()[1]
        self.stack.append((price, span))
        return span

docs.title: 2. ​反轉​價格​座標​的​ Fenwick ​最大值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(log P) ​每次​ next

​空間​： O(P)

class StockSpanner:
    """Approach: Fenwick maximum over reversed prices
    Time: O(log P) per next
    Space: O(P)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.latest = [0] * 100001
        self.day = 0

    def next(self, price: int) -> int:
        self.day += 1
        coordinate = 100001 - price
        index, blocker = coordinate - 1, 0
        while index:
            blocker = max(blocker, self.latest[index])
            index -= index & -index
        index = coordinate
        while index < len(self.latest):
            self.latest[index] = max(self.latest[index], self.day)
            index += index & -index
        return self.day - blocker

        counts = {}

        for right, value in enumerate(fruits):
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
            while len(counts) > 2:
                outgoing = fruits[left]
                counts[outgoing] -= 1
                if counts[outgoing] == 0:
                    del counts[outgoing]
                left += 1
            best = max(best, right - left + 1)
        return best

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Last-run state compression
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def totalFruit(self, fruits: list[int]) -> int:
        latest = other = None
        run = current = best = 0
        for value in fruits:
            current = current + 1 if value in (latest, other) else run + 1
            if value == latest:
                run += 1
            else:
                other, latest = latest, value
                run = 1
            best = max(best, current)
        return best

docs.title: 1. ​跳躍後​格子​的​ BFS
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: BFS over post-jump squares
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def snakesAndLadders(self, board: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from collections import deque

        n = len(board)

        def destination(square):
            row, column = divmod(square - 1, n)
            value = board[n - row - 1][column if row % 2 == 0 else n - column - 1]
            return square if value == -1 else value

        queue, seen = deque([(1, 0)]), {1}
        while queue:
            square, rolls = queue.popleft()
            if square == n * n:
                return rolls
            for landing in range(square + 1, min(square + 6, n * n) + 1):
                following = destination(landing)
                if following not in seen:
                    seen.add(following)
                    queue.append((following, rolls + 1))
        return -1

docs.title: 2. ​固定​移動邊​的​反覆​鬆​弛
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^4)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Repeated relaxation of fixed move edges
    Time: O(n^4)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def snakesAndLadders(self, board: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(board)
        edges = []
        for start in range(1, n * n):
            for square in range(start + 1, min(start + 6, n * n) + 1):
                row, column = divmod(square - 1, n)
                value = board[n - row - 1][column if row % 2 == 0 else n - column - 1]
                edges.append((start, square if value == -1 else value))
        distance = [float("inf")] * (n * n + 1)
        distance[1] = 0
        for _ in range(n * n - 1):
            changed = False
            for a, b in edges:
                if distance[a] + 1 < distance[b]:
                    distance[b] = distance[a] + 1
                    changed = True
            if not changed:
                break
        return -1 if distance[-1] == float("inf") else distance[-1]

​空間​： O(V)

from bisect import bisect_right


class TopVotedCandidate:
    """Approach: Precomputed leader timeline
    Time: O(V) constructor; O(log(V+1)) query
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def __init__(self, persons: list[int], times: list[int]):
        self.times = times.copy()
        self.leaders = []
        counts = {}
        leader = persons[0]
        for person in persons:
            counts[person] = counts.get(person, 0) + 1
            if counts[person] >= counts.get(leader, 0):
                leader = person
            self.leaders.append(leader)

    def q(self, t: int) -> int:
        return self.leaders[bisect_right(self.times, t) - 1]

docs.title: 2. ​各候​選人​投票​歷史
docs.text:
​時間​： ​建構​ O(V)；​查詢​ O(U log(V+1))，​可能​逾時​

​空間​： O(V)

from bisect import bisect_right


class TopVotedCandidate:
    """Approach: Per-candidate vote histories
    Time: O(V) constructor; O(U log(V+1)) query; may time out
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def __init__(self, persons: list[int], times: list[int]):
        self.histories = {}
        for person, time in zip(persons, times, strict=True):
            self.histories.setdefault(person, []).append(time)

    def q(self, t: int) -> int:
        winner = None
        best = (-1, -1)
        for person, history in self.histories.items():
            count = bisect_right(history, t)
            if count and (count, history[count - 1]) > best:
                best = (count, history[count - 1])
                winner = person
        return winner

class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix-sum frequency map
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def numSubarraysWithSum(self, nums: list[int], goal: int) -> int:
        counts = {0: 1}
        prefix = answer = 0
        for value in nums:
            prefix += value
            answer += counts.get(prefix - goal, 0)
            counts[prefix] = counts.get(prefix, 0) + 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​兩個​有界​總和視​窗之差
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Difference of bounded-sum windows
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def numSubarraysWithSum(self, nums: list[int], goal: int) -> int:
        def at_most(bound):
            if bound < 0:
                return 0
            left = total = answer = 0
            for right, value in enumerate(nums):
                total += value
                while total > bound:
                    total -= nums[left]
                    left += 1
                answer += right - left + 1
            return answer

        return at_most(goal) - at_most(goal - 1)

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward rolling row minima
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minFallingPathSum(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        previous = matrix[0].copy()
        for row in matrix[1:]:
            current = []
            for column, value in enumerate(row):
                best = previous[column]
                if column:
                    best = min(best, previous[column - 1])
                if column + 1 < len(row):
                    best = min(best, previous[column + 1])
                current.append(value + best)
            previous = current
        return min(previous)

    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def minFallingPathSum(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from functools import cache

        @cache
        def suffix(row, column):
            if column < 0 or column >= len(matrix):
                return float("inf")
            if row == len(matrix) - 1:
                return matrix[row][column]
            return matrix[row][column] + min(
                suffix(row + 1, column + change) for change in (-1, 0, 1)
            )

        return min(suffix(0, column) for column in range(len(matrix)))

docs.text:
​時間​： O(R*C)

​空間​： O(R*C)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Island discovery and multi-source BFS
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def shortestBridge(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        start = next((r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c])
        seen = {start}
        stack = [start]
        while stack:
            row, col = stack.pop()
            for r, c in ((row + 1, col), (row - 1, col), (row, col + 1), (row, col - 1)):
                if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and grid[r][c] and (r, c) not in seen:
                    seen.add((r, c))
                    stack.append((r, c))
        queue = deque((r, c, 0) for r, c in seen)
        while queue:
            row, col, distance = queue.popleft()
            for r, c in ((row + 1, col), (row - 1, col), (row, col + 1), (row, col - 1)):
                if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and (r, c) not in seen:
                    if grid[r][c]:
                        return distance
                    seen.add((r, c))
                    queue.append((r, c, distance + 1))
        raise AssertionError("The input contains exactly two islands")

docs.title: 2. ​全部​島格配​對​曼哈頓​距離
docs.text:
​時間​： O(RC+AB)；​可能​逾時​

​空間​： O(R*C)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: All-pairs island Manhattan distance
    Time: O(R*C+A*B); may time out
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def shortestBridge(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        seen, islands = set(), []
        for row in range(rows):
            for col in range(cols):
                if not grid[row][col] or (row, col) in seen:
                    continue
                island = []
                stack = [(row, col)]
                seen.add((row, col))
                while stack:
                    r, c = stack.pop()
                    island.append((r, c))
                    for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c), (r - 1, c), (r, c + 1), (r, c - 1)):
                        if (
                            0 <= nr < rows
                            and 0 <= nc < cols
                            and grid[nr][nc]
                            and (nr, nc) not in seen
                        ):
                            seen.add((nr, nc))
                            stack.append((nr, nc))
                islands.append(island)
        return min(abs(a - c) + abs(b - d) - 1 for a, b in islands[0] for c, d in islands[1])

from bisect import bisect_right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted buy-low sell-high pointers
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def bagOfTokensScore(self, tokens: list[int], power: int) -> int:
        values = sorted(tokens)
        left, right = 0, len(values) - 1
        score = best = 0
        while left <= right:
            if power >= values[left]:
                power -= values[left]
                left += 1
                score += 1
                best = max(best, score)
            elif score and left < right:
                power += values[right]
                right -= 1
                score -= 1
            else:
                break
        return best

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

from bisect import bisect_right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sale-count enumeration with prefix budgets
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def bagOfTokensScore(self, tokens: list[int], power: int) -> int:
        values = sorted(tokens)
        if not values or power < values[0]:
            return 0
        prefix = [0]
        for value in values:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        best = sold_power = 0
        for sold in range((len(values) - 1) // 2 + 1):
            if sold:
                sold_power += values[-sold]
            bought = bisect_right(prefix, power + sold_power, 0, len(values) - sold + 1) - 1
            best = max(best, bought - sold)
        return best
