docs.title: 1. ​隨需​計算​距離​的​稠密​ Prim
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dense Prim with on-demand distances
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minCostConnectPoints(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(points)
        distance, used = [float("inf")] * n, [False] * n
        distance[0] = 0
        total = 0
        for _ in range(n):
            node = min((i for i in range(n) if not used[i]), key=lambda i: distance[i])
            total += distance[node]
            used[node] = True
            x, y = points[node]
            for other, (ox, oy) in enumerate(points):
                if not used[other]:
                    distance[other] = min(distance[other], abs(x - ox) + abs(y - oy))
        return total

docs.title: 2. ​全部​邊的​ Kruskal
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n^2 log n)

​空間​： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: All-edge Kruskal
    Time: O(n^2 log n)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def minCostConnectPoints(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        edges = sorted(
            (abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1]), i, j)
            for i, a in enumerate(points)
            for j, b in enumerate(points)
            if i < j
        )
        parent, size = list(range(len(points))), [1] * len(points)

        def find(node):
            while parent[node] != node:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        total, remaining = 0, len(points) - 1
        for cost, a, b in edges:
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra == rb:
                continue
            if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                ra, rb = rb, ra
            parent[rb] = ra
            size[ra] += size[rb]
            total += cost
            remaining -= 1
            if remaining == 0:
                break
        return total

docs.title: 1. ​各前​綴​餘數​的​最新​索引
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)，​期望值​

​空間​： O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left


class Solution:
    """Approach: Latest index per prefix remainder
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minSubarray(self, nums: list[int], p: int) -> int:
        required = sum(nums) % p
        if required == 0:
            return 0
        latest = {0: -1}
        remainder = 0
        best = len(nums)
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            remainder = (remainder + value) % p
            wanted = (remainder - required) % p
            if wanted in latest:
                best = min(best, i - latest[wanted])
            latest[remainder] = i
        return best if best < len(nums) else -1

docs.title: 2. ​分組​前綴​位置​與​前​驅​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left


class Solution:
    """Approach: Batch prefix positions and predecessor search
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minSubarray(self, nums: list[int], p: int) -> int:
        required = sum(nums) % p
        if required == 0:
            return 0
        prefix = [0]
        positions = {0: [0]}
        for i, value in enumerate(nums, 1):
            prefix.append((prefix[-1] + value) % p)
            positions.setdefault(prefix[-1], []).append(i)
        best = len(nums)
        for end in range(1, len(prefix)):
            candidates = positions.get((prefix[end] - required) % p, [])
            index = bisect_left(candidates, end) - 1
            if index >= 0:
                best = min(best, end - candidates[index])
        return best if best < len(nums) else -1

docs.title: 1. ​最小化​最大值​的​ Dijkstra
docs.text:
​時間​： O(RC log(RC))

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Minimax Dijkstra
    Time: O(R*C log(R*C))
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def minimumEffortPath(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from heapq import heappop, heappush

        rows, columns = len(heights), len(heights[0])
        best = {(0, 0): 0}
        heap = [(0, 0, 0)]
        while heap:
            effort, r, c = heappop(heap)
            if best[(r, c)] != effort:
                continue
            if (r, c) == (rows - 1, columns - 1):
                return effort
            for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns:
                    candidate = max(effort, abs(heights[r][c] - heights[nr][nc]))
                    if candidate < best.get((nr, nc), float("inf")):
                        best[(nr, nc)] = candidate
                        heappush(heap, (candidate, nr, nc))
        return 0

docs.title: 2. ​依​排序​邊檢查​門檻連​通性
docs.text:
​時間​： O(RC log(RC))

​空間​： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Threshold connectivity by sorted edges
    Time: O(R*C log(R*C))
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def minimumEffortPath(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, columns = len(heights), len(heights[0])
        parent, size = list(range(rows * columns)), [1] * (rows * columns)
        edges = []
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(columns):
                for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c), (r, c + 1)):
                    if nr < rows and nc < columns:
                        edges.append(
                            (
                                abs(heights[r][c] - heights[nr][nc]),
                                r * columns + c,
                                nr * columns + nc,
                            )
                        )

        def find(node):
            while parent[node] != node:
                parent[node] = parent[parent[node]]
                node = parent[node]
            return node

        for cost, a, b in sorted(edges):
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra != rb:
                if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                    ra, rb = rb, ra
                parent[rb] = ra
                size[ra] += size[rb]
            if find(0) == find(rows * columns - 1):
                return cost
        return 0

docs.title: 1. ​保留​最長​正數​和​視窗
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Longest retained positive-sum window
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def minOperations(self, nums: list[int], x: int) -> int:
        target = sum(nums) - x
        if target < 0:
            return -1
        left = total = 0
        longest = 0 if target == 0 else -1
        for right, value in enumerate(nums):
            total += value
            while total > target:
                total -= nums[left]
                left += 1
            if total == target:
                longest = max(longest, right - left + 1)
        return -1 if longest < 0 else len(nums) - longest

docs.title: 2. ​移除​前綴​表與後綴​列舉
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)，​期望值​

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Removed-prefix map and suffix enumeration
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def minOperations(self, nums: list[int], x: int) -> int:
        prefix = {0: 0}
        total = 0
        for count, value in enumerate(nums, 1):
            total += value
            prefix[total] = count
        best = len(nums) + 1
        suffix = 0
        for right_count in range(len(nums) + 1):
            left_count = prefix.get(x - suffix)
            if left_count is not None and left_count + right_count <= len(nums):
                best = min(best, left_count + right_count)
            if right_count < len(nums):
                suffix += nums[len(nums) - 1 - right_count]
        return -1 if best > len(nums) else best

docs.title: 1. ​累積​合格​三元​組​最大值
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Accumulate eligible maxima
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def mergeTriplets(self, triplets: list[list[int]], target: list[int]) -> bool:
        best = [0, 0, 0]
        for values in triplets:
            if all(value <= bound for value, bound in zip(values, target, strict=True)):
                for i in range(3):
                    best[i] = max(best[i], values[i])
        return best == target

docs.title: 2. ​座​標見​證位​元​遮罩
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Coordinate witness bit mask
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def mergeTriplets(self, triplets: list[list[int]], target: list[int]) -> bool:
        witnessed = 0
        for values in triplets:
            if any(value > target[i] for i, value in enumerate(values)):
                continue
            for i, value in enumerate(values):
                if value == target[i]:
                    witnessed |= 1 << i
        return witnessed == 7

​時間​： O(10n)

​空間​： O(2^10)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Online parity-mask neighbors
    Time: O(10n)
    Space: O(2^10)
    """

    def wonderfulSubstrings(self, word: str) -> int:
        counts = [0] * 1024
        counts[0] = 1
        mask = answer = 0
        for char in word:
            mask ^= 1 << (ord(char) - 97)
            answer += counts[mask]
            for bit in range(10):
                answer += counts[mask ^ (1 << bit)]
            counts[mask] += 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​批次​遮罩​配對​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+10*2^10)

​空間​： O(2^10)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Batch mask-pair counting
    Time: O(n+10*2^10)
    Space: O(2^10)
    """

    def wonderfulSubstrings(self, word: str) -> int:
        counts = [0] * 1024
        counts[0] = 1
        mask = 0
        for char in word:
            mask ^= 1 << (ord(char) - 97)
            counts[mask] += 1
        answer = sum(count * (count - 1) // 2 for count in counts)
        for mask, count in enumerate(counts):
            for bit in range(10):
                neighbor = mask ^ (1 << bit)
                if mask < neighbor:
                    answer += count * counts[neighbor]
        return answer

docs.title: 1. Dijkstra ​距離​與​同距​路線​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O((V+E) log(V+1))

​空間​： O(V+E)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Dijkstra distances and tied-route counts
    Time: O((V+E) log(V+1))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def countPaths(self, n: int, roads: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for left, right, weight in roads:
            adjacency[left].append((right, weight))
            adjacency[right].append((left, weight))
        distances = [float("inf")] * n
        counts = [0] * n
        distances[0], counts[0] = 0, 1
        heap = [(0, 0)]
        while heap:
            distance, node = heappop(heap)
            if distance != distances[node]:
                continue
            for neighbor, weight in adjacency[node]:
                candidate = distance + weight
                if candidate < distances[neighbor]:
                    distances[neighbor] = candidate
                    counts[neighbor] = counts[node]
                    heappush(heap, (candidate, neighbor))
                elif candidate == distances[neighbor]:
                    counts[neighbor] = (counts[neighbor] + counts[node]) % modulus
        return counts[-1]

docs.title: 2. Floyd ​距離​與​最​短路​徑​ DAG DP
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V^3+V log(V+1)+E)

​空間​： O(V^2+E)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Floyd distances and shortest-path DAG DP
    Time: O(V^3+V log(V+1)+E)
    Space: O(V^2+E)
    """

    def countPaths(self, n: int, roads: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        modulus = 1_000_000_007
        distances = [[float("inf")] * n for _ in range(n)]
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for node in range(n):
            distances[node][node] = 0
        for left, right, weight in roads:
            distances[left][right] = distances[right][left] = weight
            adjacency[left].append((right, weight))
            adjacency[right].append((left, weight))
        for middle in range(n):
            for left in range(n):
                prefix = distances[left][middle]
                for right in range(n):
                    candidate = prefix + distances[middle][right]
                    if candidate < distances[left][right]:
                        distances[left][right] = candidate
        best = distances[0]
        counts = [0] * n
        counts[0] = 1
        for node in sorted(range(n), key=best.__getitem__):
            if best[node] == float("inf"):
                break
            for neighbor, weight in adjacency[node]:
                if best[node] + weight == best[neighbor]:
                    counts[neighbor] = (counts[neighbor] + counts[node]) % modulus
        return counts[-1]

docs.title: 1. ​先求​兩個​跳數​距離​再​模擬​號誌
docs.text:
​時間​： O(V+E)

​空間​： O(V+E)

from collections import deque
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Two hop distances then signal simulation
    Time: O(V+E)
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def secondMinimum(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]], time: int, change: int) -> int:
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
        for left, right in edges:
            adjacency[left].append(right)
            adjacency[right].append(left)
        distances = [[float("inf")] * 2 for _ in range(n + 1)]
        distances[1][0] = 0
        queue = deque([(1, 0)])
        while queue:
            node, hops = queue.popleft()
            if node == n and hops == distances[n][1]:
                arrival = 0
                for _ in range(hops):
                    phase = arrival // change
                    if phase % 2:
                        arrival = (phase + 1) * change
                    arrival += time
                return arrival
            for neighbor in adjacency[node]:
                candidate = hops + 1
                if candidate < distances[neighbor][0]:
                    distances[neighbor][1] = distances[neighbor][0]
                    distances[neighbor][0] = candidate
                    queue.append((neighbor, candidate))
                elif distances[neighbor][0] < candidate < distances[neighbor][1]:
                    distances[neighbor][1] = candidate
                    queue.append((neighbor, candidate))
        raise AssertionError("Connected undirected graphs admit a second walk")

docs.title: 2. ​雙抵​達標​籤​的​時間​相依​ Dijkstra
docs.text:
​時間​： O((V+E) log(V+1))

​空間​： O(V+E)

from collections import deque
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Two-arrival time-dependent Dijkstra
    Time: O((V+E) log(V+1))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def secondMinimum(self, n: int, edges: list[list[int]], time: int, change: int) -> int:
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
        for left, right in edges:
            adjacency[left].append(right)
            adjacency[right].append(left)
        arrivals = [[float("inf")] * 2 for _ in range(n + 1)]
        arrivals[1][0] = 0
        heap = [(0, 1)]
        while heap:
            arrival, node = heappop(heap)
            if arrival > arrivals[node][1]:
                continue
            if node == n and arrival == arrivals[n][1]:
                return arrival
            phase = arrival // change
            departure = (phase + 1) * change if phase % 2 else arrival
            candidate = departure + time
            for neighbor in adjacency[node]:
                if candidate < arrivals[neighbor][0]:
                    arrivals[neighbor][1] = arrivals[neighbor][0]
                    arrivals[neighbor][0] = candidate
                    heappush(heap, (candidate, neighbor))
                elif arrivals[neighbor][0] < candidate < arrivals[neighbor][1]:
                    arrivals[neighbor][1] = candidate
                    heappush(heap, (candidate, neighbor))
        raise AssertionError("Connected undirected graphs admit a second walk")

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: One rolling window sum
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def getAverages(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        width = 2 * k + 1
        answer = [-1] * len(nums)
        if width > len(nums):
            return answer
        total = sum(nums[i] for i in range(width))
        answer[k] = total // width
        for right in range(width, len(nums)):
            total += nums[right] - nums[right - width]
            answer[right - k] = total // width
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​逐​中心​前綴​和
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(n) ​輔助​空間​，​另加​輸出​

class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix sums per center
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def getAverages(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        answer = [-1] * len(nums)
        for center in range(k, len(nums) - k):
            answer[center] = (prefix[center + k + 1] - prefix[center - k]) // (2 * k + 1)
        return answer

class Solution:
    """Approach: Streaming previous nonempty count
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def numberOfBeams(self, bank: list[str]) -> int:
        previous = answer = 0
        for row in bank:
            count = row.count("1")
            if count:
                answer += previous * count
                previous = count
        return answer

class Solution:
    """Approach: Filtered device-count sequence
    Time: O(mn)
    Space: O(m)

    def numberOfBeams(self, bank: list[str]) -> int:
        counts = [count for row in bank if (count := row.count("1"))]
        return sum(counts[i - 1] * counts[i] for i in range(1, len(counts)))

​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Shrinking score window
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        left = total = answer = 0
        for right, value in enumerate(nums):
            total += value
            while left <= right and total * (right - left + 1) >= k:
                total -= nums[left]
                left += 1
            answer += right - left + 1
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​前綴​和​與​起點​二分​搜尋
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Prefix sums and binary-searched starts
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        answer = 0
        for end in range(1, len(prefix)):
            low, high = 0, end
            while low < high:
                middle = (low + high) // 2
                if (prefix[end] - prefix[middle]) * (end - middle) < k:
                    high = middle
                else:
                    low = middle + 1
            answer += end - low
        return answer

docs.title: 隱含​前緣​與​加回​最小​堆積
docs.text: ​前緣​從​一開始​，​另用​堆積​及​成員​集合​保存​較小加​回值​。​優先彈​堆積​，​否則​消耗​前緣​。addBack ​只​插入​前緣​以下​且​尚未​排隊​的​值​。

docs.text: ​只​保存​目前​已​移除​的​整數​。​彈出​時​從​一開始​掃​，​找到​首個​不​在​移除​集合​的​值​；addBack ​從​移除​集合​丟棄​其​參數​。

docs.title: 隱含​前緣​與​加回​最小​堆積
docs.text: ​所有​不小​於​前緣​的​值​仍​存在​，​較​小​的​現存​值則​恰為​加回​堆積​。​因此​其​最小值​，​或​堆積​空時​的​前緣​，​就是​全域​最小​現存值​。

docs.title: 有限​移除​集合​的​補集
docs.text: ​所​表示​的​無限​集合​，​正是​正整​數中​有限​移除​集合​的​補集​。​第一​個​不屬​移除​集合​的​正​整數​，​就​恰是​最小​現存數​。

docs.title: 範例​推演
docs.text: ​先​ pop 1、​再​ pop 2，​加​回​ 1 ​後​再​ pop ​得​ 1；​接著​ pop ​得​ 3，​因為​ 2 ​仍​被​移除​。

​物件​只擁​有限​狀態​，​兩法​都​不​假造​固定​數值​上界​。a、r ​分別​為​已​存加​回​集合​、​移除​集合​的​大小​歷史​峰值​，​因​ Python ​集合​刪除​後​可能​保留​容量​。​重​複​ addBack ​具冪​等​性​；​掃描​基準​以​簡單​表示​換取​重​複​前綴​掃描​。

docs.title: 1. ​隱含​前緣​與​加回​最小​堆積
docs.text:
​時間​： pop/addBack ​期望​攤銷​ O(log(a+1))；​前緣​ pop ​為​ O(1)

​空間​： O(a)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class SmallestInfiniteSet:
    """Approach: Implicit frontier and restored min-heap
    Time: O(log(a+1)) expected amortized pop/addBack; O(1) frontier pop
    Space: O(a)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.frontier = 1
        self.restored = []
        self.queued = set()

    def popSmallest(self) -> int:
        if self.restored:
            value = heappop(self.restored)
            self.queued.remove(value)
            return value
        value = self.frontier
        self.frontier += 1
        return value

    def addBack(self, num: int) -> None:
        if num < self.frontier and num not in self.queued:
            self.queued.add(num)
            heappush(self.restored, num)

docs.title: 2. ​有限​移除​集合​的​補集
docs.text:
​時間​： popSmallest ​期望​ O(r+1)；addBack ​期望​ O(1)

​空間​： O(r)

from heapq import heappop, heappush


class SmallestInfiniteSet:
    """Approach: Finite removed-set complement
    Time: O(r+1) expected popSmallest; O(1) expected addBack
    Space: O(r)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.removed = set()

    def popSmallest(self) -> int:
        candidate = 1
        while candidate in self.removed:
            candidate += 1
        self.removed.add(candidate)
        return candidate

    def addBack(self, num: int) -> None:
        self.removed.discard(num)

docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+M log(M+1)+M log(n+1))

​空間​： O(M+n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Free-room and finish-time heaps
    Time: O(n+M log(M+1)+M log(n+1))
    Space: O(M+n)
    """

    def mostBooked(self, n: int, meetings: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        available = list(range(n))
        heapify(available)
        busy = []
        counts = [0] * n
        for start, end in sorted(meetings):
            while busy and busy[0][0] <= start:
                _, room = heappop(busy)
                heappush(available, room)
            if available:
                room = heappop(available)
                finish = end
            else:
                release, room = heappop(busy)
                finish = release + end - start
            counts[room] += 1
            heappush(busy, (finish, room))
        return counts.index(max(counts))

docs.title: 2. ​房間​可用​時間​線性​掃描
docs.text:
​時間​： O(M log(M+1)+M*n)

​空間​： O(M+n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Linear room-availability scan
    Time: O(M log(M+1)+M*n)
    Space: O(M+n)
    """

    def mostBooked(self, n: int, meetings: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        free_at = [0] * n
        counts = [0] * n
        for start, end in sorted(meetings):
            room = next((index for index in range(n) if free_at[index] <= start), None)
            if room is None:
                room = min(range(n), key=lambda index: (free_at[index], index))
            free_at[room] = max(start, free_at[room]) + end - start
            counts[room] += 1
        return counts.index(max(counts))

docs.title: 最近​邊界值​與​非法​位置
docs.text: ​對​每個​終點​，​合法​起點​必須​在​最近​非法​值​之​後​，​且​不能​晚​於​最近​ minK、maxK ​出現​位置​中較​早者​。

docs.text: ​先計算​全部​值​留在​ [minK,maxK] ​內​的​視窗​，​再​扣除​缺​ minK ​與​缺​ maxK ​的​視窗​，​最後加​回​兩者​都​缺​的​視窗​。

docs.title: 最近​邊界值​與​非法​位置
docs.text: ​這些​不等式​同時​必要​且​充分​：​排除​所有​非法​值​，​並​包含​兩個​指定​邊界​。​合法​起點​數為​ max(0,min(last_min,last_max)-last_bad)。

docs.title: 四個​範圍​內區​段​計數​與​容斥
docs.text: ​在​允​許值​的​連續區​段​內​，​每個​終點​貢獻​的​可​選起​點數​等​於​目前​區段​長​度​。​容斥​恰​留下​同時​包含​兩個​邊界值​、​且​不​含​越界​值​的​視窗​。

docs.text:
​最近​邊界值​與​非法​位置​：​時間​ O(n)；​空間​ O(1)。 ​四個​範圍​內區​段​計數​與​容斥​：​時間​ O(n)；​空間​ O(1)。

​輸入​不變​。minK=maxK ​時​，​應計算​該​單一值​的​連續區​段​；​容斥​輔助​函式​遇到​上​下界​顛倒​的​區間​時​，​自然​回傳​零​。

docs.title: 1. ​最近​邊界值​與​非法​位置
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Latest bound and invalid positions
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], minK: int, maxK: int) -> int:
        last_min = last_max = last_bad = -1
        answer = 0
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            if value < minK or value > maxK:
                last_bad = i
            if value == minK:
                last_min = i
            if value == maxK:
                last_max = i
            answer += max(0, min(last_min, last_max) - last_bad)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​四個​範圍​內區​段​計數​與​容斥
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)

​空間​： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Four bounded-run counts by inclusion-exclusion
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], minK: int, maxK: int) -> int:
        def bounded(low, high):
            run = answer = 0
            for value in nums:
                run = run + 1 if low <= value <= high else 0
                answer += run
            return answer

        return (
            bounded(minK, maxK)
            - bounded(minK + 1, maxK)
            - bounded(minK, maxK - 1)
            + bounded(minK + 1, maxK - 1)
        )

docs.title: 樞紐​左右​平衡​值配​對
docs.text: ​找到​ k，​統計​由​它​向​左​延伸​的​所有​平衡​值​，​再​對​每個​右​平衡​值配​對​，​使​完整​平衡​為​零​或​一​。

docs.title: 中位​數門檻​之​差​與​ Fenwick ​計數
docs.text: ​計算​左中​位數​至少​為​ k ​的​數量​，​再​減去​至少​為​ k+1 ​的​數量​。​對​各門檻​，​將達標​元素​映為​ +1，​其餘為​ -1，​利用​前綴​順序​統計​計算​嚴格​正和子​陣列​。

docs.title: 樞紐​左右​平衡​值配​對
docs.text: ​含一個​ k ​時​，​奇數長​度須​使​大​於​ k ​與​小​於​ k ​的​個數​相同​；​偶數長​度則​前者​多​一​，​左中位​數才​是​ k。​配對​零​與​一恰涵​蓋​這兩種​情況​。

docs.title: 中位​數門檻​之​差​與​ Fenwick ​計數
docs.text: ​左中位​數達標​，​恰​等同​嚴格​多數​元素​達標​，​也​就是​編碼​總​和​為​正​。​比​目前​前綴​嚴格​小​的​舊​前綴​可計算​這些​和​；​兩門檻​相減​即可​隔離​中​位數​ k。

​輸入​不變​。​樞紐法​使用​ k ​唯一​的​保證​；​門檻​法​也​適用​於​重​複​值​。​嚴格​比較​前綴​大小​，​是​符合​左中位​數定​義的​關鍵​。

docs.title: 1. ​樞紐​左右​平衡​值配​對
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n)，​期望值​

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Balance matching around the pivot
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        pivot = nums.index(k)
        counts = {0: 1}
        balance = 0
        for i in range(pivot - 1, -1, -1):
            balance += 1 if nums[i] > k else -1
            counts[balance] = counts.get(balance, 0) + 1
        balance = answer = 0
        for i in range(pivot, len(nums)):
            if i > pivot:
                balance += 1 if nums[i] > k else -1
            answer += counts.get(-balance, 0) + counts.get(1 - balance, 0)
        return answer

docs.title: 2. ​中位​數門檻​之​差​與​ Fenwick ​計數
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n log n)

​空間​： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Difference of median-threshold Fenwick counts
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSubarrays(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        def at_least(threshold):
            size = 2 * len(nums) + 3
            offset = len(nums) + 1
            bit = [0] * size

            def add(index):
                while index < size:
                    bit[index] += 1
                    index += index & -index

            def count(index):
                answer = 0
                while index:
                    answer += bit[index]
                    index -= index & -index
                return answer

            prefix = answer = 0
            add(offset)
            for value in nums:
                prefix += 1 if value >= threshold else -1
                answer += count(prefix + offset - 1)
                add(prefix + offset)
            return answer

        return at_least(k) - at_least(k + 1)

docs.text: ​將值​取​負建​堆積​，​反覆​取得​最大​獎勵​，​並用​縮​小​後​的​正​整數​向上​取整值​替換​堆積​頂端​。

docs.text: ​統計​等值​次數​，​對​互異​最大值​建堆​積​。​每批​最​多​消耗​最大值​全部​副本​，​再​把​縮小值​併​入計​數桶​；​最大值​為​一時​，​剩餘​每次​獎勵​都​是​一​。

docs.text: ​每個​元素​在​重​複​除法​下​提供​遞減​獎勵​序列​。​取​目前​最大​的​外露​獎勵​，​就​等​於​標準合​併​這些​遞減​序列​，​選出​全域​最大​的​ k ​份​獎勵​。

​兩法​都​擁有​自己​的​堆積​／​計數​，​輸入​不變​。​用​ (value+2)//3 ​精確​計算​整數​向上​取整​。​壓縮法​對​大量重​複​值​有效​，​但​最大值​皆​互異​時​，​最差​界限​相同​。

docs.title: 1. ​最大​堆積​貪婪​替換
docs.text:
​時間​： O(n+k log(n+1))

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush, heapreplace


class Solution:
    """Approach: Max-heap greedy replacement
    Time: O(n+k log(n+1))
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxKelements(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        heap = [-value for value in nums]
        heapify(heap)
        score = 0
        for _ in range(k):
            value = -heap[0]
            score += value
            heapreplace(heap, -((value + 2) // 3))
        return score

docs.title: 2. ​頻率​壓縮​的​最大值​批次
docs.text:
​時間​： ​最差​ O(n+k log(n+1))

​空間​： O(n)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush, heapreplace


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency-compressed maximum batches
    Time: O(n+k log(n+1)) worst
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxKelements(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        counts = Counter(nums)
        heap = [-value for value in counts]
        heapify(heap)
        score = 0
        while k:
            value = -heappop(heap)
            multiplicity = counts.pop(value)
            if value == 1:
                return score + k
            taken = min(k, multiplicity)
            score += taken * value
            k -= taken
            if taken < multiplicity:
                counts[value] = multiplicity - taken
                heappush(heap, -value)
            reduced = (value + 2) // 3
            if reduced not in counts:
                counts[reduced] = 0
                heappush(heap, -reduced)
            counts[reduced] += taken
        return score
